+# History
+
+For any withdrawn papers, their README files explain the gap and link to the retracted manuscript. For any updated papers, previously published editions remain accessible through the version notes in their README.
+
+## October 7, 2026
+
+**Withdrawals**
+
+In “Algebraicity of Weil classes on split abelian eightfolds” a sign error invalidates a stabilization-trace cancellation argument and the construction used by two dependent papers. As a result, we have withdrawn the following three manuscripts:
+
+- Algebraicity of Weil classes on split abelian eightfolds
+- Algebraicity of Kuga–Satake Correspondences for K3 Surfaces
+- The rational Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces
+
+The withdrawn papers now carry notices explaining the gap and linking to the archived manuscripts.
+
+**Fixes**
+
+We have revised 14 other manuscripts with proof repairs, corrected statements, clearer hypotheses and dependencies, and one correction to an obsolete citation. The changes include:
+
+- Lipschitz heights and Ashkin–Teller currents (4 manuscripts): repaired crossing, boundary-attachment, conditioning and convergence arguments, including additional work on the real-Lipschitz interface proof.
+- Kähler minimal model programs and abundance (6 manuscripts): expanded positivity and contraction arguments and clarified which results are used as inputs, with their required hypotheses.
+- Taming and hypersymplectic deformation (2 manuscripts): corrected the cone-equality claim in Taming implies compatibility, added a strict-inclusion example, and removed an unnecessary cone-comparison dependency from the hypersymplectic paper.
+- Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation: revised the torus-projection and common-clock estimates.
+- Exact Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer Formula from Low Selmer Corank: removed an obsolete introductory citation to a removed supporting manuscript.
+
+Also, as a consequence of these fixes we updated 13 additional manuscripts to cite the revised editions of companion papers. These changes update references and version dates.
+
+**Additional Formalizations**
+
+We have added an additional 6 formalizations and 5 other additions covering supporting results. This brings the total percentage of top-line results formalized to 300 / 719 = ~42%.

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+namespace HadwigerMatching
+
+universe u
+variable {V : Type u}
+
+def IsTouchingMatching (G : SimpleGraph V) (M : Finset (Finset V)) : Prop :=
+  (∀ e ∈ M, e.card = 2 ∧ G.IsClique (e : Set V)) ∧
+  (∀ e ∈ M, ∀ f ∈ M, e ≠ f → Disjoint e f) ∧
+  (∀ e ∈ M, ∀ f ∈ M, e ≠ f →
+    ∃ v ∈ e, ∃ w ∈ f, G.Adj v w)
+
+noncomputable def connectedMatchingNumber (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ :=
+  sSup {n : ℕ | ∃ M : Finset (Finset V), IsTouchingMatching G M ∧ M.card = n}
+
+end HadwigerMatching
+
+namespace LinearListHadwiger
+
+def HasCliqueMinor {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ B : Fin t → Set V,
+    (∀ i, (G.induce (B i)).Connected) ∧
+    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (B i) (B j)) ∧
+    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∃ v ∈ B i, ∃ w ∈ B j, G.Adj v w)
+
+noncomputable def hadwigerNumber {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ :=
+  sSup {t : ℕ | HasCliqueMinor G t}
+
+end LinearListHadwiger
+
+namespace HadwigerCounterexample
+
+open HadwigerMatching LinearListHadwiger
+
+theorem exists_counterexamples (M : ℕ) : ∃ m : ℕ, max M 5 ≤ m ∧
+    ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin m), G.indepNum ≤ 2 ∧
+      (connectedMatchingNumber G : ℚ) < (m : ℚ) / 100 ∧
+      (hadwigerNumber G : ℚ) < 26 * (m : ℚ) / 75 + 2 / 3 ∧
+      26 * (m : ℚ) / 75 + 2 / 3 < (m : ℚ) / 2 ∧
+      (m : ℚ) / 2 ≤ (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℚ) ∧
+      hadwigerNumber G < G.chromaticNumber.toNat ∧
+      G.chromaticNumber ≠ ⊤ ∧
+      G.chromaticNumber = ↑(G.chromaticNumber.toNat) := by
+  sorry
+
+theorem not_hadwiger_conjecture :
+    ¬ (∀ (m : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin m)),
+      G.chromaticNumber ≤ ↑(hadwigerNumber G)) := by

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+namespace CriticalHoneycomb
+open scoped ENNReal
+
+abbrev Center := ℤ × ℤ × Bool
+
+def up (i j : ℤ) : Center := (i, j, true)
+def down (i j : ℤ) : Center := (i, j, false)
+
+/-- Adjacency across a full triangular edge. -/
+def Adj (v w : Center) : Prop :=
+  if v.2.2 then
+    w.2.2 = false ∧ ((w.1 = v.1 ∧ w.2.1 = v.2.1) ∨
+      (w.1 = v.1 ∧ w.2.1 = v.2.1 - 1) ∨
+      (w.1 = v.1 - 1 ∧ w.2.1 = v.2.1))
+  else
+    w.2.2 = true ∧ ((w.1 = v.1 ∧ w.2.1 = v.2.1) ∨
+      (w.1 = v.1 ∧ w.2.1 = v.2.1 + 1) ∨
+      (w.1 = v.1 + 1 ∧ w.2.1 = v.2.1))
+
+noncomputable def rowSpacing : ℝ := Real.sqrt 3 / 2
+
+/-- The fixed Euclidean embedding in the unit triangular tiling. -/
+noncomputable def centerPosition (v : Center) : ℝ × ℝ :=
+  if v.2.2 then
+    ((v.1 : ℝ) + (v.2.1 : ℝ) / 2 + 1 / 2,
+      rowSpacing * ((v.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 3))
+  else
+    ((v.1 : ℝ) + (v.2.1 : ℝ) / 2 + 1,
+      rowSpacing * ((v.2.1 : ℝ) + 2 / 3))
+
+/-- A midpoint port, oriented into the triangle domain. -/
+structure Port (D : Set Center) where
+  inside : Center
+  outside : Center
+  adjacent : Adj inside outside
+  inside_mem : inside ∈ D
+  outside_not_mem : outside ∉ D
+
+noncomputable def Port.position {D : Set Center} (p : Port D) : ℝ × ℝ :=
+  ((centerPosition p.inside).1 / 2 + (centerPosition p.outside).1 / 2,
+    (centerPosition p.inside).2 / 2 + (centerPosition p.outside).2 / 2)
+
+/-- A simple center trace, with no premature boundary exit. -/
+def IsTrace (D : Set Center) (p : List Center) : Prop :=
+  p.Nodup ∧ p.IsChain Adj ∧ ∀ v ∈ p, v ∈ D
+
+noncomputable def kappa : ℝ := (2 + Real.sqrt 2) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 2)
+
+/-- Length counts centers; the port half-edges contribute no factors. -/
+noncomputable def weight (p : List Center) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
+  ENNReal.ofReal (kappa ^ p.length)
+
+/-- The source's strip and tilt-compatible terminal support. -/
+def strip (h : ℕ) : Set Center := {v | 0 ≤ v.2.1 ∧ v.2.1 < (h : ℤ)}
+def StrictBridge (h : ℕ) :=
+  {p : List Center // IsTrace (strip h) p ∧ p.head? = some (up 0 0) ∧
+    ∃ i : ℤ, p.getLast? = some (down i ((h : ℤ) - 1))}
+noncomputable def bridgeMass (h : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
+  if h = 0 then 1 else ∑' p : StrictBridge h, weight p.val
+
+/-- Necessary estimate c:finite(1), inputs.tex:13, on the actual path sum. -/
+def FiniteBridgeMassEstimate : Prop :=
+  ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ h : ℕ,
+    ENNReal.ofReal (c * (1 + (h : ℝ)) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 4)) ≤ bridgeMass h ∧
+    bridgeMass h ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (1 + (h : ℝ)) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 4))
+
+/-- Trusted reference hole only; missing necessary main obligation. -/
+theorem finiteBridgeMassEstimate : FiniteBridgeMassEstimate := by
+  sorry
+
+end CriticalHoneycomb

+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-! Exact logarithmic-space derandomization for finite transition-table machines. -/
+
+namespace ExactDerandomization
+
+abbrev Word := List Bool
+abbrev Language := Set Word
+abbrev CoinTape := ℕ → Bool
+
+inductive Direction where
+  | left | stay | right
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+inductive InputSymbol where
+  | leftMarker | bit (b : Bool) | rightMarker
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+def Direction.move (d : Direction) (z : ℤ) : ℤ :=
+  match d with
+  | .left => z - 1
+  | .stay => z
+  | .right => z + 1
+
+def Direction.moveInput (d : Direction) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 2)) : Fin (n + 2) :=
+  match d with
+  | .left => ⟨i.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) i.isLt⟩
+  | .stay => i
+  | .right => ⟨min (i.val + 1) (n + 1), by omega⟩
+
+def readInput (x : Word) (i : Fin (x.length + 2)) : InputSymbol :=
+  if i.val = 0 then .leftMarker else
+    match x[i.val - 1]? with
+    | some b => .bit b
+    | none => .rightMarker
+
+structure Action (q w h : ℕ) where
+  nextState : Fin (q + 1)
+  write : Fin w → Bool
+  workMove : Fin w → Direction
+  inputMove : Fin h → Direction
+
+structure Machine (q w h : ℕ) where
+  initialState : Fin (q + 1)
+  output : Fin (q + 1) → Option Bool
+  transition : Fin (q + 1) → (Fin h → InputSymbol) → (Fin w → Bool) → Bool →
+    Action q w h
+
+structure Configuration (q w h n : ℕ) where
+  state : Fin (q + 1)
+  inputPos : Fin h → Fin (n + 2)
+  workPos : Fin w → ℤ
+  work : Fin w → ℤ → Bool
+
+namespace Machine
+
+variable {q w h : ℕ}
+
+def initial (M : Machine q w h) (n : ℕ) : Configuration q w h n where
+  state := M.initialState
+  inputPos := fun _ => ⟨0, by omega⟩
+  workPos := fun _ => 0
+  work := fun _ _ => false
+
+def step (M : Machine q w h) (x : Word) (b : Bool)
+    (c : Configuration q w h x.length) : Configuration q w h x.length :=
+  match M.output c.state with
+  | some _ => c
+  | none =>
+    let a := M.transition c.state (fun j => readInput x (c.inputPos j))
+      (fun k => c.work k (c.workPos k)) b
+    { state := a.nextState
+      inputPos := fun j => (a.inputMove j).moveInput (c.inputPos j)
+      workPos := fun k => (a.workMove k).move (c.workPos k)
+      work := fun k => Function.update (c.work k) (c.workPos k) (a.write k) }
+
+def run (M : Machine q w h) (x : Word) (coins : CoinTape) :
+    ℕ → Configuration q w h x.length
+  | 0 => M.initial x.length
+  | t + 1 => M.step x (coins t) (M.run x coins t)
+
+def spaceThrough (M : Machine q w h) (x : Word) (coins : CoinTape) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  ∑ k : Fin w, ((Finset.range (t + 1)).image
+    (fun s => (M.run x coins s).workPos k)).card
+
+def LogSpace (M : Machine q w h) : Prop :=
+  ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (x : Word) (coins : CoinTape) (t : ℕ),
+    M.spaceThrough x coins t ≤ c * Nat.clog 2 (x.length + 2)
+
+def Deterministic (M : Machine q w h) : Prop :=
+  ∀ s i v, M.transition s i v false = M.transition s i v true
+
+def HaltsBy (M : Machine q w h) (x : Word) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ coins : CoinTape, ∃ b : Bool, M.output (M.run x coins t).state = some b
+
+def Decides (M : Machine q w h) (A : Language) : Prop :=
+  ∀ x : Word, ∃ (t : ℕ) (b : Bool),
+    (b = true ↔ x ∈ A) ∧ ∀ coins : CoinTape,
+      M.output (M.run x coins t).state = some b
+
+def extendCoins {t : ℕ} (bits : Fin t → Bool) : CoinTape :=
+  fun s => if hs : s < t then bits ⟨s, hs⟩ else false
+
+def acceptanceProbability (M : Machine q w h) (x : Word) (t : ℕ) : ℚ :=
+  ((Finset.univ.filter (fun bits : Fin t → Bool =>
+    M.output (M.run x (extendCoins bits) t).state = some true)).card : ℚ) /
+    (2 : ℚ) ^ t
+
+end Machine
+
+def polynomialClock (c k n : ℕ) : ℕ := c * (n + 2) ^ k
+
+def L : Set Language :=
+  {A | ∃ (q w h : ℕ) (M : Machine q w h),
+    M.Deterministic ∧ M.LogSpace ∧ M.Decides A}
+
+def RL : Set Language :=
+  {A | ∃ (q w h : ℕ) (M : Machine q w h),
+    M.LogSpace ∧ ∃ (c k : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ x : Word,
+      M.HaltsBy x (polynomialClock c k x.length) ∧
+      (x ∈ A → (1 / 2 : ℚ) ≤ M.acceptanceProbability x
+        (polynomialClock c k x.length)) ∧
+      (x ∉ A → M.acceptanceProbability x (polynomialClock c k x.length) = 0)}
+
+def BPL : Set Language :=
+  {A | ∃ (q w h : ℕ) (M : Machine q w h),
+    M.LogSpace ∧ ∃ (c k : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ x : Word,
+      M.HaltsBy x (polynomialClock c k x.length) ∧
+      (x ∈ A → (2 / 3 : ℚ) ≤ M.acceptanceProbability x
+        (polynomialClock c k x.length)) ∧
+      (x ∉ A → M.acceptanceProbability x (polynomialClock c k x.length) ≤ (1 / 3 : ℚ))}
+
+
+theorem exact_logarithmic_space_derandomization :
+    L = RL ∧ RL = BPL := by
+  sorry
+
+end ExactDerandomization
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-! Finite-machine statements of the capped and unknown-time one-writable-tape
+simulation theorem. Work space counts the bits in every visited writable cell;
+public endmarked input tapes are read-only. -/
+
+namespace Fifths
+
+inductive Dir
+  | L | N | R
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+instance : Fintype Dir := ⟨{.L, .N, .R}, by intro d; cases d <;> simp⟩
+
+namespace Dir
+@[simp] def delta : Dir → ℤ
+  | L => -1
+  | N => 0
+  | R => 1
+end Dir
+
+inductive Mark (A : Type)
+  | left
+  | sym (a : A)
+  | right
+  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype
+
+namespace Mark
+variable {A : Type}
+def see (w : List A) : ℕ → Mark A
+  | 0 => left
+  | p+1 =>
+    match w[p]? with
+    | some a => sym a
+    | none => right
+
+def walk (w : List A) (p : ℕ) : Dir → ℕ
+  | .N => p
+  | .L => p - 1
+  | .R => if w.length < p then p else p + 1
+end Mark
+
+inductive Runs {σ Y : Type} (f : σ → Y ⊕ σ) (P : σ → Prop) :
+    σ → σ → Y → Prop
+  | stop {s y} (ok : P s) (eqn : f s = Sum.inl y) : Runs f P s s y
+  | step {s s' t y} (ok : P s) (eqn : f s = Sum.inr s')
+      (tail : Runs f P s' t y) : Runs f P s t y
+
+structure Inputs (X J : Type) where
+  publicWord : List X
+  arg : J → List Bool
+
+structure Readers (J : Type) where
+  px : ℕ := 0
+  parg : J → ℕ := fun _ => 0
+
+structure Reads (X J : Type) where
+  sx : Mark X
+  sarg : J → Mark Bool
+
+structure Advances (J : Type) where
+  dx : Dir := .N
+  darg : J → Dir := fun _ => .N
+
+namespace Readers
+variable {X J : Type}
+def home : Readers J := {}
+def see (r : Readers J) (i : Inputs X J) : Reads X J :=
+  ⟨Mark.see i.publicWord r.px, fun j => Mark.see (i.arg j) (r.parg j)⟩
+def walk (r : Readers J) (i : Inputs X J) (a : Advances J) : Readers J :=
+  ⟨Mark.walk i.publicWord r.px a.dx, fun j => Mark.walk (i.arg j) (r.parg j) (a.darg j)⟩
+end Readers
+
+structure Tape (A : Type) where
+  pos : ℤ
+  sym : ℤ → A
+
+structure WriteMove (A : Type) where
+  sym : A
+  dir : Dir
+
+namespace Tape
+variable {A : Type}
+def init (a : A) : Tape A := ⟨0, fun _ => a⟩
+def see (w : Tape A) : A := w.sym w.pos
+def perform (w : Tape A) (m : WriteMove A) : Tape A :=
+  ⟨w.pos + m.dir.delta, Function.update w.sym w.pos m.sym⟩
+end Tape
+
+structure TAction (Q J K : Type) (W : K → Type) where
+  next : Q
+  advance : Advances J
+  moves : ∀ k : K, WriteMove (W k)
+
+structure TM (X J Y : Type) where
+  Q : Type
+  [finiteQ : Finite Q]
+  K : Type
+  [tapes : Fintype K]
+  W : K → Type
+  [symbols : ∀ k, Fintype (W k)]
+  blank : ∀ k, W k
+  start : Q
+  table : Q → Reads X J → ((k : K) → W k) → Y ⊕ TAction Q J K W
+
+attribute [instance] TM.finiteQ TM.tapes TM.symbols
+
+namespace TM
+variable {X J Y : Type} (M : TM X J Y)
+
+structure Cfg where
+  state : M.Q
+  ro : Readers J
+  work : ∀ k, Tape (M.W k)
+
+def initial : M.Cfg :=
+  ⟨M.start, .home, fun k => .init (M.blank k)⟩
+
+def step (i : Inputs X J) (s : M.Cfg) : Y ⊕ M.Cfg :=
+  match M.table s.state (s.ro.see i) (fun k => (s.work k).see) with
+  | Sum.inl y => .inl y
+  | Sum.inr a =>
+    .inr ⟨a.next, s.ro.walk i a.advance, fun k => (s.work k).perform (a.moves k)⟩
+
+structure Window where
+  l : M.K → ℕ
+  h : M.K → ℕ
+
+def width (k : M.K) : ℕ := max 1 (Fintype.card (M.W k) - 1).size
+
+namespace Window
+variable {M}
+def ok (w : M.Window) (s : M.Cfg) : Prop :=
+  ∀ k, -(w.l k : ℤ) ≤ (s.work k).pos ∧ (s.work k).pos ≤ (w.h k : ℤ)
+open BigOperators
+def bits (w : M.Window) : ℕ :=
+  ∑ k, (w.l k + w.h k + 1) * M.width k
+end Window
+
+def Within (i : Inputs X J) (y : Y) (S : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ w : M.Window, w.bits ≤ S ∧ ∃ t, Runs (M.step i) w.ok M.initial t y
+end TM
+
+end Fifths
+
+namespace Fifths
+
+structure SingleAct (Q A : Type) (r : ℕ) where
+  out : Q
+  write : WriteMove A
+  others : Fin r → Dir
+
+structure Single (X : Type) where
+  Q : Type
+  [states : Fintype Q]
+  A : Type
+  [symbols : Fintype A]
+  beginState : Q
+  halted : Q → Bool
+  heads : ℕ
+  program : Q → A → (Fin heads → A) → SingleAct Q A heads
+  sensor : List X → Option (Fin heads) → ℤ → A
+
+attribute [instance] Single.states Single.symbols
+
+namespace Single
+variable {X : Type} (M : Single X)
+instance : Nonempty M.A := ⟨M.sensor [] none 0⟩
+instance : Nonempty M.Q := ⟨M.beginState⟩
+abbrev Tag := Option (Fin M.heads)
+
+structure At where
+  state : M.Q
+  tape : Tape M.A
+  ro : Fin M.heads → ℤ
+
+def move (q : M.Q) (s : M.A) (r : Fin M.heads → M.A) :
+    SingleAct M.Q M.A M.heads :=
+  if M.halted q then
+    ⟨q,⟨s,.N⟩,fun _ => .N⟩
+  else M.program q s r
+
+def initial (x : List X) : M.At :=
+  ⟨M.beginState,⟨0,M.sensor x none⟩, fun _ => 0⟩
+
+def next (x : List X) (s : M.At) : M.At :=
+  let t := M.move s.state s.tape.see (fun i => M.sensor x (some i) (s.ro i))
+  ⟨t.out,s.tape.perform t.write,fun i => s.ro i + (t.others i).delta⟩
+
+def atTime (M : Single X) (x : List X) : ℕ → M.At :=
+  Nat.rec (M.initial x) (fun _ s => M.next x s)
+
+abbrev Outcome := M.Q × Bool
+def finish (q : M.Q) : M.Outcome :=
+  (q, M.halted q)
+def outcome (x : List X) (n : ℕ) : M.Outcome :=
+  M.finish (M.atTime x n).state
+
+def Inside (t : ℕ) (q : ℤ) : Prop := -(t:ℤ) ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (t:ℤ)
+end Single
+
+end Fifths
+
+namespace Fifths
+
+namespace Entry
+noncomputable def code {A : Type} [Fintype A] (a : A) : ℕ :=
+  (Fintype.equivFin A a).val
+end Entry
+
+def binaryIn {X J : Type} (pub : List X) (f : J → ℕ) : Inputs X J :=
+  ⟨pub, fun j => (f j).bits⟩
+
+def files {X : Type} (x : List X) : Inputs X Empty :=
+  ⟨x, Empty.elim⟩
+
+namespace Single
+open Entry
+variable {X : Type} (M : Single X)
+
+inductive Arg
+  | cap | tag | minus | magnitude
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+instance : Fintype Arg :=
+  ⟨{.cap, .tag, .minus, .magnitude}, by intro a; cases a <;> simp⟩
+abbrev Sym := TM X Arg M.A
+
+noncomputable def arg (T : ℕ) (h : M.Tag) (p : ℤ) : Arg → ℕ
+  | .cap => T
+  | .tag => code h
+  | .minus => (decide (p < 0)).toNat
+  | .magnitude => p.natAbs
+end Single
+
+namespace Cost
+noncomputable def Log (T : ℕ) := Real.log (T+2 : ℝ) / Real.log 2
+noncomputable def exponent := (2:ℝ)/5
+end Cost
+
+namespace Single
+open Cost
+variable {X : Type} (M : Single X)
+def Access (A : M.Sym) (p q : ℝ) (x : List X) (T : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (h : M.Tag) (l : ℤ), Inside T l →
+    ∃ s : ℕ, (s:ℝ) ≤ p * (Log T)^q ∧
+      A.Within (binaryIn x (M.arg T h l)) (M.sensor x h l) s
+end Single
+
+end Fifths
+
+namespace Fifths.Single
+open Entry Cost
+variable {X : Type} (M : Single X)
+
+theorem capped [Fintype X] (A : M.Sym) (p q : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (_hq : 1 ≤ q) :
+    ∃ (N : TM X Unit M.Outcome) (e : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c ∧
+      ∀ (x : List X) (T : ℕ), 2 ≤ T → M.Access A p q x T →
+        ∃ b : ℕ, N.Within (binaryIn x (fun _ => T)) (M.outcome x T) b ∧
+          (b:ℝ) ≤ c*(T:ℝ)^exponent*(Log T)^e := by
+  sorry
+
+theorem unknown [Fintype X] (A : M.Sym) (p q : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (_hq : 1 ≤ q) :
+    ∃ (N : TM X Empty M.Outcome) (e : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c ∧
+      ∀ (x : List X), (∀ T, 2 ≤ T → M.Access A p q x T) →
+        ∀ (t : ℕ), (M.outcome x t).2 = true →
+          ∃ b, N.Within (files x) (M.outcome x t) b ∧
+            (b:ℝ) ≤ c*((t:ℝ)+2)^exponent*(Log t)^e := by
+  sorry
+
+end Fifths.Single
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+abbrev R (n : ℕ) := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ
+
+noncomputable def Q : R 4 :=
+  X 1 ^ 2 - X 3 ^ 2 + X 0 * X 2
+
+noncomputable def f : R 4 :=
+  X 0 - 2 * Q * (Q * (X 1 + X 3) + X 0 * X 3)
+
+def IsCoordinate {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (g : R n) : Prop :=
+  ∃ φ : R n ≃ₐ[ℂ] R n, φ g = X ⟨0, hn⟩
+
+noncomputable def stabilize : R 4 →ₐ[ℂ] R 5 :=
+  rename (Fin.castSucc : Fin 4 → Fin 5)
+
+def IsOneStableCoordinate (g : R 4) : Prop :=
+  ∃ φ : R 5 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 5, φ (stabilize g) = X 0
+
+noncomputable def fiberIdeal (t : ℂ) : Ideal (R 4) :=
+  Ideal.span ({f - C t} : Set (R 4))
+
+abbrev FiberRing (t : ℂ) := R 4 ⧸ fiberIdeal t
+
+def IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber (t : ℂ) : Prop :=
+  Nonempty (FiberRing t ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 3)
+
+def IsRectifiableFiber (t : ℂ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ φ : R 4 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 4,
+    Ideal.map φ.toRingHom (fiberIdeal t) = Ideal.span ({X 0} : Set (R 4))
+
+def PolynomialPackage : Prop :=
+  f.totalDegree = 5 ∧
+  IsOneStableCoordinate f ∧
+  ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f
+
+def FiberPackage : Prop :=
+  ∀ t : ℂ, IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t ∧ ¬ IsRectifiableFiber t
+
+def PrincipalPackage : Prop := PolynomialPackage ∧ FiberPackage
+
+/-- The explicit degree-five stable noncoordinate and its nonrectifiable affine-space fibers. -/
+theorem principal_package : PrincipalPackage := by
+  sorry
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+noncomputable section
+open Filter Topology Classical
+open scoped NNReal ENNReal
+
+namespace TraceConeClassification
+variable (A : Type*) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]
+
+abbrev Positive := {a : A // 0 ≤ a}
+
+namespace Positive
+variable {A}
+def zero : Positive A := ⟨0, le_rfl⟩
+def add (a b : Positive A) : Positive A := ⟨a.1 + b.1, add_nonneg a.2 b.2⟩
+def scale (r : ℝ≥0) (a : Positive A) : Positive A :=
+  ⟨(r : ℝ) • a.1, smul_nonneg r.2 a.2⟩
+def starMul (x : A) : Positive A := ⟨star x * x, star_mul_self_nonneg x⟩
+def mulStar (x : A) : Positive A := ⟨x * star x, mul_star_self_nonneg x⟩
+def cut (a : Positive A) (ε : ℝ≥0) : Positive A :=
+  ⟨cfcₙ (fun t : ℝ => max (t - (ε : ℝ)) 0) a.1,
+    cfcₙ_nonneg (fun _ _ => le_max_right _ _)⟩
+end Positive
+
+structure ExtendedTrace where
+  toFun : Positive A → ℝ≥0∞
+  map_zero : toFun Positive.zero = 0
+  map_add : ∀ a b, toFun (Positive.add a b) = toFun a + toFun b
+  map_scale : ∀ (r : ℝ≥0), 0 < r → ∀ a,
+    toFun (Positive.scale r a) = (r : ℝ≥0∞) * toFun a
+  tracial : ∀ x : A, toFun (Positive.starMul x) = toFun (Positive.mulStar x)
+  lowerSemicontinuous : LowerSemicontinuous toFun
+
+instance : CoeFun (ExtendedTrace A) (fun _ => Positive A → ℝ≥0∞) :=
+  ⟨ExtendedTrace.toFun⟩
+
+def CanonicalConvergence {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) (τ : ι → ExtendedTrace A)
+    (σ : ExtendedTrace A) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (a : Positive A) (ε : ℝ≥0), 0 < ε →
+    Filter.limsup (fun i => τ i (Positive.cut a ε)) l ≤ σ a ∧
+    σ a ≤ Filter.liminf (fun i => τ i a) l
+
+variable {A}
+namespace ExtendedTrace
+
+def scale (r : ℝ≥0) (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : ExtendedTrace A where
+  toFun a := (r : ℝ≥0∞) * τ a
+  map_zero := by rw [τ.map_zero, mul_zero]
+  map_add a b := by rw [τ.map_add, mul_add]
+  map_scale s hs a := by rw [τ.map_scale s hs]; ac_rfl
+  tracial x := by rw [τ.tracial x]
+  lowerSemicontinuous :=
+    (ENNReal.continuous_const_mul ENNReal.coe_ne_top).comp_lowerSemicontinuous
+      τ.lowerSemicontinuous (fun _ _ h => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h bot_le)
+
+end ExtendedTrace
+
+-- The proof obligations below make the ideal and equivalence constructions well typed.
+theorem closed_ideal_weight_exists
+    (I : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A) (hI : IsClosed (I : Set A))
+    (hleft : ∀ (x y : A), y ∈ I → x * y ∈ I)
+    (hright : ∀ (x y : A), x ∈ I → x * y ∈ I) :
+    ∃ τ : ExtendedTrace A, ∀ a : Positive A, τ a = if a.1 ∈ I then 0 else ∞ := by
+  sorry
+
+namespace ExtendedTrace
+variable (τ : ExtendedTrace A)
+def finiteSquareSet : Set A := {x | τ (Positive.starMul x) < ∞}
+lemma zero_mem_finiteSquareSet : (0 : A) ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet := by sorry
+lemma star_mem_finiteSquareSet {x : A} (hx : x ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet) :
+    star x ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet := by sorry
+lemma smul_mem_finiteSquareSet (c : ℂ) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet) :
+    c • x ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet := by sorry
+lemma add_mem_finiteSquareSet {x y : A}
+    (hx : x ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet) (hy : y ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet) :
+    x + y ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet := by sorry
+lemma mul_mem_finiteSquareSet_left (x : A) {y : A} (hy : y ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet) :
+    x * y ∈ τ.finiteSquareSet := by sorry
+
+def finiteSquareAlgebra : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A where
+  carrier := τ.finiteSquareSet
+  zero_mem' := τ.zero_mem_finiteSquareSet
+  add_mem' := τ.add_mem_finiteSquareSet
+  smul_mem' := τ.smul_mem_finiteSquareSet
+  mul_mem' := fun _ hy => τ.mul_mem_finiteSquareSet_left _ hy
+  star_mem' := τ.star_mem_finiteSquareSet
+
+def finiteIdeal : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A := τ.finiteSquareAlgebra.topologicalClosure
+lemma isClosed_finiteIdeal : IsClosed (τ.finiteIdeal : Set A) := by sorry
+lemma mul_mem_finiteIdeal_left (x : A) {y : A} (hy : y ∈ τ.finiteIdeal) :
+    x * y ∈ τ.finiteIdeal := by sorry
+lemma mul_mem_finiteIdeal_right {x : A} (hx : x ∈ τ.finiteIdeal) (y : A) :
+    x * y ∈ τ.finiteIdeal := by sorry
+end ExtendedTrace
+
+end TraceConeClassification
+
+namespace TraceConeClassification
+universe u v
+variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]
+
+namespace ExtendedTrace
+def add (τ σ : ExtendedTrace A) : ExtendedTrace A where
+  toFun a := τ a + σ a
+  map_zero := by rw [τ.map_zero, σ.map_zero, add_zero]
+  map_add a b := by rw [τ.map_add, σ.map_add]; ac_rfl
+  map_scale r hr a := by rw [τ.map_scale r hr, σ.map_scale r hr, mul_add]
+  tracial x := by rw [τ.tracial x, σ.tracial x]
+  lowerSemicontinuous := τ.lowerSemicontinuous.add σ.lowerSemicontinuous
+
+def zero : ExtendedTrace A where
+  toFun _ := 0
+  map_zero := rfl
+  map_add _ _ := (add_zero _).symm
+  map_scale _ _ _ := (mul_zero _).symm
+  tracial _ := rfl
+  lowerSemicontinuous := lowerSemicontinuous_const
+
+end ExtendedTrace
+
+def ClosedIdeal (A : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A]
+    [StarOrderedRing A] :=
+  {I : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A // IsClosed (I : Set A) ∧
+    (∀ (x y : A), y ∈ I → x * y ∈ I) ∧ (∀ (x y : A), x ∈ I → x * y ∈ I)}
+
+namespace ExtendedTrace
+
+def finIdeal (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : ClosedIdeal A :=
+  ⟨τ.finiteIdeal, τ.isClosed_finiteIdeal, fun x _ hy => τ.mul_mem_finiteIdeal_left x hy,
+    fun _ y hx => τ.mul_mem_finiteIdeal_right hx y⟩
+
+lemma lowerSemicontinuous_supportWeight (τ : ExtendedTrace A) :
+    LowerSemicontinuous (fun a : Positive A => if τ a = 0 then (0 : ℝ≥0∞) else ∞) := by sorry
+
+def supportWeight (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : ExtendedTrace A where
+  toFun a := if τ a = 0 then 0 else ∞
+  map_zero := by simp [τ.map_zero]
+  map_add a b := by
+    rw [τ.map_add]
+    by_cases ha : τ a = 0 <;> by_cases hb : τ b = 0 <;> simp [ha, hb]
+  map_scale r hr a := by
+    rw [τ.map_scale r hr]
+    by_cases ha : τ a = 0 <;> simp [ha, ENNReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne']
+  tracial x := by rw [τ.tracial x]
+  lowerSemicontinuous := τ.lowerSemicontinuous_supportWeight
+
+def zeroIdeal (τ : ExtendedTrace A) : ClosedIdeal A := τ.supportWeight.finIdeal
+end ExtendedTrace
+
+
+namespace ClosedIdeal
+instance : PartialOrder (ClosedIdeal A) := inferInstanceAs (PartialOrder (Subtype _))
+def weight (I : ClosedIdeal A) : ExtendedTrace A :=
+  (closed_ideal_weight_exists I.1 I.2.1 I.2.2.1 I.2.2.2).choose
+theorem weight_idempotent (I : ClosedIdeal A) : I.weight.add I.weight = I.weight := by sorry
+theorem finiteIdeal_weight (I : ClosedIdeal A) : I.weight.finiteIdeal = I.1 := by sorry
+theorem le_iff_add_weight (I J : ClosedIdeal A) :
+    I ≤ J ↔ I.weight.add J.weight = I.weight := by sorry
+end ClosedIdeal
+
+namespace ExtendedTrace
+theorem idempotent_eq_weight {τ : ExtendedTrace A} (hτ : τ.add τ = τ) :
+    τ.finIdeal.weight = τ := by sorry
+end ExtendedTrace
+
+def IdempotentTrace (A : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A]
+    [StarOrderedRing A] := {τ : ExtendedTrace A // τ.add τ = τ}
+
+def closedIdealEquivIdempotent : ClosedIdeal A ≃ IdempotentTrace A where
+  toFun I := ⟨I.weight, I.weight_idempotent⟩
+  invFun τ := τ.1.finIdeal
+  left_inv I := Subtype.ext (ClosedIdeal.finiteIdeal_weight I)
+  right_inv τ := Subtype.ext (ExtendedTrace.idempotent_eq_weight τ.2)
+
+variable {B : Type v} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B]
+
+def idempotentTraceEquiv (e : ExtendedTrace A ≃ ExtendedTrace B)
+    (he : ∀ τ σ, e (τ.add σ) = (e τ).add (e σ)) : IdempotentTrace A ≃ IdempotentTrace B where
+  toFun τ := ⟨e τ.1, by rw [← he, τ.2]⟩
+  invFun σ := ⟨e.symm σ.1, by
+    apply e.injective
+    rw [he, e.apply_symm_apply, σ.2]⟩
+  left_inv τ := Subtype.ext (e.symm_apply_apply τ.1)
+  right_inv σ := Subtype.ext (e.apply_symm_apply σ.1)
+
+def closedIdealEquivOfAdditive (e : ExtendedTrace A ≃ ExtendedTrace B)
+    (he : ∀ τ σ, e (τ.add σ) = (e τ).add (e σ)) : ClosedIdeal A ≃ ClosedIdeal B :=
+  closedIdealEquivIdempotent.trans ((idempotentTraceEquiv e he).trans
+    closedIdealEquivIdempotent.symm)
+
+lemma closedIdealEquivOfAdditive_weight (e : ExtendedTrace A ≃ ExtendedTrace B)
+    (he : ∀ τ σ, e (τ.add σ) = (e τ).add (e σ)) (I : ClosedIdeal A) :
+    (closedIdealEquivOfAdditive e he I).weight = e I.weight := by sorry
+
+def closedIdealOrderEquivOfAdditive (e : ExtendedTrace A ≃ ExtendedTrace B)
+    (he : ∀ τ σ, e (τ.add σ) = (e τ).add (e σ)) : ClosedIdeal A ≃o ClosedIdeal B where
+  toEquiv := closedIdealEquivOfAdditive e he
+  map_rel_iff' := by
+    intro I J
+    rw [ClosedIdeal.le_iff_add_weight, ClosedIdeal.le_iff_add_weight,
+      closedIdealEquivOfAdditive_weight, closedIdealEquivOfAdditive_weight, ← he]
+    exact e.injective.eq_iff
+
+def PreservesCanonicalConvergence (f : ExtendedTrace A → ExtendedTrace B) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (l : Filter (ExtendedTrace A)) (σ : ExtendedTrace A),
+    CanonicalConvergence A l id σ → CanonicalConvergence B l f (f σ)
+
+structure TraceConeEquiv (A : Type u) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A]
+    [StarOrderedRing A] (B : Type v) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B]
+    [StarOrderedRing B] where
+  toEquiv : ExtendedTrace A ≃ ExtendedTrace B
+  map_add : ∀ τ σ, toEquiv (τ.add σ) = (toEquiv τ).add (toEquiv σ)
+  map_zero : toEquiv ExtendedTrace.zero = ExtendedTrace.zero
+  map_scale : ∀ (r : ℝ≥0), 0 < r → ∀ τ, toEquiv (τ.scale r) = (toEquiv τ).scale r
+  continuous_toFun : PreservesCanonicalConvergence toEquiv
+  continuous_invFun : PreservesCanonicalConvergence toEquiv.symm
+
+namespace TraceConeEquiv
+variable (F : TraceConeEquiv A B)
+def idealOrderIso : ClosedIdeal A ≃o ClosedIdeal B :=
+  closedIdealOrderEquivOfAdditive F.toEquiv F.map_add
+
+theorem idealOrderIso_finIdeal (τ : ExtendedTrace A) :
+    F.idealOrderIso τ.finIdeal = (F.toEquiv τ).finIdeal := by
+  sorry
+
+theorem idealOrderIso_zeroIdeal (τ : ExtendedTrace A) :
+    F.idealOrderIso τ.zeroIdeal = (F.toEquiv τ).zeroIdeal := by
+  sorry
+
+end TraceConeEquiv
+end TraceConeClassification
+end
+

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+namespace ExactFourier
+noncomputable def zeta (n : ℕ) : ℂ := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / (n : ℂ))

+/-!
+# Exact scalar and index RAM used for the algorithm
+
+Finite, first-order, expression/program syntax. Arrays below are random-access arrays of
+registers (an array-valued register holds its address). An expression building an array uses
+a fresh array; `sow` builds by a loop of writes instead of a loop supplying consecutive
+entries. Programs have their usual sequential stack evaluation. Evaluation here records work
+(including stack, index and array work), the high water mark on produced/logically looped-over
+integer values (addresses *within* arrays are integers too), the value, and the side condition
+required along the executed path (in particular no division by zero). The charged units of
+work are constant time; as usual constant rescalings between ways to charge a fixed number
+of scalar or address operations are immaterial.
+
+Enough address bits must be provided BOTH for the integer high water mark (and inputs), AND
+for the work bound together with input size, as will be required in the theorem. Indeed we
+use the particularly simple RAM convention where temporaries aren't reused: one work unit can
+leave at most a constant number of cells (stack, pairs or array cells); whenever many array
+entries are made their number is charged. So a constant number of words of those sizes also
+suffices for arena addresses. Nothing charges constant work for changing an already published
+array to a different array as a whole. Register and stack layouts, and the convention whether
+registers hold pairs or addresses of pairs, only have constant factors (the program is fixed).
+
+Scalar and data field registers are separated. Tests and loop/request sizes are on nonnegative
+integer registers. There is no instruction for an arbitrary complex constant. A supplied
+specified root will be an input. Divisions are on prepared scalars; valid runs require every
+such denominator nonzero; the side condition is *not* a test performed by the algorithm.
+The Bool mode on the syntax allows or prohibits general products (two-input convolution
+versus the transform); even when allowed we use separate register kinds before and after
+the bilinear products.
+
+Definitions are mathematical operation-count semantics, not a model of running Lean code.
+E.g. a function on Fin n represents the n cells of a random-access array, not a function
+closure at runtime.
+-/
+
+namespace PowerSaving
+
+universe u v
+
+variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v}
+
+/-- Register arrays. -/
+structure Tape (α : Type u) where
+  len : ℕ
+  pos : Fin len → α
+
+namespace Tape
+
+def empty (α : Type u) : Tape α := ⟨0, Fin.elim0⟩
+
+/-- Materialized array. -/
+def tab (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) : Tape α := ⟨n, fun i => f i.val⟩
+
+/-- Read with fixed out of bounds default. -/
+def look (v : Tape α) (i : ℕ) (z : α) : α :=
+  if h : i < v.len then v.pos ⟨i,h⟩ else z
+
+@[simp] theorem look_of_lt (v : Tape α) (z : α) {i} (h : i < v.len) :
+    v.look i z = v.pos ⟨i,h⟩ := by simp [look, h]
+
+@[simp] theorem look_of_le (v : Tape α) (z : α) {i} (h : v.len ≤ i) :
+    v.look i z = z := by simp [look, Nat.not_lt.mpr h]
+
+/-- Semantics of a write into fresh storage; out-of-range writes are ignored. Only used
+  during construction, never a whole-tape functional update instruction. -/
+def set (v : Tape α) (i : ℕ) (x : α) : Tape α :=
+  ⟨v.len, fun j => if j.val = i then x else v.pos j⟩
+
+def sow (len count : ℕ) (z : α) (f : ℕ → ℕ × α) : Tape α :=
+  iter count
+where
+  iter : ℕ → Tape α
+  | 0 => tab len (fun _ => z)
+  | i+1 => (iter i).set (f i).1 (f i).2
+
+def map (f : α → β) (v : Tape α) : Tape β := ⟨v.len, fun i => f (v.pos i)⟩
+
+end Tape
+
+namespace RAM
+
+inductive Paint
+  | scalar
+  | left
+  | right
+  | both
+
+inductive Ty
+  | w
+  | c : Paint → Ty
+  | p : Ty → Ty → Ty
+  | a : Ty → Ty
+
+open Ty
+
+abbrev sc := c .scalar
+
+@[reducible] def Ty.T : Ty → Type
+  | w => ℕ
+  | c _ => ℂ
+  | p s b => s.T × b.T
+  | a b => Tape b.T
+
+noncomputable def Ty.blank : (t : Ty) → t.T
+  | w => 0
+  | c _ => 0
+  | p s t => (s.blank, t.blank)
+  | a b => Tape.empty b.T
+
+/-- One basic work unit below pays for O(1) primitive RAM operations; includes loop and
+  stack overhead. `peak` tracks produced/needed integer quantities beyond inputs
+  (total allocation for stack and array bases is covered separately by work). -/
+structure Bill (α : Type u) where
+  val : α
+  work : ℕ
+  peak : ℕ
+  valid : Prop
+
+namespace Bill
+
+/-- Charge some work and optionally a new word bound. -/
+def pay (b : Bill α) (n : ℕ) (m : ℕ) : Bill α :=
+  ⟨b.val, b.work+n, max b.peak m, b.valid⟩
+
+/-- Both computations are evaluated. -/
+def pass (b : Bill α) (f : α → Bill β) : Bill β :=
+  let d := f b.val
+  ⟨d.val, b.work+d.work, max b.peak d.peak, b.valid ∧ d.valid⟩
+
+def one (x : α) : Bill α := ⟨x,1,0,True⟩
+def word (x : ℕ) : Bill ℕ := ⟨x,1,x,True⟩
+
+/-- Execute f 0 through f (n-1), iterating an accumulator. -/
+def steps (init : α) (f : ℕ → α → Bill α) : ℕ → Bill α
+  | 0 => Bill.one init
+  | i+1 => ((steps init f i).pass (f i)).pay 1 (i+1)
+
+/-- Build Tape len by count writes (initialized with a blank z). -/
+def sow (len count : ℕ) (z : α) (f : ℕ → Bill (ℕ × α)) : Bill (Tape α) :=
+  (steps (Tape.tab len (fun _ => z))
+    (fun i v => (f i).pass (fun s => one (v.set s.1 s.2))) count).pay (1+len) len
+
+/-- Build Tape len. As for sow we can first allocate then perform writes. -/
+def tab (len : ℕ) (z : α) (f : ℕ → Bill α) : Bill (Tape α) :=
+  sow len len z (fun i => (f i).pass (fun y => one (i,y)))
+
+end Bill
+
+inductive NOp
+  | add | sub | mul | div | mod | lt  -- truncated subtraction; compare returns 1 or 0
+
+inductive Atom (allow : Bool) : Ty → Ty → Type
+  | lit {a} (n : ℕ) : Atom allow a w
+  | int (f : NOp) : Atom allow (p w w) w
+  | cz (t) {a} : Atom allow a (c t)
+  | cone {a} : Atom allow a sc
+  | add (t) : Atom allow (p (c t) (c t)) (c t)
+  | sub (t) : Atom allow (p (c t) (c t)) (c t)
+  | scale (t) : Atom allow (p sc (c t)) (c t)
+  | inv : Atom allow sc sc
+  | cross (h : allow = true) :
+      Atom allow (p (c .left) (c .right)) (c .both)
+  | id {a} : Atom allow a a
+  | fst {a b} : Atom allow (p a b) a
+  | snd {a b} : Atom allow (p a b) b
+  | len {s} : Atom allow (a s) w
+  | look {s} : Atom allow (p (a s) w) s
+
+noncomputable def NOp.run : NOp → (ℕ × ℕ) → Bill ℕ
+  | .add, (i,j) => Bill.word (i+j)
+  | .sub, (i,j) => Bill.word (i-j)
+  | .mul, (i,j) => Bill.word (i*j)
+  | .div, (i,j) => Bill.word (i/j) -- includes usual guard (returns zero)
+  | .mod, (i,j) => Bill.word (i%j) -- like Lean: returns i if j=0
+  | .lt, (i,j) => Bill.word (if i<j then 1 else 0)
+
+noncomputable def Atom.run {allow a b} : Atom allow a b → a.T → Bill b.T
+  | .lit n, _ => Bill.word n
+  | .int f, x => f.run x
+  | .cz _, _ => Bill.one 0
+  | .cone, _ => Bill.one 1
+  | .add _, (x,y) => Bill.one (x+y)
+  | .sub _, (x,y) => Bill.one (x-y)
+  | .scale _, (x,y) => Bill.one (x*y)
+  | .inv, x => ⟨x⁻¹,1,0,x ≠ 0⟩
+  | .cross _, (x,y) => Bill.one (x*y)
+  | .id, x => Bill.one x
+  | .fst, x => Bill.one x.1
+  | .snd, x => Bill.one x.2
+  | .len, x => Bill.word x.len
+  | @Atom.look _ s, (x,i) => Bill.one (x.look i s.blank)
+
+abbrev Port := Option (Ty × Ty)
+
+/-- `call` is internal for bounded recursion; a program has Port = none. `loop`, `tab`
+  and `sow` retain the input to access parameters in the body. `descend` sets up bounded
+  recursion, reading fuel and initial argument. -/
+inductive Code (allow : Bool) : Port → Ty → Ty → Type
+  | atom {r s t} (op : Atom allow s t) : Code allow r s t
+  | comp {r s t u} (f : Code allow r s t) (g : Code allow r t u) : Code allow r s u
+  | fork {r s t u} (f : Code allow r s t) (g : Code allow r s u) : Code allow r s (p t u)
+  | ifz {r s t} (q : Code allow r s w) (f g : Code allow r s t) : Code allow r s t
+  | loop {r s t} (n : Code allow r s w) (init : Code allow r s t)
+      (body : Code allow r (p s (p w t)) t) : Code allow r s t
+  | tab {r s t} (n : Code allow r s w)
+      (body : Code allow r (p s w) t) : Code allow r s (a t)
+  | sow {r s t} (n count : Code allow r s w)
+      (body : Code allow r (p s w) (p w t)) : Code allow r s (a t)
+  | importClosed {r s t} (f : Code allow none s t) : Code allow r s t
+  | call {s t} : Code allow (some (s,t)) s t
+  | descend {r s t} (base : Code allow none s t)
+      (body : Code allow (some (s,t)) s t) : Code allow r (p w s) t
+
+@[reducible] def Handler : Port → Type
+  | none => Unit
+  | some (s,t) => s.T → Bill t.T
+
+def depthRun (base : α → Bill β)
+    (step : (α → Bill β) → (α → Bill β)) : ℕ → α → Bill β
+  | 0, x => (base x).pay 1 0
+  | n+1, x => (step (depthRun base step n) x).pay 1 (n+1)
+
+noncomputable def Code.run {allow r s t} : Code allow r s t → Handler r → s.T → Bill t.T
+  | .atom op, _, x => op.run x
+  | .comp f g, h, x => ((f.run h x).pass (g.run h)).pay 1 0
+  | .fork f g, h, x => (f.run h x).pass (fun y => (g.run h x).pass (fun z => Bill.one (y,z)))
+  | .ifz q f g, h, x => ((q.run h x).pass (fun y =>
+      if (y : ℕ) = 0 then f.run h x else g.run h x)).pay 1 0
+  | .loop n init body, h, x =>
+      ((n.run h x).pass (fun l => (init.run h x).pass (fun y =>
+        Bill.steps y (fun i z => body.run h (x,(i,z))) l))).pay 1 0
+  | @Code.tab _ _ _ t n body, h, x =>
+      ((n.run h x).pass (fun l =>
+        Bill.tab l t.blank (fun i => body.run h (x,i)))).pay 1 0
+  | @Code.sow _ _ _ t n count body, h, x =>
+      ((n.run h x).pass (fun l => (count.run h x).pass (fun k =>
+        Bill.sow l k t.blank (fun i => body.run h (x,i))))).pay 1 0
+  | .importClosed f, _, x => (f.run () x).pay 1 0
+  | .call, h, x => (h x).pay 1 0
+  | .descend base step, _, (k,x) =>
+      (depthRun (base.run ()) (step.run) k x).pay 1 k
+
+abbrev Prog (allow : Bool) (s t : Ty) := Code allow none s t
+
+noncomputable abbrev run {allow s t} (f : Prog allow s t) (x : s.T) : Bill t.T :=
+  f.run () x
+
+end RAM
+end PowerSaving
+
+
+namespace PowerSaving
+noncomputable section
+open RAM RAM.Ty Filter Asymptotics
+
+def paperM : ℝ := 1000000
+def paperW : ℝ := ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (71:ℕ)
+def paperDelta : ℝ := 6871402692000000
+def paperMultiplier := paperM - paperDelta / paperW
+def theta : ℝ := Real.log paperMultiplier / Real.log paperM
+def decimalExponent : ℝ := 1 - 1/(10^(13:ℕ))
+
+def paperTime (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  (n:ℝ) * (Real.log (n:ℝ)) ^ theta * (Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ))) ^ (4-theta)
+
+def decimalTime (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n:ℝ) * (Real.log (n:ℝ)) ^ decimalExponent
+
+def nlogn (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n:ℝ) * Real.log (n:ℝ)
+
+abbrev root := ExactFourier.zeta
+
+abbrev Vec (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℂ
+
+def dft (n : ℕ) (x : Vec n) : Vec n :=
+  fun j => ∑ k, (root n) ^ (j.val*k.val) * x k
+
+def conv (n : ℕ) (x y : Vec n) : Vec (2*n-1) :=
+  fun k => ∑ r : Fin n, ∑ s : Fin n, if r.val+s.val=k.val then x r*y s else 0
+
+abbrev dftInKind := p w (p sc (a (c Paint.left)))
+abbrev dftOutKind := a (c Paint.left)
+abbrev convInKind := p w (p sc (p (a (c Paint.left)) (a (c Paint.right))))
+abbrev convOutKind := a (c Paint.both)
+
+def DFTProgram (order : Prog false w w) (solve : Prog false dftInKind dftOutKind)
+    (W : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ cBound : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 0<n →
+    let cap := (n+2)^cBound
+    let d := run order n
+    W n + 10*(n+2) ≤ cap ∧ d.peak ≤ cap ∧ d.valid ∧
+    0 < d.val ∧ d.val < 1024*n^3 ∧ d.val ≤ cap ∧
+    ∀ x : Vec n,
+      let result := run solve (n, root d.val, (⟨n,x⟩ : Tape ℂ))
+      result.valid ∧ result.peak ≤ cap ∧ d.work+1+result.work ≤ W n ∧
+      result.val = (⟨n, dft n x⟩ : Tape ℂ)
+
+def ConvProgram (order : Prog false w w) (solve : Prog true convInKind convOutKind)
+    (W : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ cBound : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 0<n →
+    let cap := (n+2)^cBound
+    let d := run order n
+    W n + 10*(n+2) ≤ cap ∧ d.peak ≤ cap ∧ d.valid ∧
+    0 < d.val ∧ d.val < 1024*(2*n-1)^3 ∧ d.val ≤ cap ∧
+    ∀ x y : Vec n,
+      let result := run solve (n, root d.val, (⟨n,x⟩ : Tape ℂ),(⟨n,y⟩ : Tape ℂ))
+      result.valid ∧ result.peak ≤ cap ∧ d.work+1+result.work ≤ W n ∧
+      result.val = (⟨2*n-1, conv n x y⟩ : Tape ℂ)
+
+def TimeBounds (W : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
+  let W' := fun n : ℕ => (W n : ℝ)
+  W' =O[atTop] paperTime ∧ W' =O[atTop] decimalTime ∧ W' =o[atTop] nlogn
+
+def DFTGoal : Prop := ∃ order solve W, DFTProgram order solve W ∧ TimeBounds W
+
+def ConvGoal : Prop := ∃ order solve W, ConvProgram order solve W ∧ TimeBounds W
+
+/-- One fixed program computes every positive-length canonical DFT, including preparation. -/
+theorem transform_main : DFTGoal := by
+  sorry
+
+/-- One fixed bilinear program computes convolution with the same asymptotic bounds. -/
+theorem convolution_main : ConvGoal := by
+  sorry
+
+end
+end PowerSaving
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Differentiating a polynomial action commuting with fiber scaling
+
+The manuscript's lifting argument obtains a polynomial additive action on the
+line-bundle torsor which commutes with its multiplicative fiber scaling. This
+file proves the coefficient-level implication: differentiation at parameter
+zero preserves every integral fiber-weight space. The commutation hypothesis
+is an equality of genuine ring maps into a two-parameter polynomial/Laurent
+ring, not a hypothesis that the differentiated map already preserves weights.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ActionWeightDerivative
+
+open Polynomial
+
+section Swap
+
+variable {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A]
+
+/-- Interchange the ordinary polynomial parameter and the Laurent parameter. -/
+def swap : Polynomial (LaurentPolynomial A) →+* LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) :=
+  Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom ℤ Polynomial.C)
+    (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 Polynomial.X)
+
+/-- The interchange map transposes the two coefficient indices. -/
+theorem coeff_coeff_swap (p : Polynomial (LaurentPolynomial A)) (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
+    ((swap p).coeff n).coeff m = (p.coeff m).coeff n := by
+  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
+  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
+  | monomial i a =>
+    simp only [swap, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_monomial,
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, nsmul_zero, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_zero,
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mapRingHom, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
+      Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
+    split_ifs <;> simp_all
+
+end Swap
+
+section Commutation
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [CommSemiring A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- The parameter interchange respects an arbitrary coefficient algebra. -/
+def swapAlgHom : Polynomial (LaurentPolynomial A) →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) where
+  __ := swap
+  commutes' r := by
+    change swap (Polynomial.C (LaurentPolynomial.C (algebraMap k A r))) =
+      LaurentPolynomial.C (Polynomial.C (algebraMap k A r))
+    simp only [swap, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
+    change (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom ℤ Polynomial.C)
+      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (algebraMap k A r)) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (Polynomial.C (algebraMap k A r))
+    exact AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single Polynomial.C 0 (algebraMap k A r)
+
+/-- A polynomial family commutes with a Laurent weight coaction if the two
+orders of applying their coefficient maps agree, after interchanging parameters. -/
+def CommutesWithWeights (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A)
+    (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A) : Prop :=
+  ∀ a, swap (Polynomial.map ρ.toRingHom (α a)) =
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom ℤ α (ρ a)
+
+/-- The two-parameter commutation identity can be read coefficient by coefficient. -/
+theorem commute_coeff (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A) (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A)
+    (hcomm : CommutesWithWeights ρ α) (a : A) (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
+    (ρ ((α a).coeff m)).coeff n = (α ((ρ a).coeff n)).coeff m := by
+  have h := congrArg (fun p : LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) => (p.coeff n).coeff m)
+    (hcomm a)
+  simp only [coeff_coeff_swap, Polynomial.coeff_map,
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mapAlgHom] at h
+  exact h
+
+/-- Every parameter coefficient of an equivariant polynomial family preserves
+an integral weight, including negative weights. -/
+theorem coeff_preserves_weight (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A)
+    (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A) (hcomm : CommutesWithWeights ρ α)
+    {a : A} {n : ℤ} (ha : ρ a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) (m : ℕ) :
+    ρ ((α a).coeff m) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n ((α a).coeff m) := by
+  ext j
+  rw [commute_coeff ρ α hcomm, ha]
+  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
+  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_zero, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
+
+/-- It suffices to check equivariance coefficientwise on a set of algebra
+generators. This converts frame-coordinate weights into equivariance of the
+whole lifted polynomial action. -/
+theorem commutesWithWeights_of_generators {σ : Type*}
+    (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A) (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A)
+    (g : σ → A) (w : σ → ℤ) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (hρ : ∀ i, ρ (g i) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (w i) (g i))
+    (hα : ∀ i m, ρ ((α (g i)).coeff m) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (w i) ((α (g i)).coeff m)) :
+    CommutesWithWeights ρ α := by
+  let L : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) :=
+    (swapAlgHom (k := k) (A := A)).comp ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom ρ).comp α)
+  let R : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) :=
+    (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom ℤ α).comp ρ
+  have heq : L = R := by
+    apply AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top hgen
+    rintro a ⟨i, rfl⟩
+    apply LaurentPolynomial.ext
+    intro n
+    apply Polynomial.ext
+    intro m
+    change (((swap (Polynomial.map ρ.toRingHom (α (g i)))).coeff n).coeff m) = _
+    rw [coeff_coeff_swap, Polynomial.coeff_map]
+    change (ρ ((α (g i)).coeff m)).coeff n =
+      ((AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom ℤ α (ρ (g i))).coeff n).coeff m
+    rw [hα, hρ, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single]
+    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
+    split_ifs <;> simp only [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
+  intro a
+  exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq a
+
+/-- Differentiation at parameter zero preserves all weights. The derivation
+may be supplied by any proved additive-action/LND correspondence. -/
+theorem derivation_preserves_weight (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A)
+    (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A) (hcomm : CommutesWithWeights ρ α)
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : ∀ a, D a = (α a).coeff 1)
+    {a : A} {n : ℤ} (ha : ρ a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) :
+    ρ (D a) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (D a) := by
+  rw [hD]
+  exact coeff_preserves_weight ρ α hcomm ha 1
+
+end Commutation
+
+end StableCoordinate.ActionWeightDerivative
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineSpace
+import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.ClosedImmersion
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Scheme-theoretic meaning of the coordinate-ring formulation
+
+An algebra equivalence with a polynomial ring yields an isomorphism to affine
+space **over the coefficient field**. The quotient presentation also supplies a
+closed immersion, so neither assertion is encoded by a bare bijection of points.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace AffineGeometry
+
+open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
+open scoped AlgebraicGeometry
+
+universe u
+
+variable {k A B : Type u} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
+variable [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
+
+/-- The spectrum of a `k`-algebra, viewed as a scheme over `Spec k`. -/
+def algebraSpec (k A : Type u) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
+    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
+  Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
+
+/-- Contravariance takes an algebra equivalence to an actual scheme isomorphism. -/
+def specIsoOfAlgEquiv (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) :
+    Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A) :=
+  Scheme.Spec.mapIso e.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op
+
+/-- This scheme isomorphism respects the coefficient base scheme. -/
+theorem specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) :
+    (specIsoOfAlgEquiv e).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)) := by
+  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.toRingHom) ≫ _ = _
+  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
+  congr 1
+  ext r
+  exact e.commutes r
+
+/-- The stronger isomorphism in the category of schemes over `Spec k`. -/
+def algebraSpecIso (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) : algebraSpec k B ≅ algebraSpec k A :=
+  Over.isoMk (specIsoOfAlgEquiv e) (specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over e)
+
+/-- Full faithfulness of `Spec` recovers the ring map from every affine scheme isomorphism. -/
+def ringEquivOfSpecIso
+    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) : A ≃+* B :=
+  (Scheme.Spec.preimageIso e).unop.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
+
+/-- The recovered ring equivalence is exactly the pullback of the original morphism. -/
+theorem ringEquivOfSpecIso_apply
+    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) (a : A) :
+    ringEquivOfSpecIso e a = Spec.preimage e.hom a := rfl
+
+/-- Every affine scheme isomorphism over the coefficient base induces an algebra
+isomorphism. Thus algebra automorphisms do not omit any ambient automorphisms. -/
+def algEquivOfSpecIso
+    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
+    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B))) : A ≃ₐ[k] B :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := ringEquivOfSpecIso e) (by
+    intro r
+    have h := congrArg Spec.preimage he
+    rw [Spec.preimage_comp, Spec.preimage_map, Spec.preimage_map] at h
+    exact congrArg (fun f : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ CommRingCat.of B => f r) h)
+
+/-- In particular, every automorphism in the category of schemes over `Spec k`
+is accounted for by an algebra automorphism. -/
+def algEquivOfAlgebraSpecIso (e : algebraSpec k B ≅ algebraSpec k A) : A ≃ₐ[k] B :=
+  algEquivOfSpecIso ((Over.forget _).mapIso e) e.hom.w
+
+/-- Recovering the algebra map and applying `Spec` returns the given isomorphism. -/
+theorem specIsoOfAlgEquiv_algEquivOfSpecIso
+    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
+    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B))) :
+    specIsoOfAlgEquiv (algEquivOfSpecIso e he) = e := by
+  apply Iso.ext
+  change Spec.map (Spec.preimage e.hom) = e.hom
+  exact Spec.map_preimage e.hom
+
+/-- The ring and scheme-over-base existence formulations are equivalent. -/
+theorem nonempty_algEquiv_iff_algebraSpecIso :
+    Nonempty (A ≃ₐ[k] B) ↔ Nonempty (algebraSpec k B ≅ algebraSpec k A) :=
+  ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ => ⟨algebraSpecIso e⟩, fun ⟨e⟩ => ⟨algEquivOfAlgebraSpecIso e⟩⟩
+
+/-- Transporting a defining ideal transports its closed subset by the associated
+ambient scheme isomorphism (with the contravariant direction made explicit). -/
+theorem specIso_image_zeroLocus_of_ideal_map
+    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B)
+    (h : I.map e.toRingHom = J) :
+    (specIsoOfAlgEquiv e.symm).hom ''
+        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set B) := by
+  change PrimeSpectrum.comap e.symm.toRingHom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = _
+  rw [image_comap_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus_comap _ _ e.symm.surjective]
+  change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.comap e.toRingEquiv.symm : Set B) = _
+  rw [Ideal.comap_symm e.toRingEquiv]
+  exact congrArg (fun K : Ideal B => PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (K : Set B)) h
+
+/-- Conversely, equality of the closed subsets under any ambient scheme
+isomorphism over the base recovers equality of their radical defining ideals. -/
+theorem ideal_map_of_specIso_image_zeroLocus
+    (I : Ideal B) (J : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical)
+    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
+    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)))
+    (h : e.hom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set B) =
+      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)) :
+    I.map (algEquivOfSpecIso e he).symm.toRingHom = J := by
+  let a := algEquivOfSpecIso e he
+  have ha : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a.toRingHom) = e.hom := by
+    exact congrArg Iso.hom (specIsoOfAlgEquiv_algEquivOfSpecIso e he)
+  have hz : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.comap a.toRingHom : Set A) =
+      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) := by
+    rw [← image_comap_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus_comap B a.toRingHom a.surjective I]
+    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a.toRingHom) ''
+      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set B) = _
+    rw [ha]
+    exact h
+  have hi : I.comap a.toRingHom = J := by
+    have hz' := PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_iff.mp hz
+    rwa [(hI.comap a.toRingHom).radical, hJ.radical] at hz'
+  change I.map a.toRingEquiv.symm = J
+  rw [Ideal.map_symm a.toRingEquiv]
+  exact hi
+
+/-- For radical defining ideals, the algebraic orbit condition is equivalent to
+the geometric orbit condition under **all** ambient automorphisms over the base. -/
+theorem ideal_transport_iff_scheme_transport (I J : Ideal A)
+    (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical) :
+    (∃ e : A ≃ₐ[k] A, I.map e.toRingHom = J) ↔
+      ∃ e : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
+        (e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
+          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) ∧
+        e.hom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
+          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
+    exact ⟨specIsoOfAlgEquiv e.symm, specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over e.symm,
+      specIso_image_zeroLocus_of_ideal_map e I J he⟩
+  · rintro ⟨e, he, h⟩
+    exact ⟨(algEquivOfSpecIso e he).symm,
+      ideal_map_of_specIso_image_zeroLocus I J hI hJ e he h⟩
+
+/-- A polynomial-ring algebra presentation gives affine space as a scheme,
+not just its underlying collection of rational points. -/
+def affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv {σ : Type u} (e : A ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ≅ AffineSpace σ (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
+  specIsoOfAlgEquiv e.symm ≪≫ (AffineSpace.SpecIso σ (CommRingCat.of k)).symm
+
+/-- The polynomial presentation isomorphism is an isomorphism over `Spec k`. -/
+theorem affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over {σ : Type u}
+    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    (affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv e).hom ≫
+      (AffineSpace σ (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) =
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) := by
+  simp only [affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
+    AffineSpace.SpecIso_inv_over]
+  exact specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over e.symm
+
+/-- Scheme-over-base version of polynomial-ring coordinates. -/
+def affineSpaceOverIsoOfAlgEquiv {σ : Type u}
+    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    algebraSpec k A ≅ Over.mk
+      (AffineSpace σ (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
+  Over.isoMk (affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv e) (affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over e)
+
+/-- The natural map from the spectrum of a quotient into the ambient affine scheme. -/
+def quotientEmbedding (I : Ideal A) :
+    Spec (CommRingCat.of (A ⧸ I)) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A) :=
+  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
+
+/-- This is genuinely a closed immersion. -/
+instance quotientEmbedding_isClosedImmersion (I : Ideal A) :
+    IsClosedImmersion (quotientEmbedding I) :=
+  IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
+
+/-- The embedded image is exactly the closed subset defined by the ideal. -/
+theorem quotientEmbedding_range (I : Ideal A) :
+    Set.range (quotientEmbedding I) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) := by

+/-!
+# Constant affine changes of polynomial coordinates
+
+The automorphisms in this file normalize a nonzero scalar multiple of a
+coordinate and a constant translate.  They are actual algebra automorphisms
+of the whole polynomial ring, with explicit polynomial inverses.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+section Generic
+
+variable {k σ : Type*} [Field k]
+
+/-- Simultaneously replace every variable `X i` by `a * X i + b`. -/
+noncomputable def affineAll (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
+    MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom
+    (aeval fun i => C a * X i + C b)
+    (aeval fun i => C a⁻¹ * (X i - C b))
+    (by
+      apply algHom_ext
+      intro i
+      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C,
+        AlgHom.id_apply, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
+      rw [add_sub_cancel_right, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, C_1, one_mul])
+    (by
+      apply algHom_ext
+      intro i
+      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul, map_add, aeval_X, aeval_C,
+        AlgHom.id_apply, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
+      rw [← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, C_1, one_mul, sub_add_cancel])
+
+@[simp] theorem affineAll_X (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (i : σ) :
+    affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha (X i) = C a * X i + C b := by
+  change (aeval fun j => C a * X j + C b) (X i) = _
+  exact aeval_X _ _
+
+@[simp] theorem affineAll_C (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (c : k) :
+    affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha (C c) = C c := by
+  exact (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).commutes c
+
+/-- Its inverse removes the scalar and translate from every variable. -/
+@[simp] theorem affineAll_symm_X (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (i : σ) :
+    (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).symm (X i) = C a⁻¹ * (X i - C b) := by
+  change (aeval fun j => C a⁻¹ * (X j - C b)) (X i) = _
+  exact aeval_X _ _
+
+/-- An ambient algebra automorphism taking a polynomial to an affine-linear
+    coordinate can be normalized to take it to that variable exactly. -/
+theorem exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine
+    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ) (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0)
+    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (hφ : φ p = C a * X i + C b) :
+    ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k, ψ p = X i := by
+  refine ⟨φ.trans (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).symm, ?_⟩
+  change (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).symm (φ p) = X i
+  rw [hφ, ← affineAll_X a b ha i, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
+
+/-- The normalization needed after identifying the generators of two
+    principal hypersurface ideals. -/
+theorem exists_equiv_eq_X_of_sub_eq_scalar_mul
+    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ) (t a : k) (ha : a ≠ 0)
+    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (hφ : φ (p - C t) = C a * X i) :
+    ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k, ψ p = X i := by
+  apply exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine p i a t ha φ
+  have hc : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
+  rw [map_sub, hc] at hφ
+  exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hφ
+
+end Generic
+
+/-- Specialized normalization for the exact `IsCoordinate` definition. -/
+theorem isCoordinate_of_equiv_sub_eq_scalar_mul_X
+    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : R n) (t a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
+    (φ : R n ≃ₐ[ℂ] R n)
+    (hφ : φ (p - C t) = C a * X ⟨0, hn⟩) :
+    IsCoordinate hn p :=
+  exists_equiv_eq_X_of_sub_eq_scalar_mul p ⟨0, hn⟩ t a ha φ hφ
+
+/-- A constant translate does not alter whether a polynomial is a coordinate. -/
+theorem isCoordinate_sub_C_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : R n) (t : ℂ) :
+    IsCoordinate hn (p - C t) ↔ IsCoordinate hn p := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
+    apply isCoordinate_of_equiv_sub_eq_scalar_mul_X hn p t 1 one_ne_zero φ
+    simpa using hφ
+  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
+    apply exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine (p - C t) ⟨0, hn⟩ 1 (-t) one_ne_zero φ
+    rw [map_sub, hφ]
+    have hc : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
+    rw [hc, C_1, one_mul, C_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Nullstellensatz
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Polynomial maps induced by coordinate-ring maps
+
+The maps in this file carry actual coordinate polynomials and satisfy polynomial
+composition identities. In particular, the geometric interpretation of an algebra
+equivalence below is not merely a set-theoretic bijection of complex points.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace AmbientMaps
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {k : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
+variable {σ τ υ : Type*}
+
+/-- The point map contravariantly induced by a homomorphism of polynomial algebras. -/
+def pointMap (φ : MvPolynomial τ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (x : σ → k) : τ → k :=
+  fun i => aeval x (φ (X i))
+
+/-- Pulling back a polynomial and evaluating agrees with evaluating it on the point map. -/
+theorem aeval_pointMap (φ : MvPolynomial τ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (x : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial τ k) :
+    aeval (pointMap φ x) p = aeval x (φ p) := by
+  have h : aeval (pointMap φ x) = (aeval x).comp φ := by
+    ext i
+    simp [pointMap]
+  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h p
+
+@[simp]
+theorem pointMap_id (x : σ → k) :
+    pointMap (AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)) x = x := by
+  funext i
+  simp [pointMap]
+
+/-- Composition is reversed, as it must be for maps of coordinate rings. -/
+theorem pointMap_comp (φ : MvPolynomial τ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (ψ : MvPolynomial υ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial τ k) (x : σ → k) :
+    pointMap (φ.comp ψ) x = pointMap ψ (pointMap φ x) := by
+  funext i
+  exact (aeval_pointMap φ x (ψ (X i))).symm
+
+/-- A polynomial isomorphism, with inverse identities in the polynomial rings,
+not just identities of functions on the base field. -/
+structure PolynomialEquiv (k : Type*) [CommSemiring k] (σ τ : Type*) where
+  forward : τ → MvPolynomial σ k
+  inverse : σ → MvPolynomial τ k
+  forward_inverse : ∀ i, aeval forward (inverse i) = X i
+  inverse_forward : ∀ i, aeval inverse (forward i) = X i
+
+namespace PolynomialEquiv
+
+/-- An algebra isomorphism supplies polynomial coordinates for both directions. -/
+def ofAlgEquiv (e : MvPolynomial τ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    PolynomialEquiv k σ τ where
+  forward i := e (X i)
+  inverse i := e.symm (X i)
+  forward_inverse i := by
+    change aeval (e.toAlgHom ∘ X) (e.symm (X i)) = X i
+    rw [← aeval_unique e.toAlgHom]
+    exact e.apply_symm_apply (X i)
+  inverse_forward i := by
+    change aeval (e.symm.toAlgHom ∘ X) (e (X i)) = X i
+    rw [← aeval_unique e.symm.toAlgHom]
+    exact e.symm_apply_apply (X i)
+
+/-- The forward polynomial map. -/
+def toPointMap (e : PolynomialEquiv k σ τ) (x : σ → k) : τ → k :=
+  fun i => aeval x (e.forward i)
+
+/-- The inverse polynomial map. -/
+def invPointMap (e : PolynomialEquiv k σ τ) (y : τ → k) : σ → k :=
+  fun i => aeval y (e.inverse i)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem invPointMap_toPointMap (e : PolynomialEquiv k σ τ) (x : σ → k) :
+    e.invPointMap (e.toPointMap x) = x := by
+  funext i
+  change aeval (fun j => aeval x (e.forward j)) (e.inverse i) = x i
+  rw [← comp_aeval_apply e.forward (aeval x), e.forward_inverse, aeval_X]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem toPointMap_invPointMap (e : PolynomialEquiv k σ τ) (y : τ → k) :
+    e.toPointMap (e.invPointMap y) = y := by
+  funext i
+  change aeval (fun j => aeval y (e.inverse j)) (e.forward i) = y i
+  rw [← comp_aeval_apply e.inverse (aeval y), e.inverse_forward, aeval_X]
+
+/-- The underlying point equivalence, retaining its polynomial witnesses in `e`. -/
+def toEquiv (e : PolynomialEquiv k σ τ) : (σ → k) ≃ (τ → k) where
+  toFun := e.toPointMap
+  invFun := e.invPointMap
+  left_inv := e.invPointMap_toPointMap
+  right_inv := e.toPointMap_invPointMap
+
+@[simp]
+theorem ofAlgEquiv_toPointMap
+    (e : MvPolynomial τ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) (x : σ → k) :
+    (ofAlgEquiv e).toPointMap x = pointMap e.toAlgHom x := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem ofAlgEquiv_invPointMap
+    (e : MvPolynomial τ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) (y : τ → k) :
+    (ofAlgEquiv e).invPointMap y = pointMap e.symm.toAlgHom y := rfl
+
+end PolynomialEquiv
+
+/-- An ambient algebra equivalence transports every level set by an explicitly
+polynomial point equivalence. The inverse direction is the one matching pullback. -/
+theorem pointMap_levelSet (e : MvPolynomial τ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (p : MvPolynomial τ k) (c : k) :
+    pointMap e.toAlgHom ⁻¹' {y | aeval y p = c} =
+      {x | aeval x (e p) = c} := by
+  ext x
+  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, aeval_pointMap]
+  rfl
+
+end AmbientMaps
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+/-!
+# The actual associated graded presentation for the source hypersurface
+
+This identifies the Rees special fiber of the source quotient filtration with
+the exact degeneration ring `Obstruction.G`, with its independent generators.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation
+
+open MvPolynomial Obstruction WeightedInitial Filtration GradedPresentationMap
+
+/-- The two source-weight APIs describe precisely the same integer weight. -/
+theorem monomialWeight_eq_weight :
+    Filtration.monomialWeight = Finsupp.weight presentationWeight := by
+  apply Finsupp.addHom_ext
+  intro i n
+  rw [Finsupp.weight_single]
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [Filtration.monomialWeight, presentationWeight ]
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- The span-of-monomials source filtration agrees with the coefficientwise
+weighted filtration used to establish the leading-relation theorem. -/
+theorem piece_eq_boundedSubmodule (d : ℤ) :
+    Filtration.piece k d = boundedSubmodule presentationWeight d := by
+  rw [boundedSubmodule_eq_span]
+  simp only [Filtration.piece, monomialWeight_eq_weight]
+
+variable {k}
+variable {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Every bounded image representative criterion is now proved for the actual
+source filtration, rather than assumed for an abstract filtered algebra. -/
+theorem imagePiece_mem_iff (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ) :
+    φ p ∈ imagePiece φ d ↔
+      ∃ r : P k 5, Bounded presentationWeight r d ∧ φ r = φ p := by
+  rw [imagePiece, piece_eq_boundedSubmodule]
+  exact GradedPresentationKernel.mem_boundedImage_iff presentationWeight φ p d
+
+
+/-- The coefficient of the actual source Rees map is the image of the matching
+weighted homogeneous component. -/
+theorem reesMap_coeff_weighted (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ) :
+    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+      φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d p) := by
+  classical
+  rw [reesMap_coeff, weightedHomogeneousComponent_apply, Finset.sum_filter]
+  simp only [monomialWeight_eq_weight]
+
+variable (k)
+
+/-- The actual polynomial presentation map of the source hypersurface. -/
+abbrev quotientMap : P k 5 →ₐ[k] Obstruction.A k := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (idealA k)
+
+/-- The actual Rees associated graded algebra of the source image filtration. -/
+abbrev associatedGraded := imageGr (quotientMap k)
+
+/-- The actual polynomial map onto the source's associated graded algebra. -/
+abbrev gradedPresentationMap : P k 5 →ₐ[k] associatedGraded k :=
+  gradedMap (quotientMap k)
+
+variable [IsDomain k]
+
+/-- Vanishing of an actual homogeneous symbol is exactly vanishing modulo the
+exact relation `Hstar`. -/
+theorem homogeneous_symbol_eq_zero_iff (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ)
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) :
+    quotientMap k p ∈ imagePiece (quotientMap k) (d - 1) ↔ p ∈ idealG k := by
+  have h := GradedPresentationKernel.homogeneous_image_mem_lower_iff presentationWeight
+    (quotientMap k) (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mem_iff (quotientMap k))
+    (H k) 1 (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).1
+    (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).2
+    (by exact Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_ker k (idealA k)) hp
+  simpa only [idealA, idealG, H_degree_one_component k] using h
+
+
+/-- The full kernel of the actual polynomial map is exactly `(Hstar)`. -/
+theorem gradedPresentation_ker :
+    RingHom.ker (gradedPresentationMap k).toRingHom = idealG k := by
+  have h := GradedPresentationKernel.kernel_eq_top_principal presentationWeight
+    (quotientMap k) (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k))
+    (imagePiece_mem_iff (quotientMap k)) (H k) 1
+    (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).1
+    (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).2
+    (by exact Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_ker k (idealA k))
+    (reesMap (quotientMap k)) (reesMap_coeff_weighted (quotientMap k))
+  simpa only [gradedPresentationMap, gradedMap, idealG, H_degree_one_component k] using h
+
+/-- The complete concrete associated-graded presentation, with no graded-domain
+or source-presentation hypothesis added. -/
+def associatedGradedEquiv : Obstruction.G k ≃ₐ[k] associatedGraded k :=
+  (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq k (gradedPresentation_ker k).symm).trans
+    (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (gradedMap_surjective (quotientMap k)))
+
+@[simp]
+theorem associatedGradedEquiv_mk (p : P k 5) :
+    associatedGradedEquiv k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) =
+      gradedPresentationMap k p := by
+  rfl
+
+/-- The presentation equivalence preserves the designated generator symbols. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem associatedGradedEquiv_gX (i : Fin 5) :
+    associatedGradedEquiv k (gX k i) =
+      FilteredRees.initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k))
+        (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) (variableElement (quotientMap k) i) := by
+  rw [gX, associatedGradedEquiv_mk]
+  exact gradedMap_X (quotientMap k) i
+
+end StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
