+/-!
+# Algebra of the two charts of the determinant bundle
+
+This module formalizes the quadric-to-determinant-ring map in Section 4 of the source.
+All variables are independent before taking the displayed principal-ideal quotient.
+The chosen sections over `D(z+1)` and `D(z)` prove the base map injective without
+assuming that the quadric ring is a domain.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.BundleCharts
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (K : Type*) [CommRing K]
+
+/-- Defining ideal of the quadric with independent coordinates `(x,y,z,u)`. -/
+def quadricIdeal : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) K) :=
+  Ideal.span {X 0 * X 1 - X 2 * (X 2 + 1)}
+
+/-- Coordinate ring of the quadric times the affine `u`-line. -/
+abbrev QuadricRing := MvPolynomial (Fin 4) K ⧸ quadricIdeal K
+
+/-- Defining ideal of the determinant-one ring with coordinates `(a,d,b,c,u)`. -/
+def determinantIdeal : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) :=
+  Ideal.span {X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1}
+
+/-- Coordinate ring of `SL₂ × A¹`, in the source's coordinate order. -/
+abbrev DeterminantRing := MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K ⧸ determinantIdeal K
+
+/-- The four quotient generators `(x,y,z,u)`. -/
+def qgen (i : Fin 4) : QuadricRing K := Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)
+
+/-- The five quotient generators `(a,d,b,c,u)`. -/
+def dgen (i : Fin 5) : DeterminantRing K := Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)
+
+theorem quadric_relation : qgen K 0 * qgen K 1 = qgen K 2 * (qgen K 2 + 1) := by
+  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
+  have h : Ideal.Quotient.mk (quadricIdeal K)
+      (X 0 * X 1 - X 2 * (X 2 + 1) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) K) = 0 := by
+    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
+  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_one, qgen] using h
+
+theorem determinant_relation : dgen K 0 * dgen K 3 - dgen K 2 * dgen K 1 = 1 := by
+  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
+  have h : Ideal.Quotient.mk (determinantIdeal K)
+      (X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) = 0 := by
+    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
+  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, dgen] using h
+
+/-- The map of polynomial rings underlying `x=ab, y=dc, z=db, u=u`. -/
+def basePolynomialMap : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) K →ₐ[K] DeterminantRing K :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval ![dgen K 0 * dgen K 2, dgen K 1 * dgen K 3,
+    dgen K 1 * dgen K 2, dgen K 4]
+
+theorem quadricIdeal_le_ker_basePolynomialMap :
+    quadricIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (basePolynomialMap K).toRingHom := by
+  rw [quadricIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
+  change basePolynomialMap K (X 0 * X 1 - X 2 * (X 2 + 1)) = 0
+  simp only [basePolynomialMap, map_mul, map_sub, map_add, map_one, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
+    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
+  have h := determinant_relation K
+  linear_combination (dgen K 1 * dgen K 2) * h
+
+/-- The source's quadric-to-determinant-ring map. -/
+def baseMap : QuadricRing K →ₐ[K] DeterminantRing K :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (quadricIdeal K) (basePolynomialMap K)
+    (fun _ h => quadricIdeal_le_ker_basePolynomialMap K h)
+
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_qgen (i : Fin 4) :
+    baseMap K (qgen K i) =
+      ![dgen K 0 * dgen K 2, dgen K 1 * dgen K 3,
+        dgen K 1 * dgen K 2, dgen K 4] i := by
+  change basePolynomialMap K (X i) = _
+  simp [basePolynomialMap]
+
+/-- The base chart `D(z+1)`. -/
+abbrev ChartA := Localization.Away (qgen K 2 + 1)
+
+/-- The base chart `D(z)`. -/
+abbrev ChartD := Localization.Away (qgen K 2)
+
+/-- Base-chart coordinate functions. -/
+def agen (i : Fin 4) : ChartA K := algebraMap (QuadricRing K) _ (qgen K i)
+
+/-- Base-chart coordinate functions. -/
+def zgen (i : Fin 4) : ChartD K := algebraMap (QuadricRing K) _ (qgen K i)
+
+/-- Inverse of `z+1` on the first chart. -/
+def ainv : ChartA K := IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (qgen K 2 + 1)
+
+/-- Inverse of `z` on the second chart. -/
+def zinv : ChartD K := IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (qgen K 2)
+
+theorem agen_relation : agen K 0 * agen K 1 = agen K 2 * (agen K 2 + 1) := by
+  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, map_one, agen] using
+    congrArg (algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K)) (quadric_relation K)
+
+theorem zgen_relation : zgen K 0 * zgen K 1 = zgen K 2 * (zgen K 2 + 1) := by
+  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, map_one, zgen] using
+    congrArg (algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K)) (quadric_relation K)
+
+@[simp] theorem agen_mul_ainv : (agen K 2 + 1) * ainv K = 1 := by
+  simpa only [agen, ainv, map_add, map_one] using
+    IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (qgen K 2 + 1) (S := ChartA K)
+
+@[simp] theorem zgen_mul_zinv : zgen K 2 * zinv K = 1 := by
+  exact IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (qgen K 2) (S := ChartD K)
+
+/-- The section with `a=1` over `D(z+1)`, expressed on polynomial generators. -/
+def sectionAPolynomialMap : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] ChartA K :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval ![1, agen K 1 * ainv K, agen K 0, agen K 2 + 1, agen K 3]
+
+/-- The section with `d=1` over `D(z)`, expressed on polynomial generators. -/
+def sectionDPolynomialMap : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] ChartD K :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval ![zgen K 0 * zinv K, 1, zgen K 2, zgen K 1, zgen K 3]
+
+theorem determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionAPolynomialMap :
+    determinantIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (sectionAPolynomialMap K).toRingHom := by
+  rw [determinantIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
+  change sectionAPolynomialMap K (X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1) = 0
+  simp only [sectionAPolynomialMap, map_mul, map_sub, map_one,
+    MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
+    Matrix.cons_val]
+  have hr := agen_relation K
+  have hi := agen_mul_ainv K
+  linear_combination -(ainv K) * hr - (agen K 2) * hi
+
+theorem determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionDPolynomialMap :
+    determinantIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (sectionDPolynomialMap K).toRingHom := by
+  rw [determinantIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
+  change sectionDPolynomialMap K (X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1) = 0
+  simp only [sectionDPolynomialMap, map_mul, map_sub, map_one,
+    MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
+    Matrix.cons_val]
+  have hr := zgen_relation K
+  have hi := zgen_mul_zinv K
+  linear_combination (zinv K) * hr + (zgen K 2 + 1) * hi
+
+/-- Restriction to the section `a=1` of the determinant bundle on the first base chart. -/
+def sectionA : DeterminantRing K →ₐ[K] ChartA K :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (determinantIdeal K) (sectionAPolynomialMap K)
+    (fun _ h => determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionAPolynomialMap K h)
+
+/-- Restriction to the section `d=1` of the determinant bundle on the second base chart. -/
+def sectionD : DeterminantRing K →ₐ[K] ChartD K :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (determinantIdeal K) (sectionDPolynomialMap K)
+    (fun _ h => determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionDPolynomialMap K h)
+
+@[simp] theorem sectionA_dgen (i : Fin 5) :
+    sectionA K (dgen K i) =
+      ![1, agen K 1 * ainv K, agen K 0, agen K 2 + 1, agen K 3] i := by
+  change sectionAPolynomialMap K (X i) = _
+  simp [sectionAPolynomialMap]
+
+@[simp] theorem sectionD_dgen (i : Fin 5) :
+    sectionD K (dgen K i) =
+      ![zgen K 0 * zinv K, 1, zgen K 2, zgen K 1, zgen K 3] i := by
+  change sectionDPolynomialMap K (X i) = _
+  simp [sectionDPolynomialMap]
+
+theorem sectionA_y :
+    (agen K 1 * ainv K) * (agen K 2 + 1) = agen K 1 := by
+  linear_combination (agen K 1) * (agen_mul_ainv K)
+
+theorem sectionA_z : (agen K 1 * ainv K) * agen K 0 = agen K 2 := by
+  linear_combination (ainv K) * (agen_relation K) + (agen K 2) * (agen_mul_ainv K)
+
+theorem sectionD_x : (zgen K 0 * zinv K) * zgen K 2 = zgen K 0 := by
+  linear_combination (zgen K 0) * (zgen_mul_zinv K)
+
+/-- The first local section splits the base map after localization. -/
+theorem sectionA_comp_baseMap :
+    (sectionA K).comp (baseMap K) = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  change sectionA K (baseMap K (qgen K i)) = agen K i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [sectionA_y, sectionA_z]
+
+/-- The second local section splits the base map after localization. -/
+theorem sectionD_comp_baseMap :
+    (sectionD K).comp (baseMap K) = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  change sectionD K (baseMap K (qgen K i)) = zgen K i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [sectionD_x]
+
+@[simp] theorem sectionA_baseMap (p : QuadricRing K) :
+    sectionA K (baseMap K p) = algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K) p :=
+  AlgHom.congr_fun (sectionA_comp_baseMap K) p
+
+@[simp] theorem sectionD_baseMap (p : QuadricRing K) :
+    sectionD K (baseMap K p) = algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K) p :=
+  AlgHom.congr_fun (sectionD_comp_baseMap K) p
+
+/-- The two principal opens cover the base: vanishing on both localizations forces zero.
+This argument works over an arbitrary commutative coefficient ring, without a domain assumption. -/
+theorem eq_zero_of_chartA_eq_zero_of_chartD_eq_zero (p : QuadricRing K)
+    (hA : algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K) p = 0)
+    (hD : algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K) p = 0) : p = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.exists_of_eq
+    (x := qgen K 2 + 1) (S := ChartA K) (a := p) (b := 0) (by simpa only [map_zero] using hA)
+  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.exists_of_eq
+    (x := qgen K 2) (S := ChartD K) (a := p) (b := 0) (by simpa only [map_zero] using hD)
+  simp only [mul_zero] at hn hm
+  have hcop : IsCoprime (qgen K 2 + 1) (qgen K 2) :=
+    IsCoprime.add_one_left_of_dvd (dvd_refl _)
+  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := hcop.pow (m := n) (n := m)
+  calc
+    p = (s * (qgen K 2 + 1) ^ n + t * qgen K 2 ^ m) * p := by rw [hst, one_mul]
+    _ = s * ((qgen K 2 + 1) ^ n * p) + t * (qgen K 2 ^ m * p) := by ring
+    _ = 0 := by rw [hn, hm]; ring
+
+/-- The base map has zero kernel, proved using the two explicit local sections. -/
+theorem baseMap_eq_zero (p : QuadricRing K) (hp : baseMap K p = 0) : p = 0 := by
+  apply eq_zero_of_chartA_eq_zero_of_chartD_eq_zero K p
+  · simpa only [sectionA_baseMap, map_zero] using congrArg (sectionA K) hp
+  · simpa only [sectionD_baseMap, map_zero] using congrArg (sectionD K) hp
+
+/-- The quadric-to-determinant-ring map of Section 4 is injective. -/
+theorem baseMap_injective : Function.Injective (baseMap K) := by
+  intro p q hpq
+  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
+  apply baseMap_eq_zero K
+  simp only [map_sub, hpq, sub_self]
+
+end StableCoordinate.BundleCharts
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Span
+import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Explicit global principalization in the quadric bundle
+
+This module gives polynomial identities, valid in every commutative ring,
+for the principalization in source Section 4, Lemma `bun:principalization`.
+Unlike the source proof, the argument uses an explicit global Bezout identity
+and requires neither localization nor prime-spectrum gluing.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.Bundle
+
+variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
+
+/-- Pullback of the source element `s_B` under `x = ab`, `y = dc`. -/
+def s (a d b c u : R) : R := d * c - (a * b) * (a * b + u ^ 2)
+
+/-- First generator of the pulled-back distinguished ideal. -/
+def f₀ (a d b c u : R) : R := a * b - s a d b c u ^ 2 + u ^ 2
+
+/-- Second generator of the pulled-back distinguished ideal. -/
+def g₀ (a d b c u : R) : R := d * b - s a d b c u * (a * b)
+
+/-- The global generator of the pulled-back ideal. -/
+def v (a d b u : R) : R := a ^ 3 * b + a ^ 2 * u ^ 2 - d ^ 2
+
+/-- First coefficient in the global Bezout relation. -/
+def coeffA (a d b : R) : R := a ^ 2 * (1 - 2 * b * d)
+
+/-- Second coefficient in the global Bezout relation. -/
+def coeffB (a d b u : R) : R :=
+  coeffA a d b * (a * b + u ^ 2) + d ^ 2 * (3 + 2 * b * d)
+
+theorem g₀_factor (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
+    g₀ a d b c u = b ^ 2 * v a d b u := by
+  unfold g₀ s v
+  linear_combination -(b * d) * h
+
+theorem f₀_factor (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
+    f₀ a d b c u = (c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 * (a * b + u ^ 2)) * v a d b u := by
+  unfold f₀ s v
+  linear_combination -((a * b + u ^ 2) * (a * c - b * d + 1)) * h
+
+theorem coefficients_bezout (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
+    coeffA a d b * (c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 * (a * b + u ^ 2)) +
+      coeffB a d b u * b ^ 2 = 1 := by
+  unfold coeffB coeffA
+  linear_combination (1 - 2 * b * d) * (a * c + b * d + 1) * h
+
+theorem generator_bezout (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
+    coeffA a d b * f₀ a d b c u + coeffB a d b u * g₀ a d b c u =
+      v a d b u := by
+  rw [f₀_factor a d b c u h, g₀_factor a d b c u h]
+  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul, coefficients_bezout a d b c u h, one_mul]
+
+/-- The exact global principalization claimed in Section 4. -/
+theorem principalization (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
+    Ideal.span ({f₀ a d b c u, g₀ a d b c u} : Set R) =
+      Ideal.span ({v a d b u} : Set R) := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · apply Ideal.span_le.2
+    intro z hz
+    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hz with rfl | hz
+    · apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2
+      exact ⟨c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 * (a * b + u ^ 2), by
+        rw [f₀_factor a d b c u h, mul_comm]⟩
+    · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
+      apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2
+      exact ⟨b ^ 2, by rw [g₀_factor a d b c u h, mul_comm]⟩
+  · apply Ideal.span_le.2
+    intro z hz
+    obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
+    exact Ideal.mem_span_pair.2
+      ⟨coeffA a d b, coeffB a d b u, generator_bezout a d b c u h⟩
+
+/-- Membership in the pulled-back ideal gives an actual factorization by `v`. -/
+theorem exists_factor_of_mem (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1)
+    {r : R} (hr : r ∈ Ideal.span ({f₀ a d b c u, g₀ a d b c u} : Set R)) :
+    ∃ q : R, r = v a d b u * q := by
+  rw [principalization a d b c u h, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hr
+  rcases hr with ⟨q, hq⟩
+  exact ⟨q, hq⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate.Bundle
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.LocalizationIntersection
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Away.Basic
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Coprime.Lemmas
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.AlgebraMap
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The coefficient-ring step in the two-chart rigidity argument
+
+A polynomial chart over a principal localization detects coefficients which
+belong to the fraction field of the coefficient ring.  This module proves the
+step by denominator clearing.  In particular, it does not require choosing a
+common overfield or treating a set-theoretic chart as an algebraic chart.
+
+The intended application is `R = k[a,d,u]` and
+`A = k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac-bd-1)`.  The two actual injective algebra maps to
+`R[a⁻¹][b]` and `R[d⁻¹][c]` are supplied by the determinant-ring charts.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection
+
+open Polynomial
+
+/-- A polynomial which becomes constant on multiplication by a nonzero
+constant was already constant. -/
+theorem eq_C_of_mul_C_eq_C {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [NoZeroDivisors S]
+    {p : Polynomial S} {r s : S} (hr : r ≠ 0)
+    (h : p * C r = C s) : p = C (p.coeff 0) := by
+  ext n
+  by_cases hn : n = 0
+  · simp [hn]
+  · have hc := congrArg (fun f : Polynomial S => f.coeff n) h
+    simp only [coeff_mul_C, coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn] at hc
+    simp only [coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn]
+    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_right hr
+
+section Chart
+
+variable {R A S : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
+  [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
+  [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S]
+  {a : R} [IsLocalization.Away a S]
+
+omit [IsDomain S] in
+/-- The canonical map to a localization away from a nonzero element is injective. -/
+theorem away_algebraMap_injective (ha : a ≠ 0) :
+    Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) := by
+  apply IsLocalization.injective (M := Submonoid.powers a) S
+  rintro x ⟨m, rfl⟩
+  exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m ha)
+
+omit [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] in
+/-- An injective polynomial chart whose value is constant supplies a power
+of the localized element as a denominator in the original algebra. -/
+theorem has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant
+    (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
+    {q : A} {v : S} (hconst : e q = C v) :
+    ∃ (m : ℕ) (t : R), q * algebraMap R A (a ^ m) = algebraMap R A t := by
+  obtain ⟨m, t, ht⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj a v
+  refine ⟨m, t, he ?_⟩
+  simp only [map_mul, AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply]
+  rw [hconst, ← map_mul, map_pow]
+  exact congrArg C ht
+
+/-- If an element of an algebra is a fraction over the coefficient ring, an
+injective polynomial chart over `R[a⁻¹]` gives an `a`-power denominator.
+This is the precise content of "there are no b terms" in Section 5. -/
+theorem has_power_denominator_of_chart
+    (ha : a ≠ 0) (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
+    {q : A} {r s : R} (hr : r ≠ 0)
+    (h : q * algebraMap R A r = algebraMap R A s) :
+    ∃ (m : ℕ) (t : R), q * algebraMap R A (a ^ m) = algebraMap R A t := by
+  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) := away_algebraMap_injective ha
+  have hrS : algebraMap R S r ≠ 0 := by
+    exact fun h0 => hr (hinj (by simpa using h0))
+  have hchart : e q * C (algebraMap R S r) = C (algebraMap R S s) := by
+    simpa only [map_mul, AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply] using congrArg e h
+  have hconst : e q = C ((e q).coeff 0) := eq_C_of_mul_C_eq_C hrS hchart
+  exact has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant e he hconst
+
+end Chart
+
+section Intersection
+
+variable {R A S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [DecompositionMonoid R]
+  [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra R A]
+  [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S]
+  [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [Algebra R T]
+  {a d : R} [IsLocalization.Away a S] [IsLocalization.Away d T]
+
+omit [IsDomain S] [IsDomain T] in
+/-- A constant in both polynomial charts lies in the base ring.  This
+version is suited to locally nilpotent derivations of the two chart rings,
+which directly show that both chart images of the rigidity coefficient are
+constant; no common fraction field needs to be constructed. -/
+theorem mem_range_of_two_constant_charts
+    (ha : a ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
+    (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
+    (f : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
+    {q : A} {v : S} {w : T} (hq : e q = C v) (hq' : f q = C w) :
+    q ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R A) := by
+  obtain ⟨m, u, hu⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant (a := a) e he hq
+  obtain ⟨n, v, hv⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant (a := d) f hf hq'
+  have hbase : Function.Injective (algebraMap R A) := by
+    intro x y hxy
+    apply away_algebraMap_injective (S := S) ha
+    apply Polynomial.C_injective
+    simpa only [AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply] using congrArg e hxy
+  exact exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators hbase ha had hu hv
+
+/-- Two injective polynomial charts at relatively prime coefficient variables
+force the intersection with the coefficient fraction field to be the original
+coefficient ring.  The fraction-field condition is encoded without an overfield
+as the equation `q*r=s` with `r ≠ 0`. -/
+theorem mem_range_of_fraction_eq_of_two_charts
+    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
+    (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
+    (f : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
+    {q : A} {r s : R} (hr : r ≠ 0)
+    (h : q * algebraMap R A r = algebraMap R A s) :
+    q ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R A) := by
+  obtain ⟨m, u, hu⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart ha e he hr h
+  obtain ⟨n, v, hv⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart hd f hf hr h
+  have hbase : Function.Injective (algebraMap R A) := by
+    intro x y hxy
+    apply away_algebraMap_injective (S := S) ha
+    apply Polynomial.C_injective
+    simpa only [AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply] using congrArg e hxy
+  exact exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators hbase ha had hu hv
+
+end Intersection
+
+section RingCharts
+
+variable {R A S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [DecompositionMonoid R]
+  [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
+  [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
+  {a d : R} [IsLocalization.Away a S] [IsLocalization.Away d T]
+
+/-- Ring-homomorphism interface for actual quotient charts.  The commuting
+squares are explicit, so callers do not have to install an algebra structure
+on the hypersurface over its polynomial coefficient subring. -/
+theorem exists_base_of_two_ring_charts
+    (ι : R →+* A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
+    (e : A →+* Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
+    (f : A →+* Polynomial T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
+    (heBase : ∀ r, e (ι r) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap R S r))
+    (hfBase : ∀ r, f (ι r) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap R T r))
+    {q : A} {v : S} {w : T}
+    (hq : e q = Polynomial.C v) (hq' : f q = Polynomial.C w) :
+    ∃ t : R, ι t = q := by

+/-!
+# Constant coefficients forced by a locally nilpotent derivation on a chart
+
+This is the complete one-chart part of the §5 rigidity argument.  Starting
+with a locally nilpotent derivation of `A`, not with an assumed derivation on
+the chart, we localize at an invariant element, transport through a polynomial
+chart, and enlarge the coefficient ring to its localization.  The one-variable
+LND theorem then forces a vertical coefficient to be constant on the chart.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ChartLNDConstant
+
+open Polynomial LocalizationLND
+
+variable {k R A L S : Type*}
+  [CommRing k] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing L] [CommRing S]
+  [Algebra k R] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k L] [Algebra k S]
+  [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower k A L]
+  [Algebra R S]
+  [IsDomain S] [CharZero S]
+  (i : R →ₐ[k] A) (a : R)
+  [IsLocalization.Away (i a) L] [IsLocalization.Away a S]
+
+/-- A chart coordinate coefficient is constant if it occurs in the derivative
+of the polynomial chart variable, multiplied by the inverted coefficient.
+All localization, transport, scalar-linearity, and nilpotence obligations are
+proved from the original derivation and the displayed chart identities. -/
+theorem chart_coefficient_eq_C
+    (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hD : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) x = 0)
+    (hi : ∀ r : R, D (i r) = 0)
+    (e : L ≃ₐ[k] S[X])
+    (he : ∀ r : R, e (algebraMap A L (i r)) = C (algebraMap R S r))
+    (b q : A)
+    (hb : e (algebraMap A L b) = X)
+    (hDb : D b = i a * q) :
+    e (algebraMap A L q) = C ((e (algebraMap A L q)).coeff 0) := by
+  have hden : ∀ m : Submonoid.powers (i a), D (m : A) = 0 := by
+    rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
+    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff m (i a)).mp hm
+    simp only [Derivation.leibniz_pow, hi a, smul_zero]
+  let DL : Derivation k L L :=
+    localizeTo D (Submonoid.powers (i a)) hden L
+  let E : Derivation k S[X] S[X] := transport DL e
+  have hEmap (x : A) :
+      E (e (algebraMap A L x)) = e (algebraMap A L (D x)) := by
+    dsimp only [E, DL]
+    rw [transport_apply, localizeTo_algebraMap]
+  have hELND : ∀ p : S[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((E : S[X] → S[X])^[n]) p = 0 :=
+    transport_locallyNilpotent DL e
+      (localizeTo_locallyNilpotent D (Submonoid.powers (i a)) hden L hD)
+  have hEC : ∀ s : S, E (C s) = 0 := by
+    apply DerivationScalarUpgrade.annihilates_localization
+      (Submonoid.powers a) E (C : S →+* S[X])
+    intro r
+    rw [← he r, hEmap, hi, map_zero, map_zero]
+  let ES : Derivation S S[X] S[X] := DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade E hEC
+  have hESLND : ∀ p : S[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((ES : S[X] → S[X])^[n]) p = 0 :=
+    DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade_locallyNilpotent E hEC hELND
+  have hESX : ES X = C (algebraMap R S a) * e (algebraMap A L q) := by
+    change E X = _
+    rw [← hb, hEmap, hDb, map_mul, map_mul, he]
+  have hconst := UnivariateLND.apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent ES hESLND
+  rw [hESX, coeff_C_mul, C_mul] at hconst
+  exact ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S) a).map
+    (C : S →+* S[X])).mul_left_cancel hconst
+
+/-- Existential form of the chart-constant conclusion. -/
+theorem exists_chart_coefficient
+    (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hD : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) x = 0)
+    (hi : ∀ r : R, D (i r) = 0)
+    (e : L ≃ₐ[k] S[X])
+    (he : ∀ r : R, e (algebraMap A L (i r)) = C (algebraMap R S r))
+    (b q : A)
+    (hb : e (algebraMap A L b) = X)
+    (hDb : D b = i a * q) :
+    ∃ s : S, e (algebraMap A L q) = C s :=
+  ⟨_, chart_coefficient_eq_C i a D hD hi e he b q hb hDb⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate.ChartLNDConstant
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Polynomial additive actions: invariants and scalar automorphisms
+
+Additional interfaces for the genuine two-parameter polynomial coaction from
+`CoactionLND`: coefficient-law construction, scalar specializations as algebra
+automorphisms, pointwise invariants, and characteristic-zero uniqueness.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+namespace StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction
+open Polynomial
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Construct an additive algebraic action from the coefficient identities of
+the actual two-parameter additive group law. -/
+def ofCoeffLaw (φ : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
+    (hzero : ∀ a, (φ a).coeff 0 = a)
+    (hadd : ∀ a m n, (φ ((φ a).coeff n)).coeff m =
+      (m + n).choose m • (φ a).coeff (m + n)) : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A where
+  toAlgHom := φ
+  identity := hzero
+  coassoc a := by
+    ext n m
+    rw [coeff_map, coeff_universal_translate, hasseDeriv_coeff]
+    simpa only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
+      Nat.choose_symm_add, nsmul_eq_mul] using hadd a m n
+
+section Specialization
+
+/-- Evaluate the additive action at a scalar parameter. -/
+noncomputable def specialize (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) : A →ₐ[k] A :=
+  (Polynomial.eval₂AlgHom (AlgHom.id k A) (algebraMap k A t)
+    (fun _ => Commute.all _ _)).comp ρ.toAlgHom
+
+@[simp] theorem specialize_apply (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) (a : A) :
+    ρ.specialize t a = (ρ.toAlgHom a).eval (algebraMap k A t) := by
+  simp [specialize, Polynomial.eval₂AlgHom_apply]
+
+/-- Applying a scalar specialization to coefficients translates the action
+parameter by that scalar. -/
+theorem map_specialize (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) (a : A) :
+    (ρ.toAlgHom a).map (ρ.specialize t).toRingHom =
+      taylor (algebraMap k A t) (ρ.toAlgHom a) := by
+  have he : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap k A t)).comp
+      ρ.toAlgHom.toRingHom = (ρ.specialize t).toRingHom := by
+    ext b
+    simp [specialize_apply]
+  have hc : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap k A t)).comp
+      (C : A →+* A[X]) = RingHom.id A := by
+    ext b
+    simp
+  have h := congrArg (Polynomial.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap k A t)))
+    (ρ.coassoc a)
+  simpa only [map_map, he, map_taylor, coe_evalRingHom, eval_X, hc, map_id] using h
+
+@[simp] theorem specialize_zero (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (a : A) :
+    ρ.specialize 0 a = a := by
+  simp [specialize_apply, ← coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, ρ.identity]
+
+/-- The two-parameter polynomial group law specializes to the group law on
+algebra automorphisms. -/
+theorem specialize_add (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (s t : k) (a : A) :
+    ρ.specialize s (ρ.specialize t a) = ρ.specialize (s + t) a := by
+  have h := Polynomial.eval_map_apply (ρ.specialize s).toRingHom
+    (p := ρ.toAlgHom a) (algebraMap k A t)
+  rw [ρ.map_specialize, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
+    AlgHom.commutes, taylor_eval] at h
+  simpa only [specialize_apply, map_add, add_comm] using h.symm
+
+/-- An algebraic additive coaction gives genuine algebra automorphisms at
+all scalar parameters, with inverse parameter `-t`. -/
+noncomputable def specializeEquiv (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) : A ≃ₐ[k] A :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (ρ.specialize t) (ρ.specialize (-t))
+    (by
+      ext a
+      change ρ.specialize t (ρ.specialize (-t) a) = a
+      rw [ρ.specialize_add, add_neg_cancel, ρ.specialize_zero])
+    (by
+      ext a
+      change ρ.specialize (-t) (ρ.specialize t a) = a
+      rw [ρ.specialize_add, neg_add_cancel, ρ.specialize_zero])
+
+@[simp] theorem specializeEquiv_apply (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) (a : A) :
+    ρ.specializeEquiv t a = ρ.specialize t a := rfl
+
+end Specialization
+
+section Invariants
+
+variable [IsDomain A] [CharZero A]
+
+/-- In characteristic zero, the kernel of the infinitesimal derivation is
+exactly the ring of invariants of the algebraic additive action. -/
+theorem invariant_iff_derivation_eq_zero (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (a : A) :
+    ρ.toAlgHom a = C a ↔ ρ.derivation a = 0 := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    simp [derivation_apply, h]
+  · intro h
+    ext n
+    by_cases hn : n = 0
+    · subst n
+      simp [ρ.identity]
+    · rw [coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn]
+      have hz : (ρ.derivation : A → A)^[n] a = 0 := by
+        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
+        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, h]
+        exact Function.iterate_fixed (map_zero ρ.derivation) m
+      rw [ρ.iterate_derivation, nsmul_eq_mul] at hz
+      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
+
+/-- Over a characteristic-zero domain the infinitesimal derivation determines
+an additive polynomial coaction. -/
+theorem toAlgHom_eq_of_derivation_eq (ρ σ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A)
+    (h : ρ.derivation = σ.derivation) : ρ.toAlgHom = σ.toAlgHom := by
+  ext a n
+  have hi : n.factorial • (ρ.toAlgHom a).coeff n =
+      n.factorial • (σ.toAlgHom a).coeff n := by
+    rw [← ρ.iterate_derivation, ← σ.iterate_derivation, h]
+  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul] at hi
+  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n) hi
+
+end Invariants
+
+end StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+

+/-!
+# Coassociativity on the image of an equivariant base algebra
+
+An arbitrary polynomial family extending a genuine additive action on a base
+algebra already satisfies the action law on that base image.  This lemma is
+used before the determinant-frame uniqueness argument: it supplies equality
+of the three base products of the two candidate composite frames.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.CoactionLND
+
+open Polynomial
+
+variable {k B A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing B] [CommRing A]
+  [Algebra k B] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Universal Taylor translation commutes with change of coefficient ring. -/
+theorem universal_translate_map (p : B[X]) (i : B →+* A) :
+    (taylor (X : B[X]) (p.map (C : B →+* B[X]))).map (mapRingHom i) =
+      taylor (X : A[X]) ((p.map i).map (C : A →+* A[X])) := by
+  rw [map_taylor]
+  have hX : mapRingHom i (X : B[X]) = (X : A[X]) := map_X i
+  rw [hX]
+  congr 1
+  rw [map_map, map_map]
+  congr 1
+  apply RingHom.ext
+  intro b
+  simp
+
+/-- Coassociativity transfers to the image of the base under any polynomial
+family extending an actual base action.  No group law or normalization for
+`β` is assumed. -/
+theorem coassoc_on_image_of_extension
+    (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k B) (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) (i : B →ₐ[k] A)
+    (hβ : ∀ b, β (i b) = (α.toAlgHom b).map i.toRingHom) (b : B) :
+    (β (i b)).map β.toRingHom =
+      taylor (X : A[X]) ((β (i b)).map (C : A →+* A[X])) := by
+  have hmaps : β.toRingHom.comp i.toRingHom =
+      (mapRingHom i.toRingHom).comp α.toAlgHom.toRingHom := by
+    apply RingHom.ext
+    intro b
+    exact hβ b
+  calc
+    (β (i b)).map β.toRingHom =
+        ((α.toAlgHom b).map i.toRingHom).map β.toRingHom := by rw [hβ]
+    _ = ((α.toAlgHom b).map α.toAlgHom.toRingHom).map (mapRingHom i.toRingHom) := by
+      rw [map_map, map_map, hmaps]
+    _ = (taylor (X : B[X]) ((α.toAlgHom b).map (C : B →+* B[X]))).map
+        (mapRingHom i.toRingHom) := by rw [α.coassoc]
+    _ = taylor (X : A[X]) (((α.toAlgHom b).map i.toRingHom).map
+        (C : A →+* A[X])) := universal_translate_map _ _
+    _ = taylor (X : A[X]) ((β (i b)).map (C : A →+* A[X])) := by rw [hβ]
+
+end StableCoordinate.CoactionLND
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Differentiating polynomial additive actions
+
+This file supplies the algebraic additive-action to locally nilpotent derivation
+interface used when the line-bundle lift is restricted to its punctured total
+space.  The action law is an equality of bivariate polynomials, not a merely
+pointwise identity.  No reducedness or characteristic-zero hypothesis is needed
+for the forward implication.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.CoactionLND
+
+open Polynomial
+
+variable (k A : Type*) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- A polynomial additive-group action on an affine algebra, in contravariant
+form. In `coassoc`, the outer polynomial variable is the second parameter and
+the inner variable is the first parameter. -/
+structure PolynomialAdditiveAction where
+  toAlgHom : A →ₐ[k] A[X]
+  identity : ∀ a, (toAlgHom a).coeff 0 = a
+  coassoc : ∀ a,
+    (toAlgHom a).map toAlgHom.toRingHom =
+      taylor (X : A[X]) ((toAlgHom a).map (C : A →+* A[X]))
+
+variable {k A}
+
+/-- Hasse derivatives commute with coefficient homomorphisms. -/
+lemma hasseDeriv_map {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
+    (p : A[X]) (n : ℕ) :
+    hasseDeriv n (p.map f) = (hasseDeriv n p).map f := by
+  ext j
+  simp only [hasseDeriv_coeff, coeff_map, map_mul, map_natCast]
+
+/-- Reading the outer coefficient of the universal translate gives a Hasse
+ derivative in the inner variable. -/
+lemma coeff_universal_translate (p : A[X]) (n : ℕ) :
+    (taylor (X : A[X]) (p.map (C : A →+* A[X]))).coeff n =
+      hasseDeriv n p := by
+  rw [taylor_coeff, hasseDeriv_map, eval_map, eval₂_C_X]
+
+namespace PolynomialAdditiveAction
+
+variable (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A)
+
+/-- The coefficient of the action parameter is its infinitesimal derivation. -/
+def derivation : Derivation k A A where
+  toFun a := (α.toAlgHom a).coeff 1
+  map_add' a b := by simp
+  map_smul' r a := by simp
+  map_one_eq_zero' := by simp [coeff_one]
+  leibniz' a b := by
+    change (α.toAlgHom (a * b)).coeff 1 = a • (α.toAlgHom b).coeff 1 + b • (α.toAlgHom a).coeff 1
+    simp only [map_mul, mul_coeff_one, α.identity, smul_eq_mul]
+    ring
+
+@[simp] theorem derivation_apply (a : A) :
+    α.derivation a = (α.toAlgHom a).coeff 1 := rfl
+
+/-- Coassociativity written coefficientwise. -/
+theorem action_coeff (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
+    α.toAlgHom ((α.toAlgHom a).coeff n) = hasseDeriv n (α.toAlgHom a) := by
+  simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_universal_translate, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom] using
+    congrArg (fun p : A[X][X] => p.coeff n) (α.coassoc a)
+
+/-- The infinitesimal action advances action coefficients by one index. -/
+theorem derivation_coeff (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
+    α.derivation ((α.toAlgHom a).coeff n) =
+      (n + 1) • (α.toAlgHom a).coeff (n + 1) := by
+  rw [derivation_apply, α.action_coeff, hasseDeriv_coeff]
+  simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.choose_succ_self_right, nsmul_eq_mul]
+
+/-- The iterates are factorial multiples of action coefficients. -/
+theorem iterate_derivation (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
+    (α.derivation : A → A)^[n] a = n.factorial • (α.toAlgHom a).coeff n := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp [α.identity]
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_nsmul, α.derivation_coeff,
+      smul_smul, Nat.factorial_succ]
+    rw [Nat.mul_comm]
+
+/-- An algebraic additive action differentiates to a locally nilpotent
+ derivation; its action polynomial gives an explicit nilpotence bound. -/
+theorem iterate_derivation_eq_zero (a : A) :
+    (α.derivation : A → A)^[(α.toAlgHom a).natDegree + 1] a = 0 := by
+  rw [α.iterate_derivation, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self _),
+    smul_zero]
+
+/-- Pointwise local nilpotence in the common interface used by the project. -/
+theorem locallyNilpotent : ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, (α.derivation : A → A)^[n] a = 0 :=
+  fun a => ⟨_, α.iterate_derivation_eq_zero a⟩
+
+/-- In characteristic zero over a domain, a vanishing infinitesimal action
+ forces the entire polynomial action to be trivial. -/
+theorem action_eq_C_of_derivation_eq_zero [NoZeroDivisors A] [CharZero A]
+    (h : α.derivation = 0) (a : A) : α.toAlgHom a = C a := by
+  ext n
+  cases n with
+  | zero => simp [α.identity]
+  | succ n =>
+    have hc := α.derivation_coeff a n
+    rw [h, Derivation.zero_apply] at hc
+    have hn : (n + 1 : A) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
+    have hz : (α.toAlgHom a).coeff (n + 1) = 0 := by
+      apply (mul_eq_zero.mp ?_).resolve_left hn
+      simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hc.symm
+    simpa using hz
+
+/-- A nontrivial polynomial additive action has a nonzero infinitesimal
+ derivation in characteristic zero over a domain. -/
+theorem derivation_ne_zero_of_nontrivial [NoZeroDivisors A] [CharZero A]
+    (h : ∃ a, α.toAlgHom a ≠ C a) : α.derivation ≠ 0 := by
+  intro hzero
+  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
+  exact ha (α.action_eq_C_of_derivation_eq_zero hzero a)
+
+/-- Equivariance of additive actions differentiates to equivariance of their
+ derivations.  In particular, a lifted action differentiates to an extension
+ of the original derivation. -/
+theorem derivation_naturality {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
+    (β : PolynomialAdditiveAction k B) (f : A →ₐ[k] B)
+    (hf : ∀ a, β.toAlgHom (f a) = (α.toAlgHom a).map f.toRingHom) (a : A) :
+    β.derivation (f a) = f (α.derivation a) := by
+  simp only [derivation_apply, hf, coeff_map, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
+    AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]
+
+/-- An injective equivariant algebra extension preserves nontriviality of the
+ infinitesimal derivation. -/
+theorem derivation_ne_zero_of_injective {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
+    (β : PolynomialAdditiveAction k B) (f : A →ₐ[k] B)
+    (hf : ∀ a, β.toAlgHom (f a) = (α.toAlgHom a).map f.toRingHom)
+    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (hα : α.derivation ≠ 0) : β.derivation ≠ 0 := by
+  intro hβ
+  apply hα
+  ext a
+  apply hinj
+  have h := α.derivation_naturality β f hf a
+  rw [hβ, Derivation.zero_apply] at h
+  simpa using h.symm
+
+end PolynomialAdditiveAction
+
+end StableCoordinate.CoactionLND
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Degrees
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Derivations obtained from polynomial coordinate systems
+
+The first step of §3 of the manuscript chooses a partial derivative in a
+coordinate distinct from the distinguished coordinate and a positive-degree
+invariant.  This file supplies the algebraic part of that choice: partial
+derivatives of multivariate polynomials are locally nilpotent, and this
+property, nonvanishing, and the values on coordinates transport through an
+actual algebra equivalence.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+section Partial
+
+variable {k σ : Type*} [CommSemiring k]
+
+/-- A coefficient vanishes once the number of differentiations exceeds the
+available exponent in the chosen variable. -/
+theorem coeff_iterate_pderiv_eq_zero (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (n : ℕ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (h : p.degreeOf i < m i + n) :
+    (((pderiv i : Derivation k (MvPolynomial σ k)
+      (MvPolynomial σ k)) : MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k)^[n] p).coeff m = 0 := by
+  classical
+  induction n generalizing m with
+  | zero =>
+      simp only [Nat.add_zero] at *
+      by_contra hn
+      exact (not_lt_of_ge (monomial_le_degreeOf i (mem_support_iff.mpr hn))) h
+  | succ n ih =>
+      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', coeff_pderiv]
+      have hm : p.degreeOf i < (m + Finsupp.single i 1 : σ →₀ ℕ) i + n := by
+        simpa only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] using
+          (show p.degreeOf i < m i + 1 + n by omega)
+      rw [ih _ hm, zero_mul]
+
+/-- Multivariate partial derivatives are pointwise locally nilpotent, over an
+arbitrary commutative coefficient semiring. -/
+theorem pderiv_locallyNilpotent (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    ∃ n : ℕ, (((pderiv i : Derivation k (MvPolynomial σ k)
+      (MvPolynomial σ k)) : MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k)^[n]) p = 0 := by
+  refine ⟨p.degreeOf i + 1, ?_⟩
+  ext m
+  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero]
+  apply coeff_iterate_pderiv_eq_zero
+  omega
+
+end Partial
+
+section Transport
+
+variable {k A B : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B]
+  [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
+
+/-- Transport of a derivation through an algebra equivalence. -/
+def transport (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) : Derivation k B B where
+  toLinearMap := e.toLinearMap.comp (D.toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearMap)
+  map_one_eq_zero' := by simp
+  leibniz' a b := by
+    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply, map_mul,
+      Derivation.coeFn_coe, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, map_add,
+      AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
+
+@[simp] theorem transport_apply (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (b : B) :
+    transport e D b = e (D (e.symm b)) := rfl
+
+/-- Iterating a transported derivation is conjugate to iterating the original
+one.  In particular, no fixed bound on the nilpotence index is assumed. -/
+theorem transport_iterate (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (b : B) :
+    ((transport e D : B → B)^[n]) b = e (((D : A → A)^[n]) (e.symm b)) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih => simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
+
+/-- Pointwise local nilpotence is invariant under an algebra equivalence. -/
+theorem transport_locallyNilpotent (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
+    ∀ b, ∃ n : ℕ, ((transport e D : B → B)^[n]) b = 0 := by
+  intro b
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD (e.symm b)
+  exact ⟨n, by rw [transport_iterate, hn, map_zero]⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem transport_apply_image (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (a : A) :
+    transport e D (e a) = e (D a) := by simp
+
+/-- Transport does not turn a nonzero derivation into zero. -/
+theorem transport_ne_zero (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    transport e D ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  apply hD
+  ext a
+  have ha := congrArg (fun E : Derivation k B B => E (e a)) h
+  simpa using e.injective (by simpa using ha)
+
+end Transport
+
+section Coordinates
+
+variable {k σ A : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [CommSemiring A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Partial differentiation in a specified member of a polynomial coordinate
+system, expressed intrinsically on the target algebra. -/
+def coordinatePartial (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i : σ) : Derivation k A A :=
+  transport e (pderiv i)
+
+@[simp] theorem coordinatePartial_self (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i : σ) :
+    coordinatePartial e i (e (X i)) = 1 := by
+  simp [coordinatePartial]
+
+@[simp] theorem coordinatePartial_other (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A)
+    {i j : σ} (h : j ≠ i) : coordinatePartial e i (e (X j)) = 0 := by
+  simp [coordinatePartial, pderiv_X_of_ne h]
+
+theorem coordinatePartial_locallyNilpotent (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i : σ) :
+    ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((coordinatePartial e i : A → A)^[n]) a = 0 :=
+  transport_locallyNilpotent e (pderiv i) (pderiv_locallyNilpotent i)
+
+theorem coordinatePartial_ne_zero [Nontrivial A]
+    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i : σ) : coordinatePartial e i ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hi := congrArg (fun D : Derivation k A A => D (e (X i))) h
+  simp at hi
+
+/-- In a polynomial coordinate system, any coordinate can be differentiated
+while two distinct other coordinates remain invariant. -/
+theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_killing_two [Nontrivial A]
+    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i j l : σ) (hji : j ≠ i) (hli : l ≠ i) :
+    ∃ D : Derivation k A A, D ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
+      D (e (X j)) = 0 ∧ D (e (X l)) = 0 := by
+  exact ⟨coordinatePartial e i, coordinatePartial_ne_zero e i,
+    coordinatePartial_locallyNilpotent e i,
+    coordinatePartial_other e hji, coordinatePartial_other e hli⟩
+
+/-- A proper subalgebra cannot contain every member of a polynomial coordinate
+system.  For the manuscript this subalgebra is the degree-at-most-zero part of
+the multiplicative integer filtration. -/
+theorem exists_coordinate_not_mem (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A)
+    (S : Subalgebra k A) (hS : S ≠ ⊤) : ∃ j, e (X j) ∉ S := by
+  classical
+  by_contra h
+  have hX : ∀ j, e (X j) ∈ S := by simpa only [not_exists, not_not] using h
+  apply hS
+  apply top_unique
+  intro a ha
+  clear ha
+  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := e.surjective a
+  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
+  | C r =>
+      change e (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial σ k) r) ∈ S
+      rw [e.commutes]
+      exact S.algebraMap_mem r
+  | add p q hp hq => simpa using S.add_mem hp hq
+  | mul_X p j hp => simpa using S.mul_mem hp (hX j)
+
+/-- The exact algebraic choice at the start of the coordinate obstruction:
+if the distinguished coordinate lies in a proper subalgebra of a polynomial
+ring of dimension at least three, a nonzero locally nilpotent derivation
+kills both that coordinate and a coordinate outside the subalgebra. -/
+theorem exists_lnd_invariant_outside [Nontrivial A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n)
+    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (S : Subalgebra k A)
+    (hS : S ≠ ⊤) (i : Fin n) (hi : e (X i) ∈ S) :
+    ∃ D : Derivation k A A, D ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ a, ∃ r : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[r]) a = 0) ∧
+      D (e (X i)) = 0 ∧ ∃ j : Fin n, j ≠ i ∧ e (X j) ∉ S ∧ D (e (X j)) = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_coordinate_not_mem e S hS
+  have hji : j ≠ i := by
+    intro h
+    apply hj
+    simpa [h] using hi
+  obtain ⟨l, hli, hlj⟩ := Fin.exists_ne_and_ne_of_two_lt i j hn
+  refine ⟨coordinatePartial e l, coordinatePartial_ne_zero e l,
+    coordinatePartial_locallyNilpotent e l, coordinatePartial_other e hli.symm,
+    j, hji, hj, coordinatePartial_other e hlj.symm⟩
+
+end Coordinates
+
+end StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FilteredReesDerivation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FiltrationDerivationShift
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# A coordinate system produces a leading locally nilpotent derivation
+
+This is the first half of the source's coordinate obstruction, through the
+construction of a nonzero homogeneous locally nilpotent derivation on the
+actual associated graded ring.  Its distinguished invariant has negative
+degree; its second invariant has strictly positive degree and is nonzero.
+The derivation and its shift are constructed, not postulated.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- The degree-at-most-zero part of a multiplicative integer filtration is a
+subalgebra. -/
+def degreeZeroSubalgebra (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] :
+    Subalgebra k A where
+  carrier := F 0
+  zero_mem' := (F 0).zero_mem
+  one_mem' := SetLike.one_mem_graded F
+  add_mem' := (F 0).add_mem
+  mul_mem' ha hb := by
+    change _ ∈ F 0
+    exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded ha hb
+  algebraMap_mem' r := by
+    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
+    exact (F 0).smul_mem r (SetLike.one_mem_graded F)
+
+@[simp] theorem mem_degreeZeroSubalgebra
+    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (a : A) :
+    a ∈ degreeZeroSubalgebra F ↔ a ∈ F 0 := Iff.rfl
+
+/-- A nonzero positive-degree initial form witnesses that the degree-zero
+subalgebra is proper.  This lets a presentation of the graded ring supply the
+properness input without a separate argument about coordinates. -/
+theorem degreeZeroSubalgebra_ne_top_of_initial_ne_zero
+    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (hmono : Monotone F)
+    {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (a : F d)
+    (ha : initial F hmono d a ≠ 0) : degreeZeroSubalgebra F ≠ ⊤ := by
+  intro htop
+  have ha0 : (a : A) ∈ F 0 := by
+    change (a : A) ∈ degreeZeroSubalgebra F
+    rw [htop]
+    trivial
+  exact ha ((initial_eq_zero_iff F hmono d a).mpr
+    (hmono (by omega : 0 ≤ d - 1) ha0))
+
+/-- A nonzero locally nilpotent derivation on a separated five-generator
+presentation has an actual nonzero homogeneous leading derivation.  All
+invariant initial forms remain invariant. -/
+theorem exists_leading_lnd
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, Filtration.imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
+    (hln : ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
+    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
+      δ ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
+      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
+        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
+          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
+      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
+        D a = 0 → δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0) := by
+  obtain ⟨m, i, _, _, hDi, hshift⟩ :=
+    Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift φ hφ hsep D hD
+  let shift : ∀ d (a : A), a ∈ Filtration.imagePiece φ d →
+      D a ∈ Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m) := fun d a ha => hshift d ha
+  refine ⟨m, gradedDerivation _ D m shift (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ), ?_,
+    gradedDerivation_locallyNilpotent _ D m shift _ hln, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact gradedDerivation_ne_zero _ D m shift _
+      (Filtration.monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
+      ⟨φ (X i), Filtration.image_monomial_mem φ (Finsupp.single i 1) 1⟩ hDi
+  · intro d a
+    exact ⟨⟨D a, shift d a a.property⟩,
+      gradedDerivation_initial _ D m shift _ d a⟩
+  · intro d a ha
+    exact gradedDerivation_initial_eq_zero _ D m shift _ d a ha
+
+/-- A nonzero element outside the degree-zero part has a nonzero initial form
+of strictly positive integer degree. -/
+theorem exists_positive_initial
+    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hext : ∀ a : A, ∃ d : ℤ, a ∈ F d) (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, F d) = ⊥)
+    {a : A} (ha : a ∉ F 0) :
+    ∃ (d : ℤ) (hd : a ∈ F d), 0 < d ∧
+      initial F hmono d ⟨a, hd⟩ ≠ 0 := by
+  have hane : a ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    exact ha (h ▸ (F 0).zero_mem)
+  obtain ⟨d, hd, hprev⟩ := IntegerFiltration.exists_initial_index
+    (fun d => (F d : Set A)) (fun _ _ h => hmono h) hext
+    (IntegerFiltration.separated_of_iInf_eq_bot F hsep) hane
+  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
+    by_contra hn
+    exact ha (hmono (by omega : d ≤ 0) hd)
+  exact ⟨d, hd, hdpos, fun h => hprev ((initial_eq_zero_iff F hmono d _).mp h)⟩
+
+/-- The first obstruction step for a polynomial coordinate system containing
+the distinguished negative-weight generator.  It supplies, on the actual
+Rees associated graded ring, a nonzero homogeneous locally nilpotent derivation
+annihilating that generator's initial form and a nonzero positive-degree
+initial form. -/
+theorem coordinate_produces_leading_lnd
+    [Nontrivial A]
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, Filtration.imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
+    (hproper : degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) ≠ ⊤)
+    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (hp : e (X 0) = φ (X 0)) :
+    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
+      δ ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
+      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
+        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
+          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
+      δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (-1)
+        ⟨φ (X 0), Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ⟩) = 0 ∧
+      ∃ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d), 0 < d ∧
+        initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a ≠ 0 ∧ δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0 := by
+  have hp0 : e (X 0) ∈ degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) := by
+    rw [hp]
+    exact Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ (by decide : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ 0)
+      (Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ)
+  obtain ⟨D, hD, hln, hDp, j, _, hj, hDj⟩ :=
+    CoordinateDerivation.exists_lnd_invariant_outside (by decide : 2 < 4)
+      e (degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ)) hproper 0 hp0
+  obtain ⟨m, δ, hδ, hδln, hhom, hinv⟩ := exists_leading_lnd φ hφ hsep D hD hln
+  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdpos, hinit⟩ := exists_positive_initial
+    (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ)
+    (Filtration.exists_mem_imagePiece φ hφ) hsep hj
+  refine ⟨m, δ, hδ, hδln, hhom, ?_, d, ⟨e (X j), hd⟩, hdpos, hinit, ?_⟩
+  · apply hinv
+    simpa only [hp] using hDp
+  · exact hinv d ⟨e (X j), hd⟩ hDj
+
+/-- In the noetherian-domain source setting, separation is a proved consequence
+of the nonunit negative-weight generator, not an extra obstruction assumption. -/
+theorem coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_nonunit
+    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (hpunit : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0)))
+    (hproper : degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) ≠ ⊤)
+    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (hp : e (X 0) = φ (X 0)) :
+    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
+      δ ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
+      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
+        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
+          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
+      δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (-1)
+        ⟨φ (X 0), Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ⟩) = 0 ∧
+      ∃ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d), 0 < d ∧
+        initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a ≠ 0 ∧ δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0 :=
+  coordinate_produces_leading_lnd φ hφ
+    (Filtration.iInf_imagePiece_eq_bot φ hpunit) hproper e hp
+
+/-- When coordinates are supplied, the noetherian-domain and nonunit facts
+required for separation follow from that coordinate equivalence.  Thus the
+only filtration input still needed is properness of its degree-zero part,
+which the graded-presentation theorem supplies. -/
+theorem coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_noetherian_domain
+    [IsNoetherianRing k] [IsDomain k]
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (hproper : degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) ≠ ⊤)
+    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (hp : e (X 0) = φ (X 0)) :
+    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
+      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
+      δ ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
+      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
+        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
+          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) =
+            initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
+      δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (-1)
+        ⟨φ (X 0), Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ⟩) = 0 ∧
+      ∃ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d), 0 < d ∧
+        initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a ≠ 0 ∧
+        δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0 := by
+  let : IsDomain A := Function.Injective.isDomain e.symm.toRingHom e.symm.injective
+  let : IsNoetherianRing A :=
+    isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) e.toRingEquiv
+  have hpunit : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0)) := by
+    intro hu
+    have hX : IsUnit (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) := by
+      have hu' := hu.map e.symm
+      simpa only [← hp, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hu'
+    exact not_isUnit_zero (by simpa only [eval_X] using hX.map (eval (fun _ => (0 : k))))
+  exact coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_nonunit φ hφ hpunit hproper e hp
+
+end StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+end OAI

+/-!
+# The source-coordinate hypothesis gives the actual quadric obstruction data
+
+This assembles Section 3 with its literal polynomial input.  The associated
+graded ring, its integer grading, the leading derivation, the Laurent
+extension, and the positive center-ideal numerator are all concrete proved
+constructions imported above.  The only hypothesis in the final theorem is
+the coordinate hypothesis which the subsequent rigidity argument refutes.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.CoordinateToQuadric
+
+open MvPolynomial Obstruction
+
+/-- Over any field, a coordinate system on the source algebra with first
+coordinate `p` produces a nonzero LND and nonzero invariant in the actual
+quadric-center ideal. -/
+theorem source_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd
+    (k : Type*) [Field k]
+    (e : P k 4 ≃ₐ[k] A k) (hp : e (X 0) = aX k 0) :
+    ∃ E : Derivation k (B k) (B k),
+      IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
+      ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨m, D, hDne, hD, hshift, hpD, d, η, hd, hη, hηne, hDη⟩ :=
+    ReesToDegeneration.coordinate_produces_degeneration_lnd k e hp
+  exact SourceInvariant.exists_quadric_lnd_invariant D m hshift hD hDne hpD
+    hd hη hηne hDη
+
+/-- The literal degree-five polynomial's unrestricted four-variable coordinate
+hypothesis produces precisely the obstruction data on `B` and `I`. -/
+theorem f_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd
+    (hf : IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) StableCoordinate.f) :
+    ∃ E : Derivation ℂ (B ℂ) (B ℂ),
+      IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
+      ∃ h : B ℂ, h ∈ I ℂ ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨e, hp⟩ := source_coordinate_system_of_f_coordinate hf
+  exact source_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd ℂ e hp
+
+end StableCoordinate.CoordinateToQuadric
+
+end

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.CommRing
+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Degrees
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations
+import Mathlib.Basic.Complex.Basic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The four-variable complex polynomial
+
+Variables are zero-indexed internally: `X 0, X 1, X 2, X 3` mean the
+paper's `x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄`.  The stabilization uses `Fin.castSucc`,
+so its fifth independent variable is `X 4`; no subring-preservation condition
+is imposed on its automorphism.
+
+Affine fibers are encoded by their complex coordinate algebras, not by sets.
+An algebra equivalence to the three-variable polynomial algebra is precisely
+the algebraic affine-space conclusion.  Rectifiability is encoded by the
+ambient algebra automorphism carrying the defining ideal to `(X 0)`.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+abbrev R (n : ℕ) := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ
+
+noncomputable def Q : R 4 :=
+  X 1 ^ 2 - X 3 ^ 2 + X 0 * X 2
+
+noncomputable def f : R 4 :=
+  X 0 - 2 * Q * (Q * (X 1 + X 3) + X 0 * X 3)
+
+/-- A coordinate is sent to the first variable by some complex algebra automorphism. -/
+def IsCoordinate {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (g : R n) : Prop :=
+  ∃ φ : R n ≃ₐ[ℂ] R n, φ g = X ⟨0, hn⟩
+
+/-- Adjoin one independent variable; the original variables retain their indices. -/
+noncomputable def stabilize : R 4 →ₐ[ℂ] R 5 :=
+  rename (Fin.castSucc : Fin 4 → Fin 5)
+
+/-- No requirement to preserve the original four-variable subring is imposed. -/
+def IsOneStableCoordinate (g : R 4) : Prop :=
+  ∃ φ : R 5 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 5, φ (stabilize g) = X 0
+
+noncomputable def fiberIdeal (t : ℂ) : Ideal (R 4) :=
+  Ideal.span ({f - C t} : Set (R 4))
+
+abbrev FiberRing (t : ℂ) := R 4 ⧸ fiberIdeal t
+
+/-- An isomorphism of affine coordinate algebras, not a set-theoretic bijection. -/
+def IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber (t : ℂ) : Prop :=
+  Nonempty (FiberRing t ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 3)
+
+/-- Algebraic rectifiability of the closed hypersurface embedding. -/
+def IsRectifiableFiber (t : ℂ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ φ : R 4 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 4,
+    Ideal.map φ.toRingHom (fiberIdeal t) = Ideal.span ({X 0} : Set (R 4))
+
+/-- Complete first principal group, with the advertised exact total degree. -/
+def PolynomialPackage : Prop :=
+  f.totalDegree = 5 ∧
+  IsOneStableCoordinate f ∧
+  ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f
+
+/-- Complete second principal group, universally including the zero fiber. -/
+def FiberPackage : Prop :=
+  ∀ t : ℂ, IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t ∧ ¬ IsRectifiableFiber t
+
+/-- Both principal groups must be proved together, without additional hypotheses. -/
+def PrincipalPackage : Prop := PolynomialPackage ∧ FiberPackage
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Basic
+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Basic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Enlarging the coefficient ring of a derivation
+
+For the two polynomial charts in Section 5, a derivation annihilating the
+coefficient ring can be regarded as linear over that ring.  The second lemma
+shows that annihilation of the original coefficient algebra implies
+annihilation of its localization, so this upgrade introduces no new condition.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace DerivationScalarUpgrade
+
+variable {k A S : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [CommRing S]
+  [Algebra k A] [Algebra S A]
+
+/-- View a derivation as linear over any coefficient algebra that it kills. -/
+def upgrade (D : Derivation k A A) (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0) :
+    Derivation S A A where
+  toFun := D
+  map_add' := D.map_add
+  map_smul' s a := by
+    simp [Algebra.smul_def, hS]
+  map_one_eq_zero' := D.map_one_eq_zero
+  leibniz' := D.leibniz
+
+@[simp] theorem upgrade_apply (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0) (a : A) :
+    upgrade D hS a = D a := rfl
+
+/-- Changing coefficient rings does not change the iterated function. -/
+theorem upgrade_iterate (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
+    (upgrade D hS : A → A)^[n] a = (D : A → A)^[n] a := rfl
+
+/-- Local nilpotence survives the coefficient-ring upgrade. -/
+theorem upgrade_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0)
+    (hD : ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
+    ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (upgrade D hS : A → A)^[n] a = 0 := hD
+
+/-- A nonzero derivation remains nonzero after upgrading its coefficient ring. -/
+theorem upgrade_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    upgrade D hS ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  apply hD
+  ext a
+  exact congrArg (fun (E : Derivation S A A) => E a) h
+
+/-- It suffices to check invariance of the images of polynomial generators. -/
+theorem annihilates_mvPolynomial {σ : Type*} (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A)
+    (hX : ∀ j : σ, D (φ (MvPolynomial.X j)) = 0) :
+    ∀ p : MvPolynomial σ k, D (φ p) = 0 := by
+  intro p
+  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
+  | C r =>
+    rw [show MvPolynomial.C r = algebraMap k (MvPolynomial σ k) r from rfl,
+      AlgHom.commutes, D.map_algebraMap]
+  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq, add_zero]
+  | mul_X p j hp =>
+    simp only [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, hX, hp, smul_zero, add_zero]
+
+section Localization
+
+variable {R L : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing L] [Algebra R L]
+variable (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M L]
+
+include M
+
+/-- If a derivation kills the image of the original coefficient algebra,
+it also kills the image of its entire localization. -/
+theorem annihilates_localization (D : Derivation k A A) (φ : L →+* A)
+    (hR : ∀ r : R, D (φ (algebraMap R L r)) = 0) :
+    ∀ l : L, D (φ l) = 0 := by
+  intro l
+  obtain ⟨⟨r, m⟩, hm⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M l
+  have hd := congrArg D (congrArg φ hm)
+  simp only [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, hR, smul_eq_mul,
+    mul_zero, zero_add] at hd
+  exact ((IsLocalization.map_units L m).map φ).mul_right_eq_zero.mp hd
+
+end Localization
+
+end DerivationScalarUpgrade
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.GradedAlgebra.Basic
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# A maximal degree shift detected on finitely many algebra generators
+
+For an integer-graded algebra, the values of a derivation on finitely many
+generators have only finitely many homogeneous components.  Thus a nonzero
+derivation has a maximal degree shift which is attained on a generator.
+These lemmas supply the finite-support step in the leading-derivation
+construction of Sections 3 and 5 of the supplied manuscript.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace DerivationTopShift
+
+open DirectSum GradedAlgebra
+
+variable {k A ι : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+variable (𝒜 : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜]
+
+/-- A nonzero element of an internally graded algebra has a nonzero
+homogeneous projection. -/
+theorem exists_proj_ne_zero {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ j : ℤ, proj 𝒜 j a ≠ 0 := by
+  classical
+  by_contra! h
+  apply ha
+  apply (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜).injective
+  ext j
+  simpa using h j
+
+/-- A nonzero derivation cannot vanish on all algebra generators. -/
+theorem exists_generator_ne_zero (g : ι → A)
+    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ i, D (g i) ≠ 0 := by
+  by_contra! h
+  apply hD
+  apply Derivation.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (Set.range g) hg
+  intro a ha
+  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
+  simpa using h i
+
+variable [Fintype ι]
+
+/-- Finitely many generator images admit a maximal degree shift, and for a
+nonzero derivation the maximum is attained.  No sign restriction is imposed
+on generator degrees or on the resulting shift. -/
+theorem exists_maximal_generator_shift (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
+    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ m : ℤ,
+      (∀ i j, d i + m < j → proj 𝒜 j (D (g i)) = 0) ∧
+      (∃ i, proj 𝒜 (d i + m) (D (g i)) ≠ 0) := by
+  classical
+  let S : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.biUnion fun i =>
+    ((DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (D (g i))).support).image (fun j => j - d i)
+  have memS (i : ι) (j : ℤ) (hj : proj 𝒜 j (D (g i)) ≠ 0) : j - d i ∈ S := by
+    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
+    refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
+    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
+    exact ⟨j, (GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 _ _).mpr hj, rfl⟩
+  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
+    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_generator_ne_zero g hg D hD
+    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_proj_ne_zero 𝒜 hi
+    exact ⟨j - d i, memS i j hj⟩
+  refine ⟨S.max' hS, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro i j hj
+    by_contra hne
+    have hle := Finset.le_max' S (j - d i) (memS i j hne)
+    omega
+  · have hm : S.max' hS ∈ S := Finset.max'_mem S hS
+    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hm
+    obtain ⟨j, hj, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
+    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
+    have hidx : d i + S.max' hS = j := by omega
+    rw [hidx]
+    exact (GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 _ _).mp hj
+
+
+/-- For a family of homogeneous component derivations, vanishing outside the
+finite shift support can be tested solely on algebra generators. -/
+theorem exists_maximal_component (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
+    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
+    (E : ℤ → Derivation k A A)
+    (hE : ∀ m i, E m (g i) = proj 𝒜 (d i + m) (D (g i))) :
+    ∃ m : ℤ, E m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ n, m < n → E n = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨m, hbound, i, hi⟩ := exists_maximal_generator_shift 𝒜 g d hg D hD
+  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro hzero
+    apply hi
+    rw [← hE, hzero]
+    rfl
+  · intro n hn
+    apply Derivation.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (Set.range g) hg
+    intro a ha
+    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
+    rw [hE]
+    exact hbound i (d i + n) (by omega)
+
+/-- Once homogeneous components are constructed, finite algebra generation
+provides a single upper degree-shift bound on every homogeneous input, with
+an attained nonzero top derivation.  This is the hypothesis needed for the
+leading-component local-nilpotence argument. -/
+theorem exists_top_component_and_global_bound
+    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
+    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
+    (E : ℤ → Derivation k A A)
+    (hE : ∀ m i (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i →
+      E m x = proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x)) :
+    ∃ m : ℤ, E m ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ n, m < n → E n = 0) ∧
+      (∀ i (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i → ∀ j, i + m < j → proj 𝒜 j (D x) = 0) := by
+  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_component 𝒜 g d hg D hD E
+    (fun m i => hE m (d i) (g i) (hhom i))
+  refine ⟨m, hm, hmax, ?_⟩
+  intro i x hx j hj
+  have heq := hE (j - i) i x hx
+  have hz := hmax (j - i) (by omega)
+  rw [hz] at heq
+  have hidx : i + (j - i) = j := by omega
+  rw [hidx] at heq
+  exact heq.symm
+
+end DerivationTopShift
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+polynomial algebra homomorphism on the determinant quotient. -/

+    (α : C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (C k))

+      DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (generator k i)).coeff m) =
+        AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Obstruction.fiberWeight i)
+          ((α (generator k i)).coeff m)) :

+    (hα : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (m : ℕ),

+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 ((α (d k)).coeff m))
+    (hb : ∀ m, DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (b k)).coeff m) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) ((α (b k)).coeff m))

+abbrev Chart (i : Fin 3) := Polynomial (BaseAway k i)
+abbrev AwayA := Localization.Away (a k)
