+
+noncomputable def chartVariable (i j : Fin 3) : Chart k i :=
+  Polynomial.C (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k i) (X j))
+noncomputable def chartInverse (i : Fin 3) : Chart k i :=
+  Polynomial.C (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (X i : Base k))
+
+@[simp] theorem chartVariable_mul_inverse (i : Fin 3) :
+    chartVariable k i i * chartInverse k i = 1 := by
+  rw [chartVariable, chartInverse, ← map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]
+
+theorem chartVariable_isUnit (i : Fin 3) : IsUnit (chartVariable k i i) :=
+  isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨chartInverse k i, chartVariable_mul_inverse k i⟩
+
+noncomputable def chartMapA : C k →ₐ[k] Chart k 0 :=
+  lift (chartVariable k 0 0) (chartVariable k 0 1) Polynomial.X
+    (chartInverse k 0 * (1 + Polynomial.X * chartVariable k 0 1))
+    (chartVariable k 0 2) (by
+      calc
+        _ = (chartVariable k 0 0 * chartInverse k 0) *
+            (1 + Polynomial.X * chartVariable k 0 1) -
+            Polynomial.X * chartVariable k 0 1 := by ring
+        _ = 1 := by rw [chartVariable_mul_inverse]; ring)
+
+@[simp] theorem chartMapA_a : chartMapA k (a k) = chartVariable k 0 0 := by
+  simp [chartMapA]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapA_d : chartMapA k (d k) = chartVariable k 0 1 := by
+  simp [chartMapA]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapA_b : chartMapA k (b k) = Polynomial.X := by
+  simp [chartMapA]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapA_c : chartMapA k (c k) =
+    chartInverse k 0 * (1 + Polynomial.X * chartVariable k 0 1) := by
+  simp [chartMapA]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapA_u : chartMapA k (u k) = chartVariable k 0 2 := by
+  simp [chartMapA]
+
+noncomputable def toChartA : AwayA k →ₐ[k] Chart k 0 :=
+  IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom (a k)
+    (show IsUnit (chartMapA k (a k)) by rw [chartMapA_a]; exact chartVariable_isUnit k 0)
+
+@[simp] theorem toChartA_algebraMap (r : C k) :
+    toChartA k (algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) r) = chartMapA k r := by
+  simp [toChartA, IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply]
+
+noncomputable def baseToAwayA : Base k →ₐ[k] AwayA k :=
+  (Algebra.algHom k (C k) (AwayA k)).comp baseMap
+
+@[simp] theorem baseToAwayA_X0 : baseToAwayA k (X 0) =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (a k) := by simp [baseToAwayA, Algebra.algHom]
+@[simp] theorem baseToAwayA_X1 : baseToAwayA k (X 1) =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (d k) := by simp [baseToAwayA, Algebra.algHom]
+@[simp] theorem baseToAwayA_X2 : baseToAwayA k (X 2) =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (u k) := by simp [baseToAwayA, Algebra.algHom]
+
+noncomputable def coefficientFromChartA : BaseAway k 0 →ₐ[k] AwayA k :=
+  IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom (X 0 : Base k)
+    (show IsUnit (baseToAwayA k (X 0)) by
+      rw [baseToAwayA_X0]
+      exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (a k))
+
+@[simp] theorem coefficientFromChartA_algebraMap (r : Base k) :
+    coefficientFromChartA k (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 0) r) = baseToAwayA k r := by
+  simp [coefficientFromChartA, IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply]
+
+noncomputable def fromChartA : Chart k 0 →ₐ[k] AwayA k :=
+  Polynomial.aevalTower (coefficientFromChartA k) (algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (b k))
+
+@[simp] theorem fromChartA_X : fromChartA k Polynomial.X =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (b k) := by simp [fromChartA]
+@[simp] theorem fromChartA_C (r : BaseAway k 0) :
+    fromChartA k (Polynomial.C r) = coefficientFromChartA k r := by simp [fromChartA]
+@[simp] theorem fromChartA_variable (i : Fin 3) :
+    fromChartA k (chartVariable k 0 i) = baseToAwayA k (X i) := by
+  simp [chartVariable]
+
+private theorem map_invSelf_eq {R S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
+    [Algebra R S] (r : R) [IsLocalization.Away r S] (f : S →+* T) (y : T)
+    (hy : f (algebraMap R S r) * y = 1) :
+    f (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf r) = y := by
+  apply ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit r).map f).mul_left_cancel
+  rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one, hy]
+
+@[simp] theorem fromChartA_inverse :
+    fromChartA k (chartInverse k 0) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k) := by
+  rw [chartInverse, fromChartA_C]
+  apply map_invSelf_eq (X 0 : Base k) (coefficientFromChartA k).toRingHom
+  change coefficientFromChartA k (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 0) (X 0)) *
+    IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k) = 1
+  simp
+
+@[simp] theorem toChartA_inverse :
+    toChartA k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k)) = chartInverse k 0 := by
+  apply map_invSelf_eq (a k) (toChartA k).toRingHom
+  change toChartA k (algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (a k)) * chartInverse k 0 = 1
+  simp
+
+theorem localized_c : algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (c k) =
+    IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k) *
+      (1 + algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (b k) * algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (d k)) := by
+  apply (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (a k)).mul_left_cancel
+  rw [← mul_assoc, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, one_mul]
+  have h := congrArg (algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k)) (determinant_relation k)
+  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_one] at h
+  linear_combination h
+
+theorem fromChartA_comp_toChartA :
+    (fromChartA k).comp (toChartA k) = AlgHom.id k (AwayA k) := by
+  apply IsLocalization.algHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (a k))
+  apply hom_ext <;> simp [Algebra.algHom, localized_c]
+
+theorem toChartA_comp_fromChartA :
+    (toChartA k).comp (fromChartA k) = AlgHom.id k (Chart k 0) := by
+  apply Polynomial.algHom_ext'
+  · apply IsLocalization.algHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (X 0 : Base k))
+    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+    intro i
+    fin_cases i <;> simp [Algebra.algHom, chartVariable]
+  · simp
+
+/-- The actual algebra equivalence `C[a⁻¹] ≃ k[a,a⁻¹,d,u][b]`. -/
+noncomputable def chartEquivA : AwayA k ≃ₐ[k] Chart k 0 :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (toChartA k) (fromChartA k)
+    (toChartA_comp_fromChartA k) (fromChartA_comp_toChartA k)
+
+noncomputable def chartMapD : C k →ₐ[k] Chart k 1 :=
+  lift (chartVariable k 1 0) (chartVariable k 1 1)
+    (chartInverse k 1 * (chartVariable k 1 0 * Polynomial.X - 1))
+    Polynomial.X (chartVariable k 1 2) (by
+      calc
+        _ = chartVariable k 1 0 * Polynomial.X -
+            (chartVariable k 1 1 * chartInverse k 1) *
+            (chartVariable k 1 0 * Polynomial.X - 1) := by ring
+        _ = 1 := by rw [chartVariable_mul_inverse]; ring)
+
+@[simp] theorem chartMapD_a : chartMapD k (a k) = chartVariable k 1 0 := by
+  simp [chartMapD]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapD_d : chartMapD k (d k) = chartVariable k 1 1 := by
+  simp [chartMapD]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapD_b : chartMapD k (b k) =
+    chartInverse k 1 * (chartVariable k 1 0 * Polynomial.X - 1) := by
+  simp [chartMapD]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapD_c : chartMapD k (c k) = Polynomial.X := by
+  simp [chartMapD]
+@[simp] theorem chartMapD_u : chartMapD k (u k) = chartVariable k 1 2 := by
+  simp [chartMapD]
+
+noncomputable def toChartD : AwayD k →ₐ[k] Chart k 1 :=
+  IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom (d k)
+    (show IsUnit (chartMapD k (d k)) by rw [chartMapD_d]; exact chartVariable_isUnit k 1)
+
+@[simp] theorem toChartD_algebraMap (r : C k) :
+    toChartD k (algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) r) = chartMapD k r := by
+  simp [toChartD, IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply]
+
+noncomputable def baseToAwayD : Base k →ₐ[k] AwayD k :=
+  (Algebra.algHom k (C k) (AwayD k)).comp baseMap
+
+@[simp] theorem baseToAwayD_X0 : baseToAwayD k (X 0) =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (a k) := by simp [baseToAwayD, Algebra.algHom]
+@[simp] theorem baseToAwayD_X1 : baseToAwayD k (X 1) =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (d k) := by simp [baseToAwayD, Algebra.algHom]
+@[simp] theorem baseToAwayD_X2 : baseToAwayD k (X 2) =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (u k) := by simp [baseToAwayD, Algebra.algHom]
+
+noncomputable def coefficientFromChartD : BaseAway k 1 →ₐ[k] AwayD k :=
+  IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom (X 1 : Base k)
+    (show IsUnit (baseToAwayD k (X 1)) by
+      rw [baseToAwayD_X1]
+      exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (d k))
+
+@[simp] theorem coefficientFromChartD_algebraMap (r : Base k) :
+    coefficientFromChartD k (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 1) r) = baseToAwayD k r := by
+  simp [coefficientFromChartD, IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply]
+
+noncomputable def fromChartD : Chart k 1 →ₐ[k] AwayD k :=
+  Polynomial.aevalTower (coefficientFromChartD k) (algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (c k))
+
+@[simp] theorem fromChartD_X : fromChartD k Polynomial.X =
+    algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (c k) := by simp [fromChartD]
+@[simp] theorem fromChartD_C (r : BaseAway k 1) :
+    fromChartD k (Polynomial.C r) = coefficientFromChartD k r := by simp [fromChartD]
+@[simp] theorem fromChartD_variable (i : Fin 3) :
+    fromChartD k (chartVariable k 1 i) = baseToAwayD k (X i) := by
+  simp [chartVariable]
+
+@[simp] theorem fromChartD_inverse :
+    fromChartD k (chartInverse k 1) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (d k) := by
+  rw [chartInverse, fromChartD_C]
+  apply map_invSelf_eq (X 1 : Base k) (coefficientFromChartD k).toRingHom
+  change coefficientFromChartD k (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 1) (X 1)) *
+    IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (d k) = 1
+  simp
+
+@[simp] theorem toChartD_inverse :
+    toChartD k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (d k)) = chartInverse k 1 := by
+  apply map_invSelf_eq (d k) (toChartD k).toRingHom
+  change toChartD k (algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (d k)) * chartInverse k 1 = 1
+  simp
+
+theorem localized_b : algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (b k) =
+    IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (d k) *
+      (algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (a k) * algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k) (c k) - 1) := by
+  apply (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (d k)).mul_left_cancel
+  rw [← mul_assoc, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, one_mul]
+  have h := congrArg (algebraMap (C k) (AwayD k)) (determinant_relation k)
+  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_one] at h
+  linear_combination -h
+
+theorem fromChartD_comp_toChartD :
+    (fromChartD k).comp (toChartD k) = AlgHom.id k (AwayD k) := by
+  apply IsLocalization.algHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (d k))
+  apply hom_ext <;> simp [Algebra.algHom, localized_b]
+
+theorem toChartD_comp_fromChartD :
+    (toChartD k).comp (fromChartD k) = AlgHom.id k (Chart k 1) := by
+  apply Polynomial.algHom_ext'
+  · apply IsLocalization.algHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (X 1 : Base k))
+    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+    intro i
+    fin_cases i <;> simp [Algebra.algHom, chartVariable]
+  · simp
+
+/-- The actual algebra equivalence `C[d⁻¹] ≃ k[a,d,d⁻¹,u][c]`. -/
+noncomputable def chartEquivD : AwayD k ≃ₐ[k] Chart k 1 :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (toChartD k) (fromChartD k)
+    (toChartD_comp_fromChartD k) (fromChartD_comp_toChartD k)
+
+theorem chartMapA_comp_baseMap :
+    (chartMapA k).comp baseMap =
+      (Polynomial.CAlgHom : BaseAway k 0 →ₐ[k] Chart k 0).comp
+        (Algebra.algHom k (Base k) (BaseAway k 0)) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [baseMap, chartVariable, Algebra.algHom]
+
+theorem chartMapD_comp_baseMap :
+    (chartMapD k).comp baseMap =
+      (Polynomial.CAlgHom : BaseAway k 1 →ₐ[k] Chart k 1).comp
+        (Algebra.algHom k (Base k) (BaseAway k 1)) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [baseMap, chartVariable, Algebra.algHom]
+
+@[simp] theorem chartMapA_baseMap (r : Base k) :
+    chartMapA k (baseMap r) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 0) r) := by
+  exact AlgHom.congr_fun (chartMapA_comp_baseMap k) r
+
+@[simp] theorem chartMapD_baseMap (r : Base k) :
+    chartMapD k (baseMap r) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 1) r) := by
+  exact AlgHom.congr_fun (chartMapD_comp_baseMap k) r
+
+/-- Algebraic independence of `a,d,u` in the determinant quotient. -/
+theorem baseMap_injective [IsDomain k] : Function.Injective (baseMap (k := k)) := by
+  intro r s h
+  have h' := congrArg (chartMapA k) h
+  simp only [chartMapA_baseMap] at h'
+  apply IsLocalization.injective (BaseAway k 0)
+    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 3)))
+  exact Polynomial.C_injective h'
+
+/-- Compatibility with the actual polynomial coefficient algebra. -/
+noncomputable def chartMapAOverBase : C k →ₐ[Base k] Chart k 0 where
+  __ := (chartMapA k).toRingHom
+  commutes' r := chartMapA_baseMap k r
+
+/-- Compatibility with the actual polynomial coefficient algebra. -/
+noncomputable def chartMapDOverBase : C k →ₐ[Base k] Chart k 1 where
+  __ := (chartMapD k).toRingHom
+  commutes' r := chartMapD_baseMap k r
+
+noncomputable instance coefficientAlgebraA : Algebra (BaseAway k 0) (AwayA k) :=
+  (coefficientFromChartA k).toRingHom.toAlgebra
+noncomputable instance coefficientAlgebraD : Algebra (BaseAway k 1) (AwayD k) :=
+  (coefficientFromChartD k).toRingHom.toAlgebra
+
+instance coefficientScalarTowerA : IsScalarTower k (BaseAway k 0) (AwayA k) :=
+  IsScalarTower.of_algHom (coefficientFromChartA k)
+instance coefficientScalarTowerD : IsScalarTower k (BaseAway k 1) (AwayD k) :=
+  IsScalarTower.of_algHom (coefficientFromChartD k)
+
+instance baseCoefficientScalarTowerA : IsScalarTower (Base k) (BaseAway k 0) (AwayA k) := by
+  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
+  intro r
+  change algebraMap (Base k) (AwayA k) r =
+    coefficientFromChartA k (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 0) r)
+  rw [coefficientFromChartA_algebraMap]
+  rfl
+
+instance baseCoefficientScalarTowerD : IsScalarTower (Base k) (BaseAway k 1) (AwayD k) := by
+  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
+  intro r
+  change algebraMap (Base k) (AwayD k) r =
+    coefficientFromChartD k (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 1) r)
+  rw [coefficientFromChartD_algebraMap]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The a-chart equivalence, over its full localized coefficient ring. -/
+noncomputable def chartEquivAOverCoefficients : AwayA k ≃ₐ[BaseAway k 0] Chart k 0 where
+  __ := (chartEquivA k).toRingEquiv
+  commutes' r := by
+    change toChartA k (coefficientFromChartA k r) = Polynomial.C r
+    have h := AlgHom.congr_fun (toChartA_comp_fromChartA k) (Polynomial.C r)
+    simpa using h
+
+/-- The d-chart equivalence, over its full localized coefficient ring. -/
+noncomputable def chartEquivDOverCoefficients : AwayD k ≃ₐ[BaseAway k 1] Chart k 1 where
+  __ := (chartEquivD k).toRingEquiv
+  commutes' r := by
+    change toChartD k (coefficientFromChartD k r) = Polynomial.C r
+    have h := AlgHom.congr_fun (toChartD_comp_fromChartD k) (Polynomial.C r)
+    simpa using h
+
+/-- Chart injectivity follows from the domain property, not an assumed chart inclusion. -/
+theorem chartMapA_injective [IsDomain k] [IsDomain (C k)] :
+    Function.Injective (chartMapA k) := by
+  have ha : a k ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    apply MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 3) (R := k)
+    apply baseMap_injective k
+    simpa using h
+  intro r s h
+  apply IsLocalization.injective (AwayA k) (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors ha)
+  apply (chartEquivA k).injective
+  change toChartA k _ = toChartA k _
+  simpa using h
+
+/-- Chart injectivity follows from the domain property, not an assumed chart inclusion. -/
+theorem chartMapD_injective [IsDomain k] [IsDomain (C k)] :
+    Function.Injective (chartMapD k) := by
+  have hd : d k ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    apply MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (1 : Fin 3) (R := k)
+    apply baseMap_injective k
+    simpa using h
+  intro r s h
+  apply IsLocalization.injective (AwayD k) (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)
+  apply (chartEquivD k).injective
+  change toChartD k _ = toChartD k _
+  simpa using h
+
+end StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Domain properties of the two concrete auxiliary rings
+
+The determinant equation and the quadric relation are irreducible primitive
+linear polynomials in one of their variables.  This file proves their
+principal ideals prime, and hence the corresponding affine coordinate rings
+are domains, over every unique factorization domain.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+namespace StableCoordinate.DeterminantDomain
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k] [IsDomain k] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid k]
+
+/-- Variables are ordered `a,d,b,c,u`. -/
+def determinantRelation : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k :=
+  X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1
+
+/-- Variables are ordered `x,y,z,u`. -/
+def quadricRelation : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k :=
+  X 0 * X 1 - X 2 * (X 2 + 1)
+
+omit [UniqueFactorizationMonoid k] in
+theorem determinantRelation_irreducible : Irreducible (determinantRelation k) := by
+  have hrel : IsRelPrime (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k)
+      (-(X 2 * X 1 + 1)) := by
+    apply (X_prime.irreducible).isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
+    intro h
+    have he := map_dvd (eval (fun _ : Fin 5 => (0 : k))) h
+    simp at he
+  have hvars : (3 : Fin 5) ∉ (-(X 2 * X 1 + 1) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k).vars := by
+    intro hv
+    rw [vars_neg] at hv
+    have hs := vars_add_subset (X 2 * X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) 1 hv
+    have hm : (3 : Fin 5) ∉ (X 2 * X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k).vars := by
+      intro h
+      have h := vars_mul (X 2 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (X 1) h
+      simp at h
+    simp [hm] at hs
+  have h := irreducible_mul_X_add (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k)
+    (-(X 2 * X 1 + 1)) 3 (X_ne_zero 0) (by simp) hvars hrel
+  convert h using 1
+  simp only [determinantRelation]
+  ring
+
+omit [UniqueFactorizationMonoid k] in
+theorem quadricRelation_irreducible : Irreducible (quadricRelation k) := by
+  have hrel : IsRelPrime (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k)
+      (-(X 2 * (X 2 + 1))) := by
+    apply (X_prime.irreducible).isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
+    intro h
+    have h : (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) ∣ X 2 * (X 2 + 1) := by
+      simpa using h
+    rcases X_prime.dvd_mul.mp h with h | h
+    · simp [X_dvd_X] at h
+    · have he := map_dvd (eval (fun _ : Fin 4 => (0 : k))) h
+      simp at he
+  have hvars : (1 : Fin 4) ∉ (-(X 2 * (X 2 + 1)) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k).vars := by
+    intro hv
+    rw [vars_neg] at hv
+    have hm := vars_mul (X 2 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) (X 2 + 1) hv
+    have ha : (1 : Fin 4) ∉ (X 2 + 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k).vars := by
+      intro h
+      have h := vars_add_subset (X 2 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) 1 h
+      simp at h
+    simp [ha] at hm
+  simpa only [quadricRelation, sub_eq_add_neg] using
+    irreducible_mul_X_add (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k)
+      (-(X 2 * (X 2 + 1))) 1 (X_ne_zero 0) (by simp) hvars hrel
+
+/-- The actual determinant hypersurface ideal is prime. -/
+theorem determinantIdeal_isPrime :
+    (Ideal.span {determinantRelation k}).IsPrime :=
+  Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (determinantRelation_irreducible k).prime
+
+/-- The actual quadric hypersurface ideal is prime. -/
+theorem quadricIdeal_isPrime :
+    (Ideal.span {quadricRelation k}).IsPrime :=
+  Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (quadricRelation_irreducible k).prime
+
+/-- Coordinate ring of the determinant hypersurface, ordered `a,d,b,c,u`. -/
+abbrev DeterminantRing :=
+  MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k ⧸ Ideal.span {determinantRelation k}
+
+/-- Coordinate ring of the quadric times the `u`-line, ordered `x,y,z,u`. -/
+abbrev QuadricRing :=
+  MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ⧸ Ideal.span {quadricRelation k}
+
+instance determinantRing_isDomain : IsDomain (DeterminantRing k) :=
+  (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mpr (determinantIdeal_isPrime k)
+
+instance quadricRing_isDomain : IsDomain (QuadricRing k) :=
+  (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mpr (quadricIdeal_isPrime k)
+
+end StableCoordinate.DeterminantDomain
+
+end

+/-!
+# The final elementary step of determinant rigidity
+

+by a single coefficient.  Preservation of the actual fiber grading makes that
+coefficient have weight `-2`.  If it lies in the polynomial base, whose weights
+are nonnegative, it vanishes; so does the derivation.  The coefficient's
+polynomiality is supplied separately by the locally nilpotent chart argument.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing
+

+
+/-- The actual weight obstruction annihilates every vertical derivation whose
+coefficient is polynomial in the base variables. -/
+theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_fixed_base_and_coefficient_mem
+    (D : Derivation k (C k) (C k))
+    (ha : D (a k) = 0) (hd : D (d k) = 0) (hu : D (u k) = 0)
+    (hgraded : ∀ n : ℤ, ∀ x ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n,
+      D x ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n)
+    (hq : rigidityCoefficient D (b k) (c k) ∈ (baseMap (k := k)).range) :
+    D = 0 := by
+  have hb : b k ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1) := by
+    change Obstruction.cX k 2 ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1)
+    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using Obstruction.cX_mem_fiberPiece k 2
+  have hc : c k ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1) := by
+    change Obstruction.cX k 3 ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1)
+    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using Obstruction.cX_mem_fiberPiece k 3
+  have hzero : rigidityCoefficient D (b k) (c k) = 0 :=
+    DeterminantGradedObstruction.coefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_baseRange k

+  obtain ⟨hb', hc'⟩ := derivation_rigidityCoefficient D (a k) (d k) (b k) (c k)
+    (determinant_relation k) ha hd

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.DeterminantGradings
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Final weight obstruction in the constructed determinant grading
+
+This module connects the actual quotient grading to the Laurent proof of
+negative-weight vanishing.  The two independently defined quotient-ring
+interfaces are definitionally equal; no extra grading or injectivity
+hypothesis is imposed here.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace DeterminantGradedObstruction
+
+open DeterminantRing
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- A fiber-weight identity for the actual Laurent coaction is equivalent
+to membership in the constructed graded piece.  This also gives the
+converse needed after differentiating an equivariant additive action. -/
+theorem mem_fiberPiece_iff_fiberCoaction {q : C k} (n : ℤ) :
+    q ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n ↔
+      DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k q = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n q :=
+  HomogeneousQuotientWeight.mem_piece_iff_coaction Obstruction.fiberWeight
+    (relation k) (DeterminantWeights.relation_fiber_homogeneous k) n q
+
+/-- An element of the actual fiber-weight piece of negative degree cannot
+lie nontrivially in the polynomial subalgebra `k[a,d,u]`. -/
+theorem eq_zero_of_mem_baseRange_of_mem_fiberPiece {q : C k}
+    (hq : q ∈ (baseMap (k := k)).range) {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0)
+    (hg : q ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n) : q = 0 :=
+  DeterminantWeights.eq_zero_of_mem_baseRange_of_mem_homogeneous_piece k hq hn hg
+
+/-- A source-style weight-preserving derivation has coefficient
+`c*D(b)-b*D(c)` in fiber degree `-2`. -/
+theorem coefficient_mem_fiberPiece_neg_two {r s : C k}
+    (hr : r ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1))
+    (hs : s ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1)) :
+    c k * r - b k * s ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-2) := by
+  have hc : c k ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1) := by
+    change Obstruction.cX k 3 ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1)
+    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using Obstruction.cX_mem_fiberPiece k 3
+  have hb : b k ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1) := by
+    change Obstruction.cX k 2 ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1)
+    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using Obstruction.cX_mem_fiberPiece k 2
+  have hcr : c k * r ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-2) := by
+    exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded (R := Obstruction.C k) hc hr
+  have hbs : b k * s ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-2) := by
+    exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded (R := Obstruction.C k) hb hs
+  exact (Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-2)).sub_mem hcr hbs
+
+/-- The precise contradiction endpoint for the rigidity coefficient,
+without introducing a homogeneous-polynomial representative premise. -/
+theorem coefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_baseRange
+    {r s : C k} (hr : r ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1))
+    (hs : s ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1))
+    (hq : c k * r - b k * s ∈ (baseMap (k := k)).range) :
+    c k * r - b k * s = 0 := by
+  exact eq_zero_of_mem_baseRange_of_mem_fiberPiece k hq (by norm_num)
+    (coefficient_mem_fiberPiece_neg_two k hr hs)

+end DeterminantGradedObstruction
+end StableCoordinate

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ObstructionDefinitions
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.WeightedHomogeneous
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The two actual integer gradings on the determinant hypersurface
+
+The degrees are exactly the two rows in source equation `rig:gradings`.
+Both gradings are constructed on `C = k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac-bd-1)` by quotienting
+weighted polynomial gradings.  In particular, negative auxiliary and fiber
+degrees are retained.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- The weighted pieces on the five-variable polynomial presentation. -/
+abbrev polynomialPiece (w : Fin 5 → ℤ) : ℤ → Submodule k (P k 5) :=
+  MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w
+
+instance polynomialGrading (w : Fin 5 → ℤ) : GradedAlgebra (polynomialPiece k w) :=
+  MvPolynomial.weightedGradedAlgebra k w
+
+/-- The determinant relation is homogeneous whenever the products `ac` and
+`bd` both have degree zero. -/
+theorem determinantRelation_homogeneous (w : Fin 5 → ℤ)
+    (hac : w 0 + w 3 = 0) (hbd : w 2 + w 1 = 0) :
+    determinantRelation k ∈ polynomialPiece k w 0 := by
+  have hac' : (X 0 * X 3 : P k 5) ∈ polynomialPiece k w 0 := by
+    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule]
+    simpa only [hac] using
+      (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X k w 0).mul
+        (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X k w 3)
+  have hbd' : (X 2 * X 1 : P k 5) ∈ polynomialPiece k w 0 := by
+    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule]
+    simpa only [hbd] using
+      (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X k w 2).mul
+        (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X k w 1)
+  exact (polynomialPiece k w 0).sub_mem ((polynomialPiece k w 0).sub_mem hac' hbd')
+    (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_one k w)
+
+/-- Thus the whole defining ideal is homogeneous, not just its displayed generator. -/
+theorem idealC_homogeneous (w : Fin 5 → ℤ)
+    (hac : w 0 + w 3 = 0) (hbd : w 2 + w 1 = 0) :
+    (idealC k).IsHomogeneous (polynomialPiece k w) := by
+  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
+  intro p hp
+  rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp with rfl
+  exact ⟨0, determinantRelation_homogeneous k w hac hbd⟩
+
+/-- The induced weighted pieces in the determinant quotient. -/
+abbrev determinantPiece (w : Fin 5 → ℤ) : ℤ → Submodule k (C k) :=
+  HomogeneousQuotient.piece (polynomialPiece k w) (idealC k)
+
+/-- The quotient grading for any weight vector satisfying the two determinant constraints. -/
+@[implicit_reducible]
+def determinantGrading (w : Fin 5 → ℤ)
+    (hac : w 0 + w 3 = 0) (hbd : w 2 + w 1 = 0) :
+    GradedAlgebra (determinantPiece k w) :=
+  HomogeneousQuotient.gradedAlgebra (polynomialPiece k w) (idealC k)
+    (idealC_homogeneous k w hac hbd)
+
+/-- Actual auxiliary homogeneous pieces: `deg(a,d,b,c,u) = (0,1,-1,0,1)`. -/
+abbrev auxiliaryPiece : ℤ → Submodule k (C k) := determinantPiece k auxiliaryWeight
+/-- Actual fiber-weight pieces: `wt(a,d,b,c,u) = (1,1,-1,-1,0)`. -/
+abbrev fiberPiece : ℤ → Submodule k (C k) := determinantPiece k fiberWeight
+
+instance auxiliaryGrading : GradedAlgebra (auxiliaryPiece k) :=
+  determinantGrading k auxiliaryWeight (by decide) (by decide)
+
+instance fiberGrading : GradedAlgebra (fiberPiece k) :=
+  determinantGrading k fiberWeight (by decide) (by decide)
+
+/-- Every generator has its assigned auxiliary degree. -/
+theorem cX_mem_auxiliaryPiece (i : Fin 5) : cX k i ∈ auxiliaryPiece k (auxiliaryWeight i) :=
+  HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_piece (polynomialPiece k auxiliaryWeight) (idealC k)
+    (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X k auxiliaryWeight i)
+
+/-- Every generator has its assigned fiber weight. -/
+theorem cX_mem_fiberPiece (i : Fin 5) : cX k i ∈ fiberPiece k (fiberWeight i) :=
+  HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_piece (polynomialPiece k fiberWeight) (idealC k)
+    (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X k fiberWeight i)
+
+/-- The degree-minus-one part of the obstruction polynomial. -/
+def vLow : C k := cX k 0 ^ 3 * cX k 2
+/-- The degree-two part of the obstruction polynomial. -/
+def vHigh : C k := cX k 0 ^ 2 * cX k 4 ^ 2 - cX k 1 ^ 2
+
+theorem v_eq_low_add_high : v k = vLow k + vHigh k := by
+  simp only [v, vLow, vHigh, add_sub_assoc]
+
+/-- The lower term of `v` has auxiliary degree minus one. -/
+theorem vLow_mem_auxiliaryPiece : vLow k ∈ auxiliaryPiece k (-1) := by
+  simpa [auxiliaryWeight, vLow] using
+    SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 3 (cX_mem_auxiliaryPiece k 0))
+      (cX_mem_auxiliaryPiece k 2)
+
+/-- The difference of squares in `v` has auxiliary degree two. -/
+theorem vHigh_mem_auxiliaryPiece : vHigh k ∈ auxiliaryPiece k 2 := by
+  have hau : cX k 0 ^ 2 * cX k 4 ^ 2 ∈ auxiliaryPiece k 2 := by
+    simpa [auxiliaryWeight] using
+      SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (cX_mem_auxiliaryPiece k 0))
+        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (cX_mem_auxiliaryPiece k 4))
+  have hd : cX k 1 ^ 2 ∈ auxiliaryPiece k 2 := by
+    simpa [auxiliaryWeight] using SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (cX_mem_auxiliaryPiece k 1)
+  exact (auxiliaryPiece k 2).sub_mem hau hd
+
+/-- Both auxiliary parts have fiber weight two. -/
+theorem vLow_mem_fiberPiece : vLow k ∈ fiberPiece k 2 := by
+  simpa [fiberWeight, vLow] using
+    SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 3 (cX_mem_fiberPiece k 0))
+      (cX_mem_fiberPiece k 2)
+
+theorem vHigh_mem_fiberPiece : vHigh k ∈ fiberPiece k 2 := by
+  have hau : cX k 0 ^ 2 * cX k 4 ^ 2 ∈ fiberPiece k 2 := by
+    simpa [fiberWeight] using
+      SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (cX_mem_fiberPiece k 0))
+        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (cX_mem_fiberPiece k 4))
+  have hd : cX k 1 ^ 2 ∈ fiberPiece k 2 := by
+    simpa [fiberWeight] using SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (cX_mem_fiberPiece k 1)
+  exact (fiberPiece k 2).sub_mem hau hd
+
+/-- The full obstruction polynomial is homogeneous of fiber weight two. -/
+theorem v_mem_fiberPiece : v k ∈ fiberPiece k 2 := by
+  rw [v_eq_low_add_high]
+  exact (fiberPiece k 2).add_mem (vLow_mem_fiberPiece k) (vHigh_mem_fiberPiece k)
+
+/-- Its auxiliary degree-two projection is exactly the source's difference of squares. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem auxiliary_proj_v_two :
+    GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) 2 (v k) = vHigh k := by
+  rw [v_eq_low_add_high, map_add]
+  have hl : GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) 2 (vLow k) = 0 :=
+    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne (auxiliaryPiece k) (vLow_mem_auxiliaryPiece k) (by decide)
+  have hh : GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) 2 (vHigh k) = vHigh k :=
+    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same (auxiliaryPiece k) (vHigh_mem_auxiliaryPiece k)
+  rw [hl, hh, zero_add]
+
+/-- No other auxiliary degrees occur beyond the two explicitly listed parts. -/
+theorem auxiliary_proj_v_eq_zero (n : ℤ) (hnlow : (-1 : ℤ) ≠ n) (hnhigh : (2 : ℤ) ≠ n) :
+    GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) n (v k) = 0 := by
+  rw [v_eq_low_add_high, map_add]
+  have hl : GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) n (vLow k) = 0 :=
+    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne (auxiliaryPiece k) (vLow_mem_auxiliaryPiece k) hnlow
+  have hh : GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) n (vHigh k) = 0 :=
+    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne (auxiliaryPiece k) (vHigh_mem_auxiliaryPiece k) hnhigh
+  rw [hl, hh, zero_add]
+
+/-- Auxiliary projections commute with passage to the quotient. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem auxiliary_proj_mk (n : ℤ) (p : P k 5) :
+    GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k) p) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k) (weightedHomogeneousComponent auxiliaryWeight n p) := by
+  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k))
+    (MvPolynomial.decompose'_apply k auxiliaryWeight p n)
+
+/-- Fiber projections commute with passage to the quotient. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem fiber_proj_mk (n : ℤ) (p : P k 5) :
+    GradedAlgebra.proj (fiberPiece k) n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k) p) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k) (weightedHomogeneousComponent fiberWeight n p) := by
+  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k))
+    (MvPolynomial.decompose'_apply k fiberWeight p n)
+
+/-- Coefficientwise weighted projections for arbitrary weight vectors commute. -/
+theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_commute (w w' : Fin 5 → ℤ)
+    (m n : ℤ) (p : P k 5) :
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent w m (weightedHomogeneousComponent w' n p) =
+      weightedHomogeneousComponent w' n (weightedHomogeneousComponent w m p) := by
+  ext d
+  by_cases hm : Finsupp.weight w d = m <;>
+    by_cases hn : Finsupp.weight w' d = n <;>
+      simp only [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, hm, hn, ↓reduceIte]
+
+/-- The fiber and auxiliary gradings are compatible on the actual quotient:
+their homogeneous projection maps commute. -/
+theorem auxiliary_fiber_proj_commute (m n : ℤ) (z : C k) :
+    GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) m (GradedAlgebra.proj (fiberPiece k) n z) =
+      GradedAlgebra.proj (fiberPiece k) n (GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) m z) := by
+  refine Quotient.inductionOn' z ?_
+  intro p
+  change GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) m
+      (GradedAlgebra.proj (fiberPiece k) n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k) p)) =
+    GradedAlgebra.proj (fiberPiece k) n
+      (GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) m (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k) p))
+  simp only [auxiliary_proj_mk, fiber_proj_mk]
+  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealC k))
+    (weightedHomogeneousComponent_commute k auxiliaryWeight fiberWeight m n p)
+
+end StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.DeterminantCharts
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ObstructionDomains
+

+/-!
+# The actual coefficient-ring intersection for the determinant hypersurface
+
+This is the two-chart coefficient-membership step in source Section 5, now
+instantiated on the exact quotient `k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac-bd-1)`.  The chart maps,
+their injectivity, the domain property, and independence of `a,d,u` are all
+proved constructions.  No chart or domain assumption remains in the theorems.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [Field k]
+
+/-- If an element of the determinant ring is a coefficient in each of its two
+polynomial charts, it belongs to the actual polynomial subring `k[a,d,u]`. -/
+theorem exists_base_of_constant_charts {q : C k}
+    {v : BaseAway k 0} {w : BaseAway k 1}
+    (hA : chartMapA k q = Polynomial.C v)
+    (hD : chartMapD k q = Polynomial.C w) :
+    ∃ r : Base k, baseMap r = q := by
+  exact ChartIntersection.exists_base_of_two_ring_charts
+    (baseMap (k := k)).toRingHom (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 3))
+    (StableCoordinate.isRelPrime_X_of_ne (k := k) (i := (0 : Fin 3))
+      (j := (1 : Fin 3)) (by decide))
+    (chartMapA k).toRingHom (chartMapA_injective k)
+    (chartMapD k).toRingHom (chartMapD_injective k)
+    (chartMapA_baseMap k) (chartMapD_baseMap k) hA hD
+
+/-- Exact membership characterization, with both implications retained. -/
+theorem mem_range_baseMap_iff_constant_charts (q : C k) :
+    q ∈ Set.range (baseMap (k := k)) ↔
+      (∃ v : BaseAway k 0, chartMapA k q = Polynomial.C v) ∧
+      (∃ w : BaseAway k 1, chartMapD k q = Polynomial.C w) := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨⟨_, chartMapA_baseMap k r⟩, ⟨_, chartMapD_baseMap k r⟩⟩
+  · rintro ⟨⟨v, hA⟩, ⟨w, hD⟩⟩
+    exact exists_base_of_constant_charts k hA hD
+
+end StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing
+
+end OAI

+input is a nonzero locally nilpotent derivation on the concrete determinant
+quotient preserving fiber weights and killing the exact obstruction `v`.
+The output is a nonzero locally nilpotent derivation with the same fiber

+quotient; none is added to the conclusion as an unproved interface.
+-/

+/-- The actual leading-component reduction in the determinant quotient.

+and compatibility with the second grading retains the fiber weights.
+Factorial closure then splits the nonzero difference-of-squares factors.
+-/

+    (D : Derivation k (C k) (C k))
+    (hD : D ≠ 0) (hln : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
+    (hpres : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : C k), x ∈ fiberPiece k n → D x ∈ fiberPiece k n)
+    (hv : D (v k) = 0) :
+    ∃ E : Derivation k (C k) (C k), E ≠ 0 ∧ IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧
+      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : C k), x ∈ fiberPiece k n → E x ∈ fiberPiece k n) ∧
+      E (cX k 0) = 0 ∧ E (cX k 1) = 0 ∧ E (cX k 4) = 0 := by
+  let : IsDomain (C k) := by

+    infer_instance
+  let : CharZero (C k) := Algebra.charZero_of_charZero k (C k)
+  have hv' : D (vLow k + vHigh k) = 0 := by
+    rw [← v_eq_low_add_high]
+    exact hv
+  obtain ⟨m, hm, hnil, hcompatible, htop⟩ :=
+    LeadingComponent.exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_compatible
+      (auxiliaryPiece k) (fiberPiece k) (auxiliary_fiber_proj_commute k)
+      (cX k) auxiliaryWeight (adjoin_range_cX k) (cX_mem_auxiliaryPiece k)
+      D hD hln hpres (vLow_mem_auxiliaryPiece k) (vHigh_mem_auxiliaryPiece k)
+      (by decide : (-1 : ℤ) < 2) hv'
+  let E := LeadingComponent.component (auxiliaryPiece k) D m
+  have hfixed : E (cX k 0) = 0 ∧ E (cX k 1) = 0 ∧ E (cX k 4) = 0 :=
+    lnd_fixed_of_difference_of_squares E hnil
+      (cX_a_ne_zero k) (cX_u_ne_zero k)

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FrameScaling

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts

+
+/-!
+# Fiber-weight compatibility of normalized lifts on the determinant quotient
+
+This specializes normalized-frame uniqueness to the actual source rings and the
+actual Laurent fiber coaction.  A normalized polynomial lift extending a base
+polynomial family has the exact fiber weights coefficient by coefficient; no
+fiber-linearity or equivariance is assumed of the chosen lift.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+namespace StableCoordinate.DeterminantLiftWeights
+
+open Polynomial FrameLift DeterminantRing DeterminantWeights
+
+variable (k : Type*) [Field k]
+
+-- Fix the polynomial coefficient structure to the commutative-ring projection.
+-- It is definitionally the usual Laurent semiring, but this guides inference
+-- through Polynomial's semiring-indexed type.
+local instance laurentSemiring : Semiring (LaurentPolynomial (C k)) :=
+  (inferInstance : CommRing (LaurentPolynomial (C k))).toSemiring
+
+local instance determinantDomain : IsDomain (C k) :=
+  DeterminantDomain.determinantRing_isDomain k
+
+/-- The original determinant frame on `SL₂ × A¹`. -/
+def sourceFrame : Frame (C k) where
+  a := a k
+  d := d k
+  b := b k
+  c := c k
+  determinant := determinant_relation k
+
+/-- The invertible Laurent parameter of fiber scaling. -/
+def parameterUnit : (LaurentPolynomial (C k))ˣ where
+  val := LaurentPolynomial.T 1
+  inv := LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)
+  val_inv := by rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]; norm_num
+  inv_val := by rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]; norm_num
+
+/-- Constant Laurent polynomials as a base-algebra map. -/
+def constants : C k →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (C k) where
+  toRingHom := LaurentPolynomial.C
+  commutes' := by intro r; rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem constants_apply (r : C k) : constants k r = LaurentPolynomial.C r := rfl
+
+/-- The actual base-quadric inclusion; definitions agree with the chart API. -/
+abbrev quadricMap : BundleCharts.QuadricRing k →ₐ[k] C k := BundleCharts.baseMap k
+
+/-- The original source frame has the prescribed scaling, with no assumption. -/
+theorem sourceFrame_scales :
+    (sourceFrame k).map (fiberCoaction k).toRingHom =
+      Frame.scale (R := LaurentPolynomial (C k))
+        ((sourceFrame k).map (constants k).toRingHom) (parameterUnit k) := by
+  apply Frame.ext
+  · change fiberCoaction k (a k) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * LaurentPolynomial.C (a k)
+    rw [fiberCoaction_a, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
+    exact mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.C (a k)) (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)
+  · change fiberCoaction k (d k) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * LaurentPolynomial.C (d k)
+    rw [fiberCoaction_d, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
+    exact mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.C (d k)) (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)
+  · change fiberCoaction k (b k) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * LaurentPolynomial.C (b k)
+    rw [fiberCoaction_b, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
+    exact mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.C (b k)) (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))
+  · change fiberCoaction k (c k) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * LaurentPolynomial.C (c k)
+    rw [fiberCoaction_c, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
+    exact mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.C (c k)) (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))
+
+/-- The base-quadric subalgebra is fixed by the fiber coaction. -/
+theorem fiberCoaction_quadricMap :
+    (fiberCoaction k).comp (quadricMap k) = (constants k).comp (quadricMap k) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  change fiberCoaction k (BundleCharts.baseMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k i)) =
+    constants k (BundleCharts.baseMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k i))
+  rw [BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen]
+  fin_cases i
+  · change fiberCoaction k (a k * b k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (a k * b k)
+    rw [map_mul, fiberCoaction_a, fiberCoaction_b, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
+    norm_num [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C]
+  · change fiberCoaction k (d k * c k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (d k * c k)
+    rw [map_mul, fiberCoaction_d, fiberCoaction_c, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
+    norm_num [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C]
+  · change fiberCoaction k (d k * b k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (d k * b k)
+    rw [map_mul, fiberCoaction_d, fiberCoaction_b, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
+    norm_num [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C]
+  · change fiberCoaction k (u k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (u k)
+    rw [fiberCoaction_u, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C]
+
+/-- A normalized polynomial frame above three base polynomial functions is
+fiber-equivariant in the source's actual determinant ring. -/
+theorem normalized_lift_scaling
+    (F : Frame (C k)[X]) (x y z : (BundleCharts.QuadricRing k)[X])
+    (hx : F.a * F.b = x.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom)
+    (hy : F.d * F.c = y.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom)
+    (hz : F.d * F.b = z.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom)
+    (hnormal : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = sourceFrame k) :
+    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (fiberCoaction k).toRingHom) =
+      Frame.scale (R := (LaurentPolynomial (C k))[X])
+        (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (constants k).toRingHom))
+        (Units.map (Polynomial.C : LaurentPolynomial (C k) →+*
+          (LaurentPolynomial (C k))[X]).toMonoidHom (parameterUnit k)) := by
+  apply normalized_frame_scaling_of_base (R := C k) (S := LaurentPolynomial (C k)) F (sourceFrame k)
+    (quadricMap k).toRingHom (fiberCoaction k).toRingHom
+    (constants k).toRingHom (parameterUnit k) ?_ x y z hx hy hz hnormal
+    (sourceFrame_scales k)
+  exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom (fiberCoaction_quadricMap k)
+
+/-- Every coefficient of the positive/negative frame coordinates has its
+prescribed fiber weight.  In particular the infinitesimal coefficients have
+weights `1,1,-1,-1`; no weight hypothesis has been placed on the lift itself. -/
+theorem normalized_lift_coefficient_weights
+    (F : Frame (C k)[X]) (x y z : (BundleCharts.QuadricRing k)[X])
+    (hx : F.a * F.b = x.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom)
+    (hy : F.d * F.c = y.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom)
+    (hz : F.d * F.b = z.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom)
+    (hnormal : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = sourceFrame k) (n : ℕ) :
+    fiberCoaction k (F.a.coeff n) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 (F.a.coeff n) ∧
+    fiberCoaction k (F.d.coeff n) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 (F.d.coeff n) ∧
+    fiberCoaction k (F.b.coeff n) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) (F.b.coeff n) ∧
+    fiberCoaction k (F.c.coeff n) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) (F.c.coeff n) := by
+  have h := coefficient_scaling (R := C k) (S := LaurentPolynomial (C k)) F (fiberCoaction k).toRingHom
+    (constants k).toRingHom (parameterUnit k)
+    (normalized_lift_scaling k F x y z hx hy hz hnormal) n
+  change fiberCoaction k (F.a.coeff n) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * LaurentPolynomial.C (F.a.coeff n) ∧
+    fiberCoaction k (F.d.coeff n) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * LaurentPolynomial.C (F.d.coeff n) ∧
+    fiberCoaction k (F.b.coeff n) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * LaurentPolynomial.C (F.b.coeff n) ∧
+    fiberCoaction k (F.c.coeff n) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * LaurentPolynomial.C (F.c.coeff n) at h
+  simp only [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
+  exact ⟨h.1.trans (mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) (LaurentPolynomial.C (F.a.coeff n))),
+    h.2.1.trans (mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) (LaurentPolynomial.C (F.d.coeff n))),
+    h.2.2.1.trans (mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) (LaurentPolynomial.C (F.b.coeff n))),
+    h.2.2.2.trans (mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) (LaurentPolynomial.C (F.c.coeff n)))⟩
+
+/-- Every polynomial coefficient pulled back from the base quadric is fixed by
+fiber scaling. -/
+theorem base_polynomial_coefficient_fixed (p : (BundleCharts.QuadricRing k)[X]) (n : ℕ) :
+    fiberCoaction k ((p.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom).coeff n) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 ((p.map (quadricMap k).toRingHom).coeff n) := by
+  rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
+  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (fiberCoaction_quadricMap k) (p.coeff n)
+  change fiberCoaction k (quadricMap k (p.coeff n)) =
+    LaurentPolynomial.C (quadricMap k (p.coeff n)) at h
+  simpa only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
+    LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C] using h
+
+/-- An arbitrary normalized polynomial lift of a base polynomial family has
+exactly the five source fiber weights, coefficient by coefficient.  In
+particular no linearity, group law, or equivariance is assumed of the lift. -/
+theorem generator_coefficient_weights_of_normalized_lift
+    (φ : C k →ₐ[k] (C k)[X])
+    (β : BundleCharts.QuadricRing k →ₐ[k] (BundleCharts.QuadricRing k)[X])
+    (hext : ∀ p, φ (quadricMap k p) = (β p).map (quadricMap k).toRingHom)
+    (hidentity : ∀ q, (φ q).coeff 0 = q) (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
+    fiberCoaction k ((φ (generator k i)).coeff n) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Obstruction.fiberWeight i) ((φ (generator k i)).coeff n) := by
+  let F : Frame (C k)[X] := (sourceFrame k).map φ.toRingHom
+  have hx0 : quadricMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 0) = a k * b k :=
+    BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 0
+  have hy0 : quadricMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 1) = d k * c k :=
+    BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 1
+  have hz0 : quadricMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 2) = d k * b k :=
+    BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 2
+  have hu0 : quadricMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 3) = u k :=
+    BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 3
+  have hx : F.a * F.b = (β (BundleCharts.qgen k 0)).map (quadricMap k).toRingHom := by
+    change φ (a k) * φ (b k) = _
+    rw [← map_mul, ← hx0, hext]
+  have hy : F.d * F.c = (β (BundleCharts.qgen k 1)).map (quadricMap k).toRingHom := by
+    change φ (d k) * φ (c k) = _
+    rw [← map_mul, ← hy0, hext]
+  have hz : F.d * F.b = (β (BundleCharts.qgen k 2)).map (quadricMap k).toRingHom := by
+    change φ (d k) * φ (b k) = _
+    rw [← map_mul, ← hz0, hext]
+  have hnormal : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = sourceFrame k := by
+    apply Frame.ext
+    · exact hidentity (a k)
+    · exact hidentity (d k)
+    · exact hidentity (b k)
+    · exact hidentity (c k)
+  have h := normalized_lift_coefficient_weights k F (β (BundleCharts.qgen k 0))
+    (β (BundleCharts.qgen k 1)) (β (BundleCharts.qgen k 2)) hx hy hz hnormal n
+  fin_cases i
+  · exact h.1
+  · exact h.2.1
+  · exact h.2.2.1
+  · exact h.2.2.2
+  · change fiberCoaction k ((φ (u k)).coeff n) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 ((φ (u k)).coeff n)
+    rw [← hu0, hext]
+    exact base_polynomial_coefficient_fixed k (β (BundleCharts.qgen k 3)) n
+
+end StableCoordinate.DeterminantLiftWeights
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.DeterminantGradings
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Concrete nonvanishing certificates in the determinant quotient
+
+These elementary evaluations verify the nonzero factors used to split the
+highest auxiliary part of `v`, without assuming the unproved headline.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- Evaluate the determinant quotient at any point satisfying its defining relation. -/
+def determinantEval (point : Fin 5 → k)
+    (hp : point 0 * point 3 - point 2 * point 1 - 1 = 0) : C k →ₐ[k] k :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (idealC k) (MvPolynomial.aeval point) (by
+    intro p hp'
+    have hker : idealC k ≤ RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval point) := by
+      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
+      intro q hq
+      rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq with rfl
+      exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (by simpa [determinantRelation] using hp)
+    exact hker hp')
+
+@[simp]
+theorem determinantEval_cX (point : Fin 5 → k)
+    (hp : point 0 * point 3 - point 2 * point 1 - 1 = 0) (i : Fin 5) :
+    determinantEval k point hp (cX k i) = point i := by
+  change (aeval point) (X i) = point i
+  simp
+
+/-- A specific point where the top auxiliary part and both of its factors are one. -/
+def highTestPoint : Fin 5 → k := ![1, 0, 0, 1, 1]
+
+/-- The test point does lie on the determinant hypersurface. -/
+theorem highTestPoint_relation :
+    highTestPoint k 0 * highTestPoint k 3 - highTestPoint k 2 * highTestPoint k 1 - 1 = 0 := by
+  simp [highTestPoint]
+
+/-- The associated evaluation is an actual algebra homomorphism. -/
+def highTestEval : C k →ₐ[k] k := determinantEval k (highTestPoint k) (highTestPoint_relation k)
+
+@[simp] theorem highTestEval_cX (i : Fin 5) : highTestEval k (cX k i) = highTestPoint k i :=
+  determinantEval_cX k _ _ i
+
+@[simp] theorem highTestEval_vHigh : highTestEval k (vHigh k) = 1 := by
+  simp [vHigh, highTestPoint]
+
+@[simp] theorem highTestEval_au_sub_d :
+    highTestEval k (cX k 0 * cX k 4 - cX k 1) = 1 := by
+  simp [highTestPoint]
+
+@[simp] theorem highTestEval_au_add_d :
+    highTestEval k (cX k 0 * cX k 4 + cX k 1) = 1 := by
+  simp [highTestPoint]
+
+/-- The finite list of displayed generators really generates the actual quotient algebra. -/
+theorem adjoin_range_cX : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (cX k)) = ⊤ := by
+  have heval : MvPolynomial.aeval (cX k) = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (idealC k) := by
+    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+    intro i
+    simp [cX]
+  rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval, heval]
+  exact (AlgHom.range_eq_top _).mpr Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
+
+variable [Nontrivial k]
+
+/-- The source's highest auxiliary part is genuinely nonzero. -/
+theorem vHigh_ne_zero : vHigh k ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hh := congrArg (highTestEval k) h
+  simp at hh
+
+/-- Both difference-of-squares factors are nonzero in the actual quotient. -/
+theorem au_sub_d_ne_zero : cX k 0 * cX k 4 - cX k 1 ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hh := congrArg (highTestEval k) h
+  simp at hh
+
+theorem au_add_d_ne_zero : cX k 0 * cX k 4 + cX k 1 ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hh := congrArg (highTestEval k) h
+  simp at hh
+
+theorem cX_a_ne_zero : cX k 0 ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hh := congrArg (highTestEval k) h
+  simp [highTestPoint] at hh
+
+theorem cX_u_ne_zero : cX k 4 ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hh := congrArg (highTestEval k) h
+  simp [highTestPoint] at hh
+
+/-- The lower auxiliary term is also genuinely nonzero. -/
+theorem vLow_ne_zero : vLow k ≠ 0 := by
+  let e : C k →ₐ[k] k := determinantEval k ![1, 0, 1, 1, 0] (by simp)
+  have he : e (vLow k) = 1 := by
+    simp [e, vLow]
+  intro h
+  rw [h, map_zero] at he
+  exact zero_ne_one he
+
+/-- The second weight-one coordinate is nonzero as well. -/
+theorem cX_d_ne_zero : cX k 1 ≠ 0 := by
+  let e : C k →ₐ[k] k := determinantEval k ![1, 1, 0, 1, 0] (by simp)
+  have he : e (cX k 1) = 1 := by simp [e]
+  intro h
+  rw [h, map_zero] at he
+  exact zero_ne_one he
+
+/-- Thus the auxiliary degree-two projection of `v` is nonzero. -/
+theorem auxiliary_proj_v_two_ne_zero : GradedAlgebra.proj (auxiliaryPiece k) 2 (v k) ≠ 0 := by
+  rw [auxiliary_proj_v_two]
+  exact vHigh_ne_zero k
+
+end StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ObstructionDomains
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Basic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The first determinant coordinate is prime
+
+This file proves the exact residual presentation obtained by setting `a=0`,
+then its domain property. Consequently `a` is a prime element of the determinant
+ring. Combined with the explicit `a`-chart, this is the algebraic input to the
+prime-element localization criterion for unique factorization.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.DeterminantPrimeA
+
+open MvPolynomial
+open DeterminantRing
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- The residual relation after setting `a=0`; variables are `d,b,c,u`. -/
+def residualRelation : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k := X 1 * X 0 + 1
+
+def residualIdeal : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) := Ideal.span {residualRelation k}
+abbrev ResidualRing := MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ⧸ residualIdeal k
+
+def residualMk : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k →ₐ[k] ResidualRing k :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (residualIdeal k)
+
+def rX (i : Fin 4) : ResidualRing k := residualMk k (X i)
+
+theorem residual_relation : rX k 1 * rX k 0 + 1 = 0 := by
+  have h : residualMk k (residualRelation k) = 0 :=
+    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
+  simpa [residualRelation, rX] using h
+
+def aIdeal : Ideal (C k) := Ideal.span {a k}
+abbrev ModA := C k ⧸ aIdeal k
+
+def modAMk : C k →ₐ[k] ModA k := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (aIdeal k)
+
+@[simp] theorem modAMk_a : modAMk k (a k) = 0 :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
+
+theorem modA_relation : modAMk k (b k) * modAMk k (d k) + 1 = 0 := by
+  have h := congrArg (modAMk k) (determinant_relation k)
+  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, modAMk_a] at h
+  linear_combination -h
+
+def toResidual : C k →ₐ[k] ResidualRing k :=
+  DeterminantRing.lift (k := k) 0 (rX k 0) (rX k 1) (rX k 2) (rX k 3) (by
+    have h := residual_relation k
+    linear_combination -h)
+
+@[simp] theorem toResidual_a : toResidual k (a k) = 0 := by simp [toResidual]
+@[simp] theorem toResidual_d : toResidual k (d k) = rX k 0 := by simp [toResidual]
+@[simp] theorem toResidual_b : toResidual k (b k) = rX k 1 := by simp [toResidual]
+@[simp] theorem toResidual_c : toResidual k (c k) = rX k 2 := by simp [toResidual]
+@[simp] theorem toResidual_u : toResidual k (u k) = rX k 3 := by simp [toResidual]
+
+def modAToResidual : ModA k →ₐ[k] ResidualRing k :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (aIdeal k) (toResidual k) (by
+    intro p hp
+    have h : aIdeal k ≤ RingHom.ker (toResidual k).toRingHom := by
+      rw [aIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
+      simp [RingHom.mem_ker]
+    exact h hp)
+
+@[simp] theorem modAToResidual_mk (p : C k) :
+    modAToResidual k (modAMk k p) = toResidual k p := rfl
+
+def residualToModA : ResidualRing k →ₐ[k] ModA k :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (residualIdeal k)
+    (aeval ![modAMk k (d k), modAMk k (b k), modAMk k (c k), modAMk k (u k)]) (by
+      intro p hp
+      have h : residualIdeal k ≤ RingHom.ker
+          (aeval ![modAMk k (d k), modAMk k (b k), modAMk k (c k), modAMk k (u k)]).toRingHom := by
+        rw [residualIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
+        simp [RingHom.mem_ker, residualRelation, modA_relation]
+      exact h hp)
+
+@[simp] theorem residualToModA_rX (i : Fin 4) :
+    residualToModA k (rX k i) =
+      (![modAMk k (d k), modAMk k (b k), modAMk k (c k), modAMk k (u k)] : Fin 4 → ModA k) i := by
+  change (aeval ![modAMk k (d k), modAMk k (b k), modAMk k (c k), modAMk k (u k)]) (X i) = _
+  simp
+
+theorem residualToModA_comp_modAToResidual :
+    (residualToModA k).comp (modAToResidual k) = AlgHom.id k (ModA k) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply DeterminantRing.hom_ext (k := k) (S := ModA k)
+  all_goals
+    change residualToModA k (modAToResidual k (modAMk k _)) = modAMk k _
+    simp
+
+theorem modAToResidual_comp_residualToModA :
+    (modAToResidual k).comp (residualToModA k) = AlgHom.id k (ResidualRing k) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  change modAToResidual k (residualToModA k (rX k i)) = rX k i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp
+
+/-- Setting `a=0` gives the domain presentation `k[d,b,c,u]/(bd+1)`. -/
+def modAEquivResidual : ModA k ≃ₐ[k] ResidualRing k :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (modAToResidual k) (residualToModA k)
+    (modAToResidual_comp_residualToModA k) (residualToModA_comp_modAToResidual k)
+
+section Domain
+variable [IsDomain k] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid k]
+
+omit [UniqueFactorizationMonoid k] in
+theorem residualRelation_irreducible : Irreducible (residualRelation k) := by
+  simpa [residualRelation, mul_comm] using
+    MvPolynomial.irreducible_mul_X_add (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k)
+      1 1 (X_ne_zero 0) (by simp) (by simp) isRelPrime_one_right
+
+instance residualIdeal_isPrime : (residualIdeal k).IsPrime :=
+  Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (residualRelation_irreducible k).prime
+
+instance residualRing_isDomain : IsDomain (ResidualRing k) := inferInstance
+
+instance modA_isDomain : IsDomain (ModA k) :=
+  Function.Injective.isDomain (modAEquivResidual k).toRingHom (modAEquivResidual k).injective
+
+end Domain
+
+end
+
+end StableCoordinate.DeterminantPrimeA
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k] [IsDomain k] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid k]
+

+# The determinant ring used in the coordinate obstruction

+The independent variables are ordered `a,d,b,c,u`.  The only relation is
+`a*c-b*d=1`.  This module records the quotient and its elementary universal
+property; it makes no domain, localization, or rigidity assertion by assumption.

+namespace StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+abbrev P := MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k
+
+noncomputable def relation : P k := X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1
+noncomputable def relationIdeal : Ideal (P k) := Ideal.span {relation k}
+abbrev C := P k ⧸ relationIdeal k
+
+noncomputable def mk : P k →ₐ[k] C k := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (relationIdeal k)
+noncomputable def generator (i : Fin 5) : C k := mk k (X i)
+noncomputable abbrev a : C k := generator k 0
+noncomputable abbrev d : C k := generator k 1
+noncomputable abbrev b : C k := generator k 2
+noncomputable abbrev c : C k := generator k 3
+noncomputable abbrev u : C k := generator k 4
+
+@[simp] theorem mk_relation : mk k (relation k) = 0 := by
+  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
+

+  have h := mk_relation k
+  simp only [relation, map_sub, map_mul, map_one] at h
+  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
+

+variable {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
+
+/-- The universal homomorphism out of the determinant quotient. -/
+noncomputable def lift (A D B C U : S) (h : A * C - B * D = 1) :
+    DeterminantRing.C k →ₐ[k] S :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (relationIdeal k) (aeval ![A, D, B, C, U]) (by
+    intro p hp
+    have hs : relationIdeal k ≤ RingHom.ker (aeval ![A, D, B, C, U]).toRingHom := by
+      rw [relationIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
+      simp [RingHom.mem_ker, relation, h]
+    exact hs hp)
+

+    lift A D B C U h (mk k p) = aeval ![A, D, B, C, U] p := rfl

+    lift A D B C U h (a k) = A := by simp [a, generator]
+@[simp] theorem lift_d (A D B C U : S) (h : A * C - B * D = 1) :
+    lift A D B C U h (d k) = D := by simp [d, generator]
+@[simp] theorem lift_b (A D B C U : S) (h : A * C - B * D = 1) :
+    lift A D B C U h (b k) = B := by simp [b, generator]
+@[simp] theorem lift_c (A D B C U : S) (h : A * C - B * D = 1) :
+    lift A D B C U h (c k) = C := by simp [c, generator]
+@[simp] theorem lift_u (A D B C U : S) (h : A * C - B * D = 1) :
+    lift A D B C U h (u k) = U := by simp [u, generator]

+    (hb : f (b k) = g (b k)) (hc : f (c k) = g (c k))

+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i

+  · exact hd
+  · exact hb
+  · exact hc
+  · exact hu

+/-!
+# Fiber weights on the actual determinant quotient
+
+The Laurent coaction is induced by the exact weights `(1,1,-1,-1,0)` on
+`a,d,b,c,u`.  We establish the final weight contradiction in the actual
+quotient ring, not just in an abstract polynomial algebra: an element in
+the image of `k[a,d,u]` with negative fiber weight is zero.

+namespace StableCoordinate

+open DeterminantRing
+open scoped LaurentPolynomial

+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]

+    (relation k).IsWeightedHomogeneous Obstruction.fiberWeight 0 := by
+  have hac : (X 0 * X 3 : P k).IsWeightedHomogeneous Obstruction.fiberWeight 0 := by
+    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using
+      (isWeightedHomogeneous_X k Obstruction.fiberWeight (0 : Fin 5)).mul
+        (isWeightedHomogeneous_X k Obstruction.fiberWeight (3 : Fin 5))
+  have hbd : (X 2 * X 1 : P k).IsWeightedHomogeneous Obstruction.fiberWeight 0 := by
+    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using
+      (isWeightedHomogeneous_X k Obstruction.fiberWeight (2 : Fin 5)).mul
+        (isWeightedHomogeneous_X k Obstruction.fiberWeight (1 : Fin 5))
+  exact (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k Obstruction.fiberWeight 0).sub_mem
+    ((weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k Obstruction.fiberWeight 0).sub_mem hac hbd)
+    (isWeightedHomogeneous_one k Obstruction.fiberWeight)

+  HomogeneousQuotientWeight.coaction Obstruction.fiberWeight (relation k)
+    (relation_fiber_homogeneous k)

+    fiberCoaction k (generator k i) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Obstruction.fiberWeight i) (generator k i) :=
+  HomogeneousQuotientWeight.coaction_variable _ _ _ i

+    fiberCoaction k (a k) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 (a k) := by
+  simp [a, Obstruction.fiberWeight]
+@[simp] theorem fiberCoaction_d :
+    fiberCoaction k (d k) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 (d k) := by
+  simp [d, Obstruction.fiberWeight]
+@[simp] theorem fiberCoaction_b :
+    fiberCoaction k (b k) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) (b k) := by
+  simp [b, Obstruction.fiberWeight]
+@[simp] theorem fiberCoaction_c :
+    fiberCoaction k (c k) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) (c k) := by
+  simp [c, Obstruction.fiberWeight]
+@[simp] theorem fiberCoaction_u :

+  simp [u, Obstruction.fiberWeight]

+    fiberCoaction k (d k * c k) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (d k * c k) := by

+  · simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight, a, d, u] using LaurentWeightObstruction.single_mem_nonnegativePart
+      (k := k) (1 : ℤ) (by norm_num) (d k)
+  · simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight, a, d, u] using LaurentWeightObstruction.single_mem_nonnegativePart

+    (hq : q ∈ (baseMap (k := k)).range) {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0)

+by the source's final step cannot lie in `k[a,d,u]`. -/

+  intro hh

+/-- Image-submodule form of the final obstruction; this matches the

+ring: no characteristic-zero or field hypothesis is required for this step.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+abbrev P := MvPolynomial (Fin 6) k
+
+noncomputable def p : P k := X 0
+noncomputable def s : P k := X 1
+noncomputable def u : P k := X 2
+noncomputable def F : P k := X 3
+noncomputable def J : P k := X 4
+noncomputable def w : P k := X 5
+
+noncomputable def x : P k := s k ^ 2 - u k ^ 2 + p k * F k
+noncomputable def H : P k := x k ^ 2 * F k - (1 + 2 * s k * x k) * J k -
+  p k * J k ^ 2 - u k
+
+noncomputable def t (c : k) : P k := C c * w k
+noncomputable def d (c : k) : P k := 2 * u k * t k c - p k * t k c ^ 2
+
+noncomputable def substitution (c : k) : Fin 6 → P k :=
+  ![p k,
+    s k + p k * x k * d k c,
+    u k - p k * t k c,
+    F k - (2 * s k * x k + 1) * d k c - p k * x k ^ 2 * d k c ^ 2,
+    J k - x k ^ 2 * d k c,
+    w k]
+
+noncomputable def shift (c : k) : P k →ₐ[k] P k :=
+  aeval (substitution k c)
+
+@[simp] theorem shift_p (c : k) : shift k c (p k) = p k := by
+  simp [shift, p, substitution]
+@[simp] theorem shift_s (c : k) : shift k c (s k) = s k + p k * x k * d k c := by
+  simp [shift, s, substitution]
+@[simp] theorem shift_u (c : k) : shift k c (u k) = u k - p k * t k c := by
+  simp [shift, u, substitution]
+@[simp] theorem shift_F (c : k) : shift k c (F k) =
+    F k - (2 * s k * x k + 1) * d k c - p k * x k ^ 2 * d k c ^ 2 := by
+  simp [shift, F, substitution]
+@[simp] theorem shift_J (c : k) : shift k c (J k) = J k - x k ^ 2 * d k c := by
+  simp [shift, J, substitution]
+@[simp] theorem shift_w (c : k) : shift k c (w k) = w k := by
+  simp [shift, w, substitution]
+@[simp] theorem shift_t (c b : k) : shift k c (t k b) = t k b := by
+  simp [t, shift, w, substitution]
+@[simp] theorem t_neg (c : k) : t k (-c) = -t k c := by
+  simp [t]
+
+private theorem quadratic_invariant {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
+    (p s u F t : A) :
+    let x := s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 + p * F
+    let d := 2 * u * t - p * t ^ 2
+    (s + p * x * d) ^ 2 - (u - p * t) ^ 2 +
+      p * (F - (2 * s * x + 1) * d - p * x ^ 2 * d ^ 2) = x := by
+  dsimp
+  ring
+
+@[simp] theorem shift_x (c : k) : shift k c (x k) = x k := by
+  simp only [x, map_add, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, shift_s, shift_u, shift_p, shift_F]
+  exact quadratic_invariant (p k) (s k) (u k) (F k) (t k c)
+
+@[simp] theorem shift_d_neg (c : k) : shift k c (d k (-c)) = -d k c := by
+  simp only [d, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_pow, shift_u, shift_t, shift_p, t_neg, map_neg]
+  ring
+
+private theorem inverse_F {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (p s F x d : A) :
+    (F - (2 * s * x + 1) * d - p * x ^ 2 * d ^ 2) -
+      (2 * (s + p * x * d) * x + 1) * -d - p * x ^ 2 * (-d) ^ 2 = F := by
+  ring
+
+@[simp] theorem shift_comp_neg (c : k) :
+    (shift k c).comp (shift k (-c)) = AlgHom.id k (P k) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i
+  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (p k)) = p k
+    simp
+  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (s k)) = s k
+    simp only [shift_s, map_add, map_mul, shift_p, shift_x, shift_d_neg]
+    ring
+  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (u k)) = u k
+    simp only [shift_u, map_sub, map_mul, shift_p, shift_t, t_neg, map_neg]
+    ring
+  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (F k)) = F k
+    simp only [shift_F, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_one, map_pow,
+      shift_s, shift_x, shift_d_neg, shift_p]
+    exact inverse_F (p k) (s k) (F k) (x k) (d k c)
+  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (J k)) = J k
+    simp only [shift_J, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, shift_x, shift_d_neg]
+    ring
+  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (w k)) = w k
+    simp
+
+/-- The explicit exponential substitution, with inverse obtained by negating its parameter. -/
+noncomputable def shiftEquiv (c : k) : P k ≃ₐ[k] P k :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (shift k c) (shift k (-c)) (shift_comp_neg k c)
+    (by simpa only [neg_neg] using shift_comp_neg k (-c))
+
+@[simp] theorem shiftEquiv_apply (c : k) (a : P k) :
+    shiftEquiv k c a = shift k c a := rfl
+
+private theorem equation_shift {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
+    (p s u F J x t d : A) :
+    x ^ 2 * (F - (2 * s * x + 1) * d - p * x ^ 2 * d ^ 2) -
+      (1 + 2 * (s + p * x * d) * x) * (J - x ^ 2 * d) -
+      p * (J - x ^ 2 * d) ^ 2 - (u - p * t) =
+      (x ^ 2 * F - (1 + 2 * s * x) * J - p * J ^ 2 - u) + p * t := by
+  ring
+
+/-- The crucial equation transport: the automorphism adds `p * c * w` to `H`. -/
+theorem shift_H (c : k) : shift k c (H k) = H k + p k * t k c := by
+  simp only [H, map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_pow, map_one, map_ofNat,
+    shift_x, shift_F, shift_s, shift_J, shift_p, shift_u]
+  exact equation_shift (p k) (s k) (u k) (F k) (J k) (x k) (t k c) (d k c)
+
+/-- Section 2's `exp(w Δ)` is an actual algebra automorphism fixing `p` and
+sending `H` to `H + p*w`. -/
+theorem exponential_shift_exists :
+    ∃ e : P k ≃ₐ[k] P k, e (p k) = p k ∧ e (H k) = H k + p k * w k := by
+  refine ⟨shiftEquiv k 1, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · simp
+  · simpa [t] using shift_H k 1
+
+end StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.NatAntidiagonal
+import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Factorial closure of the kernel of a locally nilpotent derivation
+
+This file formalizes `bun:factorial-closure` from Section 4 of the paper, using the highest nonzero iterates and the general Leibniz rule.
+No exponential/action correspondence is needed for this elementary step.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open Finset Function
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- A derivation is locally nilpotent if each element is killed by some iterate. -/
+def IsLocallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A A) : Prop :=
+  ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0
+
+/-- The general Leibniz formula for a ring derivation, with natural binomial coefficients. -/
+theorem derivation_iterate_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
+    (D : A → A)^[n] (a * b) =
+      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n,
+        n.choose ij.1 • ((D : A → A)^[ij.1] a * (D : A → A)^[ij.2] b) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [sum_antidiagonal_choose_succ_nsmul (M := A)
+      (fun i j => (D : A → A)^[i] a * (D : A → A)^[j] b) n]
+    simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_sum, map_nsmul,
+      Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_add, sum_add_distrib, add_right_inj]
+    apply sum_congr rfl
+    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
+    rw [n.choose_symm_of_eq_add (mem_antidiagonal.1 hij).symm]
+    rw [mul_comm]
+
+/-- Once an iterate vanishes, all later iterates vanish. -/
+theorem derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le (D : Derivation k A A) {a : A} {m n : ℕ}
+    (hm : (D : A → A)^[m] a = 0) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
+    (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
+  rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hm]
+  exact Function.iterate_fixed (map_zero D) r
+
+/-- A nonzero locally nilpotent element has a last nonzero iterate. -/
+theorem exists_last_nonzero_iterate (D : Derivation k A A) {a : A}
+    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hnil : ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
+    ∃ m : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[m] a ≠ 0 ∧ (D : A → A)^[m + 1] a = 0 := by
+  classical
+  have hn : Nat.find hnil ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    have := Nat.find_spec hnil
+    rw [h, Function.iterate_zero_apply] at this
+    exact ha this
+  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
+  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact Nat.find_min hnil (by omega)
+  · simpa [hm] using Nat.find_spec hnil
+
+/-- The only surviving term at the sum of the last possible derivative indices. -/
+theorem derivation_iterate_top_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (a b : A) (m n : ℕ)
+    (hm : (D : A → A)^[m + 1] a = 0)
+    (hn : (D : A → A)^[n + 1] b = 0) :
+    (D : A → A)^[m + n] (a * b) =
+      (m + n).choose m • ((D : A → A)^[m] a * (D : A → A)^[n] b) := by
+  rw [derivation_iterate_mul]
+  apply sum_eq_single (m, n)
+  · intro ij hij hne
+    have hijsum := mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
+    by_cases hi : m < ij.1
+    · rw [derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D hm (by omega), zero_mul, smul_zero]
+    · have hj : n < ij.2 := by
+        have hp : ij.1 ≠ m ∨ ij.2 ≠ n := by
+          by_contra hp
+          push Not at hp
+          exact hne (Prod.ext hp.1 hp.2)
+        omega
+      rw [derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D hn (by omega), mul_zero, smul_zero]
+  · simp
+
+/-- The kernel of a locally nilpotent derivation on a characteristic-zero domain
+is factorially closed. This is `bun:factorial-closure` from the source. -/
+theorem lnd_factorial_closure [IsDomain A] [CharZero A]
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) {a b : A}
+    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : D (a * b) = 0) :
+    D a = 0 ∧ D b = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := exists_last_nonzero_iterate D ha (hD a)
+  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := exists_last_nonzero_iterate D hb (hD b)
+  have hmn : m + n = 0 := by
+    by_contra hmn
+    have hz : (D : A → A)^[m + n] (a * b) = 0 :=
+      derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D (m := 1) (by simpa using hab) (by omega)
+    rw [derivation_iterate_top_mul D a b m n hm' hn', nsmul_eq_mul] at hz
+    have hchoose : ((m + n).choose m : A) ≠ 0 := by
+      exact_mod_cast (Nat.choose_pos (by omega : m ≤ m + n)).ne'
+    exact (mul_ne_zero hchoose (mul_ne_zero hm hn)) hz
+  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Nat.add_eq_zero_iff.mp hmn
+  simpa using And.intro hm' hn'
+
+/-- The difference-of-squares step of the rigidity proof: fixing
+`a²u²-d²` forces the three factors `a`, `d`, and `u` to be fixed. -/
+theorem lnd_fixed_of_difference_of_squares [IsDomain A] [CharZero A]
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) {a d u : A}
+    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0)
+    (hminus : a * u - d ≠ 0) (hplus : a * u + d ≠ 0)
+    (hv : D (a ^ 2 * u ^ 2 - d ^ 2) = 0) :
+    D a = 0 ∧ D d = 0 ∧ D u = 0 := by
+  have hprod : D ((a * u - d) * (a * u + d)) = 0 := by
+    rw [show (a * u - d) * (a * u + d) = a ^ 2 * u ^ 2 - d ^ 2 by ring]
+    exact hv
+  obtain ⟨hm, hp⟩ := lnd_factorial_closure D hD hminus hplus hprod
+  rw [map_sub] at hm
+  rw [map_add] at hp
+  have htwo : (2 : A) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
+  have hau : D (a * u) = 0 := by
+    apply (mul_eq_zero.mp (show (2 : A) * D (a * u) = 0 by
+      calc
+        (2 : A) * D (a * u) = (D (a * u) - D d) + (D (a * u) + D d) := by ring
+        _ = 0 := by rw [hm, hp, add_zero])).resolve_left htwo
+  have hd : D d = 0 := by simpa [hau] using hp
+  obtain ⟨ha', hu'⟩ := lnd_factorial_closure D hD ha hu hau
+  exact ⟨ha', hd, hu'⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI
