+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.FilteredAlgebra.Basic
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The associated graded algebra via the extended Rees algebra
+
+For an increasing integer filtration `F`, the Rees algebra consists of Laurent
+polynomials whose coefficient at `d` belongs to `F d`.  Its quotient by `T`
+is the associated graded algebra.  This construction supplies an actual ring,
+including negative filtration indices, without treating the associated-graded
+algebra or its multiplicative structure as an assumed interface.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+open AddMonoidAlgebra
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+variable (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F]
+
+/-- The extended Rees algebra with integer-indexed, increasing convention. -/
+noncomputable def rees : Subalgebra k (LaurentPolynomial A) where
+  carrier := {p | ∀ d, p.coeff d ∈ F d}
+  zero_mem' := by intro d; exact (F d).zero_mem
+  one_mem' := by
+    intro d
+    by_cases hd : d = 0
+    · subst d
+      simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
+        Finsupp.single_eq_same] using SetLike.one_mem_graded F
+    · simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
+        Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hd)] using (F d).zero_mem
+  add_mem' hp hq := by
+    intro d
+    exact (F d).add_mem (hp d) (hq d)
+  mul_mem' {p q} hp hq := by
+    intro d
+    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul]
+    simp only [Finsupp.sum]
+    apply (F d).sum_mem
+    intro i hi
+    apply (F d).sum_mem
+    intro j hj
+    split_ifs with hij
+    · simpa only [← hij] using SetLike.mul_mem_graded (hp i) (hq j)
+    · exact (F d).zero_mem
+  algebraMap_mem' r := by
+    intro d
+    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul_apply]
+    by_cases hd : d = 0
+    · subst d
+      simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
+        Finsupp.single_eq_same] using (F 0).smul_mem r (SetLike.one_mem_graded F)
+    · simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
+        Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hd), smul_zero, Submodule.zero_mem]
+
+@[simp] theorem mem_rees (p : LaurentPolynomial A) :
+    p ∈ rees F ↔ ∀ d, p.coeff d ∈ F d := Iff.rfl
+
+/-- A homogeneous element of the Rees algebra. -/
+noncomputable def homogeneous (d : ℤ) (a : F d) : rees F :=
+  ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (a : A), by
+    intro i
+    by_cases hi : d = i
+    · subst i
+      simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same] using a.property
+    · simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right hi] using (F i).zero_mem⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem homogeneous_coe (d : ℤ) (a : F d) :
+    (homogeneous F d a : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (a : A) := rfl
+
+/-- The positive Laurent parameter lies in the Rees algebra by monotonicity. -/
+noncomputable def parameter (hmono : Monotone F) : rees F :=
+  homogeneous F 1 ⟨1, hmono (by decide : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 1) (SetLike.one_mem_graded F)⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem parameter_coe (hmono : Monotone F) :
+    (parameter F hmono : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 := rfl
+
+noncomputable def parameterIdeal (hmono : Monotone F) : Ideal (rees F) :=
+  Ideal.span {parameter F hmono}
+
+/-- The genuine associated graded algebra, modeled as the Rees special fiber. -/
+abbrev Gr (hmono : Monotone F) := rees F ⧸ parameterIdeal F hmono
+
+/-- The class of `a` in degree `d`. -/
+noncomputable def initial (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d) : Gr F hmono :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) (homogeneous F d a)
+
+/-- A homogeneous class vanishes precisely when its representative is in the
+previous filtration step.  In particular, minimal-degree representatives have
+nonzero initial forms even when the degree is negative. -/
+theorem initial_eq_zero_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d) :
+    initial F hmono d a = 0 ↔ (a : A) ∈ F (d - 1) := by
+  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) (homogeneous F d a) = 0 ↔ _
+  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, parameterIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
+    have he := congrArg (fun p : rees F => (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d) hq
+    have hae : (a : A) = (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff (d - 1) := by
+      change (AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (a : A)).coeff d =
+        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * (q : LaurentPolynomial A)).coeff d at he
+      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply] at he
+      simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same, one_mul,
+        sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using he
+    rw [hae]
+    exact q.property (d - 1)
+  · intro ha
+    refine ⟨homogeneous F (d - 1) ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    change AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (a : A) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * AddMonoidAlgebra.single (d - 1) (a : A)
+    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]
+    congr 1
+    omega
+
+/-- The associated-graded multiplication is induced by multiplication of
+filtration representatives. -/
+theorem initial_mul (hmono : Monotone F) (d e : ℤ) (a : F d) (b : F e) :
+    initial F hmono d a * initial F hmono e b =
+      initial F hmono (d + e) ⟨(a : A) * (b : A),
+        SetLike.mul_mem_graded a.property b.property⟩ := by
+  rw [initial, initial, ← map_mul]
+  congr 1
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single d e (a : A) (b : A)
+
+
+/-- Every Rees element is the finite sum of its homogeneous coefficients. -/
+theorem rees_eq_sum (p : rees F) :
+    p = ∑ d ∈ (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff.support,
+      homogeneous F d ⟨(p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d, p.property d⟩ := by
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  change (p : LaurentPolynomial A) = (rees F).val
+    (∑ d ∈ (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff.support,
+      homogeneous F d ⟨(p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d, p.property d⟩)
+  rw [map_sum]
+  exact (AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single (p : LaurentPolynomial A)).symm
+
+/-- Addition of initial forms within one degree. -/
+theorem initial_add (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a b : F d) :
+    initial F hmono d (a + b) = initial F hmono d a + initial F hmono d b := by
+  rw [initial, initial, initial, ← map_add]
+  congr 1
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add d (a : A) (b : A)
+
+/-- Algebra homomorphisms from the associated graded algebra are determined by
+all homogeneous classes. -/
+theorem hom_ext {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
+    (hmono : Monotone F) (f g : Gr F hmono →ₐ[k] S)
+    (h : ∀ (d : ℤ) (a : F d), f (initial F hmono d a) = g (initial F hmono d a)) :
+    f = g := by
+  ext z
+  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
+  rw [rees_eq_sum F p, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro d hd
+  exact h d _
+
+/-- All homogeneous classes generate the actual associated graded algebra. -/
+theorem adjoin_initials_eq_top (hmono : Monotone F) :
+    Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range fun a : (d : ℤ) × (F d) => initial F hmono a.1 a.2) = ⊤ := by
+  apply top_unique
+  intro z hz
+  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
+  rw [rees_eq_sum F p, map_sum]
+  apply Subalgebra.sum_mem
+  intro d hd
+  exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨⟨d, _⟩, rfl⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+end OAI

+/-!
+# A shifted derivation on the extended Rees algebra
+
+A derivation with filtration shift `m` acts coefficientwise on Laurent
+polynomials and is multiplied by `T^m`.  It preserves the Rees algebra,
+annihilates its parameter, and hence descends to the associated graded ring.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+open AddMonoidAlgebra
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Coefficientwise application of a linear map to Laurent polynomials. -/
+noncomputable def coefficientLinear (f : A →ₗ[k] A) :
+    LaurentPolynomial A →ₗ[k] LaurentPolynomial A :=
+  (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).symm.toLinearMap.comp
+    ((Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap f).comp
+      (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).toLinearMap)
+
+@[simp] theorem coefficientLinear_coeff (f : A →ₗ[k] A)
+    (p : LaurentPolynomial A) (d : ℤ) :
+    (coefficientLinear f p).coeff d = f (p.coeff d) := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem coefficientLinear_single (f : A →ₗ[k] A) (d : ℤ) (a : A) :
+    coefficientLinear f (single d a) = single d (f a) := by
+  ext i
+  rw [coefficientLinear_coeff]
+  simp only [coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
+  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_zero]
+
+private theorem coefficientLinear_leibniz (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (p q : LaurentPolynomial A) :
+    coefficientLinear D.toLinearMap (p * q) =
+      p * coefficientLinear D.toLinearMap q + q * coefficientLinear D.toLinearMap p := by
+  induction p using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
+  | zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
+  | add p₁ p₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
+      simp only [add_mul, map_add, ih₁, ih₂, mul_add]
+      abel
+  | single i a =>
+      induction q using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
+      | zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
+      | add q₁ q₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
+          simp only [mul_add, map_add, ih₁, ih₂, add_mul]
+          abel
+      | single j b =>
+          simp only [single_mul_single, coefficientLinear_single]
+          change single (i + j) (D (a * b)) =
+            single (i + j) (a * D b) + single (j + i) (b * D a)
+          rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, single_add]
+          rw [add_comm j i]
+
+/-- Coefficientwise extension of a derivation, fixing the Laurent parameter. -/
+noncomputable def coefficientDerivation (D : Derivation k A A) :
+    Derivation k (LaurentPolynomial A) (LaurentPolynomial A) :=
+  Derivation.mk' (coefficientLinear D.toLinearMap) (by
+    intro p q
+    exact coefficientLinear_leibniz D p q)
+
+@[simp] theorem coefficientDerivation_coeff (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (p : LaurentPolynomial A) (d : ℤ) :
+    (coefficientDerivation D p).coeff d = D (p.coeff d) := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem coefficientDerivation_single (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (d : ℤ) (a : A) :
+    coefficientDerivation D (single d a) = single d (D a) :=
+  coefficientLinear_single D.toLinearMap d a
+
+/-- Multiplication by a Laurent monomial changes the filtration shift. -/
+noncomputable def shiftedDerivation (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ) :
+    Derivation k (LaurentPolynomial A) (LaurentPolynomial A) :=
+  (single m (1 : A) : LaurentPolynomial A) • coefficientDerivation D
+
+@[simp] theorem shiftedDerivation_coeff (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
+    (p : LaurentPolynomial A) (d : ℤ) :
+    (shiftedDerivation D m p).coeff d = D (p.coeff (d - m)) := by
+  change (single m 1 * coefficientDerivation D p).coeff d = _
+  rw [coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul, coefficientDerivation_coeff]
+  congr 2
+  omega
+
+@[simp] theorem shiftedDerivation_single (D : Derivation k A A) (m d : ℤ) (a : A) :
+    shiftedDerivation D m (single d a) = single (d + m) (D a) := by
+  change single m 1 * coefficientDerivation D (single d a) = _
+  rw [coefficientDerivation_single, single_mul_single, one_mul, add_comm]
+
+
+/-- Iterating the shifted Laurent derivation on a monomial does not introduce
+any additional coefficient factors. -/
+theorem shiftedDerivation_iterate_single (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (m d : ℤ) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
+    ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n])
+      (single d a) = single (d + (n : ℤ) * m) (((D : A → A)^[n]) a) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
+  | succ n ih =>
+      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, shiftedDerivation_single,
+        Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+      congr 1
+      push_cast
+      ring
+
+/-- Local nilpotence extends to Laurent polynomials after any integer shift. -/
+theorem shiftedDerivation_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
+    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
+    ∀ p : LaurentPolynomial A,
+      ∃ n, ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) p = 0 := by
+  intro p
+  have hzero : ∀ n, ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) 0 = 0 :=
+    fun n => Function.iterate_fixed (map_zero (shiftedDerivation D m)) n
+  have hadd : ∀ n (p q : LaurentPolynomial A),
+      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) (p + q) =
+      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) p +
+      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) q := by
+    intro n p q
+    induction n with
+    | zero => rfl
+    | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_add]
+  induction p using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
+  | zero => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
+  | add p q hp hq =>
+      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hp
+      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hq
+      refine ⟨n + l, ?_⟩
+      rw [hadd]
+      have hpn : ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n+l]) p = 0 := by
+        rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hn, hzero]
+      have hql : ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n+l]) q = 0 := by
+        rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, hl, hzero]
+      rw [hpn, hql, add_zero]
+  | single d a =>
+      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD a
+      exact ⟨n, by rw [shiftedDerivation_iterate_single, hn, single_zero]⟩
+
+variable (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F]
+variable (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
+variable (hshift : ∀ d (a : A), a ∈ F d → D a ∈ F (d + m))
+
+/-- Restriction of the shifted Laurent derivation to the Rees algebra. -/
+noncomputable def reesDerivation : Derivation k (rees F) (rees F) where
+  toFun p := ⟨shiftedDerivation D m p, by
+    intro d
+    rw [shiftedDerivation_coeff]
+    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hshift (d - m) ((p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff (d - m))
+      (p.property (d - m))⟩
+  map_add' p q := Subtype.ext ((shiftedDerivation D m).map_add p q)
+  map_smul' c p := Subtype.ext ((shiftedDerivation D m).map_smul c p)
+  map_one_eq_zero' := Subtype.ext (shiftedDerivation D m).map_one_eq_zero
+  leibniz' p q := Subtype.ext ((shiftedDerivation D m).leibniz p q)
+
+@[simp] theorem reesDerivation_coe (p : rees F) :
+    (reesDerivation F D m hshift p : LaurentPolynomial A) = shiftedDerivation D m p := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem reesDerivation_parameter (hmono : Monotone F) :
+    reesDerivation F D m hshift (parameter F hmono) = 0 := by
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  change shiftedDerivation D m (single 1 1) = 0
+  rw [shiftedDerivation_single, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, single_zero]
+
+/-- The parameter ideal is invariant under the Rees derivation. -/
+theorem reesDerivation_preserves_parameterIdeal (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (p : rees F) (hp : p ∈ parameterIdeal F hmono) :
+    reesDerivation F D m hshift p ∈ parameterIdeal F hmono := by
+  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hp
+  rw [Derivation.leibniz, reesDerivation_parameter, smul_zero, add_zero]
+  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨reesDerivation F D m hshift q, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The induced derivation on the genuine associated graded ring. -/
+noncomputable def gradedDerivation (hmono : Monotone F) :
+    Derivation k (Gr F hmono) (Gr F hmono) :=
+  Derivation.liftOfSurjective (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective k (parameterIdeal F hmono))
+    (d := reesDerivation F D m hshift) (by
+      intro p hp
+      apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+      exact reesDerivation_preserves_parameterIdeal F D m hshift hmono p
+        (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hp))
+
+
+@[simp] theorem gradedDerivation_mk (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
+    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) (reesDerivation F D m hshift p) :=
+  Derivation.liftOfSurjective_apply _ _ p
+
+/-- Exact representative formula for the induced homogeneous derivation. -/
+theorem gradedDerivation_initial (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d) :
+    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono (initial F hmono d a) =
+      initial F hmono (d + m) ⟨D a, hshift d a a.property⟩ := by
+  rw [initial, gradedDerivation_mk]
+  congr 1
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  exact shiftedDerivation_single D m d a
+
+theorem reesDerivation_iterate_coe (p : rees F) (n : ℕ) :
+    (((reesDerivation F D m hshift : rees F → rees F)^[n]) p : LaurentPolynomial A) =
+      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) p := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih =>
+      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', reesDerivation_coe, ih,
+        Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+
+theorem reesDerivation_locallyNilpotent
+    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
+    ∀ p : rees F, ∃ n, ((reesDerivation F D m hshift : rees F → rees F)^[n]) p = 0 := by
+  intro p
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := shiftedDerivation_locallyNilpotent D m hD (p : LaurentPolynomial A)
+  refine ⟨n, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
+  rw [reesDerivation_iterate_coe]
+  exact hn
+
+theorem gradedDerivation_iterate_mk (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) (n : ℕ) :
+    ((gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono : Gr F hmono → Gr F hmono)^[n])
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p) =
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono)
+      (((reesDerivation F D m hshift : rees F → rees F)^[n]) p) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih =>
+      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, gradedDerivation_mk,
+        Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+
+/-- Local nilpotence passes to the actual associated graded ring. -/
+theorem gradedDerivation_locallyNilpotent (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
+    ∀ p : Gr F hmono,
+      ∃ n, ((gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono : Gr F hmono → Gr F hmono)^[n]) p = 0 := by
+  intro p
+  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective p
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := reesDerivation_locallyNilpotent F D m hshift hD q
+  exact ⟨n, by rw [gradedDerivation_iterate_mk, hn, map_zero]⟩
+
+/-- Attaining the filtration shift on one element forces a nonzero leading
+associated-graded derivation. -/
+theorem gradedDerivation_ne_zero (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d)
+    (hDa : D a ∉ F (d + m - 1)) :
+    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono ≠ 0 := by
+  intro hzero
+  have hz := congrArg (fun E : Derivation k (Gr F hmono) (Gr F hmono) =>
+    E (initial F hmono d a)) hzero
+  rw [gradedDerivation_initial, Derivation.zero_apply] at hz
+  exact hDa ((initial_eq_zero_iff F hmono (d + m) _).mp hz)
+
+/-- Every invariant representative gives an invariant initial form. -/
+theorem gradedDerivation_initial_eq_zero (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d)
+    (ha : D a = 0) :
+    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono (initial F hmono d a) = 0 := by
+  rw [gradedDerivation_initial, initial_eq_zero_iff]
+  change D a ∈ F (d + m - 1)
+  rw [ha]
+  exact (F (d + m - 1)).zero_mem
+
+end StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FiltrationSeparation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltrationDegree
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Bounded derivation shifts for the integer source filtration
+
+This proves the generator-bound step in equation `gr:shift` of the source.
+It uses the actual five-variable integer filtration, including negative
+indices.  Bounds on derivatives of the five generators imply one common
+bound on the derivative of every filtration piece.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace Filtration
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {K A : Type*} [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
+
+/-- The image of each monomial lies in its assigned integer filtration layer. -/
+theorem image_monomial_mem (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
+    (s : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
+    φ (monomial s c) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight s) :=
+  ⟨monomial s c, monomial_mem_piece K le_rfl c, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The weight of a pure power is its exponent times the variable weight. -/
+theorem monomialWeight_single (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
+    monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i n) =
+      n • monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) := by
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [monomialWeight]
+
+/-- The product rule propagates a common filtration shift through multiplication. -/
+theorem derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A)
+    {a b : A} {d e m : ℤ}
+    (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hb : b ∈ imagePiece φ e)
+    (hDa : D a ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m))
+    (hDb : D b ∈ imagePiece φ (e + m)) :
+    D (a * b) ∈ imagePiece φ (d + e + m) := by
+  rw [D.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
+  apply (imagePiece φ _).add_mem
+  · simpa only [add_assoc] using mul_mem_imagePiece φ ha hDb
+  · convert mul_mem_imagePiece φ hb hDa using 1
+    congr 1
+    omega
+
+/-- The product rule propagates a common filtration shift through every power. -/
+theorem derivation_pow_mem_imagePiece
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A)
+    {a : A} {d m : ℤ}
+    (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hDa : D a ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m))
+    (n : ℕ) : D (a ^ n) ∈ imagePiece φ (n • d + m) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [pow_succ]
+    convert derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece φ D (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n ha) ha ih hDa using 1
+    congr 1
+    simp only [succ_nsmul]
+
+/-- A bound on generator derivatives gives the exact monomial-weight bound. -/
+theorem derivation_monomial_mem_imagePiece
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
+    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
+      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
+    (s : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
+    D (φ (monomial s c)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight s + m) := by
+  have hone : ∀ s : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ,
+      D (φ (monomial s 1)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight s + m) := by
+    intro s
+    induction s using Finsupp.induction with
+    | zero => simp
+    | single_add i n s hni hn ih =>
+      rw [add_comm (Finsupp.single i n), monomial_add_single, map_mul]
+      have hpow := derivation_pow_mem_imagePiece φ D
+        (image_monomial_mem φ (Finsupp.single i 1) 1) (hD i) n
+      change D (φ (X i) ^ n) ∈ _ at hpow
+      have hmul := derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece φ D
+        (image_monomial_mem φ s 1)
+        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n (image_monomial_mem φ (Finsupp.single i 1) 1))
+        ih hpow
+      rw [map_add, monomialWeight_single i n]
+      simpa only [map_pow, MvPolynomial.X] using hmul
+  have hsmul := (imagePiece φ _).smul_mem c (hone s)
+  have hmono : monomial s c = c • (monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) := by
+    simp only [smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
+  rw [hmono, map_smul, Derivation.map_smul]
+  exact hsmul
+
+/-- Generator bounds extend to every element of a source filtration piece. -/
+theorem derivation_source_piece_mem_imagePiece
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
+    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
+      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
+    {q : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K} {d : ℤ} (hq : q ∈ piece K d) :
+    D (φ q) ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m) := by
+  induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
+  | mem q hq =>
+    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hq
+    have hsm : monomialWeight s + m ≤ d + m := by omega
+    exact imagePiece_mono φ hsm
+      (derivation_monomial_mem_imagePiece φ D m hD s 1)
+  | zero => simp
+  | add q r hq hr ihq ihr =>
+    simpa only [map_add] using (imagePiece φ _).add_mem ihq ihr
+  | smul c q hq ihq =>
+    simpa only [map_smul, Derivation.map_smul] using (imagePiece φ _).smul_mem c ihq
+
+/-- The source's bounded-shift assertion, for every integer filtration degree. -/
+theorem derivation_imagePiece_le
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
+    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
+      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
+    (d : ℤ) :
+    imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap := by
+  rintro a ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
+  exact derivation_source_piece_mem_imagePiece φ D m hD hq
+
+/-- A derivation vanishing on all presentation generators is zero. -/
+theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_generator_values
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) = 0) : D = 0 := by
+  ext a
+  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hφ a
+  change D (φ q) = 0
+  induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
+  | C c => simp
+  | add q r ihq ihr => simp [ihq, ihr]
+  | mul_X q i ihq => simp [D.leibniz, ihq, hD]
+
+/-- A nonzero derivation has a nonzero value on a presentation generator. -/
+theorem exists_ne_zero_generator_value
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ≠ 0 := by
+  by_contra h
+  push Not at h
+  exact hD (derivation_eq_zero_of_generator_values φ hφ D h)
+
+/-- Exhaustiveness and the finite set of presentation generators supply a
+uniform integer shift for every derivation. -/
+theorem exists_derivation_imagePiece_shift
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (D : Derivation K A A) :
+    ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ,
+      imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap := by
+  classical
+  choose degree hdegree using fun i : Fin 5 =>
+    exists_mem_imagePiece φ hφ (D (φ (X i)))
+  obtain ⟨i, _, himax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
+    (fun i : Fin 5 => degree i - monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
+    (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5)).Nonempty)
+  refine ⟨degree i - monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1), ?_⟩
+  apply derivation_imagePiece_le φ D
+  intro j
+  apply imagePiece_mono φ _ (hdegree j)
+  have hj := himax j (Finset.mem_univ j)
+  omega
+
+/-- Separation makes the maximal generator shift sharp.  Some nonzero
+generator image lands in degree `weight + m`, but not the preceding layer.
+This is exactly the nonvanishing criterion for the source's leading derivation. -/
+theorem exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
+    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
+    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 5),
+      D (φ (X i)) ≠ 0 ∧
+      D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m) ∧
+      D (φ (X i)) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m - 1) ∧
+      ∀ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap := by
+  classical
+  let F : ℤ → Set A := fun d => (imagePiece φ d : Set A)
+  have hmono : Monotone F := fun _ _ h => imagePiece_mono φ h
+  have hext : ∀ a : A, ∃ d : ℤ, a ∈ F d := exists_mem_imagePiece φ hφ
+  have hseparated : ∀ a : A, (∀ d : ℤ, a ∈ F d) → a = 0 :=
+    IntegerFiltration.separated_of_iInf_eq_bot (imagePiece φ) hsep
+  let deg : Fin 5 → ℤ := fun i => IntegerFiltration.degree F (D (φ (X i)))

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Division
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Filtration
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.FilteredAlgebra.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic

+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Separation for the integer filtration
+
+The variables are ordered `(p,s,u,F,J)`.  The integer weight is
+`-exp(p) + exp(F) + exp(J)`.  This file proves the negative-weight
+power-divisibility estimate, and separates every image filtration in a
+Noetherian domain whenever the image of `p` is a nonunit.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace Filtration
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+/-- The source weight `(-1,0,0,1,1)` on exponent vectors. -/
+def monomialWeight : (Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℤ where
+  toFun e := (e 3 : ℤ) + (e 4 : ℤ) - (e 0 : ℤ)
+  map_zero' := by simp
+  map_add' e f := by simp; omega
+
+@[simp] theorem monomialWeight_apply (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) :
+    monomialWeight e = (e 3 : ℤ) + (e 4 : ℤ) - (e 0 : ℤ) := rfl
+
+/-- A monomial of weight at most `-r` has at least `r` factors of `p`. -/
+theorem exponent_zero_ge_of_weight_le_neg {e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ} {r : ℕ}
+    (h : monomialWeight e ≤ -(r : ℤ)) : r ≤ e 0 := by
+  simp only [monomialWeight_apply] at h
+  omega
+
+variable (K : Type*) [CommRing K]
+
+/-- The span of the monomials of integer source weight at most `d`. -/
+def piece (d : ℤ) : Submodule K (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) :=
+  Submodule.span K {q | ∃ e, monomialWeight e ≤ d ∧ q = monomial e 1}
+
+/-- The source filtration is increasing. -/
+theorem piece_mono : Monotone (piece K) := by
+  intro d e hde
+  apply Submodule.span_mono
+  rintro q ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
+  exact ⟨m, hm.trans hde, rfl⟩
+
+/-- Every negative-weight monomial is divisible by the corresponding power of `p`. -/
+theorem pow_X_zero_dvd_monomial {e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ} {r : ℕ}
+    (h : monomialWeight e ≤ -(r : ℤ)) (c : K) :
+    (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ^ r ∣ monomial e c := by
+  rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, monomial_dvd_monomial]
+  refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, one_dvd _⟩
+  exact Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr (exponent_zero_ge_of_weight_le_neg h)
+
+/-- The negative source piece is contained in the principal ideal `(p^r)`. -/
+theorem piece_neg_le_span_pow (r : ℕ) :
+    piece K (-(r : ℤ)) ≤
+      (Ideal.span {((X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ^ r)}).restrictScalars K := by
+  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
+  rintro q ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
+  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (pow_X_zero_dvd_monomial K he 1)
+
+/-- A monomial belongs to its assigned filtration piece. -/
+theorem monomial_mem_piece {e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ} {d : ℤ}
+    (h : monomialWeight e ≤ d) (c : K) : monomial e c ∈ piece K d := by
+  have hm : monomial e (1 : K) ∈ piece K d :=
+    Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, h, rfl⟩
+  simpa only [smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using (piece K d).smul_mem c hm
+
+/-- Membership can equivalently be tested on the support. -/
+theorem mem_piece_iff {q : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K} {d : ℤ} :
+    q ∈ piece K d ↔ ∀ e ∈ q.support, monomialWeight e ≤ d := by
+  classical
+  constructor
+  · intro hq
+    induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
+    | mem q hq =>
+      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hq
+      intro m hm
+      have hm' : m = e := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (support_monomial_subset hm)
+      simpa [hm'] using he
+    | zero => simp
+    | add q r hq hr ihq ihr =>
+      intro e he
+      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (support_add he) with he | he
+      · exact ihq e he
+      · exact ihr e he
+    | smul c q hq ihq =>
+      intro e he
+      exact ihq e (support_smul he)
+  · intro hq
+    rw [q.as_sum]
+    apply Submodule.sum_mem
+    intro e he
+    exact monomial_mem_piece K (hq e he) _
+
+/-- Exhaustiveness of the filtration on the five-variable polynomial ring. -/
+theorem exists_mem_piece (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) :
+    ∃ d : ℤ, q ∈ piece K d := by
+  classical
+  refine ⟨(q.support.sup fun e => (monomialWeight e).toNat : ℕ), mem_piece_iff K |>.mpr ?_⟩
+  intro e he
+  have hsup : (monomialWeight e).toNat ≤ q.support.sup (fun e => (monomialWeight e).toNat) :=
+    Finset.le_sup (f := fun e => (monomialWeight e).toNat) he
+  omega
+
+/-- The constant one has weight zero. -/
+theorem one_mem_piece : (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ∈ piece K 0 := by
+  simpa only [monomial_zero', C_1] using
+    (monomial_mem_piece K (e := 0) (d := 0) (by simp) 1)
+
+/-- Multiplication adds filtration indices, including negative indices. -/
+theorem mul_mem_piece {q r : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K} {d e : ℤ}
+    (hq : q ∈ piece K d) (hr : r ∈ piece K e) : q * r ∈ piece K (d + e) := by
+  classical
+  induction hq, hr using Submodule.span_induction₂ with
+  | mem_mem q r hq hr =>
+    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := hq
+    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := hr
+    rw [monomial_mul_monomial]
+    apply monomial_mem_piece
+    simpa only [map_add] using add_le_add hm hn
+  | zero_left => simp
+  | zero_right => simp
+  | add_left q r s hq hr hs ihq ihr =>
+    rw [add_mul]
+    exact (piece K _).add_mem ihq ihr
+  | add_right q r s hq hr hs ihr ihs =>
+    rw [mul_add]
+    exact (piece K _).add_mem ihr ihs
+  | smul_left c q r hq hr ihr =>
+    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
+    exact (piece K _).smul_mem c ihr
+  | smul_right c q r hq hr ihr =>
+    rw [mul_smul_comm]
+    exact (piece K _).smul_mem c ihr
+
+instance : SetLike.GradedMonoid (piece K) where
+  one_mem := one_mem_piece K
+  mul_mem := fun _ _ _ _ hq hr => mul_mem_piece K hq hr
+
+instance : IsRingFiltration (piece K) (fun d => piece K (d - 1)) :=
+  IsRingFiltration.mk_int _ (piece_mono K)
+
+variable {K}
+variable {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
+
+/-- The image filtration under a polynomial presentation.  In particular this
+is the quotient filtration when `φ` is an ideal quotient homomorphism. -/
+def imagePiece (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (d : ℤ) : Submodule K A :=
+  (piece K d).map φ.toLinearMap
+
+/-- The image filtration is increasing. -/
+theorem imagePiece_mono (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) :
+    Monotone (imagePiece φ) := by
+  intro d e hde
+  exact Submodule.map_mono (piece_mono K hde)
+
+/-- A surjective polynomial presentation gives an exhaustive image filtration. -/
+theorem exists_mem_imagePiece (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
+    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (a : A) : ∃ d : ℤ, a ∈ imagePiece φ d := by
+  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hφ a
+  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_mem_piece K q
+  exact ⟨d, q, hd, rfl⟩
+
+/-- A source generator belongs to the piece specified by its weight. -/
+theorem X_mem_piece (i : Fin 5) :
+    (X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ∈ piece K (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) := by
+  exact monomial_mem_piece K le_rfl 1
+
+/-- The negative degree of the distinguished variable is available before
+separation or identification of the associated graded ring. -/
+theorem X_zero_mem_piece_neg_one :
+    (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ∈ piece K (-1) := by
+  simpa [monomialWeight] using (X_mem_piece (K := K) 0)
+
+/-- The image of the distinguished variable belongs to degree `-1`. -/
+theorem image_X_zero_mem_neg_one (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) :
+    φ (X 0) ∈ imagePiece φ (-1) :=
+  ⟨X 0, X_zero_mem_piece_neg_one, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The image filtration is multiplicative. -/
+theorem mul_mem_imagePiece (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
+    {a b : A} {d e : ℤ} (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hb : b ∈ imagePiece φ e) :
+    a * b ∈ imagePiece φ (d + e) := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := ha
+  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hb
+  exact ⟨q * r, mul_mem_piece K hq hr, map_mul φ q r⟩
+
+instance (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) : SetLike.GradedMonoid (imagePiece φ) where
+  one_mem := ⟨1, one_mem_piece K, map_one φ⟩
+  mul_mem := fun _ _ _ _ ha hb => mul_mem_imagePiece φ ha hb
+
+instance (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) :
+    IsRingFiltration (imagePiece φ) (fun d => imagePiece φ (d - 1)) :=
+  IsRingFiltration.mk_int _ (imagePiece_mono φ)
+
+/-- Divisibility survives the polynomial presentation. -/
+theorem pow_dvd_of_mem_imagePiece_neg (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
+    {r : ℕ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ (-(r : ℤ))) :
+    φ (X 0) ^ r ∣ a := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := ha
+  have hdiv : (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ^ r ∣ q :=
+    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (piece_neg_le_span_pow K r hq)
+  simpa only [map_pow, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply] using map_dvd φ hdiv
+
+/-- Krull intersection separates the image filtration.  No claim that every
+image has this property is made: the noetherian-domain and nonunit hypotheses
+are explicit and must be supplied by a polynomial-presentation theorem. -/
+theorem eq_zero_of_mem_all_imagePieces [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hp : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0)))
+    {a : A} (ha : ∀ d : ℤ, a ∈ imagePiece φ d) : a = 0 := by
+  let I : Ideal A := Ideal.span {φ (X 0)}
+  have hI : I ≠ ⊤ := by
+    simpa only [I, ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top] using hp
+  have hmem : a ∈ ⨅ r : ℕ, I ^ r := by
+    apply Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr
+    intro r
+    change a ∈ (Ideal.span {φ (X 0)}) ^ r
+    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
+    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (pow_dvd_of_mem_imagePiece_neg φ (ha (-(r : ℤ))))

+  exact hmem
+
+/-- Equivalent submodule-valued statement of separation. -/
+theorem iInf_imagePiece_eq_bot [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
+    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hp : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0))) :
+    (⨅ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d) = ⊥ := by
+  apply eq_bot_iff.mpr
+  intro a ha
+  exact eq_zero_of_mem_all_imagePieces φ hp ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp ha)
+
+end Filtration
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+/-!
+# Coassociativity of normalized determinant-frame lifts
+
+A polynomial algebra map with the identity specialization has the additive
+group law on all four frame entries as soon as it has that law on the three
+quadric products.  This is proved as an equality of two-parameter polynomial
+frames, not by evaluating at field-valued parameters.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace FrameLift
+
+open Polynomial
+
+variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
+
+/-- The iterated polynomial substitution in an additive coaction. -/
+def iterateHom (β : R →+* R[X]) : R →+* R[X][X] :=
+  (Polynomial.mapRingHom β).comp β
+
+/-- Substitute the sum of the two independent action parameters. -/
+def addParameterHom (β : R →+* R[X]) : R →+* R[X][X] :=
+  (Polynomial.taylorAlgHom (X : R[X])).toRingHom.comp
+    ((Polynomial.mapRingHom (C : R →+* R[X])).comp β)
+
+/-- Coassociativity at one particular ring element. -/
+def CoassociativeAt (β : R →+* R[X]) (r : R) : Prop :=
+  (β r).map β = taylor (X : R[X]) ((β r).map (C : R →+* R[X]))
+
+@[simp]
+theorem iterateHom_apply (β : R →+* R[X]) (r : R) :
+    iterateHom β r = (β r).map β := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem addParameterHom_apply (β : R →+* R[X]) (r : R) :
+    addParameterHom β r = taylor (X : R[X]) ((β r).map (C : R →+* R[X])) := rfl
+
+/-- The two-parameter substitutions agree at outer parameter zero. -/
+theorem outer_constantCoeff_agrees (β : R →+* R[X])
+    (hβ : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r) (r : R) :
+    Polynomial.constantCoeff (iterateHom β r) =
+      Polynomial.constantCoeff (addParameterHom β r) := by
+  change ((β r).map β).coeff 0 =
+    (taylor (X : R[X]) ((β r).map (C : R →+* R[X]))).coeff 0
+  rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, hβ, CoactionLND.coeff_universal_translate]
+  simp
+
+/-- Group law on the base coordinates gives equality of the two iterated
+frames by normalized polynomial-frame uniqueness. -/
+theorem coassociative_frame [IsReduced R]
+    (β : R →+* R[X]) (hβ : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r)
+    (F : Frame R)
+    (hbase : CoassociativeAt β (F.a*F.b) ∧
+      CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.c) ∧ CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.b)) :
+    F.map (iterateHom β) = F.map (addParameterHom β) := by
+  let : IsReduced R[X] := ⟨by
+    intro p hp
+    ext n
+    simpa using isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero.mp ((Polynomial.isNilpotent_iff.mp hp) n)⟩
+  apply normalized_univariate_unique
+  · change iterateHom β F.a * iterateHom β F.b =
+      addParameterHom β F.a * addParameterHom β F.b ∧
+      iterateHom β F.d * iterateHom β F.c =
+      addParameterHom β F.d * addParameterHom β F.c ∧
+      iterateHom β F.d * iterateHom β F.b =
+      addParameterHom β F.d * addParameterHom β F.b
+    simpa only [iterateHom_apply, addParameterHom_apply, CoassociativeAt,
+      map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.taylor_mul] using hbase
+  · apply Frame.ext <;> exact outer_constantCoeff_agrees β hβ _
+
+/-- Coassociativity therefore holds on each of the four frame entries. -/
+theorem coassociative_on_frame_entries [IsReduced R]
+    (β : R →+* R[X]) (hβ : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r)
+    (F : Frame R)
+    (hbase : CoassociativeAt β (F.a*F.b) ∧
+      CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.c) ∧ CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.b)) :
+    CoassociativeAt β F.a ∧ CoassociativeAt β F.d ∧
+      CoassociativeAt β F.b ∧ CoassociativeAt β F.c := by
+  have h := coassociative_frame β hβ F hbase
+  exact ⟨congrArg Frame.a h, congrArg Frame.d h, congrArg Frame.b h, congrArg Frame.c h⟩
+
+end FrameLift
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+/-!
+# The action law for a normalized lift to the determinant algebra
+
+The polynomial family constructed from a normalized determinant frame is not
+assumed to be an action.  This file proves its additive group law from that of
+the base family, using the uniqueness of normalized frames.
+-/
+

+namespace StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc
+
+open Polynomial
+open CoactionLND
+
+variable {k B A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing B] [CommRing A]
+  [Algebra k B] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Applying the lifted family twice, with two independent parameters. -/
+def iterateMap (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) : A →ₐ[k] A[X][X] :=
+  (Polynomial.mapAlgHom β).comp β
+
+/-- Applying the lifted family at the sum of two independent parameters. -/
+def sumParameterMap (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) : A →ₐ[k] A[X][X] :=
+  ((Polynomial.taylorAlgHom (X : A[X])).restrictScalars k).comp
+    ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Polynomial.CAlgHom : A →ₐ[k] A[X])).comp β)
+
+@[simp] theorem iterateMap_apply (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) (r : A) :
+    iterateMap β r = (β r).map β.toRingHom := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem sumParameterMap_apply (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) (r : A) :
+    sumParameterMap β r =
+      taylor (X : A[X]) ((β r).map (C : A →+* A[X])) := rfl
+
+/-- Equality of the two action-law maps can be tested on the five actual
+quotient generators, and not merely on their values at complex points. -/
+theorem coassoc_of_generators
+    (β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] (Obstruction.C k)[X])
+    (h : ∀ i : Fin 5,

+    simpa only [hx] using hcoord 0

+def actionOfNormalizedExtension
+    [IsReduced (Obstruction.C k)]

+    (β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] (Obstruction.C k)[X])

+    PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.C k) where

+    (β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] (Obstruction.C k)[X])

+    (actionOfNormalizedExtension α β hidentity hbase).toAlgHom = β := rfl

+end StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Nilpotent
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Uniqueness of normalized polynomial lifts of determinant frames
+
+The bundle in the source is described by `a*c - b*d = 1`, with base
+coordinates `a*b`, `d*c`, and `d*b`.  This file proves directly in rings
+that two frames over the same base differ by a unit.  Consequently two
+polynomial families over a reduced ring, having the same base and the
+same specialization at the zero parameter, agree.  In the action-lift
+argument this is the algebraic group-law normalization step; the
+existence of a lifted polynomial family is a separate obligation.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace FrameLift
+
+/-- A frame for the rank-one bundle underlying the determinant presentation. -/
+structure Frame (R : Type*) [CommRing R] where
+  a : R
+  d : R
+  b : R
+  c : R
+  determinant : a * c - b * d = 1
+
+variable {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
+
+@[ext]
+theorem Frame.ext {F G : Frame R}
+    (ha : F.a = G.a) (hd : F.d = G.d) (hb : F.b = G.b) (hc : F.c = G.c) :
+    F = G := by cases F; cases G; simp_all
+
+/-- Extend each coordinate of a frame by a ring homomorphism. -/
+def Frame.map (f : R →+* S) (F : Frame R) : Frame S where
+  a := f F.a
+  d := f F.d
+  b := f F.b
+  c := f F.c
+  determinant := by simpa only [← map_mul, ← map_sub, map_one] using congrArg f F.determinant
+
+/-- Equality of the three quadric base coordinates. -/
+def SameBase (F G : Frame R) : Prop :=
+  F.a * F.b = G.a * G.b ∧ F.d * F.c = G.d * G.c ∧ F.d * F.b = G.d * G.b
+
+/-- Concrete scalar comparing two frames over the same base. -/
+def comparison (F G : Frame R) : R := F.c * G.a - F.b * G.d
+
+theorem sameBase_symm {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) : SameBase G F :=
+  ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm, h.2.2.symm⟩
+
+theorem comparison_a {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
+    comparison F G * F.a = G.a := by
+  dsimp [comparison]
+  linear_combination G.a * F.determinant + G.a * h.2.2 - G.d * h.1
+
+theorem comparison_d {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
+    comparison F G * F.d = G.d := by
+  dsimp [comparison]
+  linear_combination G.a * h.2.1 + G.d * G.determinant - G.d * h.2.2
+
+theorem comparison_b {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
+    comparison G F * F.b = G.b := by
+  dsimp [comparison]
+  linear_combination G.c * h.1 + G.b * G.determinant - G.b * h.2.2
+
+theorem comparison_c {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
+    comparison G F * F.c = G.c := by
+  dsimp [comparison]
+  linear_combination G.c * F.determinant + G.c * h.2.2 - G.b * h.2.1
+
+/-- The two comparison scalars are inverse units, without any domain hypothesis. -/
+theorem comparison_mul_reverse {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
+    comparison F G * comparison G F = 1 := by
+  calc
+    comparison F G * comparison G F =
+        comparison F G * comparison G F * (F.a * F.c - F.b * F.d) := by
+      rw [F.determinant, mul_one]
+    _ = (comparison F G * F.a) * (comparison G F * F.c) -
+        (comparison G F * F.b) * (comparison F G * F.d) := by ring
+    _ = 1 := by
+      rw [comparison_a h, comparison_c h, comparison_b h, comparison_d h, G.determinant]
+
+/-- The unique unit changing one frame into the other. -/
+def comparisonUnit {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) : Rˣ where
+  val := comparison F G
+  inv := comparison G F
+  val_inv := comparison_mul_reverse h
+  inv_val := comparison_mul_reverse (sameBase_symm h)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem comparison_self (F : Frame R) : comparison F F = 1 := by
+  simpa only [comparison, mul_comm F.c F.a] using F.determinant
+
+@[simp]
+theorem comparison_map (f : R →+* S) (F G : Frame R) :
+    comparison (F.map f) (G.map f) = f (comparison F G) := by
+  simp only [comparison, Frame.map, map_sub, map_mul]
+
+/-- The scalar is determined by its action on the two positive-weight coordinates. -/
+theorem comparison_unique (F G : Frame R) {q : R}
+    (ha : q * F.a = G.a) (hd : q * F.d = G.d) : q = comparison F G := by
+  dsimp [comparison]
+  linear_combination -q * F.determinant + F.c * ha - F.b * hd
+
+/-- Comparison scalar one forces equality of the entire frame. -/
+theorem eq_of_comparison_eq_one {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G)
+    (hq : comparison F G = 1) : F = G := by
+  have hrev : comparison G F = 1 := by
+    simpa only [hq, one_mul] using comparison_mul_reverse h
+  apply Frame.ext
+  · simpa only [hq, one_mul] using comparison_a h
+  · simpa only [hq, one_mul] using comparison_d h
+  · simpa only [hrev, one_mul] using comparison_b h
+  · simpa only [hrev, one_mul] using comparison_c h
+
+/-- Two polynomial families of frames over a reduced coefficient ring are equal
+if they have the same base coordinates and agree at the zero parameter.
+
+In particular this proves the group law for a normalized polynomial-family lift:
+compare the iterated lift over two parameters with the lift at their sum. -/
+theorem normalized_polynomial_unique {σ : Type*} [IsReduced R]
+    {F G : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)} (h : SameBase F G)
+    (hzero : F.map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff = G.map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff) :
+    F = G := by
+  have hu : IsUnit (comparison F G) := (comparisonUnit h).isUnit
+  obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp hu
+  have heval : MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (comparison F G) = 1 := by
+    rw [← comparison_map, hzero, comparison_self]
+  have hr1 : r = 1 := by simpa only [hr, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_C] using heval
+  apply eq_of_comparison_eq_one h
+  simpa only [hr1, map_one] using hr
+
+end FrameLift
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftUniqueness
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Normalizing a polynomial determinant frame
+
+A choice of trivialization gives a frame above the desired quadric base, but
+its specialization need not be the prescribed initial frame.  A constant unit
+rescaling corrects it.  This construction needs no domain or reducedness
+hypothesis; those hypotheses enter only the separate uniqueness theorem.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+variable {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
+
+/-- Fiber scaling: the positive-weight column is multiplied by a unit and the
+negative-weight row by its inverse. -/
+def Frame.scale (F : Frame R) (u : Rˣ) : Frame R where
+  a := (u : R) * F.a
+  d := (u : R) * F.d
+  b := (↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.b
+  c := (↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.c
+  determinant := by
+    calc
+      ((u : R) * F.a) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.c) -
+          ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.b) * ((u : R) * F.d) =
+          ((u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) * (F.a * F.c - F.b * F.d) := by ring
+      _ = 1 := by simp [F.determinant]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem Frame.scale_one (F : Frame R) : F.scale 1 = F := by
+  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.scale]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem Frame.scale_mul (F : Frame R) (u v : Rˣ) :
+    (F.scale u).scale v = F.scale (v * u) := by
+  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.scale, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
+
+/-- Scaling acts within a fiber of the map to the quadric. -/
+theorem Frame.scale_sameBase (F : Frame R) (u : Rˣ) : SameBase (F.scale u) F := by
+  dsimp [SameBase, Frame.scale]
+  constructor
+  · calc
+      ((u : R) * F.a) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.b) =
+          ((u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) * (F.a * F.b) := by ring
+      _ = F.a * F.b := by simp
+  constructor
+  · calc
+      ((u : R) * F.d) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.c) =
+          ((u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) * (F.d * F.c) := by ring
+      _ = F.d * F.c := by simp
+  · calc
+      ((u : R) * F.d) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.b) =
+          ((u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) * (F.d * F.b) := by ring
+      _ = F.d * F.b := by simp
+
+@[simp]
+theorem Frame.map_scale (F : Frame R) (u : Rˣ) (f : R →+* S) :
+    (F.scale u).map f = (F.map f).scale (Units.map f.toMonoidHom u) := by
+  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.scale, Frame.map]
+
+/-- The comparison unit sends the first frame exactly to the second. -/
+theorem scale_comparison {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
+    F.scale (comparisonUnit h) = G := by
+  apply Frame.ext
+  · exact comparison_a h
+  · exact comparison_d h
+  · exact comparison_b h
+  · exact comparison_c h
+
+/-- Transitivity of equality of the three base coordinates. -/
+theorem sameBase_trans {F G H : Frame R} (hFG : SameBase F G) (hGH : SameBase G H) :
+    SameBase F H :=
+  ⟨hFG.1.trans hGH.1, hFG.2.1.trans hGH.2.1, hFG.2.2.trans hGH.2.2⟩
+
+section Polynomial
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {σ : Type*}
+
+/-- Correct an arbitrary polynomial lift to the prescribed initial frame by a
+constant, invertible fiber scaling. -/
+noncomputable def normalizeFrame (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (G : Frame R)
+    (h : SameBase (F.map constantCoeff) G) : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R) :=
+  F.scale (Units.map C.toMonoidHom (comparisonUnit h))
+
+/-- Normalization leaves all three base-coordinate polynomials unchanged. -/
+theorem normalizeFrame_sameBase (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (G : Frame R)
+    (h : SameBase (F.map constantCoeff) G) : SameBase (normalizeFrame F G h) F :=
+  F.scale_sameBase _
+
+/-- The normalized polynomial lift has exactly the specified initial frame. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem normalizeFrame_at_zero (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (G : Frame R)
+    (h : SameBase (F.map constantCoeff) G) :
+    (normalizeFrame F G h).map constantCoeff = G := by
+  rw [normalizeFrame, Frame.map_scale]
+  have hu : Units.map constantCoeff.toMonoidHom
+      (Units.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial σ R).toMonoidHom (comparisonUnit h)) =
+      comparisonUnit h := by
+    apply Units.ext
+    simp
+  rw [hu, scale_comparison h]
+
+/-- Normalization is canonical over a reduced ring. -/
+theorem normalizeFrame_unique [IsReduced R]
+    (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (G : Frame R)
+    (h : SameBase (F.map constantCoeff) G)
+    (F' : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (hbase : SameBase F' F)
+    (hzero : F'.map constantCoeff = G) : F' = normalizeFrame F G h := by
+  apply normalized_polynomial_unique
+  · exact ⟨hbase.1.trans (normalizeFrame_sameBase F G h).1.symm,
+      hbase.2.1.trans (normalizeFrame_sameBase F G h).2.1.symm,
+      hbase.2.2.trans (normalizeFrame_sameBase F G h).2.2.symm⟩
+  · rw [hzero, normalizeFrame_at_zero]
+
+/-- Coefficient specialization commutes with a coefficient-ring homomorphism. -/
+theorem Frame.specialize_map (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (θ : R →+* S) :
+    (F.map (MvPolynomial.map θ)).map constantCoeff =
+      (F.map constantCoeff).map θ := by
+  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.map]
+
+/-- A normalized lift automatically commutes with a fiber scaling whenever
+its base-coordinate polynomials are unchanged by that scaling.
+

+coordinates is checked on the embedded quadric algebra. -/
+theorem normalized_lift_scaling_equivariance [IsReduced R]
+    (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (F₀ : Frame R)
+    (hzero : F.map constantCoeff = F₀)
+    (θ : R →+* R) (u : Rˣ)
+    (href : F₀.map θ = F₀.scale u)
+    (hbase : SameBase (F.map (MvPolynomial.map θ)) F) :
+    F.map (MvPolynomial.map θ) =
+      F.scale (Units.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial σ R).toMonoidHom u) := by
+  apply normalized_polynomial_unique
+  · exact sameBase_trans hbase (sameBase_symm (F.scale_sameBase _))
+  · rw [Frame.specialize_map, hzero, href, Frame.map_scale, hzero]
+    congr 1
+    apply Units.ext
+    simp
+
+end Polynomial
+
+end StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftUniqueness
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ObstructionDefinitions
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Actual determinant-quotient maps from frames
+
+A determinant frame in a commutative `k`-algebra, together with an image of
+`u`, gives an actual algebra homomorphism from the exact source ring
+`k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac-bd-1)`.  This is the quotient-map construction needed when a
+normalized polynomial frame is turned into a lifted additive action.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {k S T : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
+  [Algebra k S] [Algebra k T]
+
+/-- Evaluation on the five independent determinant-presentation variables. -/
+def Frame.polynomialMap (F : Frame S) (u : S) : Obstruction.P k 5 →ₐ[k] S :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval ![F.a, F.d, F.b, F.c, u]
+
+/-- Every determinant frame satisfies the exact source relation. -/
+theorem Frame.polynomialMap_relation (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
+    F.polynomialMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.determinantRelation k) = 0 := by
+  simpa [Frame.polynomialMap, Obstruction.determinantRelation] using
+    sub_eq_zero.mpr F.determinant
+
+/-- The determinant relation generates an ideal in the kernel of evaluation. -/
+theorem Frame.ideal_le_ker_polynomialMap (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
+    Obstruction.idealC k ≤ RingHom.ker (F.polynomialMap (k := k) u).toRingHom := by
+  rw [Obstruction.idealC, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
+  exact F.polynomialMap_relation u
+
+/-- The actual map out of the source determinant quotient induced by a frame.
+The image of the fifth coordinate `u` is arbitrary and independently specified. -/
+def Frame.quotientMap (F : Frame S) (u : S) : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (Obstruction.idealC k) (F.polynomialMap u)
+    (fun _ hp => F.ideal_le_ker_polynomialMap u hp)
+
+@[simp] theorem Frame.quotientMap_cX (F : Frame S) (u : S) (i : Fin 5) :
+    F.quotientMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.cX k i) = ![F.a, F.d, F.b, F.c, u] i := by
+  change F.polynomialMap u (X i) = _
+  simp [Frame.polynomialMap]
+
+@[simp] theorem Frame.quotientMap_a (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
+    F.quotientMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.cX k 0) = F.a := by simp
+
+@[simp] theorem Frame.quotientMap_d (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
+    F.quotientMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.cX k 1) = F.d := by simp
+
+@[simp] theorem Frame.quotientMap_b (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
+    F.quotientMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.cX k 2) = F.b := by simp
+
+@[simp] theorem Frame.quotientMap_c (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
+    F.quotientMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.cX k 3) = F.c := by simp
+
+@[simp] theorem Frame.quotientMap_u (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
+    F.quotientMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.cX k 4) = u := by simp
+
+/-- Maps from the concrete determinant quotient are determined by all five
+coordinate images. -/
+theorem determinant_algHom_ext {φ ψ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S}
+    (h : ∀ i : Fin 5, φ (Obstruction.cX k i) = ψ (Obstruction.cX k i)) : φ = ψ := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  exact h
+
+/-- The canonical determinant frame in the exact quotient. -/
+def sourceFrame (k : Type*) [CommRing k] : Frame (Obstruction.C k) where
+  a := Obstruction.cX k 0
+  d := Obstruction.cX k 1
+  b := Obstruction.cX k 2
+  c := Obstruction.cX k 3
+  determinant := sub_eq_zero.mp (Obstruction.c_relation k)
+
+/-- Each algebra map gives its frame of coordinate images. -/
+def frameOfHom (φ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S) : Frame S :=
+  (sourceFrame k).map φ.toRingHom
+
+@[simp] theorem frameOfHom_a (φ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S) :
+    (frameOfHom φ).a = φ (Obstruction.cX k 0) := rfl
+@[simp] theorem frameOfHom_d (φ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S) :
+    (frameOfHom φ).d = φ (Obstruction.cX k 1) := rfl
+@[simp] theorem frameOfHom_b (φ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S) :
+    (frameOfHom φ).b = φ (Obstruction.cX k 2) := rfl
+@[simp] theorem frameOfHom_c (φ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S) :
+    (frameOfHom φ).c = φ (Obstruction.cX k 3) := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem quotientMap_sourceFrame :
+    (sourceFrame k).quotientMap (Obstruction.cX k 4) = AlgHom.id k (Obstruction.C k) := by
+  apply determinant_algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [sourceFrame]
+
+/-- Naturality of the quotient-map construction under a target algebra map. -/
+theorem Frame.quotientMap_natural (F : Frame S) (u : S) (φ : S →ₐ[k] T) :
+    φ.comp (F.quotientMap u) = (F.map φ.toRingHom).quotientMap (φ u) := by
+  apply determinant_algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [Frame.map]
+
+@[simp] theorem quotientMap_frameOfHom (φ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S) :
+    (frameOfHom φ).quotientMap (φ (Obstruction.cX k 4)) = φ := by
+  apply determinant_algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp
+
+/-- Equality of the determinant frame and the fifth-coordinate image gives
+actual equality of quotient algebra homomorphisms. -/
+theorem determinant_algHom_ext_frame {φ ψ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S}
+    (hF : frameOfHom φ = frameOfHom ψ)
+    (hu : φ (Obstruction.cX k 4) = ψ (Obstruction.cX k 4)) : φ = ψ := by
+  rw [← quotientMap_frameOfHom φ, ← quotientMap_frameOfHom ψ, hF, hu]
+
+/-- Algebra maps from the quadric quotient are determined by its four generators. -/
+theorem quadric_algHom_ext {φ ψ : Obstruction.B k →ₐ[k] S}
+    (h : ∀ i : Fin 4, φ (Obstruction.bX k i) = ψ (Obstruction.bX k i)) : φ = ψ := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  exact h
+
+/-- The existing bundle base map with the canonical source quotient aliases. -/
+def sourceBaseMap (k : Type*) [CommRing k] : Obstruction.B k →ₐ[k] Obstruction.C k :=
+  BundleCharts.baseMap k
+
+/-- The already-constructed base map, expressed in the canonical source names. -/
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_bX (i : Fin 4) :
+    sourceBaseMap k (Obstruction.bX k i) =
+      ![Obstruction.cX k 0 * Obstruction.cX k 2,
+        Obstruction.cX k 1 * Obstruction.cX k 3,
+        Obstruction.cX k 1 * Obstruction.cX k 2, Obstruction.cX k 4] i :=
+  BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k i
+
+/-- A frame lying over the four images of a base map gives an actual extension
+of that base map to the determinant quotient. -/
+theorem Frame.quotientMap_comp_baseMap (F : Frame S) (u : S)
+    (φ : Obstruction.B k →ₐ[k] S)
+    (hx : F.a * F.b = φ (Obstruction.bX k 0))
+    (hy : F.d * F.c = φ (Obstruction.bX k 1))
+    (hz : F.d * F.b = φ (Obstruction.bX k 2))
+    (hu : u = φ (Obstruction.bX k 3)) :
+    (F.quotientMap u).comp (sourceBaseMap k) = φ := by
+  apply quadric_algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i
+  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hx
+  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hy
+  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hz
+  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hu
+
+/-- Restriction to the source base records exactly the three frame products
+and the independent coordinate `u`. -/
+theorem comp_baseMap_eq_iff {φ ψ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S} :
+    φ.comp (sourceBaseMap k) = ψ.comp (sourceBaseMap k) ↔
+      SameBase (frameOfHom φ) (frameOfHom ψ) ∧
+      φ (Obstruction.cX k 4) = ψ (Obstruction.cX k 4) := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 0)
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 1)
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 2)
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 3)
+  · rintro ⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, hu⟩
+    apply quadric_algHom_ext
+    intro i
+    fin_cases i
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hx
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hy
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hz
+    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hu
+
+/-- Normalized polynomial maps of the determinant quotient are unique over
+the same base map.  This is an actual equality of algebra homomorphisms. -/
+theorem normalized_quotientMap_unique {R σ : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
+    [IsReduced R] {φ ψ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ R}
+    (hbase : φ.comp (sourceBaseMap k) = ψ.comp (sourceBaseMap k))
+    (hzero : (frameOfHom φ).map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff =
+      (frameOfHom ψ).map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff) : φ = ψ := by
+  obtain ⟨hF, hu⟩ := comp_baseMap_eq_iff.mp hbase
+  exact determinant_algHom_ext_frame (normalized_polynomial_unique hF hzero) hu
+
+end StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FrameNormalization
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Nilpotent
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Fiber scaling of normalized polynomial determinant frames
+
+A normalized polynomial lift over the quadric is automatically equivariant for
+fiber scaling.  The proof compares the scaled and coefficientwise-transformed
+frames over the Laurent coefficient ring; both have the same base and the same
+zero-parameter frame.  Unit rigidity gives equality.  No linearity assumption
+on the chosen lift is smuggled into the statement.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+namespace StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+open Polynomial
+
+variable {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
+
+@[simp] theorem Frame.map_map (F : Frame R) (f : R →+* S)
+    {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (g : S →+* T) :
+    (F.map f).map g = F.map (g.comp f) := by
+  ext <;> rfl
+
+/-- Fiber scaling does not alter any of the three base coordinates. -/
+theorem sameBase_scale (F : Frame R) (q : Rˣ) : SameBase F (F.scale q) := by
+  have hm (x y : R) : (↑q * x) * (↑q⁻¹ * y) = x * y := by
+    calc
+      (↑q * x) * (↑q⁻¹ * y) = (↑q * ↑q⁻¹) * (x * y) := by ring
+      _ = x * y := by simp
+  exact ⟨(hm _ _).symm, (hm _ _).symm, (hm _ _).symm⟩
+
+/-- Univariate version of normalized-polynomial-frame uniqueness, allowing
+any reduced coefficient ring, in particular a Laurent parameter extension. -/
+theorem normalized_univariate_unique [IsReduced R] {F G : Frame R[X]}
+    (h : SameBase F G)
+    (hzero : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = G.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) :
+    F = G := by
+  have hu : IsUnit (comparison F G) := (comparisonUnit h).isUnit
+  have hp : comparison F G = C ((comparison F G).coeff 0) := by
+    ext n
+    by_cases hn : n = 0
+    · subst n; simp
+    · rw [coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn]
+      exact isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero.mp
+        ((Polynomial.isUnit_iff_coeff_isUnit_isNilpotent.mp hu).2 n hn)
+  have heval : (comparison F G).coeff 0 = 1 := by
+    change Polynomial.constantCoeff (comparison F G) = 1
+    rw [← comparison_map, hzero, comparison_self]
+  apply eq_of_comparison_eq_one h
+  simpa only [heval, C_1] using hp
+
+/-- Coefficientwise ring maps commute with specialization of a polynomial
+family of determinant frames. -/
+theorem Frame.map_polynomial_constantCoeff (F : Frame R[X]) (f : R →+* S) :
+    (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
+      (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map f := by
+  ext <;> simp [Frame.map, Polynomial.constantCoeff, Polynomial.coeff_map]
+
+/-- Fiber equivariance follows from normalization and equality of the base
+coordinates alone.  For the source, `S` is the Laurent extension of `R`, `ι`
+is the constant inclusion, `ρ` is fiber scaling, and `q` is its parameter. -/
+theorem normalized_frame_scaling [IsReduced S]
+    (F : Frame R[X]) (F₀ : Frame R) (ρ ι : R →+* S) (q : Sˣ)
+    (hnormal : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = F₀)
+    (hzero : F₀.map ρ = (F₀.map ι).scale q)
+    (hbase : SameBase (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ))
+      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι))) :
+    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ) =
+      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι)).scale (Units.map (Polynomial.C : S →+* S[X]).toMonoidHom q) := by
+  apply normalized_univariate_unique
+  · exact sameBase_trans hbase (sameBase_scale _ _)
+  · rw [Frame.map_polynomial_constantCoeff, hnormal, hzero, Frame.map_scale,
+      Frame.map_polynomial_constantCoeff, hnormal]
+    congr 1
+    ext
+    simp
+
+/-- If the base coordinate polynomials come from a fixed subring, two coefficient
+homomorphisms agreeing on that subring produce frames over the same base. -/
+theorem sameBase_map_of_base_polynomials
+    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (F : Frame R[X]) (j : B →+* R)
+    (ρ ι : R →+* S) (hbase : ρ.comp j = ι.comp j)
+    (x y z : B[X])
+    (hx : F.a * F.b = x.map j)
+    (hy : F.d * F.c = y.map j)
+    (hz : F.d * F.b = z.map j) :
+    SameBase (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ))
+      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι)) := by
+  have hm (p : B[X]) : (p.map j).map ρ = (p.map j).map ι := by
+    rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, hbase]
+  change (F.a.map ρ) * (F.b.map ρ) = (F.a.map ι) * (F.b.map ι) ∧
+    (F.d.map ρ) * (F.c.map ρ) = (F.d.map ι) * (F.c.map ι) ∧
+    (F.d.map ρ) * (F.b.map ρ) = (F.d.map ι) * (F.b.map ι)
+  simpa only [← Polynomial.map_mul, hx, hy, hz] using
+    And.intro (hm x) (And.intro (hm y) (hm z))
+
+/-- Version ready for an algebraic-action lift: the base coordinate
+polynomials have been constructed in the base ring, whose scaling is trivial. -/
+theorem normalized_frame_scaling_of_base [IsReduced S]
+    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (F : Frame R[X]) (F₀ : Frame R)
+    (j : B →+* R) (ρ ι : R →+* S) (q : Sˣ)
+    (hbase : ρ.comp j = ι.comp j)
+    (x y z : B[X])
+    (hx : F.a * F.b = x.map j)
+    (hy : F.d * F.c = y.map j)
+    (hz : F.d * F.b = z.map j)
+    (hnormal : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = F₀)
+    (hzero : F₀.map ρ = (F₀.map ι).scale q) :
+    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ) =
+      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι)).scale
+        (Units.map (Polynomial.C : S →+* S[X]).toMonoidHom q) :=
+  normalized_frame_scaling F F₀ ρ ι q hnormal hzero
+    (sameBase_map_of_base_polynomials F j ρ ι hbase x y z hx hy hz)
+
+/-- The exact coefficient equations implied by frame-scaling equivariance.
+The case `n=1` is the infinitesimal fiber-weight preservation statement. -/
+theorem coefficient_scaling (F : Frame R[X]) (ρ ι : R →+* S) (q : Sˣ)
+    (h : F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ) =
+      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι)).scale
+        (Units.map (Polynomial.C : S →+* S[X]).toMonoidHom q)) (n : ℕ) :
+    ρ (F.a.coeff n) = ↑q * ι (F.a.coeff n) ∧
+    ρ (F.d.coeff n) = ↑q * ι (F.d.coeff n) ∧
+    ρ (F.b.coeff n) = ↑q⁻¹ * ι (F.b.coeff n) ∧
+    ρ (F.c.coeff n) = ↑q⁻¹ * ι (F.c.coeff n) := by
+  have ha := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.a.coeff n) h
+  have hd := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.d.coeff n) h
+  have hb := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.b.coeff n) h
+  have hc := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.c.coeff n) h
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using ha
+  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using hd
+  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using hb
+  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using hc
+
+end StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.Definitions
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry
+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Division
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Schemes of the complex hypersurface fibers
+
+An algebraic isomorphism of fiber coordinate rings induces an isomorphism of
+affine schemes over `Spec ℂ`. Nonrectifiability excludes every ambient scheme
+automorphism over the complex base, for each complex parameter.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace GeometricInterpretation
+
+open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry MvPolynomial
+open scoped AlgebraicGeometry
+
+/-- The complex affine four-space in its standard spectrum presentation. -/
+abbrev Ambient := Spec (CommRingCat.of (R 4))
+
+/-- The fiber as a scheme, with its full coordinate-ring structure. -/
+abbrev Fiber (t : ℂ) := Spec (CommRingCat.of (FiberRing t))
+
+/-- The actual closed immersion defined by `f - t`. -/
+def fiberEmbedding (t : ℂ) : Fiber t ⟶ Ambient :=
+  AffineGeometry.quotientEmbedding (fiberIdeal t)
+
+instance fiberEmbedding_isClosedImmersion (t : ℂ) :
+    IsClosedImmersion (fiberEmbedding t) :=
+  AffineGeometry.quotientEmbedding_isClosedImmersion (fiberIdeal t)
+
+/-- Standard identification of the ambient spectrum with affine four-space. -/
+def ambientAffineSpaceIso :
+    Ambient ≅ AffineSpace (Fin 4) (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) :=
+  AffineGeometry.affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv (AlgEquiv.refl : R 4 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 4)
+
+/-- The coordinate hyperplane's defining ideal. -/
+def hyperplaneIdeal : Ideal (R 4) := Ideal.span {X 0}
+
+theorem hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime : hyperplaneIdeal.IsPrime := by
+  apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 4))).mpr
+  exact X_prime
+
+/-- The fiber algebra condition proves its defining ideal is prime; this is not
+an additional hypothesis about the source polynomial. -/
+theorem fiberIdeal_isPrime_of_affineFiber (t : ℂ) (h : IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) :
+    (fiberIdeal t).IsPrime := by
+  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
+  let : IsDomain (FiberRing t) := Function.Injective.isDomain e e.injective
+  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime (fiberIdeal t)).mp inferInstance
+
+/-- Geometric rectifiability of the embedded image by an arbitrary ambient
+scheme automorphism over the complex base scheme. -/
+def IsSchemeRectifiableFiber (t : ℂ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ e : Ambient ≅ Ambient,
+    (e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (R 4))) =
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℂ (R 4)))) ∧
+    e.hom '' Set.range (fiberEmbedding t) =
+      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (hyperplaneIdeal : Set (R 4))
+
+/-- The defining-ideal orbit formulation captures exactly the geometric orbit
+condition under all ambient automorphisms. Radicality follows from the specified
+fiber algebra isomorphism, and is therefore not a new principal assumption. -/
+theorem rectifiableFiber_iff_schemeRectifiable (t : ℂ)
+    (h : IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) :
+    IsRectifiableFiber t ↔ IsSchemeRectifiableFiber t := by
+  unfold IsRectifiableFiber IsSchemeRectifiableFiber fiberEmbedding
+  rw [AffineGeometry.quotientEmbedding_range]
+  exact AffineGeometry.ideal_transport_iff_scheme_transport (fiberIdeal t) hyperplaneIdeal
+    (fiberIdeal_isPrime_of_affineFiber t h).isRadical hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime.isRadical
+
+/-- The fiber condition produces an isomorphism with affine three-space in the
+category of schemes **over** `Spec ℂ`, not only an equivalence of sets. -/
+theorem affineFiber_gives_schemeIso (t : ℂ) (h : IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) :
+    Nonempty (AffineGeometry.algebraSpec ℂ (FiberRing t) ≅
+      Over.mk (AffineSpace (Fin 3) (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) ↘
+        Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))) := by
+  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
+  exact ⟨AffineGeometry.affineSpaceOverIsoOfAlgEquiv e⟩
+
+/-- The full algebraic fiber package entails the full all-fiber geometric
+conclusion, including closed immersion and nonrectifiability of its image. -/
+theorem fiberPackage_gives_geometric_conclusion (h : FiberPackage) :
+    ∀ t : ℂ,
+      Nonempty (AffineGeometry.algebraSpec ℂ (FiberRing t) ≅
+        Over.mk (AffineSpace (Fin 3) (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) ↘
+          Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))) ∧
+      IsClosedImmersion (fiberEmbedding t) ∧
+      ¬ IsSchemeRectifiableFiber t := by
+  intro t
+  obtain ⟨haff, hnonrect⟩ := h t
+  refine ⟨affineFiber_gives_schemeIso t haff, inferInstance, ?_⟩
+  exact fun hrect => hnonrect ((rectifiableFiber_iff_schemeRectifiable t haff).mpr hrect)
+
+end GeometricInterpretation
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.GradedRelation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The actual integer grading of the degeneration ring
+
+The quotient `G = k[p,s,u,F,J]/(Hstar)` carries the grading with weights
+`(-1,0,0,1,1)`.  This file constructs that grading, rather than assuming it,
+and records the degree-zero quadric coordinates used in the Laurent picture.
+It does not identify `G` with the associated graded ring of `A`.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.weightedGradedAlgebra
+
+/-- The degree-`n` submodule in the actual principal quotient `G`. -/
+def gPiece (n : ℤ) : Submodule k (G k) :=
+  HomogeneousQuotient.piece (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k presentationWeight) (idealG k) n
+
+/-- Quotient homogeneity gives a genuine integer-graded algebra structure. -/
+instance gGradedAlgebra : GradedAlgebra (gPiece k) :=
+  HomogeneousQuotient.gradedAlgebra (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k presentationWeight)
+    (idealG k) (idealG_homogeneous k)
+
+/-- Images of weighted-homogeneous polynomials lie in the specified quotient piece. -/
+theorem mk_mem_gPiece {n : ℤ} {q : P k 5}
+    (hq : q.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight n) :
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) q ∈ gPiece k n :=
+  HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_piece _ _ hq
+
+/-- Each presentation generator retains its assigned (possibly negative) weight. -/
+theorem gX_mem_piece (i : Fin 5) : gX k i ∈ gPiece k (presentationWeight i) :=
+  mk_mem_gPiece k (isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight i)
+
+/-- The weight-zero invariant `x` in the degeneration ring. -/
+def xG : G k := gX k 1 ^ 2 - gX k 2 ^ 2 + gX k 0 * gX k 3
+
+/-- The weight-zero invariant `y` in the degeneration ring. -/
+def yG : G k := gX k 1 + xG k * (xG k + gX k 2 ^ 2)
+
+/-- The weight-zero invariant `z` in the degeneration ring. -/
+def zG : G k := gX k 1 * xG k + gX k 0 * gX k 4
+
+@[simp] theorem mk_xP : Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) (xP k) = xG k := by
+  simp [xP, xG, gX]
+
+/-- The distinguished determinant invariant is homogeneous of degree zero. -/
+theorem xG_mem_piece : xG k ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  simpa using mk_mem_gPiece k (xP_homogeneous k)
+
+/-- Products of two degree-zero elements again have degree zero. -/
+theorem mul_mem_gPiece_zero {a b : G k} (ha : a ∈ gPiece k 0) (hb : b ∈ gPiece k 0) :
+    a * b ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  simpa using SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ha hb
+
+/-- The second quadric coordinate has degree zero. -/
+theorem yG_mem_piece : yG k ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  have hs : gX k 1 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 1
+  have hu : gX k 2 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 2
+  have hu2 : gX k 2 ^ 2 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+    simpa [pow_two] using mul_mem_gPiece_zero k hu hu
+  exact (gPiece k 0).add_mem hs
+    (mul_mem_gPiece_zero k (xG_mem_piece k) ((gPiece k 0).add_mem (xG_mem_piece k) hu2))
+
+/-- The third quadric coordinate has degree zero. -/
+theorem zG_mem_piece : zG k ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  have hs : gX k 1 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 1
+  have hpJ : gX k 0 * gX k 4 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+    simpa [presentationWeight] using
+      SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (gX_mem_piece k 0) (gX_mem_piece k 4)
+  exact (gPiece k 0).add_mem (mul_mem_gPiece_zero k hs (xG_mem_piece k)) hpJ
+
+/-- The variable `u` on the quadric is the original weight-zero generator. -/
+theorem uG_mem_piece : gX k 2 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 2
+
+/-- The defining equation of `G` in its named generators. -/
+theorem g_relation :
+    xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
+      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2 = 0 := by
+  simpa [Hstar, xP, xG, gX, map_ofNat] using mk_Hstar k
+
+/-- The quadric equation follows from the actual defining relation of `G`. -/
+theorem g_quadric_relation : xG k * yG k - zG k * (zG k + 1) = 0 := by
+  calc
+    xG k * yG k - zG k * (zG k + 1) =
+      gX k 0 * (xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 -
+        (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 - gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2) := by
+      unfold yG zG xG
+      ring
+    _ = 0 := by rw [g_relation k, mul_zero]
+

+/-- Polynomial map implementing the quadric coordinates in `G`. -/
+def baseToDegenerationPre : P k 4 →ₐ[k] G k :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2]
+
+/-- The quadric relation vanishes under the polynomial substitution. -/
+theorem baseToDegenerationPre_relation :
+    baseToDegenerationPre k (quadricRelation k) = 0 := by
+  simpa [baseToDegenerationPre, quadricRelation] using g_quadric_relation k
+
+/-- The canonical algebra homomorphism from the quadric ring into `G`. -/
+def baseToDegeneration : B k →ₐ[k] G k :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (idealB k) (baseToDegenerationPre k) (by
+    intro q hq
+    change q ∈ Ideal.span ({quadricRelation k} : Set (P k 4)) at hq
+    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hq
+    simp [map_mul, baseToDegenerationPre_relation])
+
+@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_mk (q : P k 4) :
+    baseToDegeneration k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealB k) q) =
+      baseToDegenerationPre k q := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_bX (i : Fin 4) :
+    baseToDegeneration k (bX k i) = ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2] i := by
+  simp [bX, baseToDegeneration_mk, baseToDegenerationPre]
+
+/-- All four polynomial substitution values lie in degree zero. -/
+theorem baseToDegenerationPre_X_mem_piece (i : Fin 4) :
+    baseToDegenerationPre k (X i) ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  simp only [baseToDegenerationPre, aeval_X]
+  fin_cases i
+  · exact xG_mem_piece k
+  · exact yG_mem_piece k
+  · exact zG_mem_piece k
+  · exact uG_mem_piece k
+
+/-- The complete quadric coordinate ring lands in weight zero. -/
