+    baseToDegeneration k q ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  refine Quotient.inductionOn' q ?_
+  intro p
+  change baseToDegenerationPre k p ∈ gPiece k 0
+  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
+  | C r =>
+      simp only [baseToDegenerationPre, aeval_C]
+      rw [← (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (idealG k)).commutes r]
+      exact mk_mem_gPiece k (isWeightedHomogeneous_C presentationWeight r)
+  | add p q hp hq =>
+      rw [map_add]
+      exact (gPiece k 0).add_mem hp hq
+  | mul_X p i hp =>
+      rw [map_mul]
+      exact mul_mem_gPiece_zero k hp (baseToDegenerationPre_X_mem_piece k i)
+
+
+@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_sB :
+    baseToDegeneration k (sB k) = gX k 1 := by
+  simp only [sB, map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_pow, baseToDegeneration_bX]
+  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val,
+    yG]
+  ring
+
+@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_f0 :
+    baseToDegeneration k (f0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 3 := by
+  simp only [f0, map_sub, map_add, map_pow, baseToDegeneration_bX, baseToDegeneration_sB]
+  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val, xG]
+  ring
+
+@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_g0 :
+    baseToDegeneration k (g0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 4 := by
+  simp only [g0, map_sub, map_mul, baseToDegeneration_bX, baseToDegeneration_sB]
+  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val, zG]
+  ring
+
+end StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+end

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitialKernel

+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Kernel of the polynomial map to a principal weighted associated graded algebra
+
+The proof connects three concrete calculations:
+* coefficientwise vanishing in the Rees special fiber;
+* the exact lower-representative criterion for a homogeneous polynomial;
+* degreewise membership in a homogeneous principal ideal.
+
+No associated-graded domain assumption or unproved initial-ideal identification
+is used in this kernel computation.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationKernel
+
+open MvPolynomial WeightedInitial
+
+variable {k σ A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Membership in the actual image of the weighted filtration is precisely the
+existence of a bounded polynomial representative. -/
+theorem mem_boundedImage_iff (w : σ → ℤ)
+    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ) :
+    φ p ∈ (boundedSubmodule w d).map φ.toLinearMap ↔
+      ∃ r : MvPolynomial σ k, Bounded w r d ∧ φ r = φ p := Iff.rfl
+
+/-- A homogeneous polynomial maps one filtration step lower exactly when it
+belongs to the ideal generated by the top component of the defining relation. -/
+theorem homogeneous_image_mem_lower_iff [IsDomain k]
+    (w : σ → ℤ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A)
+    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A)
+    (hF : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ),
+      φ p ∈ F d ↔ ∃ r : MvPolynomial σ k, Bounded w r d ∧ φ r = φ p)
+    (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (e : ℤ)
+    (hH : Bounded w H e) (hHt : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H ≠ 0)
+    (hker : RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom = Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)))
+    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℤ} (hp : IsWeightedHomogeneous w p d) :
+    φ p ∈ F (d - 1) ↔
+      p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) := by
+  rw [hF p (d - 1), ← homogeneous_quotient_kernel_iff w H e hH hHt hp]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨r, hr, heq⟩
+    refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
+    rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker]
+    change φ (p - r) = 0
+    rw [map_sub, heq, sub_self]
+  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩
+    refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
+    rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker] at hpr
+    change φ (p - r) = 0 at hpr
+    rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hpr
+    exact hpr.symm
+
+/-- Top components generate a homogeneous principal ideal, including for
+arbitrary integer weights. -/
+theorem top_principal_mem_iff (w : σ → ℤ) (H p : MvPolynomial σ k) (e : ℤ) :
+    p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) ↔
+      ∀ d : ℤ, weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ∈
+        Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) := by
+  let := weightedGradedAlgebra k w
+  apply mem_iff_weightedHomogeneousComponent_mem
+  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
+  intro q hq
+  have hq' : q = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq
+  subst q
+  exact ⟨e, weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous e H⟩
+
+/-- Exact kernel theorem for a polynomial-to-Rees construction whose coefficients
+are the images of weighted homogeneous components.  The `hF` and `hcoeff`
+arguments are compatibility identities for the constructed maps, not
+assumptions about the principal theorem. -/
+theorem kernel_eq_top_principal [IsDomain k]
+    (w : σ → ℤ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A)
+    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hF : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ),
+      φ p ∈ F d ↔ ∃ r : MvPolynomial σ k, Bounded w r d ∧ φ r = φ p)
+    (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (e : ℤ)
+    (hH : Bounded w H e) (hHt : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H ≠ 0)
+    (hker : RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom = Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)))
+    (ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] FilteredRees.rees F)
+    (hcoeff : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ),
+      ((ψ p : FilteredRees.rees F) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+        φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p)) :
+    RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (FilteredRees.parameterIdeal F hmono)).comp ψ).toRingHom =
+      Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) := by
+  ext p
+  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (FilteredRees.parameterIdeal F hmono) (ψ p) = 0 ↔ _
+  rw [FilteredRees.quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff]
+  simp_rw [hcoeff]
+  calc
+    (∀ d : ℤ, φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p) ∈ F (d - 1)) ↔
+        ∀ d : ℤ, weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ∈
+          Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) := by
+      apply forall_congr'
+      intro d
+      exact homogeneous_image_mem_lower_iff w φ F hF H e hH hHt hker
+        (weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous d p)
+    _ ↔ p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) :=
+      (top_principal_mem_iff w H p e).symm
+
+end StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationKernel
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FiltrationSeparation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.WeightedHomogeneous
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The polynomial map onto the actual associated graded algebra
+
+For the source's exact integer weight and the quotient/image filtration,
+this file constructs the algebra map from the five-variable polynomial ring
+to the Rees special fiber and proves surjectivity. No identification of the
+associated graded ring is assumed.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap
+
+open MvPolynomial
+open Filtration FilteredRees
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+variable (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A)
+
+abbrev imageGr := Gr (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ)
+
+/-- A variable as a member of its assigned image-filtration piece. -/
+def variableElement (i : Fin 5) :
+    imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) :=
+  ⟨φ (X i), X i, X_mem_piece i, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The homogeneous polynomial map into the extended Rees algebra. -/
+def reesMap : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] rees (imagePiece φ) :=
+  aeval fun i => homogeneous (imagePiece φ)
+    (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) (variableElement φ i)
+
+/-- The natural ring map from the source polynomial ring into the actual
+associated graded algebra. -/
+def gradedMap : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] imageGr φ :=
+  (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (parameterIdeal (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ))).comp (reesMap φ)
+
+@[simp] theorem gradedMap_X (i : Fin 5) :
+    gradedMap φ (X i) = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ)
+      (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) (variableElement φ i) := by
+  simp [gradedMap, reesMap, initial]
+
+theorem monomialWeight_single (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
+    monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i n) =
+      (n : ℤ) * monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) := by
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [monomialWeight]
+
+/-- Compatibility of the source's explicit exponent formula with mathlib's
+general weighted-polynomial API. -/
+theorem monomialWeight_eq_weight (w : Fin 5 → ℤ)
+    (hw : ∀ i, w i = monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) :
+    monomialWeight = Finsupp.weight w := by
+  apply Finsupp.addHom_ext
+  intro i n
+  rw [monomialWeight_single, Finsupp.weight_single, hw]
+  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
+
+/-- A monomial as a member of its assigned image-filtration piece. -/
+def monomialElement (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
+    imagePiece φ (monomialWeight e) :=
+  ⟨φ (monomial e c), monomial e c, monomial_mem_piece k le_rfl c, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The Rees map preserves each monomial with its exact integer weight. -/
+theorem reesMap_monomial_coe (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
+    (reesMap φ (monomial e c) : LaurentPolynomial A) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (monomialWeight e) (φ (monomial e c)) := by
+  induction e using Finsupp.induction with
+  | zero =>
+      rw [monomial_zero', map_zero, algHom_C, algHom_C]
+      rfl
+  | single_add i n e hi hn ih =>
+      rw [add_comm (Finsupp.single i n) e, monomial_add_single,
+        map_mul, map_pow]
+      change (reesMap φ (monomial e c) : LaurentPolynomial A) *
+        (reesMap φ (X i) : LaurentPolynomial A) ^ n = _
+      rw [ih]
+      rw [map_add, monomialWeight_single i n]
+      simp only [reesMap, aeval_X, homogeneous_coe, variableElement,
+        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
+        nsmul_eq_mul]
+      congr 1
+      simp only [map_mul, map_pow]
+
+/-- Exact formula for the homogeneous symbol of every source monomial. -/
+theorem gradedMap_monomial (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
+    gradedMap φ (monomial e c) =
+      initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) (monomialWeight e)
+        (monomialElement φ e c) := by
+  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMap φ (monomial e c)) =
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (homogeneous _ _ _)
+  congr 1
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  exact reesMap_monomial_coe φ e c
+
+/-- The exact coefficient formula, useful for identifying the kernel of
+the polynomial map degree by degree. -/
+theorem reesMap_coeff (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ) :
+    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+      φ (∑ e ∈ p.support, if monomialWeight e = d then monomial e (p.coeff e) else 0) := by
+  classical
+  have hp : reesMap φ p = ∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) := by
+    rw [← map_sum]
+    exact congrArg (reesMap φ) p.as_sum
+  rw [hp]
+  change ((rees (imagePiece φ)).val
+    (∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)))).coeff d = _
+  rw [map_sum]
+  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, map_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro e he
+  change (reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d = _
+  rw [reesMap_monomial_coe]
+  by_cases h : monomialWeight e = d <;>
+    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, h,
+      ite_true, ite_false, map_zero]
+
+/-- The Rees representative's degree-`d` coefficient is the image of the
+mathlib weighted homogeneous component. -/
+theorem reesMap_coeff_weightedComponent (w : Fin 5 → ℤ)
+    (hw : ∀ i, w i = monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
+    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ) :
+    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+      φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p) := by
+  classical
+  rw [reesMap_coeff, weightedHomogeneousComponent_apply]
+  simp only [← monomialWeight_eq_weight w hw, Finset.sum_filter]
+
+/-- A homogeneous source polynomial has precisely its expected Rees symbol. -/
+theorem reesMap_coe_of_homogeneous (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ)
+    (hp : ∀ e ∈ p.support, monomialWeight e = d) :
+    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ p) := by
+  classical
+  have he : reesMap φ p = ∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) := by
+    rw [← map_sum]
+    exact congrArg (reesMap φ) p.as_sum

+  change (rees (imagePiece φ)).val
+    (∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e))) = _
+  rw [map_sum]
+  calc
+    ∑ e ∈ p.support, (reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) : LaurentPolynomial A) =
+        ∑ e ∈ p.support, AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ (monomial e (p.coeff e))) := by
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro e he
+          rw [reesMap_monomial_coe, hp e he]
+    _ = AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ p) := by
+      change (∑ e ∈ p.support,
+        (AddMonoidAlgebra.singleAddHom d) (φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)))) =
+          (AddMonoidAlgebra.singleAddHom d) (φ p)
+      rw [← map_sum (AddMonoidAlgebra.singleAddHom d), ← map_sum]
+      exact congrArg (fun q => AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ q)) p.as_sum.symm
+
+/-- The natural map on any homogeneous polynomial equals the homogeneous
+initial form represented by its image under the presentation. -/
+theorem gradedMap_of_homogeneous (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ)
+    (hp : ∀ e ∈ p.support, monomialWeight e = d) :
+    gradedMap φ p = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d
+      ⟨φ p, p, (mem_piece_iff k).mpr (fun e he => (hp e he).le), rfl⟩ := by
+  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMap φ p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (homogeneous _ _ _)
+  congr 1
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  exact reesMap_coe_of_homogeneous φ p d hp
+
+/-- The homogeneous symbol is linear within a fixed filtration degree. -/
+def initialLinear (d : ℤ) : imagePiece φ d →ₗ[k] imageGr φ where
+  toFun := initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d
+  map_add' a b := initial_add (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d a b
+  map_smul' c a := by
+    change (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _) (homogeneous _ d (c • a)) =
+      c • (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _) (homogeneous _ d a)
+    rw [← map_smul]
+    congr 1
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    exact (AddMonoidAlgebra.smul_single c d (a : A)).symm
+
+/-- The presentation map restricted to one source filtration piece. -/
+def imagePieceMap (d : ℤ) : piece k d →ₗ[k] imagePiece φ d where
+  toFun p := ⟨φ p, p, p.property, rfl⟩
+  map_add' p q := Subtype.ext (map_add φ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) q)
+  map_smul' c p := Subtype.ext (map_smul φ c (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k))
+
+/-- A source polynomial of weight at most `d` has a degree-`d` symbol. -/
+def sourceInitial (d : ℤ) : piece k d →ₗ[k] imageGr φ :=
+  (initialLinear φ d).comp (imagePieceMap φ d)
+
+@[simp] theorem sourceInitial_apply (d : ℤ) (p : piece k d) :
+    sourceInitial φ d p = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d
+      ⟨φ p, p, p.property, rfl⟩ := rfl
+
+/-- Every source monomial symbol is in the range of the polynomial map;
+symbols placed in a strictly larger degree vanish. -/
+theorem sourceInitial_monomial_mem_range (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : k)
+    (d : ℤ) (h : monomialWeight e ≤ d) :
+    sourceInitial φ d ⟨monomial e c, monomial_mem_piece k h c⟩ ∈
+      (gradedMap φ).range := by
+  by_cases he : monomialWeight e = d
+  · subst d
+    exact ⟨monomial e c, gradedMap_monomial φ e c⟩
+  · have hl : monomialWeight e ≤ d - 1 := by omega
+    have hz : sourceInitial φ d ⟨monomial e c, monomial_mem_piece k h c⟩ = 0 := by
+      rw [sourceInitial_apply, initial_eq_zero_iff]
+      exact ⟨monomial e c, monomial_mem_piece k hl c, rfl⟩
+    rw [hz]
+    exact (gradedMap φ).range.zero_mem
+
+/-- Linear maps out of a span can be tested on its specified generators. -/
+private theorem linear_span_range
+    {M N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N]
+    [Module k M] [Module k N] (s : Set M) (L : Submodule.span k s →ₗ[k] N)
+    (S : Submodule k N)
+    (h : ∀ (p : M) (hp : p ∈ s), L ⟨p, Submodule.subset_span hp⟩ ∈ S)
+    (p : Submodule.span k s) : L p ∈ S := by
+  rcases p with ⟨p, hp⟩
+  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
+  | mem p hp => exact h p hp
+  | zero =>
+      change L 0 ∈ S
+      rw [map_zero]
+      exact S.zero_mem
+  | add p q hp hq ihp ihq =>
+      change L (⟨p, hp⟩ + ⟨q, hq⟩) ∈ S
+      rw [map_add]
+      exact S.add_mem ihp ihq
+  | smul c p hp ihp =>
+      change L (c • ⟨p, hp⟩) ∈ S
+      rw [map_smul]
+      exact S.smul_mem c ihp
+
+/-- Every symbol of a polynomial in a source filtration piece is in range. -/
+theorem sourceInitial_mem_range (d : ℤ) (p : piece k d) :
+    sourceInitial φ d p ∈ (gradedMap φ).range := by
+  apply linear_span_range (k := k) _ (sourceInitial φ d)
+    (gradedMap φ).range.toSubmodule _ p
+  rintro q ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
+  exact sourceInitial_monomial_mem_range φ e 1 d he
+
+/-- Every homogeneous class of the actual image filtration is in range. -/
+theorem initial_mem_range (d : ℤ) (a : imagePiece φ d) :
+    initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d a ∈ (gradedMap φ).range := by
+  rcases a with ⟨a, ha⟩
+  rcases ha with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
+  exact sourceInitial_mem_range φ d ⟨p, hp⟩
+
+/-- The source polynomial map onto the actual associated graded algebra is
+surjective. This uses only the image filtration, not a proposed presentation. -/
+theorem gradedMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (gradedMap φ) := by
+  intro z
+  apply (AlgHom.mem_range (gradedMap φ)).mp
+  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
+  rw [rees_eq_sum (imagePiece φ) p, map_sum]

+  have he := map_dvd (MvPolynomial.eval ![(0:k),0,0,0,1]) h

+  · intro h

+    simp [Hstar, xP] at he

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ObstructionDefinitions
+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Elementary certificates for the graded hypersurface
+
+The negative-coordinate proof uses localization away from `p`.  This file
+establishes that `p` is regular in the actual graded hypersurface quotient,
+using the exact relation rather than a domain assumption.  It also supplies
+localization-domain descent and nonvanishing certificates for the five
+specified homogeneous generators.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+section General
+
+variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [DecompositionMonoid R]
+
+/-- A coefficient relatively prime to a principal relation stays regular modulo it. -/
+theorem quotient_mem_nonZeroDivisors {h p : R} (hr : IsRelPrime h p) :
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p ∈
+      nonZeroDivisors (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) := by
+  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left]
+  intro x hx
+  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
+  rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hx
+  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
+  exact hr.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hx
+
+/-- Localization away from such a regular element is injective. -/
+theorem quotient_away_injective {h p : R} (hr : IsRelPrime h p)
+    (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S]
+    [IsLocalization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p) S] :
+    Function.Injective (algebraMap (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S) := by
+  apply IsLocalization.injective (M := Submonoid.powers
+    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p)) S
+  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
+  exact pow_mem (quotient_mem_nonZeroDivisors hr) n
+
+/-- Domain-ness descends from the localization, without assuming the quotient a domain. -/
+theorem quotient_isDomain_of_away_isDomain {h p : R} (hr : IsRelPrime h p)
+    (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S]
+    [IsLocalization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p) S]
+    [IsDomain S] : IsDomain (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) :=
+  Function.Injective.isDomain (algebraMap (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S)
+    (quotient_away_injective hr S)
+
+end General
+
+section Actual
+
+open StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+variable (k : Type*) [Field k]
+
+/-- `p` does not divide the displayed highest relation: specialize to (0,0,0,0,1). -/
+theorem p_not_dvd_Hstar : ¬ (X 0 : P k 5) ∣ Hstar k := by
+  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
+  have h := congrArg (eval (![0, 0, 0, 0, 1] : Fin 5 → k)) hq
+  norm_num [Hstar, xP] at h
+
+/-- The highest relation is a nonzero polynomial. -/
+theorem Hstar_ne_zero : Hstar k ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  apply p_not_dvd_Hstar k
+  rw [h]
+  exact dvd_zero _
+
+/-- The independent variable `p` is irreducible, hence relatively prime to `Hstar`. -/
+theorem Hstar_relPrime_p : IsRelPrime (Hstar k) (X 0 : P k 5) := by
+  have hp : Irreducible (X 0 : P k 5) := by
+    apply (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff (finSuccEquiv k 4)).mp
+    rw [finSuccEquiv_X_zero]
+    exact Polynomial.irreducible_X
+  exact (hp.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr (p_not_dvd_Hstar k)).symm
+
+/-- The class of `p` is not a zero divisor in the ACTUAL quotient, before domain descent. -/
+theorem gX_zero_mem_nonZeroDivisors : gX k 0 ∈ nonZeroDivisors (G k) :=
+  quotient_mem_nonZeroDivisors (Hstar_relPrime_p k)
+
+/-- The canonical map from `G` into its `p`-localization is injective. -/
+theorem G_away_injective (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (G k) S]
+    [IsLocalization.Away (gX k 0) S] : Function.Injective (algebraMap (G k) S) := by
+  let : Algebra (P k 5 ⧸ Ideal.span ({Hstar k} : Set (P k 5))) S :=
+    ‹Algebra (G k) S›
+  let : IsLocalization.Away
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({Hstar k} : Set (P k 5))) (X 0)) S :=
+    ‹IsLocalization.Away (gX k 0) S›
+  exact quotient_away_injective (Hstar_relPrime_p k) S
+
+/-- A domain certificate for the explicit localized model proves the original `G` a domain. -/
+theorem G_isDomain_of_away_isDomain (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (G k) S]
+    [IsLocalization.Away (gX k 0) S] [IsDomain S] : IsDomain (G k) := by
+  exact Function.Injective.isDomain (algebraMap (G k) S) (G_away_injective k S)
+
+end Actual
+
+end StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.GradedAlgebra.Homogeneous.Ideal
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Grading a quotient by a homogeneous ideal
+
+The manuscript uses two integer gradings on a determinant hypersurface.  This
+module constructs the grading on a quotient from the grading on the original
+algebra; homogeneity of the defining ideal is a proved input, not a new
+assumption on a headline theorem.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient
+
+open DirectSum
+
+variable {ι k A : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [AddMonoid ι]
+  [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+  (𝒜 : ι → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] (I : Ideal A)
+
+/-- Images of homogeneous pieces in the actual ideal quotient. -/
+def piece (i : ι) : Submodule k (A ⧸ I) :=
+  (𝒜 i).map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I).toLinearMap
+
+/-- The quotient map, restricted to one homogeneous piece. -/
+def pieceMap (i : ι) : 𝒜 i →ₗ[k] piece 𝒜 I i :=
+  LinearMap.codRestrict _
+    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I).toLinearMap.comp (𝒜 i).subtype)
+    (fun x ↦ ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩)
+
+omit [DecidableEq ι] [AddMonoid ι] [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] in
+@[simp]
+theorem coe_pieceMap (i : ι) (x : 𝒜 i) :
+    (pieceMap 𝒜 I i x : A ⧸ I) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (x : A) := rfl
+
+/-- Decompose upstairs, then apply the quotient map to every component. -/
+def decomposeBefore : A →ₗ[k] ⨁ i, piece 𝒜 I i :=
+  (DirectSum.lmap (pieceMap 𝒜 I)).comp (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜).toLinearMap
+
+@[simp]
+theorem decomposeBefore_apply (a : A) (i : ι) :
+    (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I a i : A ⧸ I) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a i : A) := rfl
+
+variable (hI : I.IsHomogeneous 𝒜)
+
+include hI
+
+/-- Homogeneity is exactly what permits componentwise decomposition to descend. -/
+theorem ideal_le_ker_decomposeBefore :
+    I.restrictScalars k ≤ LinearMap.ker (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) := by
+  intro a ha
+  apply DFinsupp.ext
+  intro i
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a i : A) = 0
+  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hI i ha)
+
+/-- The decomposition map on the quotient. -/
+def decomposeQuotient : (A ⧸ I) →ₗ[k] ⨁ i, piece 𝒜 I i where
+  toFun := Quotient.lift (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) (fun a b hab ↦ by
+    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
+    rw [← map_sub (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) a b]
+    exact ideal_le_ker_decomposeBefore 𝒜 I hI ((Submodule.quotientRel_def I).mp hab))
+  map_add' := by
+    rintro ⟨a⟩ ⟨b⟩
+    exact map_add (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) a b
+  map_smul' := by
+    rintro r ⟨a⟩
+    exact map_smul (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) r a
+
+@[simp]
+theorem decomposeQuotient_mk (a : A) :
+    decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) = decomposeBefore 𝒜 I a := rfl
+
+omit hI in
+/-- Recomposition of the descended homogeneous pieces is the quotient map. -/
+theorem recompose_decomposeBefore :
+    (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (piece 𝒜 I)).comp (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) =
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I).toLinearMap := by
+  apply DirectSum.decompose_lhom_ext 𝒜
+  intro i
+  apply LinearMap.ext
+  intro x
+  simp [decomposeBefore, DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe]
+
+/-- The descended decomposition has the expected left inverse. -/
+theorem recompose_decomposeQuotient :
+    (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (piece 𝒜 I)).comp (decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI) =
+      LinearMap.id := by
+  apply LinearMap.ext
+  intro x
+  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
+  intro a
+  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (recompose_decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) a
+
+/-- The descended decomposition has the expected right inverse. -/
+theorem decomposeQuotient_recompose :
+    (decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI).comp (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (piece 𝒜 I)) =
+      LinearMap.id := by
+  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
+  intro i
+  apply LinearMap.ext
+  intro y
+  obtain ⟨a, ha, hay⟩ := y.2
+  have hy : y = pieceMap 𝒜 I i ⟨a, ha⟩ := Subtype.ext hay.symm
+  subst y
+  have hdecomp : DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜 a =
+      DirectSum.lof k ι (fun i ↦ 𝒜 i) i ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
+    DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe 𝒜 i ⟨a, ha⟩
+  simp [decomposeBefore, hdecomp]
+
+/-- A quotient by a homogeneous ideal has a direct-sum decomposition. -/
+@[implicit_reducible]
+def decomposition : DirectSum.Decomposition (piece 𝒜 I) :=
+  DirectSum.Decomposition.ofLinearMap (piece 𝒜 I) (decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI)
+    (recompose_decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI) (decomposeQuotient_recompose 𝒜 I hI)
+
+/-- Multiplication of homogeneous representatives descends with its degree. -/
+instance pieceGradedMonoid : SetLike.GradedMonoid (piece 𝒜 I) where
+  one_mem := by
+    refine ⟨1, SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem, ?_⟩
+    exact map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I)
+  mul_mem := by
+    rintro i j _ _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
+    refine ⟨a * b, SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ha hb, ?_⟩
+    exact map_mul (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I) a b
+
+/-- The quotient algebra carries the induced grading, with no restriction on
+negative degrees or on the grading monoid. -/
+@[implicit_reducible]
+def gradedAlgebra : GradedAlgebra (piece 𝒜 I) where
+  toDecomposition := decomposition 𝒜 I hI
+  toGradedMonoid := pieceGradedMonoid 𝒜 I
+
+/-- Homogeneous projections commute with the quotient map. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem proj_mk (i : ι) (a : A) :
+    letI : GradedAlgebra (piece 𝒜 I) := gradedAlgebra 𝒜 I hI
+    GradedAlgebra.proj (piece 𝒜 I) i (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (GradedAlgebra.proj 𝒜 i a) := rfl
+
+omit [DecidableEq ι] [AddMonoid ι] [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] hI in
+/-- A homogeneous representative gives a homogeneous quotient element. -/
+theorem mk_mem_piece {i : ι} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) :
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk I a ∈ piece 𝒜 I i := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightObstruction
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# An integral weight coaction on a homogeneous principal quotient
+
+This construction supplies the fiber-weight action for the actual
+presentation `k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac-bd-1)`.  It works for an arbitrary
+weighted-homogeneous principal relation and uses genuine quotient algebra
+homomorphisms.  Its hypotheses are construction data, not assumptions added
+to the principal package.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace HomogeneousQuotientWeight
+
+open MvPolynomial
+open scoped LaurentPolynomial
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {k σ : Type*} [CommRing k]
+
+/-- The principal quotient determined by a relation. -/
+abbrev QuotientRing (H : MvPolynomial σ k) :=
+  MvPolynomial σ k ⧸ Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k))
+
+/-- The coordinate images in a principal quotient. -/
+def generator (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ) : QuotientRing H :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem aeval_variable (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    aeval (generator H) p = (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
+      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p := by
+  have h : aeval (generator H) = (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
+      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) := by
+    ext i
+    simp [generator]
+  exact congrArg (fun f => f p) h
+
+@[simp]
+theorem defining_relation_zero (H : MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) H = 0 := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton H)
+
+/-- Weighted evaluation annihilates a weighted-homogeneous defining relation. -/
+theorem weightedEval_relation_zero (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) :
+    LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval w (generator H) H = 0 := by
+  rw [LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval_of_homogeneous w (generator H) hH]
+  simp
+
+/-- The Laurent weight coaction on the principal quotient by a homogeneous relation. -/
+def coaction (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) :
+    QuotientRing H →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (QuotientRing H) :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval w (generator H))
+    (by
+      intro p hp
+      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hp
+      rw [map_mul, weightedEval_relation_zero w H hH, zero_mul])
+
+@[simp]
+theorem coaction_mk (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    coaction w H hH ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
+      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p) =
+      LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval w (generator H) p := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem coaction_variable (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (i : σ) :
+    coaction w H hH (generator H i) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (w i) (generator H i) := by
+  change LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval w (generator H) (X i) = _
+  simp [LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval]
+
+/-- A homogeneous polynomial representative gives the expected weight
+identity in the quotient algebra. -/
+theorem coaction_mk_of_homogeneous (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ}
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m) :
+    coaction w H hH ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
+      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p) =
+      AddMonoidAlgebra.single m ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
+        MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p) := by
+  rw [coaction_mk, LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval_of_homogeneous w (generator H) hp]
+  simp
+
+/-- Coefficients of the quotient coaction are the images of polynomial
+weighted components.  In particular, component projection is independent
+of the chosen representative. -/
+theorem coeff_coaction_mk (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (m : ℤ) :
+    (coaction w H hH ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
+      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p)).coeff m =
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H)
+        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w m p) := by
+  rw [coaction_mk, LaurentWeightObstruction.coeff_weightedEval, aeval_variable]
+
+/-- A well-defined linear projection to an integral weight in the quotient. -/
+def component (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (m : ℤ) :
+    QuotientRing H →ₗ[k] QuotientRing H :=
+  (Finsupp.lapply m).comp
+    ((AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).toLinearMap.comp (coaction w H hH).toLinearMap)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem component_apply (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (m : ℤ) (q : QuotientRing H) :
+    component w H hH m q = (coaction w H hH q).coeff m := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem component_mk (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (m : ℤ) :
+    component w H hH m ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
+      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p) =
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H)
+        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w m p) := coeff_coaction_mk w H hH p m
+
+/-- The image definition of a weight piece in a homogeneous principal quotient. -/
+def piece (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (m : ℤ) :
+    Submodule k (QuotientRing H) :=
+  (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w m).map
+    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)))).toLinearMap
+
+/-- A projected component belongs to the corresponding image piece. -/
+theorem component_mem_piece (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (m : ℤ) (q : QuotientRing H) :
+    component w H hH m q ∈ piece w H m := by
+  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective k (Ideal.span {H}) q
+  rw [component_mk]
+  exact ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w m p,
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous m p, rfl⟩
+
+/-- Elements of an image piece have the corresponding single-monomial
+coaction, and conversely the coaction identity detects the image piece. -/
+theorem mem_piece_iff_coaction (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (m : ℤ) (q : QuotientRing H) :
+    q ∈ piece w H m ↔ coaction w H hH q = AddMonoidAlgebra.single m q := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
+    exact coaction_mk_of_homogeneous w H hH hp
+  · intro hq
+    have heq : component w H hH m q = q := by
+      rw [component_apply, hq]
+      simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
+    rw [← heq]
+    exact component_mem_piece w H hH m q
+
+/-- The quotient projections are identity on their own piece and zero on
+all other pieces. -/
+theorem component_of_mem_piece (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
+    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) {m : ℤ} {q : QuotientRing H}
+    (hq : q ∈ piece w H m) (r : ℤ) :
+    component w H hH r q = if r = m then q else 0 := by
+  rw [component_apply, (mem_piece_iff_coaction w H hH m q).mp hq]
+  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
+  by_cases h : r = m
+  · simp [h]
+  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
+
+/-- Any two polynomial weighted-component projections commute. -/
+theorem polynomial_components_commute (w₁ w₂ : σ → ℤ) (m₁ m₂ : ℤ)
+    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent w₁ m₁ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w₂ m₂ p) =
+      weightedHomogeneousComponent w₂ m₂ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w₁ m₁ p) := by
+  classical
+  ext d
+  simp only [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
+  by_cases h₁ : Finsupp.weight w₁ d = m₁ <;>
+    by_cases h₂ : Finsupp.weight w₂ d = m₂ <;> simp [h₁, h₂]
+
+/-- Compatible integral gradings descend to compatible component projections
+on the actual same quotient. -/
+theorem components_commute (w₁ w₂ : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n₁ n₂ : ℤ}
+    (hH₁ : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w₁ n₁) (hH₂ : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w₂ n₂)
+    (m₁ m₂ : ℤ) (q : QuotientRing H) :
+    component w₁ H hH₁ m₁ (component w₂ H hH₂ m₂ q) =
+      component w₂ H hH₂ m₂ (component w₁ H hH₁ m₁ q) := by
+  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective k (Ideal.span {H}) q
+  simp only [component_mk, polynomial_components_commute]
+
+end
+end HomogeneousQuotientWeight
+end StableCoordinate

+import Mathlib.Data.Int.LeastGreatest
+import Mathlib.Data.Int.ConditionallyCompleteOrder
+import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Basic
+import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Defs
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Submodule.Lattice
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Integer filtration degree and initial forms
+
+Section 3 uses an exhaustive separated increasing filtration indexed by all
+integers, including negative integers.  These generic lemmas prove that every
+nonzero element has a least layer and that its image modulo the preceding layer
+is nonzero.  They do not assume any coordinate obstruction or associated-graded
+presentation.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace IntegerFiltration
+
+/-- The integer degree is the infimum of the layers containing an element.
+The lemmas below show that for a nonzero element this infimum is attained. -/
+noncomputable def degree {A : Type*} (F : ℤ → Set A) (x : A) : ℤ :=
+  sInf {d : ℤ | x ∈ F d}
+
+/-- A least layer computes the filtration degree. -/
+theorem degree_eq_of_least {A : Type*} (F : ℤ → Set A) {x : A} {d : ℤ}
+    (hd : x ∈ F d) (hleast : ∀ e : ℤ, x ∈ F e → d ≤ e) :
+    degree F x = d := by
+  exact IsLeast.csInf_eq ⟨hd, hleast⟩
+
+section LeastDegree
+
+variable {A : Type*} [Zero A]
+
+/-- An exhaustive separated increasing integer filtration gives every nonzero
+object a genuine least degree, not merely an infimum or a natural-number degree. -/
+theorem exists_least_index (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
+    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d ∧ ∀ e : ℤ, x ∈ F e → d ≤ e := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℤ, x ∉ F b := by
+    by_contra habs
+    push Not at habs
+    exact hx (hseparated x habs)
+  apply Int.exists_least_of_bdd _ (hexhaustive x)
+  refine ⟨b + 1, fun e he => ?_⟩
+  have hnot : ¬ e ≤ b := fun heb => hb (hmono heb he)
+  omega
+
+/-- In particular the initial form of a nonzero element is represented in one
+layer but not the preceding layer. -/
+theorem exists_initial_index (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
+    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d ∧ x ∉ F (d - 1) := by
+  obtain ⟨d, hd, hleast⟩ := exists_least_index F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx
+  refine ⟨d, hd, fun hprev => ?_⟩
+  have := hleast (d - 1) hprev
+  omega
+
+omit [Zero A] in
+/-- Such an initial index is unique. -/
+theorem initial_index_unique (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    {x : A} {d e : ℤ} (hd : x ∈ F d) (hd' : x ∉ F (d - 1))
+    (he : x ∈ F e) (he' : x ∉ F (e - 1)) : d = e := by
+  have hde : d ≤ e := by
+    by_contra h
+    exact hd' (hmono (by omega : e ≤ d - 1) he)
+  have hed : e ≤ d := by
+    by_contra h
+    exact he' (hmono (by omega : d ≤ e - 1) hd)
+  exact le_antisymm hde hed
+
+/-- The degree of a nonzero element is an attained least index. -/
+theorem degree_spec (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
+    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
+    x ∈ F (degree F x) ∧ ∀ e : ℤ, x ∈ F e → degree F x ≤ e := by
+  obtain ⟨d, hd, hleast⟩ := exists_least_index F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx
+  rw [degree_eq_of_least F hd hleast]
+  exact ⟨hd, hleast⟩
+
+/-- Membership in a filtration layer is equivalent to the integer degree bound. -/
+theorem mem_iff_degree_le (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
+    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) (e : ℤ) :
+    x ∈ F e ↔ degree F x ≤ e := by
+  obtain ⟨hd, hleast⟩ := degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx
+  exact ⟨hleast e, fun he => hmono he hd⟩
+
+/-- The preceding layer misses every nonzero element. -/
+theorem not_mem_degree_sub_one (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
+    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) : x ∉ F (degree F x - 1) := by
+  intro h
+  have := (degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx).2 _ h
+  omega
+
+/-- The degree is characterized by membership in a layer and failure of
+membership in the immediately preceding layer. -/
+theorem degree_eq_iff_initial (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
+    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) (d : ℤ) :
+    degree F x = d ↔ x ∈ F d ∧ x ∉ F (d - 1) := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro rfl
+    exact ⟨(degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx).1,
+      not_mem_degree_sub_one F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx⟩
+  · rintro ⟨hd, hprev⟩
+    exact initial_index_unique F hmono
+      (degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx).1
+      (not_mem_degree_sub_one F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx) hd hprev
+
+/-- Being outside the zeroth layer is exactly positivity of filtration degree. -/
+theorem degree_pos_iff (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
+    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
+    0 < degree F x ↔ x ∉ F 0 := by
+  rw [mem_iff_degree_le F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx 0]
+  exact lt_iff_not_ge
+
+end LeastDegree
+
+section InitialForm
+
+variable {K A : Type*} [Ring K] [AddCommGroup A] [Module K A]
+
+/-- A representative in the first possible layer is nonzero in the quotient by
+its preceding layer.  This is the nonvanishing needed for an initial form. -/
+theorem initial_form_ne_zero (F : ℤ → Submodule K A) {d : ℤ} {x : A}
+    (hx : x ∈ F d) (hxprev : x ∉ F (d - 1)) :
+    (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩ :
+      (F d) ⧸ (F (d - 1)).comap (F d).subtype) ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hmem : (⟨x, hx⟩ : F d) ∈ (F (d - 1)).comap (F d).subtype :=
+    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp h
+  exact hxprev hmem
+
+/-- Separation phrased as a lattice intersection implies elementwise separation. -/
+theorem separated_of_iInf_eq_bot (F : ℤ → Submodule K A) (hF : ⨅ d, F d = ⊥)
+    (x : A) (hx : ∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) : x = 0 := by
+  have hx' : x ∈ ⨅ d, F d := (Submodule.mem_iInf F).mpr hx
+  rw [hF] at hx'
+  exact hx'
+
+/-- The source's exhaustive separated filtration has a nonzero initial form for
+every nonzero element, as a genuine quotient-module element. -/
+theorem exists_nonzero_initial_form (F : ℤ → Submodule K A) (hmono : Monotone F)
+    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) (hF : ⨅ d, F d = ⊥)
+    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ (d : ℤ) (hd : x ∈ F d),
+      (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hd⟩ :
+        (F d) ⧸ (F (d - 1)).comap (F d).subtype) ≠ 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨d, hd, hprev⟩ := exists_initial_index
+    (fun d => (F d : Set A)) (fun _ _ hij => hmono hij)
+    hexhaustive (separated_of_iInf_eq_bot F hF) hx
+  exact ⟨d, hd, initial_form_ne_zero F hd hprev⟩
+
+end InitialForm
+
+end IntegerFiltration
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Successive hypersurface and fiber quotients
+
+The source uses `A = P/(H)` and then `A/(p-lam)`.  This file identifies the
+successive quotient, as an algebra, with `P/(H,p-lam)`.  It is purely a
+quotient interface and contains no geometric or polynomial hypotheses.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace IteratedQuotient
+
+variable (k A : Type*) [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- The ideal generated by a single equation. -/
+abbrev relationIdeal (a : A) : Ideal A := Ideal.span {a}
+
+/-- The ideal generated by two simultaneous equations. -/
+abbrev pairIdeal (a b : A) : Ideal A := Ideal.span {a, b}
+
+lemma span_pair_eq_sup (a b : A) :
+    pairIdeal A a b = relationIdeal A a ⊔ relationIdeal A b := by
+  rw [pairIdeal, relationIdeal, relationIdeal, Ideal.span_insert]
+
+lemma map_relationIdeal (a b : A) :
+    (relationIdeal A b).map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (relationIdeal A a)) =
+      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A a) b} := by
+  simp only [relationIdeal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
+    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]
+
+/-- Two successive principal quotients are the quotient by the pair of equations. -/
+noncomputable def equiv (a b : A) :
+    ((A ⧸ relationIdeal A a) ⧸
+      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A a) b}) ≃ₐ[k]
+        A ⧸ pairIdeal A a b :=
+  (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq k (map_relationIdeal k A a b).symm).trans
+    ((DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSupₐ k (relationIdeal A a)
+      (relationIdeal A b)).trans
+        (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq k (span_pair_eq_sup A a b).symm))
+
+@[simp] theorem equiv_mk_mk (a b x : A) :
+    equiv k A a b
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A a) x)) =
+        Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A a b) x := by
+  rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem equiv_symm_mk (a b x : A) :
+    (equiv k A a b).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A a b) x) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A a) x) := by
+  apply (equiv k A a b).injective
+  simp
+
+/-- Ring-theoretic fibers have the expected simultaneous-equation presentation,
+with the scalar subtraction performed in the appropriate algebra at each stage. -/
+noncomputable def fiberEquiv (H p : A) (lam : k) :
+    ((A ⧸ relationIdeal A H) ⧸ Ideal.span {
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A H) p -
+        algebraMap k (A ⧸ relationIdeal A H) lam}) ≃ₐ[k]
+      A ⧸ pairIdeal A H (p - algebraMap k A lam) :=
+  (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq k (by
+    congr 1)).trans
+      (equiv k A H (p - algebraMap k A lam))
+
+@[simp] theorem fiberEquiv_mk_mk (H p x : A) (lam : k) :
+    fiberEquiv k A H p lam
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A H) x)) =
+        Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A H (p - algebraMap k A lam)) x := by
+  rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem fiberEquiv_symm_mk (H p x : A) (lam : k) :
+    (fiberEquiv k A H p lam).symm
+      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A H (p - algebraMap k A lam)) x) =
+        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A H) x) := by
+  apply (fiberEquiv k A H p lam).injective
+  simp
+
+end IteratedQuotient
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.CoactionAction
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The algebraic additive action of a locally nilpotent derivation
+
+This file combines the finite polynomial exponential with its proved additive
+group law. It constructs an actual polynomial coaction from any locally
+nilpotent derivation in characteristic zero and proves both round-trip laws.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open Polynomial
+open CoactionLND (PolynomialAdditiveAction)
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [Field k] [CharZero k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- The algebraic additive action corresponding to a locally nilpotent derivation. -/
+def exponentialAction (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
+    PolynomialAdditiveAction k A :=
+  PolynomialAdditiveAction.ofCoeffLaw (LNDExponential.exponential D hD)
+    (LNDExponential.coeff_exponential_zero D hD)
+    (LNDExponentialLaw.coefficient_iterative D
+      (LNDExponential.exponential D hD) (LNDExponential.coeff_exponential D hD))
+
+@[simp] theorem exponentialAction_toAlgHom
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
+    (exponentialAction D hD).toAlgHom = LNDExponential.exponential D hD := rfl
+
+/-- Differentiating the exponential algebraic action recovers the derivation. -/
+@[simp] theorem exponentialAction_derivation
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
+    (exponentialAction D hD).derivation = D := by
+  ext a
+  exact LNDExponential.coeff_exponential_one D hD a
+
+/-- Full polynomial coassociativity, not merely the coefficient specification. -/
+theorem exponentialAction_group_law
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
+    (LNDExponential.exponential D hD a).map (LNDExponential.exponential D hD).toRingHom =
+      taylor (X : A[X]) ((LNDExponential.exponential D hD a).map C) :=
+  (exponentialAction D hD).coassoc a
+
+/-- Action invariants are exactly elements annihilated by the derivation.
+No domain hypothesis is required here. -/
+theorem exponentialAction_fixed_iff
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
+    (exponentialAction D hD).toAlgHom a = C a ↔ D a = 0 :=
+  LNDExponentialLaw.fixed_iff D (LNDExponential.exponential D hD)
+    (LNDExponential.coeff_exponential D hD) a
+
+/-- A polynomial additive action is recovered by exponentiating its
+infinitesimal derivation, over every characteristic-zero field algebra. -/
+theorem exponential_derivation_eq (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) :
+    LNDExponential.exponential ρ.derivation ρ.locallyNilpotent = ρ.toAlgHom := by
+  ext a n
+  calc
+    _ = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (ρ.derivation : A → A)^[n] a :=
+      LNDExponential.coeff_exponential ρ.derivation ρ.locallyNilpotent a n
+    _ = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (n.factorial • (ρ.toAlgHom a).coeff n) := by
+      rw [ρ.iterate_derivation]
+    _ = (ρ.toAlgHom a).coeff n := by
+      rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul k, smul_smul]
+      have hn : (n.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
+      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]
+
+/-- Existence of the action is unconditional once local nilpotence is proved. -/
+theorem exists_additiveCoaction_of_locallyNilpotent
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
+    ∃ ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A, ρ.derivation = D :=
+  ⟨exponentialAction D hD, exponentialAction_derivation D hD⟩
+
+omit [CharZero k] in
+/-- Equality of additive coactions is determined by their actual algebra maps. -/
+theorem additiveCoaction_ext {ρ σ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A}
+    (h : ρ.toAlgHom = σ.toAlgHom) : ρ = σ := by
+  cases ρ
+  cases σ
+  cases h
+  rfl

+    {D : Derivation k A A // IsLocallyNilpotent D} ≃ PolynomialAdditiveAction k A where
+  toFun D := exponentialAction D.1 D.2

+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, h, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

+    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : Derivation k B B)
+    (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E)
+    (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (h : ∀ a, E (f a) = f (D a)) (a : A) :
+    (exponentialAction E hE).toAlgHom (f a) =
+      ((exponentialAction D hD).toAlgHom a).map f.toRingHom := by
+  ext n
+  simp only [exponentialAction_toAlgHom, LNDExponential.coeff_exponential,
+    coeff_map, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
+    derivation_iterate_naturality D E f h]
+  exact (f.toLinearMap.map_smul _ _).symm
+
+end Naturality
+

+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.AlgebraMap
+import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Cast
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Polynomial exponentials of locally nilpotent derivations
+
+The exponential of a locally nilpotent derivation in characteristic zero is
+an actual polynomial algebra homomorphism, not a formal power series.  This
+is the forward algebraic interface for the additive-action step in Section 4.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.LNDExponential
+
+open Function Polynomial Finset
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- The factorially divided `n`th iterate of a derivation. -/
+def dividedIterate (D : Derivation k A A) (a : A) (n : ℕ) : A :=
+  ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[n] a
+
+lemma dividedIterate_finiteSupport (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
+    (Function.support (dividedIterate D a)).Finite := by
+  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hD a
+  apply (Set.finite_Iio N).subset
+  intro n hn
+  by_contra h
+  have hz := derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D hN (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)
+  exact hn (by simp [dividedIterate, hz])
+
+/-- A finite-support construction of `exp(T D)(a)`. -/
+def polynomial (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) : A[X] :=
+  Polynomial.ofFinsupp (AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
+    (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite (dividedIterate D a) (dividedIterate_finiteSupport D hD a)))
+
+@[simp]
+lemma coeff_polynomial (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
+    (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
+    (polynomial D hD a).coeff n = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[n] a := rfl
+
+lemma iterate_add (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
+    (D : A → A)^[n] (a + b) = (D : A → A)^[n] a + (D : A → A)^[n] b := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_add]
+
+lemma iterate_smul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (c : k) (a : A) :
+    (D : A → A)^[n] (c • a) = c • (D : A → A)^[n] a := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, Derivation.map_smul]
+
+lemma polynomial_add (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a b : A) :
+    polynomial D hD (a + b) = polynomial D hD a + polynomial D hD b := by
+  ext n
+  simp [smul_add]
+
+lemma polynomial_smul (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
+    (c : k) (a : A) : polynomial D hD (c • a) = c • polynomial D hD a := by
+  ext n
+  rw [coeff_polynomial, Polynomial.coeff_smul, coeff_polynomial, iterate_smul, smul_comm]
+
+lemma polynomial_one (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
+    polynomial D hD 1 = 1 := by
+  ext n
+  cases n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n =>
+    have hzero : (D : A → A)^[n + 1] 1 = 0 :=
+      derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D (m := 1) (by simp) (by omega)
+    simp [hzero, Polynomial.coeff_one]
+
+variable [CharZero k]
+
+lemma inverse_factorial_mul_choose (i j : ℕ) :
+    ((i + j).factorial : k)⁻¹ * ((i + j).choose i : k) =
+      (i.factorial : k)⁻¹ * (j.factorial : k)⁻¹ := by
+  rw [Nat.cast_add_choose]
+  have hi : (i.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero i)
+  have hj : (j.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero j)
+  have hij : ((i+j).factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
+  field_simp
+
+lemma dividedIterate_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
+    ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[n] (a * b) =
+    ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n,
+      (((ij.1.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[ij.1] a) *
+      (((ij.2.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[ij.2] b) := by
+  rw [derivation_iterate_mul, Finset.smul_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  rintro ⟨i,j⟩ hij
+  have hn : i + j = n := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
+  subst n
+  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul k, smul_smul, inverse_factorial_mul_choose]
+  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
+  rw [mul_comm ((i.factorial : k)⁻¹)]
+
+lemma polynomial_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a b : A) :
+    polynomial D hD (a * b) = polynomial D hD a * polynomial D hD b := by
+  ext n
+  simpa only [coeff_polynomial, Polynomial.coeff_mul] using dividedIterate_mul D n a b
+
+/-- The polynomial exponential is a coefficient-field algebra homomorphism. -/
+def exponential (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) : A →ₐ[k] A[X] where
+  toFun := polynomial D hD
+  map_one' := polynomial_one D hD
+  map_mul' := polynomial_mul D hD
+  map_zero' := by
+    ext n
+    simp [Function.iterate_fixed (map_zero D)]
+  map_add' := polynomial_add D hD
+  commutes' c := by
+    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, polynomial_smul, polynomial_one]
+    exact (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one c).symm
+
+@[simp]
+lemma coeff_exponential (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
+    (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
+    (exponential D hD a).coeff n = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[n] a :=
+  coeff_polynomial D hD a n
+
+@[simp]
+lemma coeff_exponential_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
+    (exponential D hD a).coeff 0 = a := by simp
+
+@[simp]
+lemma coeff_exponential_one (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
+    (exponential D hD a).coeff 1 = D a := by simp
+
+end StableCoordinate.LNDExponential
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
+import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Cast
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Additive group law for the polynomial exponential of a derivation
+
+For any polynomial algebra map whose coefficients are the factorially divided
+iterates of a derivation, this file proves the iterative coefficient law. The
+construction of the polynomial map from local nilpotence is kept separate.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw
+
+open Polynomial
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [Field k] [CharZero k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+omit [CharZero k] in
+lemma iterate_smul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (r : k) (a : A) :
+    ((D : A → A)^[n]) (r • a) = r • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih =>
+    simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
+    exact D.toLinearMap.map_smul r _
+
+lemma inv_factorial_mul_inv_factorial (n m : ℕ) :
+    (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ * (m.factorial : k)⁻¹ =
+      ((n + m).choose n : k) * ((n + m).factorial : k)⁻¹ := by
+  have hn : (n.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
+  have hm : (m.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
+  have hnm : ((n + m).factorial : k) ≠ 0 :=
+    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (n + m))
+  rw [Nat.cast_add_choose]
+  field_simp
+
+/-- The coefficient law of the additive group, derived from divided iterates. -/
+theorem coefficient_iterative
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
+    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
+    (a : A) (n m : ℕ) :
+    (E ((E a).coeff m)).coeff n =
+      (n + m).choose n • (E a).coeff (n + m) := by
+  simp only [hE, iterate_smul, smul_smul]
+  rw [← Function.iterate_add_apply]
+  rw [inv_factorial_mul_inv_factorial]
+  rw [mul_smul]
+  exact Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul k _ _
+
+omit [CharZero k] in
+/-- Normalization at the identity of the additive group. -/
+theorem coefficient_zero
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
+    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
+    (a : A) : (E a).coeff 0 = a := by
+  simp [hE]
+
+omit [CharZero k] in
+/-- Extracting the linear coefficient recovers the infinitesimal derivation. -/
+theorem coefficient_one
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
+    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
+    (a : A) : (E a).coeff 1 = D a := by
+  simp [hE]
+
+omit [CharZero k] in
+lemma iterate_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) :
+    ((D : A → A)^[n]) 0 = 0 := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_zero]
+
+omit [CharZero k] in
+lemma iterate_eq_zero_of_pos (D : Derivation k A A) {a : A}
+    (ha : D a = 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn)
+  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ha, iterate_zero]

+omit [CharZero k] in
+/-- Invariants of the infinitesimal derivation are exactly fixed elements of its exponential. -/
+theorem fixed_iff
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
+    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
+    (a : A) : E a = C a ↔ D a = 0 := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have h1 := congrArg (fun q : A[X] => q.coeff 1) h

+    | zero => simp only [coefficient_zero D E hE, coeff_C, ite_true]

+      rw [hE, iterate_eq_zero_of_pos D h (Nat.succ_pos n), smul_zero]
+      simp
+
+omit [CharZero k] in
+/-- Evaluation at parameter zero is the identity. -/
+theorem eval_zero
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
+    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)

+  simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using coefficient_zero D E hE a

+end StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw
+
+end

+end OAI

+

+/-!
+# Transport of the actual graded-hypersurface derivation to its Laurent model
+
+This is the concrete bridge between the graded leading derivation and descent
+to the quadric.  The invariant denominator is the actual generator `gX k 0`;
+all maps use the explicit equivalence proved in `LaurentPresentation`.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport
+open StableCoordinate.Obstruction StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation
+
+section General
+variable {k : Type*} [CommRing k]
+variable (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)) (hp : D (gX k 0) = 0)
+
+/-- Extend to the actual `p`-localization and transport to the Laurent model. -/
+noncomputable def lift : Derivation k (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)
+    (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k) :=
+  LocalizationLND.transport (B := LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)
+    (LocalizationLND.localizeAway D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k))
+    (LaurentPresentation.equiv k)
+
+/-- Intertwining holds on every element of the actual graded presentation. -/
+theorem lift_intertwine (r : G k) :
+    lift D hp (toLaurentBase k r) = toLaurentBase k (D r) := by
+  have h := LocalizationLND.transport_apply (B := LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)
+    (LocalizationLND.localizeAway D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k))
+    (LaurentPresentation.equiv k) (localMap k r)
+  change lift D hp (LaurentPresentation.equiv k (localMap k r)) =
+    LaurentPresentation.equiv k
+      (LocalizationLND.localizeAway D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k) (localMap k r)) at h
+  have hlocal : LocalizationLND.localizeAway D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k) (localMap k r) =
+      localMap k (D r) := LocalizationLND.localizeAway_algebraMap D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k) r
+  simpa only [hlocal, equiv_apply, toLaurent_localMap] using h

+theorem lift_C (b : B k) :
+    lift D hp (LaurentPolynomial.C b) = toLaurentBase k (D (baseMap k b)) := by
+  rw [← toLaurentBase_baseMap k b, lift_intertwine]

+@[simp] theorem lift_T_one : lift D hp (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = 0 := by
+  have h := lift_intertwine D hp (gX k 0)
+  rw [hp, map_zero, toLaurentBase_gX] at h
+  exact h
+
+/-- Invariant source elements remain invariant after Laurent transport. -/
+theorem lift_kills (r : G k) (hr : D r = 0) :
+    lift D hp (toLaurentBase k r) = 0 := by rw [lift_intertwine, hr, map_zero]
+
+/-- Iteration commutes with the concrete presentation map. -/
+theorem lift_iterate (n : ℕ) (r : G k) :
+    (lift D hp : LaurentPresentation.Laurent k → LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)^[n]
+      (toLaurentBase k r) = toLaurentBase k ((D : G k → G k)^[n] r) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, lift_intertwine, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+
+/-- Local nilpotence needs no additional domain or characteristic hypothesis. -/
+theorem lift_locallyNilpotent
+    (hD : ∀ r : G k, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : G k → G k)^[n] r = 0) :
+    ∀ r : LaurentPresentation.Laurent k, ∃ n : ℕ,
+      (lift D hp : LaurentPresentation.Laurent k → LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)^[n] r = 0 :=
+  LocalizationLND.transport_locallyNilpotent (B := LaurentPresentation.Laurent k) _ _

+
+end General
+
+section Field
+variable {k : Type*} [Field k]
+
+/-- The literal source-to-Laurent map is injective; no `IsDomain G` circularity. -/
+theorem toLaurentBase_injective : Function.Injective (toLaurentBase k) := by
+  intro a b h
+  apply GradedRelationSanity.G_away_injective k (Localized k)
+  apply (LaurentPresentation.equiv k).injective
+  change LaurentPresentation.equiv k (localMap k a) = LaurentPresentation.equiv k (localMap k b)
+  simpa only [equiv_apply, toLaurent_localMap] using h
+

+theorem lift_ne_zero (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)) (hp : D (gX k 0) = 0)
+    (hD : D ≠ 0) : lift D hp ≠ 0 := by
+  intro hzero
+  apply hD
+  ext r
+  apply toLaurentBase_injective
+  have h := congrArg (fun E : Derivation k (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)

+  simpa only [lift_intertwine, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero] using h
+

+theorem lift_nonzero_invariant (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)) (hp : D (gX k 0) = 0)
+    (r : G k) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hDr : D r = 0) :
+    toLaurentBase k r ≠ 0 ∧ lift D hp (toLaurentBase k r) = 0 := by
+  refine ⟨?_, lift_kills D hp r hDr⟩
+  intro h
+  apply hr
+  apply toLaurentBase_injective
+  simpa using h

+end StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FactorialClosure
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Homogeneous locally nilpotent derivations on a Laurent polynomial ring
+
+The degree convention in the manuscript is `deg τ = -1`. Thus a derivation
+of degree `m` maps constants to Laurent monomials with exponent `-m`.
+We use the exponent `q` directly, so the source application takes `q = -m`.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent
+
+open LaurentPolynomial Function
+open scoped LaurentPolynomial
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem coeff_C_mul_T (a : A) (q i : ℤ) :
+    (C a * T q : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff i = if q = i then a else 0 := by
+  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T]
+  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
+
+/-- Vanishing of a derivation on `T` implies vanishing on every integral power. -/
+theorem derivation_T_eq_zero (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹])
+    (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (n : ℤ) : D (T n) = 0 := by
+  have hneg : D (T (-1)) = 0 := by
+    simpa [hT] using D.leibniz_invOf (T 1)
+  induction n using Int.induction_on with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [T_add, D.leibniz, hT, ih]
+    simp
+  | pred n ih =>
+    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, T_add, D.leibniz, hneg, ih]
+    simp
+
+/-- Constants followed by a specified coefficient of the derivation. -/
+def coefficientLinear (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ) : A →ₗ[k] A where
+  toFun a := (D (C a)).coeff q
+  map_add' a b := by simp
+  map_smul' r a := by
+    change (D ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A A[T;T⁻¹]) (r • a))).coeff q = _
+    rw [map_smul, Derivation.map_smul]
+    rfl
+
+/-- The precise homogeneous-on-constants condition needed for Laurent descent. -/
+def HomogeneousOnConstants (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ a : A, D (C a) = C ((D (C a)).coeff q) * T q
+
+/-- The homogeneous-on-constants condition is exactly absence of all other exponents. -/
+theorem homogeneousOnConstants_iff (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ) :
+    HomogeneousOnConstants D q ↔
+      ∀ (a : A) (i : ℤ), i ≠ q → (D (C a)).coeff i = 0 := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h a i hi
+    rw [h a, coeff_C_mul_T, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hi)]
+  · intro h a
+    apply LaurentPolynomial.ext
+    intro i
+    by_cases hi : i = q
+    · subst i
+      simp
+    · rw [h a i hi, coeff_C_mul_T, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hi)]
+
+/-- The coefficient derivation obtained from a homogeneous Laurent derivation. -/
+def descend (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) : Derivation k A A where
+  toLinearMap := coefficientLinear D q
+  map_one_eq_zero' := by simp [coefficientLinear]
+  leibniz' a b := by
+    change (D (C (a * b))).coeff q =
+      a • (D (C b)).coeff q + b • (D (C a)).coeff q
+    rw [map_mul, D.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hq a, hq b]
+    have hmul (r s : A) : C r * (C s * T q : A[T;T⁻¹]) = C (r * s) * T q := by
+      rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
+    simp only [hmul, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, coeff_C_mul_T,
+      ite_true, smul_eq_mul]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem descend_apply (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (a : A) :
+    descend D q hq a = (D (C a)).coeff q := rfl
+
+/-- The defining homogeneous expression in terms of the descended derivation. -/
+theorem derivation_C_eq (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (a : A) :
+    D (C a) = C (descend D q hq a) * T q := hq a
+
+/-- A homogeneous Laurent derivation differentiates a monomial only through its coefficient. -/
+theorem derivation_C_mul_T (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (a : A) (j : ℤ) :
+    D (C a * T j) = C (descend D q hq a) * T (q + j) := by
+  rw [D.leibniz, derivation_T_eq_zero D hT, smul_zero, zero_add, smul_eq_mul,
+    derivation_C_eq D q hq, mul_comm (T j), mul_T_assoc]
+
+/-- The exact iterate formula; in the source `q=-m`. -/
+theorem iterate_C (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
+    (D : A[T;T⁻¹] → A[T;T⁻¹])^[n] (C a) =
+      C ((descend D q hq : A → A)^[n] a) * T ((n : ℤ) * q) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, derivation_C_mul_T D q hq hT,
+      Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+    congr 2
+    push_cast
+    ring
+
+/-- Local nilpotence descends from the Laurent ring to the coefficient ring. -/
+theorem descend_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0)
+    (hD : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
+    StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent (descend D q hq) := by
+  intro a
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD (C a)
+  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
+  rw [iterate_C D q hq hT] at hn
+  have hc := congrArg (fun p : A[T;T⁻¹] => p.coeff ((n : ℤ) * q)) hn
+  simpa using hc
+
+/-- A derivation on the Laurent ring is determined by constants and `T`. -/
+theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_constants (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹])
+    (hC : ∀ a : A, D (C a) = 0) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) : D = 0 := by
+  apply Derivation.ext
+  intro p
+  change D p = 0
+  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
+  | add p p' hp hp' => simp [map_add, hp, hp']
+  | C_mul_T n a => simp [D.leibniz, hC, derivation_T_eq_zero D hT]
+
+/-- Nonzero homogeneous Laurent derivations descend to nonzero derivations. -/
+theorem descend_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    descend D q hq ≠ 0 := by
+  intro hE
+  apply hD
+  apply derivation_eq_zero_of_constants D ?_ hT
+  intro a
+  rw [derivation_C_eq D q hq, hE]
+  simp
+
+/-- An invariant Laurent monomial has invariant coefficient after descent. -/
+theorem descend_invariant (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) {a : A} {j : ℤ}
+    (ha : D (C a * T j) = 0) : descend D q hq a = 0 := by
+  rw [derivation_C_mul_T D q hq hT] at ha
+  have hc := congrArg (fun p : A[T;T⁻¹] => p.coeff (q + j)) ha
+  simpa using hc
+
+/-- The standalone Laurent descent package used in `gr:descent`. -/
+theorem exists_descended_lnd (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
+    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0)
+    (hD : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D) (hne : D ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ E : Derivation k A A,
+      StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ a : A, D (C a) = C (E a) * T q) ∧
+      (∀ (a : A) (j : ℤ), D (C a * T j) = 0 → E a = 0) := by
+  refine ⟨descend D q hq, descend_locallyNilpotent D q hq hT hD,
+    descend_ne_zero D q hq hT hne, derivation_C_eq D q hq, ?_⟩
+  intro a j ha
+  exact descend_invariant D q hq hT ha
+
+end StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ObstructionDefinitions
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent

+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# The localized graded presentation
+
+This file constructs the actual algebra equivalence
+`G[p⁻¹] ≃ₐ[k] (B k)[T;T⁻¹]` from Section 3.  No domain hypothesis is
+needed for this explicit coordinate calculation.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation
+open MvPolynomial
+open StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+noncomputable def xG : G k := gX k 1 ^ 2 - gX k 2 ^ 2 + gX k 0 * gX k 3
+noncomputable def yG : G k := gX k 1 + xG k * (xG k + gX k 2 ^ 2)
+noncomputable def zG : G k := gX k 1 * xG k + gX k 0 * gX k 4
+
+private theorem quadric_identity {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (p s u F J : R) :
+    let x := s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 + p * F
+    let y := s + x * (x + u ^ 2)
+    let z := s * x + p * J
+    x * y - z * (z + 1) =
+      p * (x ^ 2 * F - (1 + 2 * s * x) * J - p * J ^ 2) := by
+  dsimp
+  ring
+
+ theorem quadricG : xG k * yG k - zG k * (zG k + 1) = 0 := by
+  have h : xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
+      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2 = 0 := by
+    simpa [gX, Hstar, xP, xG, map_ofNat] using mk_Hstar k
+  change (let x := gX k 1 ^ 2 - gX k 2 ^ 2 + gX k 0 * gX k 3
+          let y := gX k 1 + x * (x + gX k 2 ^ 2)
+          let z := gX k 1 * x + gX k 0 * gX k 4
+          x * y - z * (z + 1)) = 0
+  rw [quadric_identity]
+  change gX k 0 * (xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
+      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2) = 0
+  rw [h, mul_zero]
+
+/-- The source's degree-zero quadric algebra maps into its graded presentation. -/
+noncomputable def baseMap : B k →ₐ[k] G k :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (idealB k) (aeval ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2]) (by
+    change Ideal.span {quadricRelation k} ≤ RingHom.ker
+      (aeval ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2]).toRingHom
+    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
+    rintro r (rfl : r = quadricRelation k)
+    change (aeval ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2]) (quadricRelation k) = 0
+    simpa [quadricRelation] using quadricG k)
+
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_bX (i : Fin 4) :
+    baseMap k (bX k i) = ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2] i := by
+  change (aeval ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2]) (X i) = _

+
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_sB : baseMap k (sB k) = gX k 1 := by
+  simp [sB, yG]
+
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_f0 : baseMap k (f0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 3 := by
+  simp [f0, xG]
+  ring
+
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_g0 : baseMap k (g0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 4 := by
+  simp [g0, zG]
+
+abbrev Laurent := LaurentPolynomial (B k)
+abbrev Localized := Localization.Away (gX k 0)
+
+noncomputable def localMap : G k →ₐ[k] Localized k :=
+  IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (G k) (Localized k)
+
+noncomputable def localParameter : (Localized k)ˣ where
+  val := localMap k (gX k 0)
+  inv := IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)
+  val_inv := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (gX k 0)
+  inv_val := by rw [mul_comm]; exact IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (gX k 0)
+
+noncomputable def fromLaurent : Laurent k →ₐ[k] Localized k where

+    rw [LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_C]
+    exact ((localMap k).comp (baseMap k)).commutes r

+@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_C (r : B k) :
+    fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C r) = localMap k (baseMap k r) :=

+
+@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_T (n : ℤ) :

+  LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_T _ _ n
+
+@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_T_one :
+    fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = localMap k (gX k 0) := by
+  simp [localParameter]
+
+@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_T_neg_one :

+  simp [localParameter]
+  rfl

+noncomputable def laurentValues : Fin 5 → Laurent k :=

+    LaurentPolynomial.C (g0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)]

+  calc
+    LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * (LaurentPolynomial.C r * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) =
+        LaurentPolynomial.C r * (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) := by ring
+    _ = LaurentPolynomial.C r := by rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]; simp

+private theorem value_x :

+      laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 3 = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) := by
+  change LaurentPolynomial.C (sB k) ^ 2 - LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 3) ^ 2 +
+    LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * (LaurentPolynomial.C (f0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
+  rw [cancel_T]
+  simp only [f0, map_add, map_sub, map_pow]
+  ring
+
+private theorem value_y :

+      LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 1) := by
+  change LaurentPolynomial.C (sB k) + LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) *
+    (LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) + LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 3) ^ 2) = _
+  simp only [sB, map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_pow]
+  ring
+
+private theorem value_z :
+    laurentValues k 1 * LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) +
+      laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 4 = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 2) := by
+  change LaurentPolynomial.C (sB k) * LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) +
+    LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * (LaurentPolynomial.C (g0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
+  rw [cancel_T]
+  simp only [g0, map_sub, map_mul]
+  ring
+
+private theorem laurentValues_relation :
+    (let x := laurentValues k 1 ^ 2 - laurentValues k 2 ^ 2 +
+      laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 3

+       laurentValues k 4 - laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 4 ^ 2) = 0 := by
+  let e := (let x := laurentValues k 1 ^ 2 - laurentValues k 2 ^ 2 +
+      laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 3
+     x ^ 2 * laurentValues k 3 - (1 + 2 * laurentValues k 1 * x) *
+       laurentValues k 4 - laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 4 ^ 2)

+    rw [← quadric_identity (laurentValues k 0) (laurentValues k 1) (laurentValues k 2)
+      (laurentValues k 3) (laurentValues k 4)]
+    rw [value_x, value_y, value_z]

+    simpa using h

+@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_gX (i : Fin 5) :

+  change (aeval (laurentValues k)) (X i) = laurentValues k i

+
+theorem toLaurentBase_parameter_isUnit : IsUnit (toLaurentBase k (gX k 0)) := by
+  rw [toLaurentBase_gX]

+
+noncomputable def toLaurent : Localized k →ₐ[k] Laurent k :=

+@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_xG :
+    toLaurentBase k (xG k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) := by
+  simpa only [xG, map_add, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, toLaurentBase_gX] using value_x k
+
+@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_yG :
+    toLaurentBase k (yG k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 1) := by
+  simpa only [yG, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, toLaurentBase_xG, toLaurentBase_gX]

+
+@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_zG :

+private theorem parameter_cancel (r : Localized k) :
+    (localMap k (gX k 0) * r) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0) = r := by

+    (localMap k (gX k 0) * r) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0) =

+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k

+    toLaurent k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by
