+      rw [← mul_assoc, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
+      simp
+    _ = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by rw [h, mul_one]
+
+private theorem laurent_hom_ext {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
+    {f g : LaurentPolynomial R →+* S}
+    (hC : ∀ a, f (LaurentPolynomial.C a) = g (LaurentPolynomial.C a))
+    (hT : f (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = g (LaurentPolynomial.T 1))
+    (hTi : f (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = g (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))) : f = g := by
+  apply RingHom.ext
+  intro r
+  refine LaurentPolynomial.induction_on r hC ?_ ?_ ?_
+  · intro p q hp hq
+    simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
+  · intro n a h
+    rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_add, ← mul_assoc, map_mul f, map_mul g, h, hT]
+  · intro n a h
+    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, LaurentPolynomial.T_add, ← mul_assoc, map_mul f, map_mul g, h, hTi]
+
+ theorem toLaurent_comp_fromLaurent :
+    (toLaurent k).comp (fromLaurent k) = AlgHom.id k (Laurent k) := by
+  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
+  apply laurent_hom_ext (R := B k) (S := Laurent k)
+  · intro r
+    change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C r)) = LaurentPolynomial.C r
+    simp
+  · change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1
+    rw [fromLaurent_T_one, toLaurent_localMap, toLaurentBase_gX]
+    rfl
+  · change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)
+    rw [fromLaurent_T_neg_one, toLaurent_invSelf]
+
+ theorem fromLaurent_comp_toLaurent :
+    (fromLaurent k).comp (toLaurent k) = AlgHom.id k (Localized k) := by
+  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
+  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (gX k 0))
+  apply RingHom.ext
+  intro r
+  change fromLaurent k (toLaurent k (localMap k r)) = localMap k r
+  simp
+
+/-- The exact Laurent presentation of the localized graded hypersurface. -/
+noncomputable def equiv : Localized k ≃ₐ[k] Laurent k :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (toLaurent k) (fromLaurent k)

+argument applies directly inside an ambient algebra: no reflection of a
+quotient grading and no injectivity of a chosen polynomial presentation is

+open scoped LaurentPolynomial

+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

+/-- Laurent polynomials with no negative powers, viewed as a `k`-subalgebra. -/
+def nonnegativePart : Subalgebra k A[T;T⁻¹] :=
+  (Polynomial.toLaurentAlg (R := A)).range.restrictScalars k

+/-- A single nonnegative Laurent monomial is an ordinary polynomial. -/

+  lift n to ℕ using hn
+  change ∃ p : Polynomial A, p.toLaurent = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (n : ℤ) a
+  exact ⟨Polynomial.monomial n a, by
+    simp [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_T]⟩

+strictly negative degree. -/
+theorem eq_zero_of_single_mem_nonnegativePart {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) {a : A}
+    (h : AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a ∈ nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A)) :
+    a = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h
+  change p.toLaurent = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a at hp
+  have hp0 : p = 0 := by
+    calc
+      p = LaurentPolynomial.trunc p.toLaurent := (Polynomial.trunc_toLaurent p).symm
+      _ = LaurentPolynomial.trunc (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) := congrArg _ hp
+      _ = 0 := by
+        rw [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, LaurentPolynomial.trunc_C_mul_T]
+        simp [not_le.mpr hn]
+  have hs : AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a = (0 : A[T;T⁻¹]) := by
+    rw [← hp, hp0, map_zero]
+  have hc := congrArg (fun f : A[T;T⁻¹] => f.coeff n) hs
+  simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same,

+algebra homomorphism to Laurent polynomials, then its generated subalgebra

+    (ρ : A →ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]) {s : Set A}

+  have hle : Algebra.adjoin k s ≤ (nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A)).comap ρ :=
+    Algebra.adjoin_le hs
+  exact hle ha

+be the weight coaction of a quotient algebra; no polynomial subalgebra
+injectivity is needed. -/

+    (ρ : A →ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]) {s : Set A}
+    (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, ρ a ∈ nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A))
+    {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin k s) {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0)
+    (hweight : ρ a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) : a = 0 := by
+  apply eq_zero_of_single_mem_nonnegativePart (k := k) hn
+  rw [← hweight]
+  exact adjoin_mem_nonnegativePart ρ hs ha
+

+def weightedEval {σ : Type*} (w : σ → ℤ) (f : σ → A) :
+    MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹] :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => AddMonoidAlgebra.single (w i) (f i)
+

+weighted evaluation homomorphism. -/
+theorem weightedEval_of_homogeneous {σ : Type*} (w : σ → ℤ) (f : σ → A)
+    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) :
+    weightedEval w f p = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (MvPolynomial.aeval f p) := by
+  induction hp using MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.induction_on with
+  | zero => simp [weightedEval]
+  | add p q hp hq ihp ihq =>
+      simp only [map_add, ihp, ihq, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add]
+  | monomial d r hw =>
+      simp only [weightedEval, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial,
+        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, AddMonoidAlgebra.finsuppProd_single,
+        LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C,
+        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, zero_add]
+      rw [← Finsupp.weight_apply, hw]

+corresponding weighted homogeneous component. -/
+theorem coeff_weightedEval {σ : Type*} (w : σ → ℤ) (f : σ → A)
+    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (n : ℤ) :
+    (weightedEval w f p).coeff n =
+      MvPolynomial.aeval f (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n p) := by

+        simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
+      · rw [MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.weightedHomogeneousComponent_ne n hd (Ne.symm h)]
+        simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
+          ite_eq_right h]
+
+end
+end LaurentWeightObstruction
+end StableCoordinate

+/-!
+# Weighted polynomial evaluation in a Laurent polynomial algebra
+
+The source convention has degree `T = -1`.  Consequently a variable of
+integer weight `w i` is evaluated as a constant times `T (-w i)`.
+This module supplies the graded compatibility needed when extending the
+leading derivation to the source's Laurent localization.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap
+
+open scoped LaurentPolynomial
+open LaurentPolynomial
+
+variable {k B σ : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
+
+/-- The polynomial map with prescribed homogeneous Laurent images. -/
+def evaluate (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B) : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] B[T;T⁻¹] :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => C (c i) * T (-w i))
+
+@[simp] theorem evaluate_X (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B) (i : σ) :
+    evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k) = C (c i) * T (-w i) := by
+  simp [evaluate]
+
+/-- The exact Laurent exponent of an evaluated monomial. -/
+theorem evaluate_monomial (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
+    evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.monomial d r) =
+      C (MvPolynomial.aeval c (MvPolynomial.monomial d r)) * T (-Finsupp.weight w d) := by
+  classical
+  simp only [evaluate, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply]
+  simp only [← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, Finsupp.prod,
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.prod_single]
+  simp [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_assoc]
+
+/-- Every polynomial homogeneous for the integer weights maps to a single
+Laurent exponent.  The coefficient is its ordinary evaluation. -/
+theorem evaluate_homogeneous (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B)
+    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m) :
+    evaluate w c p = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m) := by
+  classical
+  calc
+    evaluate w c p = ∑ d ∈ p.support, evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.monomial d (p.coeff d)) := by
+      conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum, map_sum]
+    _ = ∑ d ∈ p.support, C (MvPolynomial.aeval c (MvPolynomial.monomial d (p.coeff d))) * T (-m) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro d hd
+      rw [evaluate_monomial, hp (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd)]
+    _ = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m) := by
+      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← map_sum, ← map_sum, ← p.as_sum]
+

+    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)

+    (evaluate w c p).coeff j = 0 := by
+  rw [evaluate_homogeneous w c hp, ← single_eq_C_mul_T]

+    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] B[T;T⁻¹])
+    (hφ : ∀ i : σ, φ (MvPolynomial.X i) = C (c i) * T (-w i))

+    φ p = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m) := by
+  have heq : φ = evaluate w c := by
+    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+    intro i
+    rw [hφ, evaluate_X]
+  rw [heq]
+  exact evaluate_homogeneous w c hp

+end StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.GradedAlgebra.Basic
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Leading components of locally nilpotent derivations
+
+This module supplies the graded-algebra mechanism used in §5 of the
+source.  Integer degrees are allowed, including negative degrees.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace LeadingComponent
+
+open DirectSum
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+variable (𝒜 : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜]
+
+/-- Projection to one homogeneous component, regarded as an endomorphism. -/
+abbrev proj (i : ℤ) : A →ₗ[k] A := GradedAlgebra.proj 𝒜 i
+
+@[simp] theorem proj_mem (i : ℤ) (x : A) : proj 𝒜 i x ∈ 𝒜 i :=
+  (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x i).property
+
+theorem proj_of_mem {x : A} {i : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) : proj 𝒜 i x = x :=
+  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hx
+
+theorem proj_of_mem_ne {x : A} {i j : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hij : i ≠ j) :
+    proj 𝒜 j x = 0 :=
+  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 hx hij
+
+theorem proj_mul_left {x y : A} {i j : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
+    proj 𝒜 (i + j) (x * y) = x * proj 𝒜 j y :=
+  DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem 𝒜 hx
+
+/-- The part of a linear map that raises homogeneous degree by exactly `m`. -/
+def componentLinear (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ) : A →ₗ[k] A :=
+  (DirectSum.toModule k ℤ A fun i =>
+    (proj 𝒜 (i + m)).comp (D.comp (𝒜 i).subtype)).comp
+      (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜).toLinearMap
+
+theorem componentLinear_of_mem (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ)
+    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
+    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x = proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x) := by
+  let x' : 𝒜 i := ⟨x, hx⟩
+  change componentLinear 𝒜 D m (x' : A) = _
+  simp only [componentLinear, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
+    DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
+    Submodule.subtype_apply]
+  rfl

+    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
+    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x ∈ 𝒜 (i + m) := by
+  rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx]
+  exact proj_mem 𝒜 _ _
+

+    componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m 1 = 0 := by
+  rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜))]
+  change proj 𝒜 (0 + m) (D 1) = 0
+  rw [Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, map_zero]

+  induction x using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
+  | zero => simp
+  | homogeneous x =>
+    induction y using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
+    | zero => simp
+    | homogeneous y =>
+      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
+      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := y
+      dsimp only at *
+      dsimp only [E]
+      rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hx hy),
+        componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m hx, componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m hy]
+      change proj 𝒜 _ (D (x * y)) = _
+      rw [D.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_add]
+      have h₁ : ∀ i j : ℤ, i + j + m = i + (j + m) := by omega
+      have h₂ : ∀ i j : ℤ, i + j + m = j + (i + m) := by omega
+      rw [h₁, proj_mul_left 𝒜 hx]
+      congr 1
+      rw [← h₁, h₂, proj_mul_left 𝒜 hy]
+      rfl
+    | add y z hy hz => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz]; ring
+  | add x z hx hz => simp only [add_mul, map_add, hx, hz]; ring

+  toLinearMap := componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m
+  map_one_eq_zero' := componentLinear_one 𝒜 D m
+  leibniz' x y := by
+    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using componentLinear_mul 𝒜 D m x y

+    component 𝒜 D m x = componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m x := rfl
+

+    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :

+
+/-- Every homogeneous component above degree `d` vanishes. -/
+def DegreeLE (d : ℤ) (x : A) : Prop :=
+  ∀ j : ℤ, d < j → proj 𝒜 j x = 0
+
+theorem degreeLE_of_mem {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
+    DegreeLE 𝒜 i x := by
+  intro j hj
+  exact proj_of_mem_ne 𝒜 hx (ne_of_lt hj)

+  intro j _
+  exact map_zero _

+    (hi : proj 𝒜 i x ≠ 0) : i ≤ d := by
+  by_contra h
+  exact hi (hx i (lt_of_not_ge h))

+lower bounds and therefore applies to the source's integer gradings. -/
+def HasShiftLE (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i → DegreeLE 𝒜 (i + m) (D x)
+
+theorem degreeLE_map (D : A →ₗ[k] A) {m d : ℤ}
+    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D m) {x : A} (hx : DegreeLE 𝒜 d x) :
+    DegreeLE 𝒜 (d + m) (D x) := by
+  classical
+  intro j hj
+  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 i x = x :=

+  rw [← hsum, map_sum, map_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro i hi
+  have hid := le_of_proj_ne_zero_of_degreeLE 𝒜 hx ((GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 x i).mp hi)
+  exact hD i (proj 𝒜 i x) (proj_mem 𝒜 i x) j (by omega)
+

+the top output component. -/
+theorem top_projection_map (D : A →ₗ[k] A) {m d : ℤ}
+    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D m) {x : A} (hx : DegreeLE 𝒜 d x) :
+    proj 𝒜 (d + m) (D x) = componentLinear 𝒜 D m (proj 𝒜 d x) := by
+  classical
+  rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 D m (proj_mem 𝒜 d x)]
+  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 i x = x :=
+    DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x
+  conv_lhs => rw [← hsum, map_sum, map_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_single d
+  · intro i hi hid
+    have hle := le_of_proj_ne_zero_of_degreeLE 𝒜 hx ((GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 x i).mp hi)
+    exact hD i (proj 𝒜 i x) (proj_mem 𝒜 i x) (d + m) (by omega)

+      by_contra hne
+      exact hd ((GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 x d).mpr hne)
+    simp only [hzero, map_zero]

+    DegreeLE 𝒜 (i + (n : ℤ) * m) ((D : A → A)^[n] x) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simpa using degreeLE_of_mem 𝒜 hx
+  | succ n hn =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+    convert degreeLE_map 𝒜 D hD hn using 1
+    push_cast
+    ring

+  induction n with
+  | zero => simpa using proj_of_mem 𝒜 hx
+  | succ n hn =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+    have hindex : i + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * m = (i + (n : ℤ) * m) + m := by
+      push_cast
+      ring
+    rw [hindex, top_projection_map 𝒜 D hD (degreeLE_iterate 𝒜 D hD hx n), hn]
+
+theorem iterate_linear_zero (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (n : ℕ) :
+    (D : A → A)^[n] 0 = 0 := by
+  rw [← Module.End.pow_apply]
+  exact map_zero _
+
+theorem iterate_linear_add (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (n : ℕ) (x y : A) :
+    (D : A → A)^[n] (x + y) = (D : A → A)^[n] x + (D : A → A)^[n] y := by
+  simp only [← Module.End.pow_apply, map_add]
+
+theorem eventually_zero_add (D : A →ₗ[k] A) {x y : A}
+    (hx : ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0)
+    (hy : ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] y = 0) :
+    ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] (x + y) = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨nx, hx⟩ := hx
+  obtain ⟨ny, hy⟩ := hy
+  refine ⟨nx + ny, ?_⟩
+  rw [iterate_linear_add]
+  have hx' : (D : A → A)^[nx + ny] x = 0 := by
+    rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hx, iterate_linear_zero]
+  have hy' : (D : A → A)^[nx + ny] y = 0 := by
+    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, hy, iterate_linear_zero]
+  rw [hx', hy', zero_add]
+
+/-- Taking the highest allowed shift preserves local nilpotence.  No
+sign assumption on `m`, no field hypothesis, and no characteristic
+hypothesis are needed for this linear-algebra fact. -/
+theorem locallyNilpotent_componentLinear (D : A →ₗ[k] A) {m : ℤ}
+    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D m)
+    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0) :
+    ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((componentLinear 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x) = 0 := by
+  intro x
+  induction x using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
+  | zero => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
+  | homogeneous x =>
+    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hln x
+    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
+    rw [← top_projection_iterate 𝒜 D hD x.property n, hn, map_zero]
+  | add x y hx hy =>
+    exact eventually_zero_add (componentLinear 𝒜 D m) hx hy
+
+/-- The leading homogeneous component of a locally nilpotent derivation
+is locally nilpotent, provided no component has larger degree shift. -/
+theorem locallyNilpotent_component (D : Derivation k A A) {m : ℤ}
+    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m)
+    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0) :
+    ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x) = 0 :=
+  locallyNilpotent_componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap hD hln
+
+/-- A component is nonzero as soon as its value is nonzero on one
+homogeneous element. -/
+theorem component_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
+    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hDx : proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x) ≠ 0) :
+    component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have heq : component 𝒜 D m x = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
+  rw [component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx] at heq
+  exact hDx heq
+
+/-- Every component annihilates any homogeneous element annihilated by
+the original derivation. -/
+theorem component_eq_zero_of_eq_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
+    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hDx : D x = 0) :
+    component 𝒜 D m x = 0 := by
+  rw [component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx, hDx, map_zero]
+
+/-- If a derivation kills a sum with two distinct homogeneous degrees,
+its leading component kills the higher-degree summand.  This is used with
+`a³*b` of degree `-1` and `a²*u²-d²` of degree `2`. -/
+theorem component_high_term_eq_zero (D : Derivation k A A) {m : ℤ}
+    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m)
+    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)
+    (hij : i < j) (hxy : D (x + y) = 0) : component 𝒜 D m y = 0 := by
+  have hxzero : proj 𝒜 (j + m) (D x) = 0 :=
+    hD i x hx (j + m) (by omega)
+  have heq := congrArg (proj 𝒜 (j + m)) hxy
+  rw [map_add, map_add, map_zero, hxzero, zero_add] at heq
+  rw [component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hy]
+  exact heq
+
+theorem componentLinear_eq_sum [DecidableEq A] (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ) (x : A) :
+    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x =
+      ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D (proj 𝒜 i x)) := by
+  classical
+  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 i x = x :=
+    DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x
+  conv_lhs => rw [← hsum, map_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro i _
+  exact componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 D m (proj_mem 𝒜 i x)
+
+/-- A homogeneous component preserves any submodule that is preserved
+by the original map and by all grading projections. -/
+theorem componentLinear_preserves (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ) (S : Submodule k A)
+    (hS : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : A), x ∈ S → proj 𝒜 i x ∈ S)
+    (hD : ∀ x : A, x ∈ S → D x ∈ S) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ S) :
+    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x ∈ S := by
+  classical
+  rw [componentLinear_eq_sum]
+  apply Submodule.sum_mem
+  intro i _
+  exact hS (i + m) _ (hD _ (hS i x hx))
+
+/-- Commuting gradings preserve one another's homogeneous submodules. -/
+theorem projection_preserves_of_commute
+    (ℬ : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
+    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (x : A),
+      proj 𝒜 i (proj ℬ j x) = proj ℬ j (proj 𝒜 i x))
+    {i j : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ ℬ j) : proj 𝒜 i x ∈ ℬ j := by
+  rw [← proj_of_mem ℬ hx, hcomm]
+  exact proj_mem ℬ j _
+
+/-- Taking an auxiliary-degree component preserves a compatible second
+grading whenever the original derivation preserves that grading. -/
+theorem component_preserves_compatible_grading
+    (ℬ : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
+    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (x : A),
+      proj 𝒜 i (proj ℬ j x) = proj ℬ j (proj 𝒜 i x))
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
+    (hD : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : A), x ∈ ℬ j → D x ∈ ℬ j)
+    {j : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ ℬ j) : component 𝒜 D m x ∈ ℬ j := by
+  apply componentLinear_preserves 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m (ℬ j)
+  · intro i x hx
+    exact projection_preserves_of_commute 𝒜 ℬ hcomm hx
+  · exact hD j
+  · exact hx
+
+end LeadingComponent
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.DerivationTopShift
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# A nonzero leading locally nilpotent derivation
+
+This module combines finite algebra generation with the actual homogeneous
+component construction.  It establishes the auxiliary-grading passage in
+§5 of the source without assuming a global degree-shift bound.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace LeadingComponent
+
+variable {k A ι : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Fintype ι]
+variable (𝒜 : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜]
+
+/-- Every nonzero locally nilpotent derivation of a finitely generated
+integer-graded algebra with homogeneous generators has a nonzero leading
+homogeneous locally nilpotent component. -/
+theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component
+    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
+    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
+    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0) :
+    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
+      HasShiftLE 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m ∧
+      (∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x) = 0) := by
+  obtain ⟨m, hm, _, hbound⟩ :=
+    DerivationTopShift.exists_top_component_and_global_bound 𝒜 g d hg hhom D hD
+      (component 𝒜 D) (fun m _ _ hx => component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx)
+  exact ⟨m, hm, hbound, locallyNilpotent_component 𝒜 D hbound hln⟩
+
+/-- The source's auxiliary-grading reduction: if a locally nilpotent
+derivation annihilates a sum of two distinct homogeneous degrees, its
+nonzero leading locally nilpotent component annihilates the higher part. -/
+theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_annihilating_top
+    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
+    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
+    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0)
+    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)
+    (hij : i < j) (hxy : D (x + y) = 0) :
+    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ z : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] z) = 0) ∧
+      component 𝒜 D m y = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨m, hm, hbound, hnil⟩ :=
+    exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component 𝒜 g d hg hhom D hD hln
+  exact ⟨m, hm, hnil, component_high_term_eq_zero 𝒜 D hbound hx hy hij hxy⟩
+
+/-- The leading component also preserves a compatible second grading.
+This packages the full leading-component step of the source's rigidity
+proof, including preservation of the fiber weights. -/
+theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_compatible
+    (ℬ : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
+    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (x : A),
+      proj 𝒜 i (proj ℬ j x) = proj ℬ j (proj 𝒜 i x))
+    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
+    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
+    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
+    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
+    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0)
+    (hpres : ∀ (r : ℤ) (z : A), z ∈ ℬ r → D z ∈ ℬ r)
+    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)
+    (hij : i < j) (hxy : D (x + y) = 0) :
+    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ z : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] z) = 0) ∧
+      (∀ (r : ℤ) (z : A), z ∈ ℬ r → component 𝒜 D m z ∈ ℬ r) ∧
+      component 𝒜 D m y = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨m, hm, hnil, htop⟩ :=
+    exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_annihilating_top 𝒜 g d hg hhom D hD hln
+      hx hy hij hxy
+  refine ⟨m, hm, hnil, ?_, htop⟩
+  intro r z hz
+  exact component_preserves_compatible_grading 𝒜 ℬ hcomm D m hpres hz
+
+end LeadingComponent
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.DeterminantLiftWeights

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.LNDAction

+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The actual weight-preserving locally nilpotent lift
+
+This file completes source Proposition `prop:lift` for the exact rings `B` and
+`C`.  There is no assumed action lift or line-bundle trivialization: the genuine
+UFD structure of `C[T]` gives a determinant frame, its constant-unit
+normalization gives a polynomial family, and normalized-frame uniqueness proves
+the additive group law.  A second use of uniqueness proves fiber-scaling
+equivariance.  Differentiation therefore gives a locally nilpotent derivation
+that extends the given one and preserves the actual constructed fiber grading.
+
+Finally, injectivity of `B → C`, the identity `IC = (v)`, and factorial closure
+of an LND kernel transport a nonzero invariant in `I` to the condition `D(v)=0`.
+All intermediate existence and equivariance interfaces are discharged here.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+open CoactionLND
+
+variable {k : Type*} [Field k]
+
+/-- The actual additive action on the determinant ring lifting a given action
+on the quadric ring.  Its group law is a theorem of normalized-frame uniqueness. -/
+def liftedAdditiveAction (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (B k)) :
+    PolynomialAdditiveAction k (C k) :=
+  FrameLiftCoassoc.actionOfNormalizedExtension α
+    (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom α)
+    (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_identity α)
+    (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_baseMap α)
+
+@[simp] theorem liftedAdditiveAction_toAlgHom
+    (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (B k)) :
+    (liftedAdditiveAction α).toAlgHom = NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom α := rfl
+
+/-- The constructed action is equivariant for the actual injective base map. -/
+theorem liftedAdditiveAction_baseMap (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (B k))
+    (b : B k) :
+    (liftedAdditiveAction α).toAlgHom (baseMap k b) =
+      (α.toAlgHom b).map (baseMap k).toRingHom :=
+  NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_baseMap α b
+
+/-- Differentiation of the constructed action preserves every actual fiber
+weight submodule.  The five coefficient laws are proved, not hypothesized. -/
+theorem liftedAdditiveAction_derivation_preserves_fiberPiece
+    (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (B k)) :
+    ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n →
+      (liftedAdditiveAction α).derivation q ∈ fiberPiece k n := by
+  apply DeterminantActionWeights.derivation_preserves_fiberPiece k
+    (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom α)
+  · exact DeterminantLiftWeights.generator_coefficient_weights_of_normalized_lift k
+      (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom α) α.toAlgHom
+      (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_baseMap α)
+      (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_identity α)
+  · intro q
+    rfl
+
+variable [CharZero k]
+
+/-- Every locally nilpotent derivation on the exact base quadric admits an
+actual locally nilpotent extension preserving the source's fiber grading.
+This is the unconditional existence part of source Proposition `prop:lift`. -/
+theorem exists_weight_preserving_lnd_lift
+    (E : Derivation k (B k) (B k)) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E) :
+    ∃ D : Derivation k (C k) (C k), IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧
+      (∀ b, D (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (E b)) ∧
+      (∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n → D q ∈ fiberPiece k n) := by
+  let α := exponentialAction E hE
+  let β := liftedAdditiveAction α
+  refine ⟨β.derivation, β.locallyNilpotent, ?_,
+    liftedAdditiveAction_derivation_preserves_fiberPiece α⟩
+  intro b
+  have h := α.derivation_naturality β (baseMap k)
+    (liftedAdditiveAction_baseMap α) b
+  simpa only [α, exponentialAction_derivation] using h
+
+/-- Full source lift proposition, retaining the extension equation as well as
+the nonzero invariant and grading conclusions required by rigidity. -/
+theorem lift_invariant
+    (E : Derivation k (B k) (B k)) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E) (hE0 : E ≠ 0)
+    (hInv : ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0) :
+    ∃ D : Derivation k (C k) (C k), IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧ D ≠ 0 ∧
+      (∀ b, D (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (E b)) ∧
+      (∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n → D q ∈ fiberPiece k n) ∧
+      D (v k) = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨D, hD, hExt, hWeight⟩ := exists_weight_preserving_lnd_lift E hE
+  obtain ⟨hD0, hv⟩ := extension_nonzero_and_annihilates_v E D hE0 hD hExt hInv
+  exact ⟨D, hD, hD0, hExt, hWeight, hv⟩
+
+/-- The precise existence conclusion needed by the final weight contradiction. -/
+theorem exists_nonzero_weight_preserving_lnd_killing_v
+    (E : Derivation k (B k) (B k)) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E) (hE0 : E ≠ 0)
+    (hInv : ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0) :
+    ∃ D : Derivation k (C k) (C k), D ≠ 0 ∧ IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧
+      (∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n → D q ∈ fiberPiece k n) ∧
+      D (v k) = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨D, hD, hD0, _, hWeight, hv⟩ := lift_invariant E hE hE0 hInv
+  exact ⟨D, hD0, hD, hWeight, hv⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The determinant-one linear substitution in the stabilization construction
+
+This module formalizes the `L,N` change of variables in Section 2 of the source.
+It uses six genuinely independent polynomial generators, in the order
+`p,s,u,F,J,w`.  All results hold over any commutative coefficient ring.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.Linearization
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+abbrev P := MvPolynomial (Fin 6) k
+
+/-- The part of the auxiliary quadratic not containing `p`. -/
+def x0 : P k := X 1 ^ 2 - X 2 ^ 2
+
+/-- The first new linear coordinate, denoted `L` in the manuscript. -/
+def l : P k := x0 k ^ 2 * X 3 - (1 + 2 * X 1 * x0 k) * X 4
+
+/-- The second new linear coordinate, denoted `N` in the manuscript. -/
+def n : P k := (1 - 2 * X 1 * x0 k) * X 3 + 4 * X 1 ^ 2 * X 4
+
+/-- The inverse formula for `F` in terms of the slots now called `L,N`. -/
+def inverseF : P k := 4 * X 1 ^ 2 * X 3 + (1 + 2 * X 1 * x0 k) * X 4
+
+/-- The inverse formula for `J` in terms of the slots now called `L,N`. -/
+def inverseJ : P k := -(1 - 2 * X 1 * x0 k) * X 3 + x0 k ^ 2 * X 4
+
+/-- Substitution `F ↦ L`, `J ↦ N`, fixing the other four generators. -/
+def forward : P k →ₐ[k] P k :=
+  aeval ![X 0, X 1, X 2, l k, n k, X 5]
+
+/-- The inverse determinant-one substitution. -/
+def backward : P k →ₐ[k] P k :=
+  aeval ![X 0, X 1, X 2, inverseF k, inverseJ k, X 5]
+
+@[simp] theorem forward_X (i : Fin 6) :
+    forward k (X i) = ![X 0, X 1, X 2, l k, n k, X 5] i := by
+  simp [forward]
+
+@[simp] theorem backward_X (i : Fin 6) :
+    backward k (X i) = ![X 0, X 1, X 2, inverseF k, inverseJ k, X 5] i := by
+  simp [backward]
+
+@[simp] theorem forward_x0 : forward k (x0 k) = x0 k := by
+  simp [x0]
+
+@[simp] theorem backward_x0 : backward k (x0 k) = x0 k := by
+  simp [x0]
+
+ theorem backward_comp_forward : (backward k).comp (forward k) = AlgHom.id k (P k) := by
+  ext i : 1
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [l, n, inverseF, inverseJ, map_ofNat] <;> ring
+
+ theorem forward_comp_backward : (forward k).comp (backward k) = AlgHom.id k (P k) := by
+  ext i : 1
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [l, n, inverseF, inverseJ, map_ofNat] <;> ring
+
+/-- The exact determinant-one `L,N` change is a polynomial algebra automorphism. -/
+def equiv : P k ≃ₐ[k] P k :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (forward k) (backward k)
+    (forward_comp_backward k) (backward_comp_forward k)
+
+@[simp] theorem equiv_apply (p : P k) : equiv k p = forward k p := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem equiv_symm_apply (p : P k) : (equiv k).symm p = backward k p := rfl
+
+/-- The source's auxiliary quadratic including `p F`. -/
+def x : P k := x0 k + X 0 * X 3
+
+/-- The source hypersurface relation, extended by the independent variable `w`. -/
+def h : P k := x k ^ 2 * X 3 - (1 + 2 * X 1 * x k) * X 4 - X 0 * X 4 ^ 2 - X 2
+
+/-- The polynomial remainder `Q₀` in the source equation `H = L-u+p Q₀`. -/
+def q0 : P k := 2 * x0 k * X 3 ^ 2 + X 0 * X 3 ^ 3 - 2 * X 1 * X 3 * X 4 - X 4 ^ 2
+
+/-- The divisibility identity used to remove the nonlinear remainder. -/
+theorem h_expansion : h k = l k - X 2 + X 0 * q0 k := by
+  unfold h x l q0
+  ring
+
+/-- `Q₀` written in the new linear coordinates. -/
+def qTrans : P k :=
+  2 * x0 k * inverseF k ^ 2 + X 0 * inverseF k ^ 3 -
+    2 * X 1 * inverseF k * inverseJ k - inverseJ k ^ 2
+
+@[simp] theorem backward_q0 : backward k (q0 k) = qTrans k := by
+  simp [q0, qTrans, map_ofNat]
+
+@[simp] theorem backward_l : backward k (l k) = X 3 := by
+  have hh := DFunLike.congr_fun (backward_comp_forward k) (X 3)

+  simp [normalization]
+

+  simp [normalization]

+theorem normalization_stabilized_h :
+    normalization k (h k + X 0 * X 5) = X 3 - X 2 + X 0 * X 5 := by
+  change minusShear k (backward k (h k + X 0 * X 5)) = _
+  simp [backward_h]

+end StableCoordinate.Linearization

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.AsSubring

+/-!
+# The two-localization intersection used in the rigidity argument
+
+This module supplies the denominator-clearing step in Section 5 of the source:
+for relatively prime elements `a` and `d` in a unique factorization domain,
+the localizations away from `a` and `d` intersect in the original ring inside
+its fraction field.  Relative primeness here means that every common divisor
+is a unit; it does *not* incorrectly assume that the ideal `(a,d)` is the unit
+ideal.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+section DenominatorClearing
+
+variable {A K : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [DecompositionMonoid A]
+  [CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [Algebra A K]
+
+/-- Clearing two relatively prime power denominators forces an element of an
+overring into the original ring.  The overring need not be a field. -/
+theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators
+    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K))
+    {a d : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
+    {z : K} {m n : ℕ} {r s : A}
+    (hr : z * algebraMap A K (a ^ m) = algebraMap A K r)
+    (hs : z * algebraMap A K (d ^ n) = algebraMap A K s) :
+    ∃ t : A, algebraMap A K t = z := by
+  have hcross : r * d ^ n = s * a ^ m := by
+    apply hinj
+    simp only [map_mul]
+    rw [← hr, ← hs]
+    exact mul_right_comm _ _ _
+  have hdiv : a ^ m ∣ r :=
+    had.pow.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (hcross ▸ dvd_mul_left (a ^ m) s)
+  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdiv
+  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
+  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (show algebraMap A K (a ^ m) ≠ 0 from
+    fun h ↦ pow_ne_zero m ha (hinj (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)))
+  rw [hr, ht, map_mul, mul_comm]
+
+end DenominatorClearing
+
+section FractionField
+
+variable {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
+variable (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
+
+/-- Powers of a nonzero element are legitimate fraction-field denominators. -/
+theorem powers_le_nonZeroDivisors {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
+    Submonoid.powers a ≤ nonZeroDivisors A := by
+  rintro s ⟨n, rfl⟩
+  exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero n ha)
+
+/-- The localization `A[a⁻¹]`, realized as an actual subalgebra of a fraction field. -/
+noncomputable def awayInFractionField (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Subalgebra A K :=
+  Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers a) (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors ha)
+
+/-- Membership in a one-element localization can be expressed by clearing a
+power denominator. -/
+theorem mem_awayInFractionField_iff (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (z : K) :
+    z ∈ awayInFractionField K a ha ↔
+      ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : A), z * algebraMap A K (a ^ n) = algebraMap A K r := by
+  change (∃ (r s : A) (_ : s ∈ Submonoid.powers a),
+    z = algebraMap A K r * (algebraMap A K s)⁻¹) ↔ _
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨r, s, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hz⟩
+    refine ⟨n, r, ?_⟩
+    have hnonzero : algebraMap A K (a ^ n) ≠ 0 :=
+      fun h ↦ pow_ne_zero n ha (IsFractionRing.injective A K (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
+    exact (eq_div_iff hnonzero).mp (by simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hz)
+  · rintro ⟨n, r, hz⟩
+    refine ⟨r, a ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
+    have hnonzero : algebraMap A K (a ^ n) ≠ 0 :=
+      fun h ↦ pow_ne_zero n ha (IsFractionRing.injective A K (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
+    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using (eq_div_iff hnonzero).mpr hz
+
+variable [DecompositionMonoid A]
+
+/-- The two principal localizations at relatively prime elements intersect
+in the base ring, as subalgebras of its fraction field. -/
+theorem awayInFractionField_inf_eq_bot {a d : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
+    (had : IsRelPrime a d) :
+    awayInFractionField K a ha ⊓ awayInFractionField K d hd = ⊥ := by
+  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
+  intro z hz
+  obtain ⟨m, r, hr⟩ := (mem_awayInFractionField_iff K a ha z).mp hz.1
+  obtain ⟨n, s, hs⟩ := (mem_awayInFractionField_iff K d hd z).mp hz.2
+  exact Algebra.mem_bot.mpr
+    (exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators
+      (IsFractionRing.injective A K) ha had hr hs)
+
+end FractionField
+
+section PolynomialVariables
+
+variable {k σ : Type*} [Field k]
+
+/-- Distinct independent polynomial variables are relatively prime in the
+common-divisor sense required by the intersection argument. -/
+theorem isRelPrime_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
+    IsRelPrime (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k) (MvPolynomial.X j) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.X_prime.irreducible.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
+  simpa only [MvPolynomial.X_dvd_X] using hij
+
+/-- Specialization of the two-chart intersection result to distinct variables
+of a polynomial ring over a field. -/
+theorem polynomial_variable_localizations_inf_eq_bot
+    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra (MvPolynomial σ k) K]
+    [IsFractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k) K] {i j : σ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
+    awayInFractionField K (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i) ⊓
+      awayInFractionField K (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ k) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero j) = ⊥ := by
+  exact awayInFractionField_inf_eq_bot K (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero j)
+    (isRelPrime_X_of_ne hij)
+
+end PolynomialVariables
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Localization of locally nilpotent derivations at invariants
+
+This module proves the localization step used twice in the manuscript:
+Section 3 after equation (gr:iterate), and Section 5 before the univariate
+locally nilpotent derivation argument.  Denominators are required to be
+annihilated by the derivation; there is no characteristic or domain assumption
+for the extension and its local nilpotence.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace LocalizationLND
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+variable (D : Derivation k A A) (M : Submonoid A)
+variable (hM : ∀ m : M, D (m : A) = 0)
+
+include hM
+
+private theorem numerator_wellDefined {a c : A} {b d : M}
+    (h : Localization.r M (a, b) (c, d)) :
+    Localization.mk (D a) b = Localization.mk (D c) d := by
+  apply Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
+  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Localization.r_iff_exists.mp h
+  apply Localization.r_iff_exists.mpr
+  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
+  have hd := congrArg D he
+  simpa only [Derivation.leibniz, hM, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul,
+    add_zero, zero_add] using hd
+
+/-- On fractions with invariant denominators the extension differentiates only
+the numerator. -/
+def localizeFun (x : Localization M) : Localization M :=
+  Localization.liftOn x (fun a b => Localization.mk (D a) b)
+    (numerator_wellDefined D M hM)
+
+@[simp] theorem localizeFun_mk (a : A) (b : M) :
+    localizeFun D M hM (Localization.mk a b) = Localization.mk (D a) b := rfl
+
+private theorem localizeFun_add (x y : Localization M) :
+    localizeFun D M hM (x + y) = localizeFun D M hM x + localizeFun D M hM y := by
+  induction x using Localization.induction_on with | H x =>
+  induction y using Localization.induction_on with | H y =>
+  rcases x with ⟨a, b⟩
+  rcases y with ⟨c, d⟩
+  simp only [Localization.add_mk, localizeFun_mk, map_add,
+    Derivation.leibniz, hM, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
+
+private theorem localizeFun_one : localizeFun D M hM 1 = 0 := by
+  rw [← Localization.mk_one, localizeFun_mk, D.map_one_eq_zero, Localization.mk_zero]
+
+private theorem localizeFun_mul (x y : Localization M) :
+    localizeFun D M hM (x * y) =
+      x * localizeFun D M hM y + y * localizeFun D M hM x := by
+  induction x using Localization.induction_on with | H x =>
+  induction y using Localization.induction_on with | H y =>
+  rcases x with ⟨a, b⟩
+  rcases y with ⟨c, d⟩
+  simp only [Localization.mk_mul, localizeFun_mk, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul]
+  rw [mul_comm d b, Localization.add_mk_self]
+
+private theorem localizeFun_algebraMap (r : k) :
+    localizeFun D M hM (algebraMap k (Localization M) r) = 0 := by
+  rw [← Localization.mk_algebraMap, localizeFun_mk, D.map_algebraMap, Localization.mk_zero]
+
+/-- Extend a derivation to a localization whose denominators it annihilates. -/
+def localize : Derivation k (Localization M) (Localization M) where
+  toFun := localizeFun D M hM
+  map_add' := localizeFun_add D M hM
+  map_smul' r x := by
+    simp only [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.id_apply, localizeFun_mul,
+      localizeFun_algebraMap, mul_zero, add_zero]
+  map_one_eq_zero' := localizeFun_one D M hM
+  leibniz' x y := by
+    change localizeFun D M hM (x * y) =
+      x * localizeFun D M hM y + y * localizeFun D M hM x
+    exact localizeFun_mul D M hM x y
+
+@[simp] theorem localize_mk (a : A) (b : M) :
+    localize D M hM (Localization.mk a b) = Localization.mk (D a) b := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem localize_algebraMap (a : A) :
+    localize D M hM (algebraMap A (Localization M) a) =
+      algebraMap A (Localization M) (D a) := rfl
+
+/-- Iteration continues to differentiate only the numerator. -/
+theorem localize_iterate_mk (n : ℕ) (a : A) (b : M) :
+    (localize D M hM : Localization M → Localization M)^[n] (Localization.mk a b) =
+      Localization.mk ((D : A → A)^[n] a) b := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, localize_mk, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+
+/-- Local nilpotence is preserved on localization at invariant denominators. -/
+theorem localize_locallyNilpotent
+    (hD : ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
+    ∀ x : Localization M, ∃ n : ℕ,
+      (localize D M hM : Localization M → Localization M)^[n] x = 0 := by
+  intro x
+  induction x using Localization.induction_on with | H x =>
+  rcases x with ⟨a, b⟩
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD a
+  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
+  rw [localize_iterate_mk, hn, Localization.mk_zero]
+
+
+omit hM
+
+section Transport
+
+variable {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
+
+/-- Transport a derivation across an algebra equivalence. -/
+def transport (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) : Derivation k B B :=
+  D.liftOfRightInverse e.apply_symm_apply (fun a ha => by
+    have ha' : a = 0 := e.injective (ha.trans (map_zero e).symm)
+    simp [ha'])
+
+@[simp] theorem transport_apply (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (a : A) :
+    transport D e (e a) = e (D a) :=
+  Derivation.liftOfRightInverse_apply _ _ a
+
+/-- Iteration commutes with transport. -/
+theorem transport_iterate (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
+    (transport D e : B → B)^[n] (e a) = e ((D : A → A)^[n] a) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, transport_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+
+/-- Local nilpotence is independent of the chosen algebra presentation. -/
+theorem transport_locallyNilpotent (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B)
+    (hD : ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
+    ∀ b : B, ∃ n : ℕ, (transport D e : B → B)^[n] b = 0 := by
+  intro b
+  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := e.surjective b
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD a
+  exact ⟨n, by rw [transport_iterate, hn, map_zero]⟩
+
+/-- Transport preserves nonzero derivations. -/
+theorem transport_ne_zero (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (hD : D ≠ 0) : transport D e ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  apply hD
+  ext a
+  apply e.injective
+  have he := congrArg (fun (d : Derivation k B B) => d (e a)) h
+  simpa only [transport_apply, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero] using he
+
+end Transport
+
+section AnyLocalization
+include hM
+
+variable (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra A S] [IsLocalization M S]
+  [Algebra k S] [IsScalarTower k A S]
+
+/-- Extend to any algebra satisfying the localization universal property. -/
+def localizeTo : Derivation k S S :=
+  transport (localize D M hM) ((Localization.algEquiv M S).restrictScalars k)
+
+@[simp] theorem localizeTo_mk' (a : A) (b : M) :
+    localizeTo D M hM S (IsLocalization.mk' S a b) = IsLocalization.mk' S (D a) b := by
+  change transport (localize D M hM) ((Localization.algEquiv M S).restrictScalars k)
+    (IsLocalization.mk' S a b) = _
+  rw [← Localization.algEquiv_mk, ← AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_apply k, transport_apply]
+  change Localization.algEquiv M S (localize D M hM (Localization.mk a b)) = _
+  rw [localize_mk, Localization.algEquiv_mk]
+
+@[simp] theorem localizeTo_algebraMap (a : A) :
+    localizeTo D M hM S (algebraMap A S a) = algebraMap A S (D a) := by
+  rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_one (S := S) (M := M) a, localizeTo_mk',
+    IsLocalization.mk'_one]
+
+/-- The extension to any localization is locally nilpotent. -/
+theorem localizeTo_locallyNilpotent
+    (hD : ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
+    ∀ s : S, ∃ n : ℕ, (localizeTo D M hM S : S → S)^[n] s = 0 :=
+  transport_locallyNilpotent _ _ (localize_locallyNilpotent D M hM hD)
+
+/-- If localization is injective, a nonzero derivation remains nonzero. -/
+theorem localizeTo_ne_zero (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A S)) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    localizeTo D M hM S ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  apply hD
+  ext a
+  apply hinj
+  have he := congrArg (fun (d : Derivation k S S) => d (algebraMap A S a)) h
+  simpa only [localizeTo_algebraMap, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero] using he
+
+end AnyLocalization
+
+
+omit hM
+
+section Away
+
+variable (a : A) (ha : D a = 0)
+
+include ha in
+/-- Killing one element implies killing all powers used as denominators. -/
+theorem annihilates_powers : ∀ m : Submonoid.powers a, D (m : A) = 0 := by
+  rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
+  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hm
+  simp only [Derivation.leibniz_pow, ha, smul_zero]
+
+variable (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
+  [IsLocalization.Away a S] [Algebra k S] [IsScalarTower k A S]
+
+/-- The common special case of localization at one invariant element. -/
+def localizeAway : Derivation k S S :=
+  localizeTo D (Submonoid.powers a) (annihilates_powers D a ha) S
+
+@[simp] theorem localizeAway_algebraMap (b : A) :
+    localizeAway D a ha S (algebraMap A S b) = algebraMap A S (D b) :=
+  localizeTo_algebraMap D (Submonoid.powers a) (annihilates_powers D a ha) S b
+
+/-- Localization at a single invariant preserves local nilpotence. -/
+theorem localizeAway_locallyNilpotent
+    (hD : ∀ b : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] b = 0) :
+    ∀ s : S, ∃ n : ℕ, (localizeAway D a ha S : S → S)^[n] s = 0 :=
+  localizeTo_locallyNilpotent D (Submonoid.powers a) (annihilates_powers D a ha) S hD
+
+end Away
+
+end LocalizationLND
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
+import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The determinant-preserving change in §2
+
+These identities are valid in every commutative ring.  The parameter `t` gives
+`(I - 2t n eᵀ) M`, and composition adds parameters.  No division by two is
+needed in the coordinate formulas.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.MatrixChange
+
+variable {K : Type*} [CommRing K]
+
+/-- The negative determinant of the displayed two-by-two matrix. -/
+def quad (p s u F : K) : K := s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 + p * F
+
+def pChange (t p s u F J : K) : K :=
+  p + 2 * t * quad p s u F * (quad p s u F * (s - u) + p * J)
+
+def sChange (t p s u F J : K) : K :=
+  s + t * (2 * J * quad p s u F * u - p * J ^ 2 - (quad p s u F) ^ 2 * F)
+
+def uChange (t p s u F J : K) : K :=
+  u + t * (2 * s * J * quad p s u F + p * J ^ 2 - (quad p s u F) ^ 2 * F)
+
+def FChange (t p s u F J : K) : K :=
+  F + 2 * t * J * (J * (s + u) - quad p s u F * F)
+
+/-- The defining equation of the five-variable hypersurface. -/
+def relation (p s u F J : K) : K :=
+  (quad p s u F) ^ 2 * F - (1 + 2 * s * quad p s u F) * J - p * J ^ 2 - u
+
+section Maps
+variable {L : Type*} [CommRing L] {G : Type*} [FunLike G K L] [RingHomClass G K L]
+
+@[simp] lemma map_quad (h : G) (p s u F : K) :
+    h (quad p s u F) = quad (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) := by
+  simp [quad]
+
+@[simp] lemma map_pChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
+    h (pChange t p s u F J) = pChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J) := by
+  simp [pChange, map_ofNat]
+
+@[simp] lemma map_sChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
+    h (sChange t p s u F J) = sChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J) := by
+  simp [sChange, map_ofNat]
+
+@[simp] lemma map_uChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
+    h (uChange t p s u F J) = uChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J) := by
+  simp [uChange, map_ofNat]
+
+@[simp] lemma map_FChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
+    h (FChange t p s u F J) = FChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J) := by
+  simp [FChange, map_ofNat]
+
+@[simp] lemma map_relation (h : G) (p s u F J : K) :
+    h (relation p s u F J) = relation (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J) := by
+  simp [relation, map_ofNat]
+
+end Maps
+
+lemma quad_change (t p s u F J : K) :
+    quad (pChange t p s u F J) (sChange t p s u F J)
+      (uChange t p s u F J) (FChange t p s u F J) = quad p s u F := by
+  unfold quad pChange sChange uChange FChange
+  ring
+
+lemma pChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
+    pChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
+      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = pChange (t + r) p s u F J := by
+  rw [pChange]
+  simp only [quad_change]
+  simp only [pChange, sChange, uChange]
+  ring
+
+lemma sChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
+    sChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
+      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = sChange (t + r) p s u F J := by
+  rw [sChange]
+  simp only [quad_change]
+  simp only [pChange, sChange, uChange, FChange]
+  ring
+
+lemma uChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
+    uChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
+      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = uChange (t + r) p s u F J := by
+  rw [uChange]
+  simp only [quad_change]
+  simp only [pChange, sChange, uChange, FChange]
+  ring
+
+lemma FChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
+    FChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
+      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = FChange (t + r) p s u F J := by
+  rw [FChange]
+  simp only [quad_change]
+  simp only [sChange, uChange, FChange]
+  ring
+
+@[simp] lemma pChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : pChange 0 p s u F J = p := by
+  simp [pChange]
+@[simp] lemma sChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : sChange 0 p s u F J = s := by
+  simp [sChange]
+@[simp] lemma uChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : uChange 0 p s u F J = u := by
+  simp [uChange]
+@[simp] lemma FChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : FChange 0 p s u F J = F := by
+  simp [FChange]
+
+lemma uChange_one (p s u F J : K) :
+    uChange 1 p s u F J = -relation p s u F J - J := by
+  unfold uChange relation
+  ring
+
+lemma relation_change_neg_one (p s u F J : K) :
+    relation (pChange (-1) p s u F J) (sChange (-1) p s u F J)
+      (uChange (-1) p s u F J) (FChange (-1) p s u F J) J = -J - u := by
+  have h := uChange_one (pChange (-1) p s u F J) (sChange (-1) p s u F J)
+      (uChange (-1) p s u F J) (FChange (-1) p s u F J) J
+  rw [uChange_add] at h
+  simp only [add_neg_cancel, uChange_zero] at h
+  linear_combination h
+
+end StableCoordinate.MatrixChange
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The degeneration embeds into the affine-modification Laurent model
+
+This file uses the canonical source map from `LaurentPresentation` and
+identifies its image with the extended Rees algebra.  Injectivity is supplied
+by the separate localization/domain argument; it is not assumed here.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding
+
+open MvPolynomial
+open scoped LaurentPolynomial
+
+namespace LP
+abbrev C {R : Type*} [CommRing R] := LaurentPolynomial.C (R := R)
+abbrev T {R : Type*} [CommRing R] := LaurentPolynomial.T (R := R)
+end LP
+
+open Obstruction
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- Alias for the canonical source-ordered Laurent coordinate values. -/
+abbrev values := LaurentPresentation.laurentValues k
+
+/-- Polynomial evaluation before taking the degeneration quotient. -/
+def polynomialMap : P k 5 →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (B k) :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval (values k)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem polynomialMap_X (i : Fin 5) :
+    polynomialMap k (X i) = values k i :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _
+
+/-- Alias for the canonical map from `G` to `B[τ,τ⁻¹]`. -/
+abbrev toLaurent := LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k
+
+@[simp]
+theorem toLaurent_mk (p : P k 5) :
+    toLaurent k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) = polynomialMap k p :=
+  rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem toLaurent_gX (i : Fin 5) :
+    toLaurent k (gX k i) = values k i :=
+  LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_gX k i
+
+theorem values_mem (i : Fin 5) :
+    values k i ∈ ModificationPieces.modification (I k) := by
+  fin_cases i
+  · exact ModificationPieces.T_one_mem_modification _
+  · exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).algebraMap_mem _
+  · exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).algebraMap_mem _
+  · apply ModificationPieces.numerator_mem_modification
+    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
+  · apply ModificationPieces.numerator_mem_modification
+    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
+
+theorem polynomialMap_mem (p : P k 5) :
+    polynomialMap k p ∈ ModificationPieces.modification (I k) := by
+  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
+  | C a =>
+      simp only [polynomialMap, MvPolynomial.aeval_C, LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply]
+      exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).algebraMap_mem _
+  | add p q hp hq =>
+      rw [map_add]
+      exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).add_mem hp hq
+  | mul_X p i hp =>
+      rw [map_mul, polynomialMap_X]
+      exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).mul_mem hp (values_mem k i)
+
+/-- Every element of the actual source degeneration lands in the affine modification. -/
+theorem toLaurent_mem (a : G k) :
+    toLaurent k a ∈ ModificationPieces.modification (I k) := by
+  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with
+  | h p => exact polynomialMap_mem k p
+
+/-- The source generator weights are exactly opposite their Laurent exponents. -/
+theorem values_homogeneous (i : Fin 5) :
+    ModificationPieces.Homogeneous (presentationWeight i) (values k i) := by
+  fin_cases i
+  · exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_single (-1) (1 : B k)
+  · exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_C (sB k)
+  · exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_C (bX k 3)
+  · change ModificationPieces.Homogeneous 1 (LP.C (f0 k) * LP.T (-1))
+    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
+    exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_single 1 (f0 k)
+  · change ModificationPieces.Homogeneous 1 (LP.C (g0 k) * LP.T (-1))
+    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
+    exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_single 1 (g0 k)
+
+/-- An actual weighted homogeneous representative maps to the corresponding
+single Laurent degree; no grading of a quotient is postulated. -/
+theorem polynomialMap_homogeneous {p : P k 5} {d : ℤ}
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) :
+    ModificationPieces.Homogeneous d (polynomialMap k p) :=
+  ModificationPieces.homogeneous_aeval presentationWeight (values k)
+    (values_homogeneous k) hp
+
+/-- Positive-degree homogeneous representatives have numerators in the
+appropriate power of the exact source ideal. -/
+theorem polynomialMap_positive_piece {p : P k 5} {ℓ : ℕ}
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight (ℓ : ℤ)) :
+    ∃ h ∈ I k ^ ℓ, polynomialMap k p = LP.C h * LP.T (-(ℓ : ℤ)) :=
+  ModificationPieces.homogeneous_numerator (polynomialMap_mem k p)
+    (polynomialMap_homogeneous k hp)
+
+/-- The extraction needed for the noncoordinate obstruction, stated directly
+for nonzero Laurent images of homogeneous representatives. -/
+theorem polynomialMap_positive_nonzero_numerator {p : P k 5} {ℓ : ℕ}
+    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight (ℓ : ℤ))
+    (hne : polynomialMap k p ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ h ∈ I k, h ≠ 0 ∧ polynomialMap k p = LP.C h * LP.T (-(ℓ : ℤ)) :=
+  ModificationPieces.positive_nonzero_numerator hℓ (polynomialMap_mem k p)
+    (polynomialMap_homogeneous k hp) hne
+
+/-- The canonical map's image is a `B`-subalgebra, since the base map is a
+section on constant Laurent polynomials. -/
+def imageSubalgebra : Subalgebra (B k) (LaurentPolynomial (B k)) where
+  carrier := Set.range (toLaurent k)
+  zero_mem' := ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
+  one_mem' := ⟨1, map_one _⟩
+  add_mem' := by
+    rintro p q ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨a + b, map_add _ _ _⟩
+  mul_mem' := by
+    rintro p q ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨a * b, map_mul _ _ _⟩
+  algebraMap_mem' r :=
+    ⟨LaurentPresentation.baseMap k r, LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_baseMap k r⟩
+
+/-- Exact affine-modification image, with the actual source's two-generator center. -/
+theorem image_eq_modification :
+    imageSubalgebra k = ModificationPieces.modification (I k) := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · rintro p ⟨a, rfl⟩
+    exact toLaurent_mem k a
+  · rw [I, ModificationPieces.modification_pair_eq]
+    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
+    rintro p (rfl | rfl | rfl)
+    · exact ⟨gX k 0, toLaurent_gX k 0⟩
+    · exact ⟨gX k 3, toLaurent_gX k 3⟩
+    · exact ⟨gX k 4, toLaurent_gX k 4⟩
+
+theorem range_toLaurent :
+    Set.range (toLaurent k) = (ModificationPieces.modification (I k) : Set _) := by
+  change (imageSubalgebra k : Set (LaurentPolynomial (B k))) = _
+  rw [image_eq_modification]
+
+end StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Homogeneous pieces of an affine modification
+
+For an ideal `I` of `R`, this file identifies the Laurent subalgebra
+`R[T, I/T]` with the Laurent polynomials whose coefficient at exponent
+`n` belongs to `I ^ max (-n) 0`.  The grading in the source is opposite
+to the Laurent exponent, so its positive degree-`ℓ` piece is
+`T^(-ℓ) I^ℓ`.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces
+
+open LaurentPolynomial
+open scoped LaurentPolynomial
+
+variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
+
+/-- The coefficient realization of the extended Rees algebra `R[T,I/T]`. -/
+def extendedRees (I : Ideal R) : Subalgebra R R[T;T⁻¹] where
+  carrier := { p | ∀ n : ℤ, p.coeff n ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat }
+  zero_mem' n := by simp
+  one_mem' n := by
+    change (C (1 : R)).coeff n ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat
+    rw [C_apply]
+    split_ifs with hn
+    · subst n
+      simp
+    · exact Ideal.zero_mem _
+  add_mem' hp hq n := by
+    simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply] using
+      (I ^ (-n).toNat).add_mem (hp n) (hq n)
+  mul_mem' hp hq n := by
+    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul]
+    unfold Finsupp.sum
+    apply Ideal.sum_mem
+    intro a ha
+    apply Ideal.sum_mem
+    intro b hb
+    dsimp only
+    by_cases hab : a + b = n
+    · rw [ite_eq_left hab]
+      have hprod := Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hp a) (hq b)
+      rw [← pow_add] at hprod
+      exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hprod
+    · rw [ite_eq_right hab]
+      exact Ideal.zero_mem _
+  algebraMap_mem' r n := by
+    change (C r).coeff n ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat
+    rw [C_apply]
+    split_ifs with hn
+    · subst n
+      simp
+    · exact Ideal.zero_mem _
+
+@[simp]
+theorem mem_extendedRees_iff (I : Ideal R) (p : R[T;T⁻¹]) :
+    p ∈ extendedRees I ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, p.coeff n ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat :=
+  Iff.rfl
+
+theorem single_mem_extendedRees_iff (I : Ideal R) (n : ℤ) (r : R) :
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r ∈ extendedRees I ↔ r ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_true] using h n
+  · intro h i
+    by_cases hi : n = i
+    · subst i
+      simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_true] using h
+    · simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right hi]
+      exact Ideal.zero_mem _
+
+/-- The Laurent subalgebra generated by `T` and `r/T` for `r ∈ I`. -/
+def modification (I : Ideal R) : Subalgebra R R[T;T⁻¹] :=
+  Algebra.adjoin R
+    (insert (T 1) ((fun r : R => C r * T (-1)) '' (I : Set R)))
+
+theorem T_one_mem_modification (I : Ideal R) :
+    (T 1 : R[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ modification I :=
+  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert _ _)
+
+theorem numerator_mem_modification {I : Ideal R} {r : R} (hr : r ∈ I) :
+    C r * T (-1) ∈ modification I :=
+  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
+
+theorem modification_le_extendedRees (I : Ideal R) :
+    modification I ≤ extendedRees I := by
+  apply Algebra.adjoin_le
+  rintro p (rfl | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
+  · change AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 ∈ extendedRees I
+    rw [single_mem_extendedRees_iff]
+    simp
+  · dsimp only
+    rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T]
+    change AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) r ∈ extendedRees I
+    rw [single_mem_extendedRees_iff]
+    simpa using hr
+
+theorem negative_single_mem_modification {I : Ideal R} {n : ℕ} {r : R}
+    (hr : r ∈ I ^ n) :
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-(n : ℤ)) r ∈ modification I := by
+  induction n generalizing r with
+  | zero =>
+      change C r ∈ modification I
+      exact (modification I).algebraMap_mem r
+  | succ n ih =>
+      rw [pow_succ'] at hr
+      refine Submodule.smul_induction_on hr ?_ ?_
+      · intro a ha b hb
+        have h₁ := numerator_mem_modification ha
+        have h₂ := ih hb
+        rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T] at h₁
+        convert (modification I).mul_mem h₁ h₂ using 1
+        simp only [smul_eq_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, Nat.cast_add,
+          Nat.cast_one, neg_add_rev]
+      · intro a b ha hb
+        simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add] using
+          (modification I).add_mem ha hb
+
+theorem nonnegative_single_mem_modification (I : Ideal R) (n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n)
+    (r : R) :
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r ∈ modification I := by
+  have hT := (modification I).pow_mem (T_one_mem_modification I) n.toNat
+  rw [T_pow, mul_one, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn] at hT
+  rw [single_eq_C_mul_T]
+  exact (modification I).mul_mem ((modification I).algebraMap_mem r) hT
+
+theorem single_mem_modification_of_mem_power {I : Ideal R} (n : ℤ) {r : R}
+    (hr : r ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat) :
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r ∈ modification I := by
+  by_cases hn : 0 ≤ n
+  · exact nonnegative_single_mem_modification I n hn r
+  · convert negative_single_mem_modification hr using 1
+    congr 1
+    omega
+
+/-- The generator and coefficient definitions of the extended Rees algebra coincide. -/
+theorem modification_eq_extendedRees (I : Ideal R) :
+    modification I = extendedRees I := by
+  apply le_antisymm (modification_le_extendedRees I)
+  intro p hp
+  rw [← p.sum_coeff_single]
+  unfold Finsupp.sum
+  apply Subalgebra.sum_mem
+  intro n hn
+  exact single_mem_modification_of_mem_power n (hp n)
+
+/-- Exact Laurent monomial membership. -/
+theorem single_mem_modification_iff (I : Ideal R) (n : ℤ) (r : R) :
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r ∈ modification I ↔ r ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat := by
+  rw [modification_eq_extendedRees, single_mem_extendedRees_iff]
+
+/-- The source's degree-`ℓ` piece, using `deg T = -1`. -/
+theorem positive_piece (I : Ideal R) (ℓ : ℕ) (r : R) :
+    C r * T (-(ℓ : ℤ)) ∈ modification I ↔ r ∈ I ^ ℓ := by
+  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T, single_mem_modification_iff]
+  simp
+
+/-- Every negative-exponent coefficient of a modification element lies in the
+corresponding power of the center ideal. -/
+theorem coefficient_mem_power {I : Ideal R} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]}
+    (hp : p ∈ modification I) (ℓ : ℕ) :
+    p.coeff (-(ℓ : ℤ)) ∈ I ^ ℓ := by
+  have h := modification_le_extendedRees I hp (-(ℓ : ℤ))
+  simpa using h
+
+/-- Numerators whose division by `T` lies in a specified Laurent subalgebra. -/
+def numeratorIdeal (S : Subalgebra R R[T;T⁻¹]) : Ideal R where
+  carrier := { r | C r * T (-1) ∈ S }
+  zero_mem' := by simp
+  add_mem' hr hs := by
+    change C (_ + _) * T (-1) ∈ S
+    simpa only [map_add, add_mul] using S.add_mem hr hs
+  smul_mem' a r hr := by
+    change C (a * r) * T (-1) ∈ S
+    rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
+    exact S.mul_mem (S.algebraMap_mem a) hr
+
+/-- A presentation by an arbitrary chosen set of generators of the center. -/
+def generatedModification (s : Set R) : Subalgebra R R[T;T⁻¹] :=
+  Algebra.adjoin R (insert (T 1) ((fun r : R => C r * T (-1)) '' s))
+
+/-- Passing from ideal generators to every numerator in the ideal does not change
+the generated Laurent subalgebra. -/
+theorem modification_span_eq (s : Set R) :
+    modification (Ideal.span s) = generatedModification s := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · have hspan : Ideal.span s ≤ numeratorIdeal (generatedModification s) := by
+      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
+      intro r hr
+      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
+    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
+    rintro p (rfl | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
+    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert _ _)
+    · exact hspan hr
+  · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
+    rintro p (rfl | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
+    · exact T_one_mem_modification _
+    · exact numerator_mem_modification (Ideal.subset_span hr)
+
+/-- The exact two-generator presentation used for the distinguished ideal
+`I=(f₀,g₀)`. -/
+theorem modification_pair_eq (f g : R) :
+    modification (Ideal.span ({f, g} : Set R)) =
+      Algebra.adjoin R ({T 1, C f * T (-1), C g * T (-1)} : Set R[T;T⁻¹]) := by
+  simpa only [generatedModification, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using
+    modification_span_eq ({f, g} : Set R)
+
+/-- Laurent homogeneity for the source convention `deg T = -1`. -/
+def Homogeneous (ℓ : ℤ) (p : R[T;T⁻¹]) : Prop :=
+  ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ -ℓ → p.coeff n = 0
+
+theorem eq_single_of_homogeneous {ℓ : ℤ} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]}
+    (hp : Homogeneous ℓ p) :
+    p = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-ℓ) (p.coeff (-ℓ)) := by
+  apply LaurentPolynomial.ext
+  intro n
+  by_cases hn : n = -ℓ
+  · subst n
+    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_true]
+  · rw [hp n hn]
+    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
+      ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hn)]
+
+theorem homogeneous_single (ℓ : ℤ) (r : R) :
+    Homogeneous ℓ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-ℓ) r) := by
+  intro n hn
+  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hn)]
+
+theorem homogeneous_zero (ℓ : ℤ) : Homogeneous ℓ (0 : R[T;T⁻¹]) := by
+  intro n hn
+  simp
+
+theorem homogeneous_C (r : R) : Homogeneous 0 (C r) := by
+  simpa only [neg_zero, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C] using homogeneous_single 0 r
+
+namespace Homogeneous
+
+theorem add {d : ℤ} {p q : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hp : Homogeneous d p) (hq : Homogeneous d q) :
+    Homogeneous d (p + q) := by
+  intro n hn
+  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp n hn, hq n hn, add_zero]
+
+theorem mul {d e : ℤ} {p q : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hp : Homogeneous d p) (hq : Homogeneous e q) :
+    Homogeneous (d + e) (p * q) := by
+  rw [eq_single_of_homogeneous hp, eq_single_of_homogeneous hq,
+    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, ← neg_add]
+  exact homogeneous_single _ _
+
+theorem pow {d : ℤ} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hp : Homogeneous d p) (n : ℕ) :
+    Homogeneous (n • d) (p ^ n) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero =>
+      simpa only [pow_zero, zero_nsmul, map_one] using homogeneous_C (1 : R)
+  | succ n ih =>
+      simpa only [pow_succ, succ_nsmul] using ih.mul hp
+
+theorem sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → R[T;T⁻¹]) (d : ℤ)
+    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Homogeneous d (p i)) : Homogeneous d (∑ i ∈ s, p i) := by
+  classical
+  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
+  | empty => simpa using homogeneous_zero d
+  | @insert i s his ih =>
+      rw [Finset.sum_insert his]
+      exact (hp i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).add
+        (ih (fun j hj => hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))
+
+theorem prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → R[T;T⁻¹]) (d : ι → ℤ)
+    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Homogeneous (d i) (p i)) :
+    Homogeneous (∑ i ∈ s, d i) (∏ i ∈ s, p i) := by
+  classical
+  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
+  | empty => simpa only [Finset.sum_empty, Finset.prod_empty, map_one] using homogeneous_C (1 : R)
+  | @insert i s his ih =>
+      rw [Finset.sum_insert his, Finset.prod_insert his]
+      exact (hp i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).mul
+        (ih (fun j hj => hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))
+
+end Homogeneous
+
+/-- Weighted polynomial evaluation preserves the source-to-Laurent grading
+whenever the images of the independent variables have the specified weights. -/
+theorem homogeneous_aeval {k σ : Type*} [CommRing k] [Algebra k R]
+    (w : σ → ℤ) (v : σ → R[T;T⁻¹]) (hv : ∀ i, Homogeneous (w i) (v i))
+    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) :
+    Homogeneous d (MvPolynomial.aeval v p) := by
+  classical
+  rw [p.as_sum, map_sum]
+  apply Homogeneous.sum
+  intro m hm
+  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial]
+  have hprod : Homogeneous (Finsupp.weight w m) (m.prod fun i n => v i ^ n) := by
+    simpa only [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.prod] using
+      Homogeneous.prod m.support (fun i => v i ^ m i) (fun i => m i • w i)
+        (fun i hi => (hv i).pow (m i))
+  have hweight : Finsupp.weight w m = d := hp (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
+  simpa only [LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply, zero_add, hweight] using
+    (homogeneous_C (algebraMap k R (p.coeff m))).mul hprod
+
+/-- Every homogeneous positive-degree element has a numerator from the exact
+power of the center ideal. -/
+theorem homogeneous_numerator {I : Ideal R} {ℓ : ℕ} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]}
+    (hp : p ∈ modification I) (hh : Homogeneous (ℓ : ℤ) p) :
+    ∃ r ∈ I ^ ℓ, p = C r * T (-(ℓ : ℤ)) :=
+  ⟨p.coeff (-(ℓ : ℤ)), coefficient_mem_power hp ℓ,
+    (eq_single_of_homogeneous hh).trans (single_eq_C_mul_T _ _)⟩
+
+/-- The nonzero-numerator form consumed by the coordinate obstruction. -/
+theorem homogeneous_nonzero_numerator {I : Ideal R} {ℓ : ℕ} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]}
+    (hp : p ∈ modification I) (hh : Homogeneous (ℓ : ℤ) p) (hne : p ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ r ∈ I ^ ℓ, r ≠ 0 ∧ p = C r * T (-(ℓ : ℤ)) := by
+  obtain ⟨r, hr, heq⟩ := homogeneous_numerator hp hh
+  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_, heq⟩
+  intro hzero
+  apply hne
+  simp [heq, hzero]
+
+/-- In strictly positive degree the numerator lies in the center ideal itself. -/
+theorem positive_nonzero_numerator {I : Ideal R} {ℓ : ℕ} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]}
+    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : p ∈ modification I)
+    (hh : Homogeneous (ℓ : ℤ) p) (hne : p ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ r ∈ I, r ≠ 0 ∧ p = C r * T (-(ℓ : ℤ)) := by
+  obtain ⟨r, hr, hne, heq⟩ := homogeneous_nonzero_numerator hp hh hne
+  exact ⟨r, Ideal.pow_le_self (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hℓ) hr, hne, heq⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.WeightedHomogeneous
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Nonnegative polynomial weights
+
+The final step of the source rigidity argument uses the weights `(1, 1, 0)`
+on the algebraically independent generators `a, d, u`.  This module proves
+that the resulting polynomial algebra has no nonzero homogeneous elements
+of negative weight.  It does not assume or assert the geometric interfaces
+needed to identify this polynomial algebra inside the source quotient.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+section General
+
+variable {σ K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]
+
+/-- A monomial has nonnegative integral weight when all variable weights are
+nonnegative.  Variables of weight zero are allowed. -/
+theorem monomial_weight_nonneg (w : σ → ℤ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
+    (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : 0 ≤ Finsupp.weight w d := by
+  classical
+  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
+  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => nsmul_nonneg (hw i) (d i)
+
+/-- Every nonzero homogeneous polynomial for nonnegative variable weights
+has nonnegative weight. -/
+theorem homogeneous_weight_nonneg {w : σ → ℤ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
+    {p : MvPolynomial σ K} (hp : p ≠ 0) {n : ℤ}
+    (hn : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) : 0 ≤ n := by
+  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := MvPolynomial.ne_zero_iff.mp hp
+  rw [← hn hd]
+  exact monomial_weight_nonneg w hw d
+
+/-- No polynomial supported on nonnegative variable weights can be nonzero
+and homogeneous of negative weight. -/
+theorem eq_zero_of_homogeneous_negative {w : σ → ℤ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
+    {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {n : ℤ}
+    (hn : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (hneg : n < 0) : p = 0 := by
+  by_contra hp
+  exact (not_le_of_gt hneg) (homogeneous_weight_nonneg hw hp hn)
+
+/-- The negative homogeneous components all vanish. -/
+theorem homogeneousComponent_negative {w : σ → ℤ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
+    (p : MvPolynomial σ K) {n : ℤ} (hneg : n < 0) :
+    MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n p = 0 := by
+  apply eq_zero_of_homogeneous_negative hw
+  · exact MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous n p
+  · exact hneg
+
+end General
+
+/-- The weights of the source polynomial subalgebra `k[a,d,u]`: index `0`
+is `a`, index `1` is `d`, and index `2` is `u`. -/
+def rigidityPolynomialWeight (i : Fin 3) : ℤ := if i = 2 then 0 else 1
+
+theorem rigidityPolynomialWeight_nonneg (i : Fin 3) :
+    0 ≤ rigidityPolynomialWeight i := by
+  unfold rigidityPolynomialWeight
+  split_ifs <;> norm_num
+
+/-- The precise impossibility used for the coefficient `q` in source
+§5: a polynomial in `a,d,u` of fiber weight `-2` must vanish. -/
+theorem rigidity_polynomial_weight_neg_two {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]
+    {q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K}
+    (hq : q.IsWeightedHomogeneous rigidityPolynomialWeight (-2)) : q = 0 := by
+  exact eq_zero_of_homogeneous_negative rigidityPolynomialWeight_nonneg hq (by norm_num)
+
+/-- Contradiction form for the final source rigidity step. -/
+theorem no_nonzero_rigidity_polynomial_weight_neg_two {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]
+    (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
+    ¬ q.IsWeightedHomogeneous rigidityPolynomialWeight (-2) := by
+  intro hweight
+  exact hq (rigidity_polynomial_weight_neg_two hweight)
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI
