+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.CommRing
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations
+import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Nonzero fibers of the polynomial hypersurface presentation
+
+Source: `sources/build/source/sections/02-construction.tex`, especially
+`con:quadric-identity`, `con:localized-inverse`, and `prop:fibers`.
+
+The variables of `P5 K` are ordered `p,s,u,F,J`. This file proves the
+explicit algebra equivalence
+
+`K[p,s,u,F,J] / (H, p-l) ≃ₐ[K] K[x,y,z]` for every nonzero `l : K`.
+
+It uses actual quotient algebras and mutually inverse algebra homomorphisms,
+not a pointwise bijection. The identities work over any commutative ring
+with an inverse to `p`; the quotient construction is stated over any field.
+The transport from the presentation to the exact four-variable polynomial
+is supplied separately by the polynomial-presentation equivalence.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+variable {K : Type*} [CommRing K]
+
+def quadric (p s u F : K) : K := s^2 - u^2 + p*F
+
+def relation (p s u F J : K) : K :=
+  (quadric p s u F)^2 * F - (1+2*s*quadric p s u F)*J - p*J^2-u
+
+def xCoord (p s u F : K) : K := quadric p s u F
+
+def yCoord (p s u F : K) : K := s + quadric p s u F * (quadric p s u F + u^2)
+
+def zCoord (p s u F J : K) : K := s * quadric p s u F + p*J
+
+theorem quadric_identity (p s u F J : K) :
+    xCoord p s u F * yCoord p s u F - zCoord p s u F J * (zCoord p s u F J + 1) =
+      p * (relation p s u F J + u) := by
+  unfold xCoord yCoord zCoord relation quadric
+  ring
+
+end StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+variable {K : Type*} [CommRing K]
+
+def inverseU (t x y z : K) : K := t * (x*y - z*(z+1))
+def inverseS (t x y z : K) : K := y-x*(x+(inverseU t x y z)^2)
+def inverseF (t x y z : K) : K := t*(x-(inverseS t x y z)^2+(inverseU t x y z)^2)
+def inverseJ (t x y z : K) : K := t*(z-inverseS t x y z*x)
+
+theorem x_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
+    xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z) = x := by
+  unfold xCoord quadric inverseF
+  rw [← mul_assoc, hpt, one_mul]
+  ring
+
+theorem y_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
+    yCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z) = y := by
+  change inverseS t x y z + xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
+    (inverseF t x y z) * (xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
+    (inverseF t x y z) + inverseU t x y z ^ 2) = y
+  rw [x_inverse p t x y z hpt]
+  unfold inverseS
+  ring
+
+theorem z_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
+    zCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z)
+      (inverseJ t x y z) = z := by
+  change inverseS t x y z * xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
+    (inverseF t x y z) + p*inverseJ t x y z = z
+  rw [x_inverse p t x y z hpt]
+  unfold inverseJ
+  rw [← mul_assoc, hpt, one_mul]
+  ring
+
+theorem inverseU_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
+    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
+    inverseU t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = u := by
+  unfold inverseU
+  rw [quadric_identity, hH, zero_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm t p, hpt, one_mul]
+
+theorem inverseS_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
+    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
+    inverseS t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = s := by
+  unfold inverseS
+  rw [inverseU_forward p t s u F J hpt hH]
+  unfold xCoord yCoord
+  ring
+
+theorem inverseF_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
+    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
+    inverseF t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = F := by
+  unfold inverseF
+  rw [inverseU_forward p t s u F J hpt hH, inverseS_forward p t s u F J hpt hH]
+  unfold xCoord quadric
+  have ht : t*p=1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hpt
+  calc
+    t * (s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 + p * F - s ^ 2 + u ^ 2) = (t*p)*F := by ring
+    _ = F := by rw [ht, one_mul]
+
+theorem inverseJ_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
+    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
+    inverseJ t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = J := by
+  unfold inverseJ
+  rw [inverseS_forward p t s u F J hpt hH]
+  unfold zCoord xCoord
+  have ht : t*p=1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hpt
+  calc
+    t * (s * quadric p s u F + p * J - s * quadric p s u F) = (t*p)*J := by ring
+    _ = J := by rw [ht, one_mul]
+
+end StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+variable {K : Type*} [CommRing K]
+
+theorem relation_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
+    relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z)
+      (inverseJ t x y z) = 0 := by
+  have hq := quadric_identity p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
+    (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z)
+  rw [x_inverse p t x y z hpt, y_inverse p t x y z hpt,
+    z_inverse p t x y z hpt] at hq
+  have hu : p*inverseU t x y z = x*y-z*(z+1) := by
+    unfold inverseU
+    rw [← mul_assoc, hpt, one_mul]
+  have hz : p*relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
+      (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z) = 0 := by
+    calc
+      _ = p*(relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
+        (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z) + inverseU t x y z) -
+        p*inverseU t x y z := by ring
+      _ = 0 := by rw [← hq, hu, sub_self]
+  calc
+    _ = t*(p*relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
+      (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z)) := by
+        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm t p, hpt, one_mul]
+    _ = 0 := by rw [hz, mul_zero]
+
+end StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+section Quotient
+variable {K : Type*} [Field K]
+
+abbrev P5 (K : Type*) [CommRing K] := MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K
+abbrev P3 (K : Type*) [CommRing K] := MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K
+
+def H : P5 K := relation (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (X 3) (X 4)
+
+def fiberIdeal (l : K) : Ideal (P5 K) := Ideal.span {H, X 0-C l}
+
+abbrev Fiber (l : K) := P5 K ⧸ fiberIdeal l
+
+def mk (l : K) : P5 K →ₐ[K] Fiber l := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K (fiberIdeal l)
+
+def decode (l : K) : Fin 5 → P3 K :=
+  ![C l,
+    inverseS (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2),
+    inverseU (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2),
+    inverseF (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2),
+    inverseJ (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2)]
+
+def forward (l : K) : P5 K →ₐ[K] P3 K := MvPolynomial.aeval (decode l)
+
+@[simp] theorem forward_X (l : K) (i : Fin 5) : forward l (X i) = decode l i :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _
+
+@[simp] theorem forward_C (l c : K) : forward l (C c) = C c :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ _
+
+theorem constants_inv (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
+    (C l : P3 K)*C l⁻¹=1 := by rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hl, map_one]
+
+theorem forward_H (l : K) (hl : l≠0) : forward l H = 0 := by
+  unfold H
+  simp only [relation, quadric, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_one,
+    map_ofNat, forward_X]
+  change relation (C l) (inverseS (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2))
+    (inverseU (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2))
+    (inverseF (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2))
+    (inverseJ (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2)) = 0
+  exact relation_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl)
+
+theorem forward_relation (l : K) : forward l (X 0-C l) = 0 := by
+  simp [decode]
+
+theorem forward_kills (l : K) (hl : l≠0) : ∀ a ∈ fiberIdeal l, forward l a=0 := by
+  intro a ha
+  rcases Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp ha with ⟨b,c,rfl⟩
+  simp [forward_H l hl, forward_relation l]
+
+def toPoly (l : K) (hl : l≠0) : Fiber l →ₐ[K] P3 K :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (fiberIdeal l) (forward l) (forward_kills l hl)
+
+@[simp] theorem toPoly_mk (l : K) (hl : l≠0) (a : P5 K) :
+    toPoly l hl (mk l a)=forward l a := by
+  rfl
+
+def encode (l : K) : Fin 3 → Fiber l :=
+  ![xCoord (mk l (X 0)) (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)),
+    yCoord (mk l (X 0)) (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)),
+    zCoord (mk l (X 0)) (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)) (mk l (X 4))]
+
+def fromPoly (l : K) : P3 K →ₐ[K] Fiber l := MvPolynomial.aeval (encode l)
+
+@[simp] theorem fromPoly_X (l : K) (i : Fin 3) : fromPoly l (X i)=encode l i :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _
+
+@[simp] theorem fromPoly_C (l c : K) : fromPoly l (C c)=algebraMap K (Fiber l) c :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ _
+
+end Quotient
+end StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+open MvPolynomial
+variable {K : Type*} [Field K]
+
+theorem mk_H (l : K) : mk l H = 0 := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+  exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
+
+theorem mk_p (l : K) : mk l (X 0) = algebraMap K (Fiber l) l := by
+  have hr : mk l (X 0-C l) = 0 := by
+    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
+  simpa only [map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_eq] using sub_eq_zero.mp hr
+
+theorem mk_relation (l : K) :
+    relation (mk l (X 0)) (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)) (mk l (X 4))=0 := by
+  simpa only [H, relation, quadric, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_one,
+    map_ofNat] using mk_H l
+
+theorem mk_unit (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
+    mk l (X 0)*algebraMap K (Fiber l) l⁻¹=1 := by
+  rw [mk_p, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hl, map_one]
+
+theorem toPoly_fromPoly (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
+    (toPoly l hl).comp (fromPoly l) = AlgHom.id K (P3 K) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i
+  · simpa [encode, xCoord, quadric, decode] using
+      (x_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl))
+  · simpa [encode, xCoord, yCoord, quadric, decode] using
+      (y_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl))
+  · simpa [encode, xCoord, zCoord, quadric, decode] using
+      (z_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl))
+
+end StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber
+
+open MvPolynomial
+variable {K : Type*} [Field K]
+
+theorem fromPoly_toPoly (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
+    (fromPoly l).comp (toPoly l hl) = AlgHom.id K (Fiber l) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext K
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  change fromPoly l (toPoly l hl (mk l (X i))) = mk l (X i)

+
+This module connects the simultaneous-equation calculation in `NonzeroFiber`

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.DeterminantUFD
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization

+/-!
+# Constructing the normalized polynomial lift on the determinant ring
+
+For every actual polynomial additive action on the exact quadric ring `B`,
+this file constructs a polynomial family of algebra maps on the exact
+`C = k[a,d,b,c,u]/(ac-bd-1)`.  Its restriction is the given action on `B`,
+and its parameter-zero specialization is the identity on all of `C`.
+
+Existence uses the proved UFD structure on `C[T]`, the concrete gcd frame
+factorization, and normalization by a constant comparison unit.  No line
+bundle, arbitrary frame, or lift-existence premise is assumed.  The additive
+group law for this normalized family is proved separately by frame uniqueness.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift
+
+open Obstruction FrameLift CoactionLND
+open Polynomial
+
+variable {k : Type*} [Field k]
+
+/-- Pull the base action back along the actual quadric-to-determinant-ring map. -/
+def pulledBase (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    Obstruction.B k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (Obstruction.C k) :=
+  (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (sourceBaseMap k)).comp α.toAlgHom
+
+@[simp] theorem pulledBase_apply (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
+    (b : Obstruction.B k) :
+    pulledBase α b = (α.toAlgHom b).map (sourceBaseMap k).toRingHom := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem pulledBase_at_zero (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
+    (b : Obstruction.B k) :
+    Polynomial.constantCoeff (pulledBase α b) = sourceBaseMap k b := by
+  change (pulledBase α b).coeff 0 = _
+  rw [pulledBase_apply, Polynomial.coeff_map, α.identity]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The polynomial base coordinates satisfy the quadric equation identically. -/
+theorem pulledBase_relation (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    pulledBase α (bX k 0) * pulledBase α (bX k 1) =
+      pulledBase α (bX k 2) * (pulledBase α (bX k 2) + 1) := by
+  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, map_one] using
+    congrArg (pulledBase α) (sub_eq_zero.mp (b_relation k))
+
+/-- A genuine polynomial determinant frame exists by unique factorization. -/
+def rawFrame (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    Frame (Polynomial (Obstruction.C k)) :=
+  QuadricFactorization.frameAbove (pulledBase α (bX k 0))
+    (pulledBase α (bX k 1)) (pulledBase α (bX k 2)) (pulledBase_relation α)
+
+@[simp] theorem rawFrame_ab (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (rawFrame α).a * (rawFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 0) :=
+  QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_ab _ _ _ _
+
+@[simp] theorem rawFrame_dc (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (rawFrame α).d * (rawFrame α).c = pulledBase α (bX k 1) :=
+  QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_dc _ _ _ _
+
+@[simp] theorem rawFrame_db (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (rawFrame α).d * (rawFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 2) :=
+  QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_db _ _ _ _
+
+/-- At parameter zero the raw frame and the original frame have the same base. -/
+theorem rawFrame_at_zero_sameBase (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    SameBase ((rawFrame α).map Polynomial.constantCoeff) (sourceFrame k) := by
+  constructor
+  · change Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).a *
+      Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).b = cX k 0 * cX k 2
+    rw [← map_mul, rawFrame_ab, pulledBase_at_zero]
+    simp
+  constructor
+  · change Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).d *
+      Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).c = cX k 1 * cX k 3
+    rw [← map_mul, rawFrame_dc, pulledBase_at_zero]
+    simp
+  · change Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).d *
+      Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).b = cX k 1 * cX k 2
+    rw [← map_mul, rawFrame_db, pulledBase_at_zero]
+    simp
+
+/-- The chosen polynomial frame has exactly the original frame at parameter zero. -/
+def normalizedFrame (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    Frame (Polynomial (Obstruction.C k)) :=
+  normalizePolynomialFrame (rawFrame α) (sourceFrame k) (rawFrame_at_zero_sameBase α)
+
+theorem normalizedFrame_sameBase (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    SameBase (normalizedFrame α) (rawFrame α) :=
+  normalizePolynomialFrame_sameBase _ _ _
+
+@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_at_zero (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (normalizedFrame α).map Polynomial.constantCoeff = sourceFrame k :=
+  normalizePolynomialFrame_at_zero _ _ _
+
+@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_ab (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (normalizedFrame α).a * (normalizedFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 0) :=
+  (normalizedFrame_sameBase α).1.trans (rawFrame_ab α)
+
+@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_dc (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (normalizedFrame α).d * (normalizedFrame α).c = pulledBase α (bX k 1) :=
+  (normalizedFrame_sameBase α).2.1.trans (rawFrame_dc α)
+
+@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_db (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (normalizedFrame α).d * (normalizedFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 2) :=
+  (normalizedFrame_sameBase α).2.2.trans (rawFrame_db α)
+
+/-- The actual normalized polynomial-family homomorphism on the determinant ring.
+The independent `u` coordinate is lifted through the same base action. -/
+def liftHom (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (Obstruction.C k) :=
+  (normalizedFrame α).quotientMap (pulledBase α (bX k 3))
+
+/-- The family restricts to the original base action on the whole base algebra. -/
+theorem liftHom_comp_baseMap (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    (liftHom α).comp (sourceBaseMap k) = pulledBase α :=
+  Frame.quotientMap_comp_baseMap _ _ _ (normalizedFrame_ab α)
+    (normalizedFrame_dc α) (normalizedFrame_db α) rfl
+
+/-- Pointwise form of the exact base-extension identity. -/
+theorem liftHom_baseMap (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
+    (b : Obstruction.B k) :
+    liftHom α (sourceBaseMap k b) = (α.toAlgHom b).map (sourceBaseMap k).toRingHom :=
+  AlgHom.congr_fun (liftHom_comp_baseMap α) b
+
+/-- Zero-parameter specialization, bundled as a coefficient-algebra homomorphism. -/
+def atZero : Polynomial (Obstruction.C k) →ₐ[k] Obstruction.C k where
+  toRingHom := Polynomial.constantCoeff
+  commutes' r := by simp
+
+/-- The normalization is an equality of actual algebra maps, not just of points. -/
+theorem atZero_comp_liftHom (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    atZero.comp (liftHom α) = AlgHom.id k (Obstruction.C k) := by
+  unfold liftHom
+  rw [(normalizedFrame α).quotientMap_natural (pulledBase α (bX k 3)) (atZero (k := k))]
+  change ((normalizedFrame α).map Polynomial.constantCoeff).quotientMap
+    (Polynomial.constantCoeff (pulledBase α (bX k 3))) = _
+  rw [normalizedFrame_at_zero, pulledBase_at_zero]
+  simp
+
+/-- The lifted polynomial family is normalized on every element of `C`. -/
+@[simp] theorem liftHom_identity (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
+    (c : Obstruction.C k) : (liftHom α c).coeff 0 = c :=
+  AlgHom.congr_fun (atZero_comp_liftHom α) c
+
+/-- Unconditional existence of a normalized polynomial lift over the exact rings. -/
+theorem exists_normalized_lift (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
+    ∃ β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (Obstruction.C k),
+      (∀ c, (β c).coeff 0 = c) ∧
+      (∀ b, β (sourceBaseMap k b) = (α.toAlgHom b).map (sourceBaseMap k).toRingHom) :=
+  ⟨liftHom α, liftHom_identity α, liftHom_baseMap α⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+# Exact rings in the noncoordinate obstruction

+
+/-- Highest weighted part of the source hypersurface equation. -/
+noncomputable def Hstar : P k 5 :=
+  xP k ^ 2 * X 3 - (1 + 2 * X 1 * xP k) * X 4 - X 0 * X 4 ^ 2
+
+noncomputable def H : P k 5 := Hstar k - X 2
+noncomputable def idealA : Ideal (P k 5) := Ideal.span {H k}

+abbrev G := P k 5 ⧸ idealG k

+noncomputable def aX (i : Fin 5) : A k := Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealA k) (X i)
+/-- Generator images of the weighted degeneration presentation. -/
+noncomputable def gX (i : Fin 5) : G k := Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) (X i)
+
+noncomputable def quadricRelation : P k 4 := X 0 * X 1 - X 2 * (X 2 + 1)
+noncomputable def idealB : Ideal (P k 4) := Ideal.span {quadricRelation k}
+abbrev B := P k 4 ⧸ idealB k
+/-- Quadric variables `x,y,z,u`, in this order. -/
+noncomputable def bX (i : Fin 4) : B k := Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealB k) (X i)

+noncomputable def determinantRelation : P k 5 := X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1
+noncomputable def idealC : Ideal (P k 5) := Ideal.span {determinantRelation k}
+abbrev C := P k 5 ⧸ idealC k

+/-- Evaluation at an actual determinant-one matrix supplies a scalar retraction. -/

+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (idealC k) (MvPolynomial.aeval ![1, 0, 0, 1, 0]) (by

+    have hh := congrArg (determinantBasepoint k) h

+noncomputable abbrev baseMap : B k →ₐ[k] C k := BundleCharts.baseMap k
+

+    baseMap k (bX k i) =
+      ![cX k 0 * cX k 2, cX k 1 * cX k 3, cX k 1 * cX k 2, cX k 4] i :=
+  BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k i
+
+/-- Injectivity is proved by two explicit local sections, not assumed. -/
+theorem baseMap_injective : Function.Injective (baseMap k) :=
+  BundleCharts.baseMap_injective k
+
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_sB :
+    baseMap k (sB k) = Bundle.s (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4) := by
+  simp [sB, Bundle.s]
+
+@[simp] theorem baseMap_f0 :
+    baseMap k (f0 k) = Bundle.f₀ (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4) := by
+  simp [f0, Bundle.f₀]

+    baseMap k (g0 k) = Bundle.g₀ (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4) := by
+  simp [g0, Bundle.g₀]

+  rw [I, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
+  change Ideal.span ({baseMap k (f0 k), baseMap k (g0 k)} : Set (C k)) = _
+  rw [baseMap_f0, baseMap_g0]
+  exact Bundle.principalization (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4)
+    (sub_eq_zero.mp (c_relation k))

+/-- Every element of the distinguished ideal admits the required factorization
+in the total ring, with its actual image under the base map. -/
+theorem baseMap_factor_of_mem_I {h : B k} (hh : h ∈ I k) :
+    ∃ q : C k, baseMap k h = v k * q := by
+  have hm : baseMap k h ∈ Ideal.map (baseMap k).toRingHom (I k) :=
+    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hh
+  rw [map_I_eq_span_v, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hm

+source ring embeds in the total ring. -/
+theorem extension_ne_zero
+    (hD : D ≠ 0) (hExt : ∀ b, D' (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (D b)) : D' ≠ 0 := by
+  intro hD'
+  apply hD
+  ext b
+  apply baseMap_injective k
+  change baseMap k (D b) = baseMap k 0
+  rw [map_zero, ← hExt, hD', Derivation.zero_apply]

+variable [IsDomain (C k)] [CharZero k]
+
+/-- The principalized invariant is fixed by any actual locally nilpotent lift.
+This is the final factorial-closure argument of source `prop:lift`. -/
+theorem extension_annihilates_v
+    (hLND : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D')
+    (hExt : ∀ b, D' (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (D b))
+    {h : B k} (hh : h ∈ I k) (h0 : h ≠ 0) (hFix : D h = 0) : D' (v k) = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := baseMap_factor_of_mem_I k hh
+  have hmap : baseMap k h ≠ 0 := by
+    intro hz
+    apply h0
+    exact baseMap_injective k (by simpa using hz)

+  have hv : v k ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).1

+  have hFixed : D' (v k * q) = 0 := by rw [← hq, hExt, hFix, map_zero]
+  exact (StableCoordinate.lnd_factorial_closure D' hLND hv hq0 hFixed).1

+    (hD : D ≠ 0) (hLND : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D')
+    (hExt : ∀ b, D' (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (D b))
+    (hInv : ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ D h = 0) :
+    D' ≠ 0 ∧ D' (v k) = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨h, hh, h0, hFix⟩ := hInv
+  exact ⟨extension_ne_zero D D' hD hExt,
+    extension_annihilates_v D D' hLND hExt hh h0 hFix⟩
+
+end Derivations
+
+end StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+
+end OAI

+/-!
+# Picard triviality for the factorial affine charts
+
+Algebraic support for `bun:homotopy` in §4 of the source.  Over a GCD domain,
+all invertible modules are trivial; in particular this applies to the UFD
+localizations in the two charts and their polynomial extensions.

+underlying sets.  Invertible modules correspond to line bundles on an affine scheme.
+-/

+/-- An invertible module over a GCD domain admits a linear trivialization.
+There is no Noetherian hypothesis: Mathlib's class-group theorem is stronger
+than the particular source input. -/
+theorem invertibleModule_trivial_of_gcd
+    (A M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsGCDMonoid A]
+    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Invertible A M] :
+    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[A] A) :=
+  CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_one_iff.mp (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
+
+/-- Triviality survives localization of a UFD at non-zero-divisors. -/

+    (A B M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
+    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B]
+    (hS : S ≤ nonZeroDivisors A)
+    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module.Invertible B M] :
+    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[B] B) := by
+  let : IsDomain B := IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors B hS
+  let : UniqueFactorizationMonoid B := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization S B
+  exact invertibleModule_trivial_of_gcd B M
+
+/-- In particular, every invertible module on a principal localization of a
+UFD at a nonzero element is trivial. -/
+theorem invertibleModule_trivial_of_away
+    (A B M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
+    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (a : A) [IsLocalization.Away a B] (ha : a ≠ 0)
+    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module.Invertible B M] :
+    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[B] B) :=
+  invertibleModule_trivial_of_localization A B M (Submonoid.powers a)
+    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors ha)
+
+/-- The affine-line parameter used in the action-lift argument preserves
+triviality of invertible modules on a factorial affine chart. -/
+theorem invertibleModule_polynomial_trivial
+    (A M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
+    [AddCommGroup M] [Module (Polynomial A) M] [Module.Invertible (Polynomial A) M] :
+    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[(Polynomial A)] (Polynomial A)) :=
+  invertibleModule_trivial_of_gcd (Polynomial A) M
+
+/-- Combined version for a principal affine chart and its affine-line extension. -/
+theorem invertibleModule_away_polynomial_trivial
+    (A B M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
+    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (a : A) [IsLocalization.Away a B] (ha : a ≠ 0)

+  let : UniqueFactorizationMonoid B :=
+    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers a) B

+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.AlgebraMap
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Constants in polynomial charts
+
+Section 5 identifies two localizations of the determinant ring with polynomial
+rings over principal localizations of `k[a,d,u]`.  The needed intersection with
+`k(a,d,u)` is not a set-theoretic assertion: a polynomial over the chart's
+coefficient ring which becomes constant over the fraction field has that
+constant in its coefficient ring.  The lemmas here prove that exact algebraic
+interface without assuming the manuscript's chart identifications.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection
+
+open Polynomial
+
+section RingHom
+
+variable {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
+
+/-- Taking the constant coefficient recovers a constant in the range of an
+actual polynomial coefficient map.  No injectivity assumption is needed. -/
+theorem constant_mem_range_map_iff (f : R →+* S) (s : S) :
+    C s ∈ Set.range (Polynomial.map f) ↔ s ∈ Set.range f := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
+    refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
+    simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_C_zero] using congrArg (fun q : S[X] ↦ q.coeff 0) hp
+  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨C r, map_C f⟩
+
+/-- A mapped polynomial that becomes constant was itself constant when the
+coefficient map is injective. -/
+theorem map_eq_C_iff (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Injective f)
+    (p : R[X]) (s : S) :
+    Polynomial.map f p = C s ↔ ∃ r : R, p = C r ∧ f r = s := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have hr : f (p.coeff 0) = s := by
+      simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_C_zero] using congrArg (fun q : S[X] ↦ q.coeff 0) h
+    use p.coeff 0
+    refine ⟨?_, hr⟩
+    apply Polynomial.map_injective f hf
+    rw [h, map_C, hr]
+  · rintro ⟨r, rfl, rfl⟩
+    exact map_C f
+
+/-- The intersection of coefficientwise images with the constant polynomials
+is exactly the image of the original coefficient ring. -/
+theorem polynomial_range_inf_constants (f : R →+* S) :
+    (Polynomial.mapRingHom f).rangeS ⊓ (C : S →+* S[X]).rangeS =
+      ((C : S →+* S[X]).comp f).rangeS := by
+  ext p
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
+    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (constant_mem_range_map_iff f s).mp ⟨r, hr⟩
+    exact ⟨a, by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, ha]⟩
+  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨⟨C r, map_C f⟩, ⟨f r, rfl⟩⟩
+
+end RingHom
+
+end StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection
+
+open Polynomial
+
+section CompatibleCharts
+
+variable {A C K Ω : Type*} [Semiring A] [Semiring C] [Semiring K] [Semiring Ω]
+
+/-- If a polynomial chart and a coefficient-field embedding agree in a common
+ambient ring, injectivity of the polynomial chart forces the putative constant
+to belong to the chart coefficient ring.  All maps and commuting-square
+conditions are explicit; no identification of abstractly isomorphic rings is
+silently used. -/
+theorem mem_coefficient_range_of_compatible_chart
+    (f : A →+* K) (chart : C →+* A[X])
+    (inclusion : C →+* Ω) (coefficients : K →+* Ω)
+    (polynomialEmbedding : K[X] →+* Ω)
+    (hinj : Function.Injective polynomialEmbedding)
+    (hchart : (polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)).comp chart = inclusion)
+    (hcoeff : polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.C : K →+* K[X]) = coefficients)
+    {c : C} {q : K} (h : inclusion c = coefficients q) :
+    q ∈ Set.range f := by
+  apply (constant_mem_range_map_iff f q).mp
+  refine ⟨chart c, hinj ?_⟩
+  calc
+    polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.map f (chart c)) = inclusion c :=
+      RingHom.congr_fun hchart c
+    _ = coefficients q := h
+    _ = polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.C q) := (RingHom.congr_fun hcoeff q).symm
+
+/-- The previous lemma also records the stronger conclusion that the chart
+polynomial itself is constant whenever its coefficient map is injective. -/
+theorem chart_eq_constant_of_compatible_chart
+    (f : A →+* K) (hf : Function.Injective f) (chart : C →+* A[X])
+    (inclusion : C →+* Ω) (coefficients : K →+* Ω)
+    (polynomialEmbedding : K[X] →+* Ω)
+    (hinj : Function.Injective polynomialEmbedding)
+    (hchart : (polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)).comp chart = inclusion)
+    (hcoeff : polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.C : K →+* K[X]) = coefficients)
+    {c : C} {q : K} (h : inclusion c = coefficients q) :
+    ∃ a : A, chart c = Polynomial.C a ∧ f a = q := by
+  apply (map_eq_C_iff f hf _ _).mp
+  apply hinj
+  calc
+    polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.map f (chart c)) = inclusion c :=
+      RingHom.congr_fun hchart c
+    _ = coefficients q := h
+    _ = polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.C q) := (RingHom.congr_fun hcoeff q).symm
+
+end CompatibleCharts
+
+section AlgebraHom
+
+variable {k R S : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
+  [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
+
+/-- The constants-in-chart statement in the form of an equality of
+`k`-subalgebras, for direct use with affine coordinate rings. -/
+theorem polynomial_algRange_inf_constants (f : R →ₐ[k] S) :
+    (Polynomial.mapAlgHom f).range ⊓ (Polynomial.CAlgHom : S →ₐ[k] S[X]).range =
+      ((Polynomial.CAlgHom : S →ₐ[k] S[X]).comp f).range := by
+  ext p
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
+    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (constant_mem_range_map_iff f.toRingHom s).mp ⟨r, hr⟩
+    exact ⟨a, congrArg (Polynomial.C : S → S[X]) ha⟩
+  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨⟨C r, map_C f.toRingHom⟩, ⟨f r, rfl⟩⟩
+
+end AlgebraHom
+
+end StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Nilpotent
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Ordinary-polynomial adapters for normalized determinant lifts
+
+The additive-coaction interface uses ordinary and iterated `Polynomial`, while
+multivariate frames are convenient for the underlying unit rigidity argument.
+These adapters give the same normalization and uniqueness directly for the
+coaction parameter type, without changing variables through an equivalence.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+variable {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
+
+/-- Equality of base coordinates is preserved under every ring homomorphism. -/
+private theorem sameBase_map_aux {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) (f : R →+* S) :
+    SameBase (F.map f) (G.map f) := by
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · simpa only [Frame.map, map_mul] using congrArg f h.1
+  · simpa only [Frame.map, map_mul] using congrArg f h.2.1
+  · simpa only [Frame.map, map_mul] using congrArg f h.2.2
+
+/-- Units of an ordinary polynomial ring over a reduced ring are constant. -/
+theorem univariate_unit_eq_C_constantCoeff [IsReduced R]
+    {p : Polynomial R} (hp : IsUnit p) :
+    p = Polynomial.C (Polynomial.constantCoeff p) := by
+  have hd : p.natDegree = 0 := by
+    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos
+    intro hpos
+    exact Polynomial.not_isUnit_of_natDegree_pos_of_isReduced p hpos hp
+  exact Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hd
+
+/-- Reducedness passes to ordinary polynomial rings. -/
+theorem polynomial_isReduced [IsReduced R] : IsReduced (Polynomial R) := by
+  rw [isReduced_iff]
+  intro p hp
+  apply Polynomial.ext
+  intro n
+  simpa using ((Polynomial.isNilpotent_iff.mp hp) n).eq_zero
+
+/-- Iterated-polynomial version: normalization at the two-parameter origin
+is enough for the additive coaction group-law comparison. -/
+theorem normalized_bivariate_unique [IsReduced R]
+    {F G : Frame (Polynomial (Polynomial R))} (h : SameBase F G)
+    (hzero : (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
+      (G.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map Polynomial.constantCoeff) : F = G := by
+  let : IsReduced (Polynomial R) := polynomial_isReduced
+  apply normalized_univariate_unique h
+  exact normalized_univariate_unique (sameBase_map_aux h Polynomial.constantCoeff) hzero
+
+/-- Normalize an ordinary-polynomial frame to a prescribed initial frame. -/
+noncomputable def normalizePolynomialFrame (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (G : Frame R)
+    (h : SameBase (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) G) : Frame (Polynomial R) :=
+  F.scale (Units.map Polynomial.C.toMonoidHom (comparisonUnit h))
+
+/-- Ordinary-polynomial normalization does not change the base-coordinate family. -/
+theorem normalizePolynomialFrame_sameBase (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (G : Frame R)
+    (h : SameBase (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) G) :
+    SameBase (normalizePolynomialFrame F G h) F :=
+  F.scale_sameBase _
+
+/-- The normalized ordinary-polynomial frame starts at exactly the chosen frame. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem normalizePolynomialFrame_at_zero (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (G : Frame R)
+    (h : SameBase (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) G) :
+    (normalizePolynomialFrame F G h).map Polynomial.constantCoeff = G := by
+  rw [normalizePolynomialFrame, Frame.map_scale]
+  have hu : Units.map Polynomial.constantCoeff.toMonoidHom
+      (Units.map (Polynomial.C : R →+* Polynomial R).toMonoidHom (comparisonUnit h)) =
+      comparisonUnit h := by
+    apply Units.ext
+    simp
+  rw [hu, scale_comparison h]
+
+/-- Ordinary-polynomial coefficient specialization commutes with a ring map. -/
+theorem Frame.specializePolynomial_map (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (θ : R →+* S) :
+    (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ)).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
+      (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map θ := by
+  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.map]
+
+/-- Ordinary-polynomial covariance under a normalized fiber scaling. -/
+theorem normalized_univariate_lift_scaling_equivariance [IsReduced R]
+    (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (F₀ : Frame R)
+    (hzero : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = F₀)
+    (θ : R →+* R) (u : Rˣ)
+    (href : F₀.map θ = F₀.scale u)
+    (hbase : SameBase (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ)) F) :
+    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ) =
+      F.scale (Units.map (Polynomial.C : R →+* Polynomial R).toMonoidHom u) := by
+  apply normalized_univariate_unique
+  · exact sameBase_trans hbase (sameBase_symm (F.scale_sameBase _))
+  · rw [Frame.specializePolynomial_map, hzero, href, Frame.map_scale, hzero]
+    congr 1
+    apply Units.ext
+    simp
+
+end StableCoordinate.FrameLift
+
+end OAI

+
+The source variables in `P n` are `p,s,u,F,J`, in that order, followed by

+variables fixed.  In particular `n=0` gives the unstabilized presentation and

+
+def p (n : ℕ) : P n := X ((0 : Fin 5).castAdd n)
+def s (n : ℕ) : P n := X ((1 : Fin 5).castAdd n)
+def u (n : ℕ) : P n := X ((2 : Fin 5).castAdd n)
+def F (n : ℕ) : P n := X ((3 : Fin 5).castAdd n)
+def J (n : ℕ) : P n := X ((4 : Fin 5).castAdd n)

+  ![pChange (C t) (p n) (s n) (u n) (F n) (J n),

+
+def changeHom (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) : P n →ₐ[ℂ] P n :=
+  aeval (Fin.addCases (changeCoords n t) (fun i : Fin n => X (i.natAdd 5)))
+
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_C (n : ℕ) (t c : ℂ) : changeHom n t (C c) = C c := by
+  simp [changeHom]
+
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_X_left (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) :
+    changeHom n t (X (i.castAdd n)) = changeCoords n t i := by
+  simp [changeHom]
+
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_X_right (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
+    changeHom n t (X (i.natAdd 5)) = X (i.natAdd 5) := by
+  simp [changeHom]
+
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_p (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) :
+    changeHom n t (p n) = pChange (C t) (p n) (s n) (u n) (F n) (J n) := by
+  simp [p, changeCoords]
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_s (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) :
+    changeHom n t (s n) = sChange (C t) (p n) (s n) (u n) (F n) (J n) := by
+  simp [s, changeCoords]
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_u (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) :
+    changeHom n t (u n) = uChange (C t) (p n) (s n) (u n) (F n) (J n) := by
+  simp [u, changeCoords]
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_F (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) :
+    changeHom n t (F n) = FChange (C t) (p n) (s n) (u n) (F n) (J n) := by
+  simp [F, changeCoords]
+@[simp] lemma changeHom_J (n : ℕ) (t : ℂ) : changeHom n t (J n) = J n := by
+  simp [J, changeCoords]
+
+lemma changeHom_comp (n : ℕ) (t r : ℂ) :
+    (changeHom n t).comp (changeHom n r) = changeHom n (r + t) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
+  · fin_cases j <;>
+      simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, changeCoords,
+        pChange_add, sChange_add, uChange_add, FChange_add, map_add]
+  · simp
+
+lemma changeHom_zero (n : ℕ) : changeHom n 0 = AlgHom.id ℂ (P n) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
+  · fin_cases j <;> simp [changeCoords, p, s, u, F, J]
+  · simp
+
+/-- The source's inverse matrix substitution, regarded as an algebra automorphism.
+It carries the original hypersurface equation to `-J-u`. -/
+def matrixEquiv (n : ℕ) : P n ≃ₐ[ℂ] P n :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (changeHom n (-1)) (changeHom n 1)
+    (by rw [changeHom_comp]; simpa using changeHom_zero n)
+    (by rw [changeHom_comp]; simpa using changeHom_zero n)
+
+@[simp] lemma matrixEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (v : P n) :
+    matrixEquiv n v = changeHom n (-1) v := rfl
+
+@[simp] lemma matrixEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℕ) (v : P n) :
+    (matrixEquiv n).symm v = changeHom n 1 v := rfl
+
+lemma matrixEquiv_H (n : ℕ) : matrixEquiv n (H n) = -J n - u n := by
+  simp [H, relation_change_neg_one]
+
+lemma matrixEquiv_x (n : ℕ) : matrixEquiv n (x n) = x n := by
+  simp [x, quad_change]
+
+
+/-- Set the transformed variable `u` equal to `-J` and retain all other variables. -/
+def eliminateHom (n : ℕ) : P n →ₐ[ℂ] R (4 + n) :=
+  aeval (Fin.addCases
+    ![X ((0 : Fin 4).castAdd n), X ((1 : Fin 4).castAdd n),
+      -X ((3 : Fin 4).castAdd n), X ((2 : Fin 4).castAdd n), X ((3 : Fin 4).castAdd n)]
+    (fun i : Fin n => X (i.natAdd 4)))
+
+/-- Include the four retained variables and all the extra variables. -/
+def includeHom (n : ℕ) : R (4 + n) →ₐ[ℂ] P n :=
+  aeval (Fin.addCases ![p n, s n, F n, J n] (fun i : Fin n => X (i.natAdd 5)))
+
+@[simp] lemma eliminateHom_p (n : ℕ) : eliminateHom n (p n) = X ((0 : Fin 4).castAdd n) := by
+  simp [eliminateHom, p]
+@[simp] lemma eliminateHom_s (n : ℕ) : eliminateHom n (s n) = X ((1 : Fin 4).castAdd n) := by
+  simp [eliminateHom, s]
+@[simp] lemma eliminateHom_u (n : ℕ) : eliminateHom n (u n) = -X ((3 : Fin 4).castAdd n) := by
+  simp [eliminateHom, u]
+@[simp] lemma eliminateHom_F (n : ℕ) : eliminateHom n (F n) = X ((2 : Fin 4).castAdd n) := by
+  simp [eliminateHom, F]
+@[simp] lemma eliminateHom_J (n : ℕ) : eliminateHom n (J n) = X ((3 : Fin 4).castAdd n) := by
+  simp [eliminateHom, J]
+
+@[simp] lemma eliminateHom_X_right (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
+    eliminateHom n (X (i.natAdd 5)) = X (i.natAdd 4) := by
+  simp [eliminateHom]
+@[simp] lemma includeHom_X_right (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
+    includeHom n (X (i.natAdd 4)) = X (i.natAdd 5) := by
+  simp [includeHom]
+
+lemma eliminateHom_includeHom (n : ℕ) :
+    (eliminateHom n).comp (includeHom n) = AlgHom.id ℂ (R (4+n)) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
+  · fin_cases j <;> simp [includeHom]
+  · simp
+
+/-- Quotient projection for the source hypersurface. -/
+def mk (n : ℕ) : P n →ₐ[ℂ] A n := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ (relationIdeal n)
+
+@[simp] lemma mk_H (n : ℕ) : mk n (H n) = 0 := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+  exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
+
+/-- Evaluation in the explicit four-variable polynomial presentation. -/
+def polynomialMap (n : ℕ) : P n →ₐ[ℂ] R (4+n) :=
+  (eliminateHom n).comp (matrixEquiv n).toAlgHom
+
+@[simp] lemma polynomialMap_H (n : ℕ) : polynomialMap n (H n) = 0 := by
+  change eliminateHom n (matrixEquiv n (H n)) = 0
+  rw [matrixEquiv_H]
+  simp
+
+/-- The source quotient maps to the four-variable polynomial presentation. -/
+def toPolynomial (n : ℕ) : A n →ₐ[ℂ] R (4+n) :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (relationIdeal n) (polynomialMap n) (by
+    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem (RingHom.ker (polynomialMap n).toRingHom)).mpr
+    exact polynomialMap_H n)
+
+@[simp] lemma toPolynomial_mk (n : ℕ) (v : P n) :
+    toPolynomial n (mk n v) = polynomialMap n v := rfl
+
+/-- The inverse polynomial presentation uses the forward matrix coordinates upstairs. -/
+def fromPolynomial (n : ℕ) : R (4+n) →ₐ[ℂ] A n :=
+  (mk n).comp ((matrixEquiv n).symm.toAlgHom.comp (includeHom n))
+
+lemma toPolynomial_fromPolynomial (n : ℕ) :
+    (toPolynomial n).comp (fromPolynomial n) = AlgHom.id ℂ (R (4+n)) := by
+  apply AlgHom.ext
+  intro r
+  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, fromPolynomial, toPolynomial_mk, polynomialMap, AlgHom.id_apply]
+  change eliminateHom n ((matrixEquiv n) ((matrixEquiv n).symm (includeHom n r))) = r
+  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
+  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (eliminateHom_includeHom n) r
+
+lemma mk_matrix_symm_include_eliminate (n : ℕ) :
+    ((mk n).comp (matrixEquiv n).symm.toAlgHom).comp
+      ((includeHom n).comp (eliminateHom n)) =
+    (mk n).comp (matrixEquiv n).symm.toAlgHom := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
+  · fin_cases j
+    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, p]
+    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, s]
+    · change mk n ((matrixEquiv n).symm (includeHom n (eliminateHom n (u n)))) =
+        mk n ((matrixEquiv n).symm (u n))
+      have hj : includeHom n (X ((3 : Fin 4).castAdd n)) = J n := by simp [includeHom]
+      rw [eliminateHom_u, map_neg, hj]
+      simp only [map_neg, matrixEquiv_symm_apply, changeHom_J, changeHom_u, map_one]
+      rw [uChange_one]
+      change -(mk n (J n)) = mk n (-H n - J n)
+      simp
+    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, F]
+    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, J]
+  · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply]
+
+lemma fromPolynomial_toPolynomial (n : ℕ) :
+    (fromPolynomial n).comp (toPolynomial n) = AlgHom.id ℂ (A n) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext ℂ
+  apply AlgHom.ext
+  intro v
+  change fromPolynomial n (toPolynomial n (mk n v)) = mk n v
+  rw [toPolynomial_mk]
+  change mk n ((matrixEquiv n).symm (includeHom n
+    (eliminateHom n ((matrixEquiv n) v)))) = mk n v
+  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (mk_matrix_symm_include_eliminate n) ((matrixEquiv n) v)
+  simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h
+
+/-- Proposition 2.1, stable under adjoining any number of independent variables. -/
+def polynomialPresentation (n : ℕ) : A n ≃ₐ[ℂ] R (4+n) :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (toPolynomial n) (fromPolynomial n)
+    (toPolynomial_fromPolynomial n) (fromPolynomial_toPolynomial n)
+
+@[simp] lemma polynomialPresentation_mk (n : ℕ) (v : P n) :
+    polynomialPresentation n (mk n v) = polynomialMap n v := rfl
+
+
+/-- The distinguished source variable is exactly the polynomial in the question,
+renamed into the first four variables; the extra variables are not involved. -/
+lemma polynomialPresentation_p (n : ℕ) :
+    polynomialPresentation n (mk n (p n)) =
+      MvPolynomial.rename (Fin.castAdd n : Fin 4 → Fin (4+n)) StableCoordinate.f := by
+  rw [polynomialPresentation_mk]
+  simp [polynomialMap, pChange, quad, StableCoordinate.f, StableCoordinate.Q, map_ofNat]
+  ring
+
+@[simp] lemma polynomialPresentation_extra (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
+    polynomialPresentation n (mk n (X (i.natAdd 5))) = X (i.natAdd 4) := by
+  simp [polynomialMap]
+
+/-- The unstabilized polynomial presentation. -/
+abbrev originalPresentation : A 0 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 4 := polynomialPresentation 0
+
+lemma originalPresentation_p : originalPresentation (mk 0 (p 0)) = StableCoordinate.f := by
+  simpa using polynomialPresentation_p 0
+
+/-- The same presentation after adjoining one independent variable. -/
+abbrev stabilizedPresentation : A 1 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 5 := polynomialPresentation 1
+
+lemma stabilizedPresentation_p :
+    stabilizedPresentation (mk 1 (p 1)) = stabilize StableCoordinate.f := by
+  have hi : (Fin.castAdd 1 : Fin 4 → Fin 5) = Fin.castSucc := by
+    funext i
+    apply Fin.ext
+    rfl
+  simpa [stabilize, hi] using polynomialPresentation_p 1
+
+end
+end StableCoordinate.Presentation
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.Degree
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.GeometricInterpretation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.Stabilization
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.StabilizationEmbedding
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.AllFibers
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.NonCoordinate
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The stable noncoordinate polynomial and its fibers
+
+The degree-five polynomial becomes a coordinate after adjoining one variable
+but is not a coordinate in four variables. Every complex fiber is affine
+three-space and has a nonrectifiable embedding in affine four-space.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+/-- The exact polynomial has degree five, is one-stable, and is not a
+coordinate in its original four-variable polynomial algebra. -/
+theorem polynomial_package : PolynomialPackage :=
+  ⟨f_totalDegree, f_isOneStableCoordinate, f_not_coordinate⟩
+
+/-- Every complex fiber is affine three-space and its embedding in affine
+four-space is nonrectifiable. -/
+theorem fiber_package : FiberPackage :=
+  fiberPackage_of_noncoordinate f_not_coordinate
+
+/-- Both complete principal groups, with every required quantifier. -/
+theorem principal_package : PrincipalPackage :=
+  ⟨polynomial_package, fiber_package⟩
+
+/-- Literal polynomial-extension form of the unrestricted stabilization. -/
+theorem f_is_coordinate_in_polynomial_extension :
+    ∃ φ : Polynomial (R 4) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (R 4),
+      φ (Polynomial.C f) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X 0) :=
+  (isOneStableCoordinate_iff_polynomial f).mp f_isOneStableCoordinate
+
+/-- The exact example disproves the stable-coordinate statement for four
+original variables and one independent added variable over `ℂ`. -/
+theorem stable_coordinate_conjecture_four_false :
+    ¬ (∀ g : R 4, IsOneStableCoordinate g →
+      IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) g) := by
+  intro h
+  exact f_not_coordinate (h f f_isOneStableCoordinate)
+
+/-- The dimension-four Abhyankar–Sathaye statement over `ℂ` fails for this
+exact polynomial.  Its zero fiber already supplies the required counterexample;
+the stronger all-fiber statement is `fiber_package`. -/
+theorem abhyankar_sathaye_statement_four_false :
+    ¬ (∀ g : R 4,
+      Nonempty ((R 4 ⧸ Ideal.span ({g} : Set (R 4))) ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 3) →
+      IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) g) := by
+  intro h
+  apply f_not_coordinate
+  apply h f
+  have hI : fiberIdeal 0 = Ideal.span ({f} : Set (R 4)) := by
+    unfold fiberIdeal
+    rw [MvPolynomial.C_0, sub_zero]
+  exact ⟨(Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq ℂ hI.symm).trans (exactFiberEquiv 0)⟩
+
+open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
+open scoped AlgebraicGeometry
+
+/-- The all-fiber result as actual schemes over `Spec ℂ`, with the actual
+closed hypersurface immersion and obstruction to every base-preserving ambient
+scheme automorphism.  This is not merely a statement about sets of points. -/
+theorem all_fibers_geometric_conclusion :
+    ∀ t : ℂ,
+      Nonempty (AffineGeometry.algebraSpec ℂ (FiberRing t) ≅
+        Over.mk (AffineSpace (Fin 3) (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) ↘
+          Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))) ∧
+      IsClosedImmersion (GeometricInterpretation.fiberEmbedding t) ∧
+      ¬ GeometricInterpretation.IsSchemeRectifiableFiber t :=
+  GeometricInterpretation.fiberPackage_gives_geometric_conclusion fiber_package
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Nilpotent
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Maps
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Span
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Principal hypersurface ideals over a field
+
+The elementary algebraic interface used in the proof of `cor:fibers` is that two
+polynomials which generate the same ideal differ by a nonzero scalar.  This
+module proves that statement and its transported form under algebra maps.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {k σ : Type*} [Field k]
+
+/-- Equal principal ideals in a polynomial ring over a field have generators
+that differ by a nonzero scalar.  This includes the zero ideal. -/
+theorem eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_span_singleton_eq
+    {f g : MvPolynomial σ k}
+    (h : Ideal.span ({f} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) = Ideal.span {g}) :
+    ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = C c * g := by
+  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mp h).symm
+  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcu⟩ :=
+    MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp u.isUnit
+  exact ⟨c, isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hc, by simpa [hcu, mul_comm] using hu.symm⟩
+
+/-- Scalar multiples by a nonzero field element generate the same ideal. -/
+theorem span_singleton_eq_of_eq_nonzero_scalar_mul
+    {f g : MvPolynomial σ k} {c : k} (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : f = C c * g) :
+    Ideal.span ({f} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) = Ideal.span {g} := by
+  rw [h]
+  exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hc).map C) g
+
+/-- A precise algebraic form of the generator normalization step. -/
+theorem span_singleton_eq_iff_nonzero_scalar_mul
+    {f g : MvPolynomial σ k} :
+    Ideal.span ({f} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) = Ideal.span {g} ↔
+      ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = C c * g := by
+  constructor
+  · exact eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_span_singleton_eq
+  · rintro ⟨c, hc, h⟩
+    exact span_singleton_eq_of_eq_nonzero_scalar_mul hc h
+
+/-- Images of principal ideals under algebra maps are generated by the image
+of the generator.  No surjectivity assumption is needed. -/
+theorem map_span_singleton_algHom
+    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
+    (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (f : A) :
+    Ideal.map φ.toRingHom (Ideal.span ({f} : Set A)) = Ideal.span {φ f} := by
+  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
+  rfl
+
+/-- If an algebra map takes a polynomial principal ideal to another principal
+ideal, its value on the generator is a nonzero scalar multiple of the target. -/
+theorem eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_map_span_singleton_eq
+    {τ : Type*} (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial τ k)
+    {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {g : MvPolynomial τ k}
+    (h : Ideal.map φ.toRingHom (Ideal.span ({f} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k))) =
+      Ideal.span {g}) :
+    ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ φ f = C c * g := by
+  apply eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_span_singleton_eq
+  simpa only [map_span_singleton_algHom] using h
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitialIdeal
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.GradedRelation
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The exact initial relation of the source hypersurface
+
+For the five independent variables `p,s,u,F,J`, with integer weights
+`(-1,0,0,1,1)`, this file proves that the initial ideal of `(H)` is exactly
+`(Hstar)`. It also gives the actual homogeneous kernel criterion in terms of
+the quotient rings `A` and `G`, without assuming an associated-graded isomorphism.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.PrincipalInitialRelation
+
+noncomputable section
+
+open MvPolynomial WeightedInitial Obstruction
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- The original relation has no monomials above weight one. -/
+theorem H_bounded : Bounded presentationWeight (H k) 1 := by
+  unfold H
+  apply (bounded_of_homogeneous (Hstar_homogeneous k)).sub
+  have hu : (X 2 : P k 5).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 0 := by
+    simpa [presentationWeight] using isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (2 : Fin 5)
+  exact (bounded_of_homogeneous hu).mono (by omega)
+
+/-- The original relation has actual highest integer weight one. -/
+theorem H_isTopDegree [Nontrivial k] : IsTopDegree presentationWeight (H k) 1 := by
+  refine ⟨H_bounded k, ?_⟩
+  rw [H_degree_one_component k]
+  intro hzero
+  exact p_not_dvd_Hstar k (hzero ▸ dvd_zero _)
+
+/-- The leading weight of a product by the exact relation is obtained by
+multiplying the leading component by the exact polynomial `Hstar`. -/
+theorem component_mul_H (q : P k 5) (d : ℤ)
+    (hq : Bounded presentationWeight q d) :
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight (d + 1) (q * H k) =
+      weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d q * Hstar k := by
+  rw [component_mul_of_bounded hq (H_bounded k), H_degree_one_component k]
+
+variable [IsDomain k]
+
+/-- The principal initial-ideal identity for the exact source relation. -/
+theorem initialIdeal_idealA :
+    initialIdeal presentationWeight (idealA k) = idealG k := by
+  unfold idealA idealG
+  rw [initialIdeal_span_singleton (H_isTopDegree k), H_degree_one_component k]
+
+/-- A homogeneous polynomial has a lower-weight representative modulo `H`
+if and only if it belongs to `(Hstar)`. -/
+theorem homogeneous_lower_iff (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ)
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) :
+    (∃ r : P k 5, Bounded presentationWeight r (d - 1) ∧ p - r ∈ idealA k) ↔
+      p ∈ idealG k := by
+  simpa only [idealA, idealG, H_degree_one_component k] using
+    homogeneous_quotient_kernel_iff presentationWeight (H k) 1
+      (H_isTopDegree k).1 (H_isTopDegree k).2 hp
+
+/-- The same exact kernel criterion, stated directly in the two quotient rings.
+This is the degreewise algebraic interface used to identify `G` with `gr A`. -/
+theorem quotient_homogeneous_lower_iff (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ)
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) :
+    (∃ r : P k 5, Bounded presentationWeight r (d - 1) ∧
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealA k) p = Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealA k) r) ↔
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p = 0 := by
+  simpa only [Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using
+    homogeneous_lower_iff k p d hp
+
+end
+end StableCoordinate.PrincipalInitialRelation
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftUniqueness
+import Mathlib.Algebra.GCDMonoid.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Lifting a quadric point to a determinant-one frame over a GCD domain
+
+This is an algebraic substitute for the local trivialization step in the
+additive-action lift.  It constructs a frame, rather than assuming a line
+bundle is trivial.  After pullback to the factorial ring of the determinant-one
+quadric, it can be applied over that ring's polynomial extension.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization
+
+variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsGCDMonoid R]
+
+/-- Every point of `xy=z(z+1)` over a GCD domain with nonzero `x` admits a
+factorization by a determinant-one matrix.  No Bezout-domain assumption is used. -/
+theorem exists_frame_of_ne_zero (x y z : R) (hx : x ≠ 0)
+    (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
+    ∃ a d b c : R,
+      a * b = x ∧ d * b = z ∧ d * c = y ∧ a * c = z + 1 ∧
+        a * c - b * d = 1 := by
+  rcases (inferInstance : IsGCDMonoid R) with ⟨hGCD⟩
+  let := hGCD
+  obtain ⟨a, d, hxa, hzd, had⟩ := extract_gcd x z
+  let b := gcd x z
+  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
+    intro hb
+    exact hx (by simpa [b, hb] using hxa)
+  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
+    intro ha
+    exact hx (by simpa [ha] using hxa)
+  have hrel : IsRelPrime a d := gcd_isUnit_iff_isRelPrime.mp had
+  have hcancel : a * y = d * (z + 1) := by
+    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hb
+    calc
+      b * (a * y) = x * y := by rw [hxa]; simp [b, mul_assoc]
+      _ = z * (z + 1) := h
+      _ = b * (d * (z + 1)) := by rw [hzd]; simp [b, mul_assoc]

+  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hrel.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hadvd

+    apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha
+    calc
+      a * (d * c) = d * (a * c) := by ring
+      _ = d * (z + 1) := by rw [← hc]
+      _ = a * y := hcancel.symm
+  refine ⟨a, d, b, c, ?_, ?_, hy, hc.symm, ?_⟩
+  · simpa [b, mul_comm] using hxa.symm
+  · simpa [b, mul_comm] using hzd.symm
+  · rw [← hc, ← hzd]

+any nonvanishing assumption on the given quadric point. -/
+theorem exists_frame (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
+    ∃ a d b c : R,
+      a * b = x ∧ d * b = z ∧ d * c = y ∧ a * c = z + 1 ∧
+        a * c - b * d = 1 := by
+  by_cases hx : x = 0
+  · have hz : z = 0 ∨ z + 1 = 0 := mul_eq_zero.mp (by rw [← h, hx, zero_mul])
+    rcases hz with hz | hz
+    · refine ⟨1, y, 0, 1, ?_⟩

+
+/-- Existence in the canonical frame type used by the action-lift construction. -/
+theorem exists_frameAbove (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
+    ∃ F : FrameLift.Frame R,
+      F.a * F.b = x ∧ F.d * F.c = y ∧ F.d * F.b = z := by
+  obtain ⟨a, d, b, c, hx, hz, hy, _, hdet⟩ := exists_frame x y z h
+  exact ⟨⟨a, d, b, c, hdet⟩, hx, hy, hz⟩
+
+/-- A choice of determinant-one frame above a quadric point. -/
+def frameAbove (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) : FrameLift.Frame R :=
+  (exists_frameAbove x y z h).choose
+
+@[simp]
+theorem frameAbove_ab (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
+    (frameAbove x y z h).a * (frameAbove x y z h).b = x :=
+  (exists_frameAbove x y z h).choose_spec.1
+
+@[simp]
+theorem frameAbove_dc (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
+    (frameAbove x y z h).d * (frameAbove x y z h).c = y :=
+  (exists_frameAbove x y z h).choose_spec.2.1
+
+@[simp]
+theorem frameAbove_db (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
+    (frameAbove x y z h).d * (frameAbove x y z h).b = z :=
+  (exists_frameAbove x y z h).choose_spec.2.2
+
+end StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization
+
+end

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Transporting hypersurface coordinate rings
+
+The polynomial-presentation, stabilization, and fiber arguments use algebra
+equivalences of ambient rings.  This file records the induced equivalences of
+principal quotients, including their action on representatives.  In particular,
+transporting a distinguished element transports *all* of its fibers, without
+excluding the zero fiber.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+variable {k A B : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
+  [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
+
+/-- An ambient algebra equivalence carrying one equation to another induces an
+algebra equivalence of their hypersurface coordinate rings. -/
+def principalQuotientEquiv (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B) (hpq : e p = q) :
+    (A ⧸ Ideal.span {p}) ≃ₐ[k] (B ⧸ Ideal.span {q}) :=
+  Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ _ e (by
+    simp only [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
+    exact congrArg (fun b : B => Ideal.span {b}) hpq.symm)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem principalQuotientEquiv_mk (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B)
+    (hpq : e p = q) (a : A) :
+    principalQuotientEquiv e p q hpq (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (e a) := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem principalQuotientEquiv_symm_mk (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B)
+    (hpq : e p = q) (b : B) :
+    (principalQuotientEquiv e p q hpq).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (e.symm b) := rfl
+
+/-- The equivalence induced on the fiber over an arbitrary scalar `c`.  No
+nonzero hypothesis is needed: this is equally valid for the zero fiber. -/
+def fiberQuotientEquiv (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B)
+    (hpq : e p = q) (c : k) :
+    (A ⧸ Ideal.span {p - algebraMap k A c}) ≃ₐ[k]
+      (B ⧸ Ideal.span {q - algebraMap k B c}) :=
+  principalQuotientEquiv e _ _ (by simp only [map_sub, hpq, e.commutes])
+
+@[simp]
+theorem fiberQuotientEquiv_mk (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B)
+    (hpq : e p = q) (c : k) (a : A) :
+    fiberQuotientEquiv e p q hpq c (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (e a) := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem fiberQuotientEquiv_symm_mk (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B)
+    (hpq : e p = q) (c : k) (b : B) :
+    (fiberQuotientEquiv e p q hpq c).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (e.symm b) := rfl
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.Definitions
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.PrincipalIdeal
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.AffineNormalization
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# The coordinate obstruction and rectifiability of every fiber
+
+The ambient algebra automorphisms in this file are arbitrary complex algebra
+automorphisms.  In particular, there is no restriction to a chosen subgroup or
+triangular form.  The scalar-image characterization keeps the nonzero scalar
+which occurs when generators of two equal principal ideals are compared.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+/-- Rectifiability is equivalent to sending `f` to an affine-linear polynomial
+in the first coordinate, with nonzero linear coefficient. -/
+theorem rectifiableFiber_iff_affine_image (t : ℂ) :
+    IsRectifiableFiber t ↔
+      ∃ (φ : R 4 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 4) (c : ℂ), c ≠ 0 ∧
+        φ f = C c * X 0 + C t := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
+    obtain ⟨c, hc, heq⟩ := eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_map_span_singleton_eq
+      φ.toAlgHom (f := f - C t) (g := X 0) hφ
+    refine ⟨φ, c, hc, ?_⟩
+    have hC : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
+    change φ (f - C t) = C c * X 0 at heq
+    rw [map_sub, hC] at heq
+    exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mp heq
+  · rintro ⟨φ, c, hc, heq⟩
+    use φ
+    unfold fiberIdeal
+    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
+    change Ideal.span ({φ (f - C t)} : Set (R 4)) = Ideal.span {X 0}
+    apply span_singleton_eq_of_eq_nonzero_scalar_mul hc
+    change φ (f - C t) = C c * X 0
+    have hC : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
+    rw [map_sub, hC, heq, add_sub_cancel_right]
+
+/-- For every complex level, rectifiability of the defining hypersurface ideal
+is equivalent to the coordinate property of the original polynomial. -/
+theorem rectifiableFiber_iff_coordinate (t : ℂ) :
+    IsRectifiableFiber t ↔ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f := by
+  rw [rectifiableFiber_iff_affine_image]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨φ, c, hc, hφ⟩
+    exact exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine f 0 c t hc φ hφ
+  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
+    refine ⟨φ.trans (affineAll (σ := Fin 4) 1 t one_ne_zero), 1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
+    change affineAll (σ := Fin 4) 1 t one_ne_zero (φ f) = _
+    rw [hφ, affineAll_X]
+    rfl
+
+/-- The four-variable coordinate obstruction forbids rectification at every
+complex level, with no exclusion of zero or exceptional fibers. -/
+theorem noncoordinate_implies_all_fibers_nonrectifiable
+    (h : ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f) :
+    ∀ t : ℂ, ¬ IsRectifiableFiber t := by
+  intro t ht
+  exact h ((rectifiableFiber_iff_coordinate t).mp ht)
+
+/-- The all-fiber geometric package follows from actual coordinate-algebra
+isomorphisms and the four-variable coordinate obstruction. -/
+theorem fiberPackage_of_noncoordinate_of_affine
+    (h : ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f)
+    (hFibers : ∀ t : ℂ, IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) : FiberPackage := by
+  intro t
+  exact ⟨hFibers t, noncoordinate_implies_all_fibers_nonrectifiable h t⟩
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Coefficientwise vanishing in an associated graded algebra
+
+The principal Rees ideal `(T)` consists precisely of Laurent polynomials whose
+coefficient in degree `d` belongs to `F (d-1)`.  This gives an actual
+coefficientwise kernel test for the Rees model, including negative degrees.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+open AddMonoidAlgebra
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+variable (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F]
+
+/-- The complete defining-ideal membership criterion for the Rees special fiber. -/
+theorem mem_parameterIdeal_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
+    p ∈ parameterIdeal F hmono ↔
+      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈ F (d - 1) := by
+  rw [parameterIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ d
+    have he := congrArg (fun p : rees F => (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d) hq
+    have hae : (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+        (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff (d - 1) := by
+      change (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * (q : LaurentPolynomial A)).coeff d at he
+      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply] at he
+      simpa only [one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using he
+    rw [hae]
+    exact q.property (d - 1)
+  · intro hp
+    let q : rees F := ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A), by
+      intro d
+      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul]
+      have hd := hp (1 + d)
+      simpa only [neg_neg, show (1 : ℤ) + d - 1 = d by omega] using hd⟩
+    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    change (p : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 *
+      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A))
+    rw [← mul_assoc, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
+    simp only [add_neg_cancel, mul_one, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, one_mul]
+
+/-- A Rees representative vanishes in the associated graded algebra iff each
+coefficient has dropped one filtration step. -/
+theorem quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p = 0 ↔
+      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈ F (d - 1) := by
+  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_parameterIdeal_iff]
+
+/-- Two arbitrary Rees representatives determine the same graded element iff
+their coefficientwise difference lies one step lower. -/
+theorem quotient_mk_eq_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (p q : rees F) :
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p =
+        Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) q ↔
+      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d - (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈
+        F (d - 1) := by
+  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff]
+  rfl
+
+end StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Coefficientwise kernel and homogeneous independence for the Rees model
+
+The kernel of the Rees specialization is detected one coefficient at a time.
+This supplies the directness of homogeneous components without assuming an
+associated-graded decomposition as an extra interface.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+open AddMonoidAlgebra
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+variable (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F]
+
+/-- An arbitrary Rees element vanishes after specialization by `T` exactly when
+each coefficient belongs to the previous filtration step. -/
+theorem mk_eq_zero_iff_coeff (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p = 0 ↔
+      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈ F (d - 1) := by
+  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, parameterIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ d
+    have he := congrArg (fun r : rees F => (r : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d) hq
+    change (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * (q : LaurentPolynomial A)).coeff d at he
+    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply] at he
+    have he' : (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+        (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff (d - 1) := by
+      simpa only [one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using he
+    rw [he']
+    exact q.property (d - 1)
+  · intro hp
+    let q : rees F := ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A), by
+      intro d
+      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul]
+      have hd := hp (1 + d)
+      simpa using hd⟩
+    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    change (p : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 *
+      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A))
+    rw [← mul_assoc, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
+    simp
+
+/-- A finite sum of distinct homogeneous initial forms vanishes if and only if
+all of those initial forms vanish, expressed by lower-filtration membership. -/
+theorem sum_initial_eq_zero_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (s : Finset ℤ)
+    (a : (d : ℤ) → F d) :
+    (∑ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d)) = 0 ↔
+      ∀ d ∈ s, (a d : A) ∈ F (d - 1) := by
+  classical
+  have hcoeff (d : ℤ) :
+      ((∑ i ∈ s, homogeneous F i (a i) : rees F) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
+        if d ∈ s then (a d : A) else 0 := by
+    change ((rees F).val (∑ i ∈ s, homogeneous F i (a i))).coeff d = _
+    rw [map_sum]
+    change (∑ i ∈ s, AddMonoidAlgebra.single i (a i : A) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d = _
+    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
+    exact Finset.sum_ite_eq' s d (fun i => (a i : A))
+  have hmk : (∑ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d)) =
+      Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) (∑ d ∈ s, homogeneous F d (a d)) := by
+    simp only [map_sum, initial]
+  rw [hmk, mk_eq_zero_iff_coeff]
+  constructor
+  · intro h d hd
+    have h' := h d
+    simpa only [hcoeff, ite_eq_left hd] using h'
+  · intro h d
+    rw [hcoeff]
+    split_ifs with hd
+    · exact h d hd
+    · exact (F (d - 1)).zero_mem
+
+/-- The homogeneous pieces are linearly independent in the actual Rees quotient. -/
+theorem sum_initial_eq_zero_iff_individual (hmono : Monotone F) (s : Finset ℤ)
+    (a : (d : ℤ) → F d) :
+    (∑ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d)) = 0 ↔
+      ∀ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d) = 0 := by
+  simp only [sum_initial_eq_zero_iff, initial_eq_zero_iff]
+
+end StableCoordinate.FilteredRees
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.GradedDegeneration
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.CoordinateLeadingDerivation
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.FactorialClosure
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Homogeneous transport from the actual Rees algebra to the degeneration
+
+The concrete presentation equivalence preserves every integer degree in both
+directions.  This is proved from homogeneous polynomial representatives and
+the exact lower-step criterion for initial forms.  Consequently actual leading
+derivations, including their nonzero positive-degree invariants, transport to
+the canonical degeneration ring without any additional grading assumptions.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration
+
+open MvPolynomial Obstruction Filtration FilteredRees
+open GradedPresentationMap AssociatedGradedPresentation WeightedInitial
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Homogeneous source polynomials belong to their exact filtration piece. -/
+theorem homogeneous_mem_piece {p : P k 5} {d : ℤ}
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) : p ∈ piece k d := by
+  rw [piece_eq_boundedSubmodule]
+  exact fun m hm => (hp hm).le
+
+/-- Removing the degree-`d` part of a bounded source polynomial lowers its
+filtration index by one, even if `d` is negative. -/
+theorem sub_top_mem_piece {p : P k 5} {d : ℤ} (hp : p ∈ piece k d) :
+    p - weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d p ∈ piece k (d - 1) := by
+  rw [piece_eq_boundedSubmodule] at hp ⊢
+  exact bounded_sub_top hp
+
+/-- The homogeneous component's symbol is exactly the symbol of any bounded
+representative in the same degree. -/
+theorem sourceInitial_eq_gradedMap_component
+    (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (d : ℤ) (p : piece k d) :
+    sourceInitial φ d p =
+      gradedMap φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d (p : P k 5)) := by
+  let q := weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d (p : P k 5)
+  have hqhom : q.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d :=
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous d (p : P k 5)
+  have hq : q ∈ piece k d := homogeneous_mem_piece hqhom
+  have hsub : (p : P k 5) - q ∈ piece k (d - 1) := sub_top_mem_piece p.property
+  have hinit : sourceInitial φ d p = sourceInitial φ d ⟨q, hq⟩ := by
+    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
+    rw [← map_sub (sourceInitial φ d)]
+    rw [sourceInitial_apply, initial_eq_zero_iff]
+    exact ⟨(p : P k 5) - q, hsub, rfl⟩
+  rw [hinit, sourceInitial_apply]
+  symm
+  apply gradedMap_of_homogeneous
+  intro m hm
+  rw [AssociatedGradedPresentation.monomialWeight_eq_weight]
+  exact hqhom (mem_support_iff.mp hm)
+
+/-- Every initial form has a homogeneous polynomial representative in exactly
+the same integer degree. -/
+theorem initial_has_homogeneous_representative
+    (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (d : ℤ) (a : imagePiece φ d) :
+    ∃ p : P k 5, p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d ∧
+      gradedMap φ p = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d a := by
+  rcases a with ⟨a, p, hp, rfl⟩
+  refine ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d p,
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous d p, ?_⟩
+  exact (sourceInitial_eq_gradedMap_component φ d ⟨p, hp⟩).symm
+
+variable (k) [IsDomain k]
+
+/-- The concrete quotient equivalence preserves a homogeneous piece in both
+directions; its image is precisely the set of degree-`d` initial forms. -/
+theorem mem_gPiece_iff (d : ℤ) (g : G k) :
+    g ∈ gPiece k d ↔ ∃ a : imagePiece (quotientMap k) d,
+      associatedGradedEquiv k g =
+        initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k)) d a := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
+    have hp' : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d := hp
+    refine ⟨⟨quotientMap k p, p, homogeneous_mem_piece hp', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
+    change associatedGradedEquiv k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) = _
+    rw [associatedGradedEquiv_mk]
+    apply gradedMap_of_homogeneous
+    intro m hm
+    rw [AssociatedGradedPresentation.monomialWeight_eq_weight]
+    exact hp' (mem_support_iff.mp hm)
+  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
+    obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := initial_has_homogeneous_representative (quotientMap k) d a
+    have hg : g = Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p := by
+      apply (associatedGradedEquiv k).injective

+  rw [associatedGradedEquiv_gX]
+  unfold initial
+  congr 1
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  simp [homogeneous, monomialWeight, variableElement]

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Coefficients of derivations on the determinant-one hypersurface
+
+This file formalizes the coefficient step of §5, equation `rig:q`, from the
+supplied manuscript.  No local nilpotence or domain hypothesis is needed for
+this purely algebraic step.  The nonzero criterion uses the stated generation
+hypothesis rather than silently assuming the five displayed elements generate.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+section DeterminantIdentities
+
+variable {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
+
+/-- The first coefficient identity follows from the determinant-one relation. -/
+theorem determinant_coefficient_left (a d b c B C : A)
+    (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1) (hcompat : a * C = d * B) :
+    B = a * (c * B - b * C) := by
+  symm
+  calc
+    a * (c * B - b * C) = (a * c - b * d) * B + b * (d * B - a * C) := by ring
+    _ = B := by rw [hdet, hcompat]; ring
+
+/-- The second coefficient identity follows from the same relation. -/
+theorem determinant_coefficient_right (a d b c B C : A)
+    (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1) (hcompat : a * C = d * B) :
+    C = d * (c * B - b * C) := by
+  symm
+  calc
+    d * (c * B - b * C) = (a * c - b * d) * C + c * (d * B - a * C) := by ring
+    _ = C := by rw [hdet, hcompat]; ring
+
+/-- The coefficient is unique, without cancellation or nonzero hypotheses. -/
+theorem determinant_coefficient_unique (a d b c B C q : A)
+    (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1) (hB : B = a * q) (hC : C = d * q) :
+    q = c * B - b * C := by
+  rw [hB, hC]
+  calc
+    q = (a * c - b * d) * q := by rw [hdet, one_mul]
+    _ = c * (a * q) - b * (d * q) := by ring
+
+end DeterminantIdentities
+
+section Derivations
+
+variable {k A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+
+/-- Differentiating `ac - bd = 1`, when `a,d` are invariant. -/
+theorem derivation_determinant_compatibility (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (a d b c : A) (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1)
+    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) :
+    a * D c = d * D b := by
+  have h := congrArg D hdet
+  simpa only [map_sub, Derivation.leibniz, ha, hd, smul_eq_mul,
+    mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] using h
+
+/-- The source coefficient `q = c D(b) - b D(c)`. -/
+def rigidityCoefficient (D : Derivation k A A) (b c : A) : A :=
+  c * D b - b * D c
+
+/-- The two identities in source equation `rig:q` in arbitrary commutative algebras. -/
+theorem derivation_rigidityCoefficient (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (a d b c : A) (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1)
+    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) :
+    D b = a * rigidityCoefficient D b c ∧ D c = d * rigidityCoefficient D b c := by
+  have hcompat := derivation_determinant_compatibility D a d b c hdet ha hd
+  exact ⟨determinant_coefficient_left a d b c (D b) (D c) hdet hcompat,
+    determinant_coefficient_right a d b c (D b) (D c) hdet hcompat⟩
+
+/-- A derivation of the algebra generated by `a,d,b,c,u` vanishes once these
+five generators are invariant. -/
+theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_five_generators (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (a d b c u : A) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin k {a, d, b, c, u} = ⊤)
+    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) (hb : D b = 0) (hc : D c = 0)
+    (hu : D u = 0) : D = 0 := by
+  apply Derivation.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top {a, d, b, c, u} hgen
+  intro x hx
+  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
+  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
+    simp only [ha, hd, hb, hc, hu, Derivation.zero_apply]
+
+/-- Under the exact generation condition used in §5, the source coefficient
+is nonzero whenever the derivation is nonzero. -/
+theorem rigidityCoefficient_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A A)
+    (a d b c u : A) (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1)
+    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin k {a, d, b, c, u} = ⊤)
+    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) (hu : D u = 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
+    rigidityCoefficient D b c ≠ 0 := by
+  intro hq
+  obtain ⟨hb, hc⟩ := derivation_rigidityCoefficient D a d b c hdet ha hd
+  rw [hq, mul_zero] at hb hc
+  exact hD (derivation_eq_zero_of_five_generators D a d b c u hgen ha hd hb hc hu)
+
+end Derivations
+
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+

+def presentation : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A k := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (idealA k)

+def testPoint (t : k) : Fin 5 → k := ![0, 0, 0, t, 0]

+  simp [H, Hstar, xP, testPoint]

+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (idealA k) (aeval (testPoint k t)) (by
+    change idealA k ≤ RingHom.ker (aeval (testPoint k t)).toRingHom
+    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
+    intro q hq
+    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq with rfl
+    exact aeval_H_testPoint k t)

+  classical
+  rw [aeval_monomial, aeval_monomial]
+  congr 1

+variable {k : Type*} [Field k]

+/-- The final source-specific Laurent descent step.  A nonzero homogeneous
+locally nilpotent derivation of the actual degeneration ring, fixing the
+parameter and a nonzero positive-degree element, produces the nonzero
+quadric derivation and center-ideal invariant required in the obstruction. -/
+theorem exists_quadric_lnd_invariant
+    (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)) (m : ℤ)
+    (hshift : ∀ (n : ℤ) (r : G k), r ∈ gPiece k n → D r ∈ gPiece k (n + m))
