+/-!
+# Homogeneity through the source's actual Laurent presentation
+
+The integer grading on `G` is the quotient grading with generator weights
+`(-1,0,0,1,1)`.  The canonical map into the Laurent algebra over the quadric
+ring sends degree `n` to the single Laurent exponent `-n`.  In particular,
+a homogeneous derivation of degree `m`, when intertwined with a derivation
+on that Laurent algebra, satisfies the precise homogeneity hypothesis of
+`LaurentDescent` with exponent `-m`.

+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation
+
+open MvPolynomial LaurentPolynomial
+open StableCoordinate.Obstruction
+open scoped LaurentPolynomial
+
+variable (k : Type*) [CommRing k]
+
+/-- The coefficient part of the five canonical Laurent generator images. -/
+def generatorCoefficients : Fin 5 → B k :=
+  ![1, sB k, bX k 3, f0 k, g0 k]
+
+/-- The canonical generator images have exactly the assigned integer weights. -/
+theorem toLaurentBase_generator (i : Fin 5) :
+    LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (gX k i) =
+      LaurentPolynomial.C (generatorCoefficients k i) *
+        LaurentPolynomial.T (-presentationWeight i) := by
+  fin_cases i <;>
+    simp [LaurentPresentation.laurentValues, generatorCoefficients, presentationWeight]
+
+/-- A homogeneous representative maps to its expected Laurent monomial. -/
+theorem toLaurentBase_mk_homogeneous {p : P k 5} {n : ℤ}
+    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight n) :
+    LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) =
+      LaurentPolynomial.C (aeval (generatorCoefficients k) p) *
+        LaurentPolynomial.T (-n) := by
+  exact LaurentWeightedMap.map_homogeneous presentationWeight (generatorCoefficients k)
+    ((LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (idealG k)))
+    (fun i => toLaurentBase_generator k i) hp
+
+/-- The image of every homogeneous element has support at one Laurent exponent. -/
+theorem toLaurentBase_coeff_eq_zero {r : G k} {n : ℤ}
+    (hr : r ∈ gPiece k n) (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ -n) :
+    (LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k r).coeff j = 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hr
+  change (LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p)).coeff j = 0
+  rw [toLaurentBase_mk_homogeneous k hp, LaurentDescent.coeff_C_mul_T,
+    ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hj)]
+
+/-- The singleton-support statement in the exact normalization used by descent. -/
+theorem toLaurentBase_homogeneous {r : G k} {n : ℤ}
+    (hr : r ∈ gPiece k n) :
+    LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k r =
+      LaurentPolynomial.C ((LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k r).coeff (-n)) *
+        LaurentPolynomial.T (-n) := by
+  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hr
+  change LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) =
+    LaurentPolynomial.C
+      ((LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p)).coeff (-n)) *
+      LaurentPolynomial.T (-n)
+  rw [toLaurentBase_mk_homogeneous k hp, LaurentDescent.coeff_C_mul_T, ite_eq_left rfl]
+

+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext

+  simp only [LaurentPresentation.baseMap_bX, baseToDegeneration_bX]
+  rfl

+/-- The existing Laurent-presentation base map has degree-zero image. -/
+theorem baseMap_mem_piece (b : B k) :
+    LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
+  rw [baseMap_eq_baseToDegeneration]
+  exact baseToDegeneration_mem_piece k b

+/-- Actual homogeneous-degree transport gives the hypothesis of Laurent descent.

+-/
+theorem homogeneousOnConstants_of_intertwining
+    (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k))
+    (δ : Derivation k (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k) (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k))
+    (m : ℤ)
+    (hD : ∀ (n : ℤ) (r : G k), r ∈ gPiece k n → D r ∈ gPiece k (n + m))
+    (hintertwine : ∀ r : G k,
+      δ (LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k r) = LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (D r)) :
+    LaurentDescent.HomogeneousOnConstants δ (-m) := by
+  intro b
+  have hDb : D (LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b) ∈ gPiece k m := by
+    simpa using hD 0 (LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b) (baseMap_mem_piece k b)
+  have hcompat := hintertwine (LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b)
+  rw [LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_baseMap] at hcompat
+  rw [hcompat]

+end StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+/-!
+# The added variable is a genuine polynomial indeterminate
+
+The target encodes `R[w]` as a polynomial algebra on five independent
+variables. Here that encoding is identified with the literal univariate
+polynomial ring over `R 4`, fixing all original variables. Conjugating
+algebra automorphisms through this equivalence shows that the target's
+stabilization criterion is exactly the one in the source, with no
+condition that the automorphism preserve the coefficient subring.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+/-- The last of five independent variables becomes the new indeterminate;
+the first four become coefficient variables. -/
+noncomputable def stabilizationEquiv : R 5 ≃ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (R 4) :=
+  (renameEquiv ℂ (finSuccEquivLast : Fin 5 ≃ Option (Fin 4))).trans
+    (optionEquivLeft ℂ (Fin 4))
+
+@[simp]
+theorem stabilizationEquiv_X_castSucc (i : Fin 4) :
+    stabilizationEquiv (X i.castSucc) = Polynomial.C (X i) := by
+  simp [stabilizationEquiv, renameEquiv_apply]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem stabilizationEquiv_X_last :
+    stabilizationEquiv (X 4) = Polynomial.X := by
+  have h : (finSuccEquivLast : Fin 5 ≃ Option (Fin 4)) (4 : Fin 5) = none :=
+    finSuccEquivLast_last
+  simp [stabilizationEquiv, renameEquiv_apply, h]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem stabilizationEquiv_stabilize (g : R 4) :
+    stabilizationEquiv (stabilize g) = Polynomial.C g := by
+  have h : stabilizationEquiv.toAlgHom.comp stabilize =
+      (Polynomial.CAlgHom : R 4 →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (R 4)) := by
+    ext i
+    simp [stabilize]
+  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h g
+
+@[simp]
+theorem stabilizationEquiv_symm_C (g : R 4) :
+    stabilizationEquiv.symm (Polynomial.C g) = stabilize g := by
+  apply stabilizationEquiv.injective
+  simp
+
+/-- Adjoining the variable does not identify distinct original polynomials. -/
+theorem stabilize_injective : Function.Injective stabilize := by
+  intro g h hgh
+  apply Polynomial.C_injective
+  simpa using congrArg stabilizationEquiv hgh
+
+/-- The added variable is not already in the original four-variable subring. -/
+theorem last_variable_not_mem_stabilize_range :
+    (X 4 : R 5) ∉ Set.range stabilize := by
+  rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
+  have h := congrArg stabilizationEquiv hg
+  simp only [stabilizationEquiv_stabilize, stabilizationEquiv_X_last] at h
+  exact Polynomial.X_ne_C g h.symm

+    IsOneStableCoordinate g ↔
+      ∃ φ : Polynomial (R 4) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (R 4),

+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
+    refine ⟨stabilizationEquiv.symm.trans (φ.trans stabilizationEquiv), ?_⟩
+    change stabilizationEquiv (φ (stabilizationEquiv.symm (Polynomial.C g))) = _
+    rw [stabilizationEquiv_symm_C, hφ]

+    refine ⟨stabilizationEquiv.trans (φ.trans stabilizationEquiv.symm), ?_⟩

+    rw [stabilizationEquiv_stabilize, hφ, stabilizationEquiv_symm_C]
+    simp [stabilize]

+import Mathlib
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Eliminating the last linear relation in the stabilization
+
+The variables of the six-variable ring are ordered `p,s,u,L,N,w`.
+The quotient by `L-u+p*w` is the polynomial algebra on `p,s,u,N,w`.
+This file gives an actual algebra equivalence, including its effect on `p`.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+abbrev P := MvPolynomial (Fin 6) ℂ
+abbrev S := MvPolynomial (Fin 5) ℂ
+
+def equation : P := X 3 - X 2 + X 0 * X 5
+
+def equationIdeal : Ideal P := Ideal.span ({equation} : Set P)
+
+abbrev A := P ⧸ equationIdeal
+
+def evaluate : P →ₐ[ℂ] S :=
+  aeval ![X 0, X 1, X 2, X 2 - X 0 * X 4, X 3, X 4]
+
+@[simp] theorem evaluate_equation : evaluate equation = 0 := by
+  simp [evaluate, equation]
+
+def out : A →ₐ[ℂ] S :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ equationIdeal evaluate (by
+    intro r hr
+    have hi : equationIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker evaluate.toRingHom := by
+      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
+      intro t ht
+      rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ht with rfl
+      exact evaluate_equation
+    exact hi hr)
+
+def into : S →ₐ[ℂ] A :=
+  aeval ![Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ equationIdeal (X 0),
+    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ equationIdeal (X 1),
+    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ equationIdeal (X 2),
+    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ equationIdeal (X 4),
+    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ equationIdeal (X 5)]
+
+@[simp] theorem out_mk (r : P) : out (Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal r) = evaluate r := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem quotient_equation : Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ equationIdeal equation = 0 := by
+  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton equation))
+
+theorem out_comp_into : out.comp into = AlgHom.id ℂ S := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [into, evaluate]
+
+theorem into_comp_out : into.comp out = AlgHom.id ℂ A := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [evaluate, into]
+  have h := quotient_equation
+  simp only [equation, map_add, map_sub, map_mul] at h
+  change Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 3) -
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 2) +
+    Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 0) * Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 5) = 0 at h
+  linear_combination -h
+
+/-- The quotient by `L-u+p*w` is the five-variable polynomial algebra. -/
+def equiv : A ≃ₐ[ℂ] S :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom out into out_comp_into into_comp_out
+
+@[simp] theorem equiv_mk (r : P) : equiv (Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal r) = evaluate r := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem equiv_p : equiv (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ equationIdeal (X 0)) = X 0 := by
+  simp [evaluate]
+
+end StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+/-- A polynomial unit over a reduced ring is the constant polynomial given by
+any specialization of its parameters.  In particular this applies to an

+theorem polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : IsUnit p)

+  obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp hp
+  simp

+/-- Polynomial units do not depend on the value of the polynomial parameters. -/
+theorem polynomial_unit_eval_independent {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : IsUnit p)

+  obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp hp

+  rw [polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval hp x, polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval hq x, h]

+theorem polynomial_unit_eq_one_of_eval_eq_one {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
+    (hp : IsUnit p) (x : σ → R) (h : eval x p = 1) : p = 1 := by
+  rw [polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval hp x, h, map_one]

+    simp

+theorem normalized_two_parameter_unit_eq_one

+    (hzero : eval (fun _ => 0) c = 1) : c = 1 :=
+  polynomial_unit_eq_one_of_eval_eq_one hc (fun _ => 0) hzero
+
+end PolynomialUnits
+
+end StableCoordinate

+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Derivation
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Degree.Domain
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Locally nilpotent derivations in one polynomial variable
+
+This file supplies the one-variable derivation step in the proof of
+Proposition `prop:rigidity`, §5 of the source manuscript. Over an integral domain of
+characteristic zero, a locally nilpotent derivation of `K[X]` maps `X` to
+a constant. Local nilpotence is stated explicitly as the vanishing of a
+sufficiently high iterate on every polynomial.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace UnivariateLND
+
+open Polynomial
+
+variable {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [CharZero K]
+
+omit [IsDomain K] [CharZero K] in
+/-- A derivation of a univariate polynomial algebra is multiplication of
+the ordinary derivative by its value on the indeterminate. -/
+theorem apply_eq_derivative_mul (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X]) (p : K[X]) :
+    D p = p.derivative * D X := by
+  simpa using D.map_aeval p (X : K[X])
+
+/-- If the value on `X` has positive degree, a derivation preserves
+positive degree. This excludes nilpotence on `X`. -/
+theorem natDegree_apply_pos (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
+    (hD : 0 < (D X).natDegree) {p : K[X]} (hp : 0 < p.natDegree) :
+    0 < (D p).natDegree := by
+  have hp' : p.derivative ≠ 0 := derivative_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hp)
+  have hD' : D X ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    simp [h] at hD
+  rw [apply_eq_derivative_mul, natDegree_mul hp' hD', natDegree_derivative]
+  omega
+
+/-- Every iterate on `X` retains positive degree if the value on `X`
+has positive degree. -/
+theorem natDegree_iterate_X_pos (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
+    (hD : 0 < (D X).natDegree) (n : ℕ) :
+    0 < (((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) X).natDegree := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+    exact natDegree_apply_pos D hD ih
+
+/-- Vanishing of one iterate on the indeterminate already forces a
+univariate derivation's value on the indeterminate to have degree zero. -/
+theorem natDegree_apply_X_eq_zero_of_iterate_eq_zero
+    (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
+    (hD : ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) X = 0) :
+    (D X).natDegree = 0 := by
+  by_contra h
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD
+  have hp := natDegree_iterate_X_pos D (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) n
+  simp [hn] at hp
+
+/-- The needed rigidity fact: every locally nilpotent derivation of a
+one-variable polynomial algebra over a characteristic-zero domain sends
+the variable to a constant in the coefficient field. -/
+theorem apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
+    (hD : ∀ p : K[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) p = 0) :
+    D X = C ((D X).coeff 0) := by
+  exact eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero
+    (natDegree_apply_X_eq_zero_of_iterate_eq_zero D (hD X))
+
+/-- Existential form matching the source's statement `D(X) ∈ K`. -/
+theorem exists_apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
+    (hD : ∀ p : K[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) p = 0) :
+    ∃ c : K, D X = C c :=
+  ⟨(D X).coeff 0, apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent D hD⟩
+
+end UnivariateLND
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ChartLNDConstant
+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.DeterminantIntersection

+import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
+

+
+/-!
+# Vertical locally nilpotent derivations of the determinant ring
+
+The vertical-coefficient step is the assertion in Section 5 that a locally
+nilpotent derivation fixing `a,d,u` has coefficient in `k[a,d,u]`.  The
+coefficient is the actual element `c * D b - b * D c` of the determinant-one
+quotient, not an assumed polynomial representative.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.VerticalLND
+
+open DeterminantRing
+
+variable {k : Type*} [CommRing k]
+
+/-- Fixing the three displayed variables means fixing the entire polynomial
+coefficient subalgebra; no algebraic-independence assumption is inserted. -/
+theorem annihilates_baseMap (D : Derivation k (DeterminantRing.C k) (DeterminantRing.C k))
+    (ha : D (a k) = 0) (hd : D (d k) = 0) (hu : D (u k) = 0) :
+    ∀ p : Base k, D (baseMap p) = 0 := by
+  apply DerivationScalarUpgrade.annihilates_mvPolynomial D baseMap
+  intro i
+  fin_cases i
+  · simpa using ha
+  · simpa using hd
+  · simpa using hu
+
+/-- The source's common coefficient in the two remaining generator values. -/
+def coefficient (D : Derivation k (DeterminantRing.C k) (DeterminantRing.C k)) :
+    DeterminantRing.C k := rigidityCoefficient D (b k) (c k)
+
+/-- The coefficient formulas hold in the exact determinant quotient. -/
+theorem coefficient_equations
+    (D : Derivation k (DeterminantRing.C k) (DeterminantRing.C k))
+    (ha : D (a k) = 0) (hd : D (d k) = 0) :
+    D (b k) = a k * coefficient D ∧ D (c k) = d k * coefficient D :=
+  derivation_rigidityCoefficient D (a k) (d k) (b k) (c k)
+    (determinant_relation k) ha hd
+
+
+
+section CharacteristicZero
+
+variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
+
+/-- The source coefficient is constant on the actual `a`-chart. -/
+theorem coefficient_chartA_eq_C
+    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
+    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
+      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
+    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
+    chartMapA K (coefficient D) =
+      Polynomial.C ((chartMapA K (coefficient D)).coeff 0) := by
+  let : IsDomain (BaseAway K 0) :=
+    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (BaseAway K 0) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := K) (0 : Fin 3))
+  let : CharZero (BaseAway K 0) :=
+    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K (BaseAway K 0)).injective
+  let : IsLocalization.Away (baseMap (MvPolynomial.X 0 : Base K)) (AwayA K) := by
+    rw [baseMap_X0]
+    infer_instance
+  have h := ChartLNDConstant.chart_coefficient_eq_C
+    (baseMap (k := K)) (MvPolynomial.X 0) D hD
+    (annihilates_baseMap D ha hd hu) (chartEquivA K)
+    (fun r => by
+      change toChartA K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (baseMap r)) = _
+      simp only [toChartA_algebraMap, chartMapA_baseMap])
+    (b K) (coefficient D)
+    (by
+      change toChartA K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (b K)) = _
+      simp only [toChartA_algebraMap, chartMapA_b])
+    (by simpa only [baseMap_X0] using (coefficient_equations D ha hd).1)
+  change toChartA K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (coefficient D)) =
+    Polynomial.C ((toChartA K
+      (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (coefficient D))).coeff 0) at h
+  simpa only [toChartA_algebraMap] using h
+
+/-- The same source coefficient is constant on the actual `d`-chart. -/
+theorem coefficient_chartD_eq_C
+    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
+    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
+      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
+    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
+    chartMapD K (coefficient D) =
+      Polynomial.C ((chartMapD K (coefficient D)).coeff 0) := by
+  let : IsDomain (BaseAway K 1) :=
+    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (BaseAway K 1) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := K) (1 : Fin 3))
+  let : CharZero (BaseAway K 1) :=
+    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K (BaseAway K 1)).injective
+  let : IsLocalization.Away (baseMap (MvPolynomial.X 1 : Base K)) (AwayD K) := by
+    rw [baseMap_X1]
+    infer_instance
+  have h := ChartLNDConstant.chart_coefficient_eq_C
+    (baseMap (k := K)) (MvPolynomial.X 1) D hD
+    (annihilates_baseMap D ha hd hu) (chartEquivD K)
+    (fun r => by
+      change toChartD K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (baseMap r)) = _
+      simp only [toChartD_algebraMap, chartMapD_baseMap])
+    (c K) (coefficient D)
+    (by
+      change toChartD K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (c K)) = _
+      simp only [toChartD_algebraMap, chartMapD_c])
+    (by simpa only [baseMap_X1] using (coefficient_equations D ha hd).2)
+  change toChartD K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (coefficient D)) =
+    Polynomial.C ((toChartD K
+      (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (coefficient D))).coeff 0) at h
+  simpa only [toChartD_algebraMap] using h
+
+/-- Every vertical LND on the exact determinant hypersurface has a
+polynomial coefficient in the three independent variables `a,d,u`. -/
+theorem exists_polynomial_coefficient
+    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
+    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
+      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
+    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
+    ∃ r : Base K, baseMap r = coefficient D :=
+  exists_base_of_constant_charts K (coefficient_chartA_eq_C D hD ha hd hu)
+    (coefficient_chartD_eq_C D hD ha hd hu)
+
+/-- Subalgebra-membership form of the polynomial-coefficient result. -/
+theorem coefficient_mem_baseRange
+    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
+    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
+      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
+    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
+    coefficient D ∈ (baseMap (k := K)).range :=
+  exists_polynomial_coefficient D hD ha hd hu
+
+/-- Exact generator-value classification of vertical locally nilpotent
+derivations; the polynomial representative is constructed, not assumed. -/
+theorem classification
+    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
+    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
+      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
+    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
+    ∃ r : Base K, D (b K) = a K * baseMap r ∧ D (c K) = d K * baseMap r := by
+  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_polynomial_coefficient D hD ha hd hu
+  exact ⟨r, by rw [hr]; exact (coefficient_equations D ha hd).1,
+    by rw [hr]; exact (coefficient_equations D ha hd).2⟩
+
+end CharacteristicZero
+
+end StableCoordinate.VerticalLND
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.WeightedHomogeneous
+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Highest components for integer-weighted polynomials
+
+The weights may be negative. These lemmas give the top-product identity needed
+in §3 for the initial ideal of a principal hypersurface relation.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace WeightedInitial
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {σ K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]
+
+/-- Every monomial appearing in `p` has integer weight at most `d`. -/
+def Bounded (w : σ → ℤ) (p : MvPolynomial σ K) (d : ℤ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, p.coeff m ≠ 0 → Finsupp.weight w m ≤ d
+
+lemma bounded_zero (w : σ → ℤ) (d : ℤ) : Bounded w (0 : MvPolynomial σ K) d := by
+  intro m hm
+  simp at hm
+
+lemma Bounded.mono {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
+    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hde : d ≤ e) : Bounded w p e :=
+  fun m hm => (hp m hm).trans hde
+
+lemma Bounded.add {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ}
+    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q d) : Bounded w (p + q) d := by
+  intro m hm
+  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add] at hm
+  by_cases hpm : p.coeff m = 0
+  · exact hq m (by simpa [hpm] using hm)
+  · exact hp m hpm
+
+lemma Bounded.mul {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
+    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q e) : Bounded w (p * q) (d + e) := by
+  classical
+  intro m hm
+  rw [coeff_mul] at hm
+  obtain ⟨⟨a,b⟩, hab, hterm⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hm
+  have ha : p.coeff a ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hterm
+  have hb : q.coeff b ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hterm
+  have hab' : a + b = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hab
+  rw [← hab', map_add]
+  exact add_le_add (hp a ha) (hq b hb)
+
+/-- Coefficientwise boundedness is exactly the upper bound on weighted total degree. -/
+theorem bounded_iff_degree_le {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ} :
+    Bounded w p d ↔ weightedTotalDegree' w p ≤ (d : WithBot ℤ) := by
+  simp only [Bounded, weightedTotalDegree', Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_support_iff,
+    WithBot.coe_le_coe]
+
+/-- The bounded polynomials form the usual weighted filtration submodule. -/
+def boundedSubmodule (w : σ → ℤ) (d : ℤ) : Submodule K (MvPolynomial σ K) where
+  carrier := {p | Bounded w p d}
+  zero_mem' := bounded_zero w d
+  add_mem' := fun hp hq => hp.add hq
+  smul_mem' := by
+    intro c p hp m hm
+    rw [coeff_smul] at hm
+    exact hp m (right_ne_zero_of_mul hm)
+
+/-- A monomial has the expected weight bound, with arbitrary coefficient. -/
+lemma bounded_monomial (w : σ → ℤ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : K) {d : ℤ}
+    (hm : Finsupp.weight w m ≤ d) : Bounded w (monomial m c) d := by
+  intro a ha
+  have hw := isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial w m c rfl ha
+  exact hw.le.trans hm
+
+/-- The coefficientwise filtration agrees with the span-of-monomials definition. -/
+theorem boundedSubmodule_eq_span (w : σ → ℤ) (d : ℤ) :
+    boundedSubmodule (K := K) w d = Submodule.span K
+      {p | ∃ m : σ →₀ ℕ, Finsupp.weight w m ≤ d ∧ p = monomial m (1 : K)} := by
+  classical
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · intro p hp
+    change Bounded w p d at hp
+    rw [p.as_sum]
+    apply Submodule.sum_mem
+    intro m hm
+    have hsingle : monomial m (1 : K) ∈ Submodule.span K
+        {p | ∃ m : σ →₀ ℕ, Finsupp.weight w m ≤ d ∧ p = monomial m (1 : K)} :=
+      Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, hp m (mem_support_iff.mp hm), rfl⟩
+    simpa only [smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
+      Submodule.smul_mem _ (p.coeff m) hsingle
+  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
+    rintro p ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
+    exact bounded_monomial w m 1 hm
+
+/-- The highest possible component of a product is the product of the respective
+highest possible components. This does not assume their nonvanishing. -/
+theorem component_mul_of_bounded {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
+    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q e) :
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent w (d + e) (p * q) =
+      weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p * weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q := by
+  classical
+  ext m
+  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
+  rw [Finset.ite_sum_zero]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  rintro ⟨a,b⟩ hab
+  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
+  have hab' : a + b = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hab
+  by_cases ha : p.coeff a = 0
+  · simp [ha]
+  by_cases hb : q.coeff b = 0
+  · simp [hb]
+  have hap := hp a ha
+  have hbq := hq b hb
+  have hweight : Finsupp.weight w a + Finsupp.weight w b = Finsupp.weight w m := by
+    rw [← map_add, hab']
+  have hiff : Finsupp.weight w m = d + e ↔
+      Finsupp.weight w a = d ∧ Finsupp.weight w b = e := by omega
+  by_cases hma : Finsupp.weight w a = d <;>
+    by_cases hmb : Finsupp.weight w b = e <;> simp [hiff, hma, hmb]
+
+/-- A component strictly above a bound vanishes. -/
+lemma component_eq_zero_of_bounded {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
+    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hde : d < e) : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e p = 0 := by
+  classical
+  ext m
+  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero]
+  split_ifs with hm
+  · by_contra hc
+    have := hp m hc
+    omega
+  · rfl
+
+/-- Every nonzero polynomial has a highest integer-weight component. -/
+theorem exists_top {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ d : ℤ, Bounded w p d ∧ weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ≠ 0 := by
+  classical
+  have hs : p.support.Nonempty := support_nonempty.mpr hp
+  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image p.support (Finsupp.weight w) hs
+  refine ⟨Finsupp.weight w m, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro a ha
+    exact hmax a (mem_support_iff.mpr ha)
+  · intro h
+    have heq := congrArg (fun q : MvPolynomial σ K => q.coeff m) h
+    simp only [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at heq
+    exact (mem_support_iff.mp hm) heq
+
+/-- A bound with a nonzero component is exactly the weighted total degree. -/
+theorem degree_eq_of_top {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ}
+    (hb : Bounded w p d) (ht : weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ≠ 0) :
+    weightedTotalDegree' w p = (d : WithBot ℤ) := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · rw [weightedTotalDegree', Finset.sup_le_iff]
+    intro m hm
+    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (hb m (mem_support_iff.mp hm))
+  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_coeff_ne_zero ht
+    rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent] at hm
+    split_ifs at hm with hmd
+    · have hb' := Finset.le_sup (f := fun a => (Finsupp.weight w a : WithBot ℤ))
+        (mem_support_iff.mpr hm)
+      simpa only [weightedTotalDegree', hmd] using hb'
+    · exact (hm rfl).elim
+
+section Domain
+variable [NoZeroDivisors K]
+
+/-- Nonzero top components multiply to a nonzero top component over a domain. -/
+theorem top_mul {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
+    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q e)
+    (htp : weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ≠ 0)
+    (htq : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q ≠ 0) :

+  rw [component_mul_of_bounded hp hq]

+  by_cases hp : p = 0

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Span
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Principal initial ideals for integer-weighted polynomial rings
+
+This module uses the canonical weighted-product API to prove that the ideal of
+leading relations of a principal polynomial ideal is generated by the leading
+form of its generator.  The weights are arbitrary integers.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial
+
+noncomputable section
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {σ R : Type*} [CommRing R]
+variable {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} {d e : ℤ}
+
+/-- `d` is the largest weight of a nonzero polynomial, including negative weights. -/
+def IsTopDegree (w : σ → ℤ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : ℤ) : Prop :=
+  Bounded w p d ∧ weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ≠ 0
+
+lemma homogeneous_bounded (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) : Bounded w p d :=
+  fun _ hm => le_of_eq (hp hm)
+
+lemma IsTopDegree.ne_zero (hp : IsTopDegree w p d) : p ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  exact hp.2 (by rw [h, map_zero])
+
+lemma IsTopDegree.of_homogeneous (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) (hne : p ≠ 0) :
+    IsTopDegree w p d := by
+  refine ⟨homogeneous_bounded hp, ?_⟩
+  rwa [hp.weightedHomogeneousComponent_same]
+
+lemma IsTopDegree.unique (hp : IsTopDegree w p d) (hq : IsTopDegree w p e) : d = e := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · by_contra h
+    exact hp.2 (component_eq_zero_of_bounded hq.1 (lt_of_not_ge h))
+  · by_contra h
+    exact hq.2 (component_eq_zero_of_bounded hp.1 (lt_of_not_ge h))
+
+/-- Projection through multiplication by a homogeneous polynomial.  This needs
+no bound on the other factor and allows negative degree shifts. -/
+lemma component_mul_homogeneous_left (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) (q : MvPolynomial σ R)
+    (e : ℤ) :
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent w (d + e) (p * q) =
+      p * weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q := by
+  classical
+  ext m
+  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_mul, coeff_mul, Finset.ite_sum_zero]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hab
+  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
+  by_cases ha : p.coeff a = 0
+  · simp [ha]
+  have hwa : Finsupp.weight w a = d := hp ha
+  have hab' : a + b = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hab
+  have hwm : Finsupp.weight w m = d + Finsupp.weight w b := by
+    rw [← hab', map_add, hwa]
+  simp only [hwm, add_right_inj]
+  split_ifs <;> simp_all
+
+variable [NoZeroDivisors R]
+
+/-- The initial ideal contains leading forms at the actual largest weights,
+not all homogeneous components of the relation ideal. -/
+def initialIdeal (w : σ → ℤ) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) :=
+  Ideal.span {f | ∃ p ∈ I, ∃ d : ℤ, IsTopDegree w p d ∧
+    f = weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p}
+
+/-- A principal relation has a principal weighted initial ideal. -/
+theorem initialIdeal_span_singleton (hH : IsTopDegree w q e) :
+    initialIdeal w (Ideal.span ({q} : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))) =
+      Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q} : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
+    intro f hf
+    obtain ⟨r, hr, d, hd, rfl⟩ := hf
+    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hr
+    have htne : t ≠ 0 := by
+      intro hzero
+      exact hd.ne_zero (by rw [ht, hzero, mul_zero])
+    obtain ⟨c, hc, hct⟩ := exists_top (w := w) htne
+    have hp : IsTopDegree w (q * t) (e + c) := top_mul hH.1 hc hH.2 hct
+    rw [← ht] at hp
+    have hdegree := hd.unique hp
+    rw [hdegree, ht, component_mul_of_bounded hH.1 hc]
+    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w c t, rfl⟩
+  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
+    intro f hf
+    have hf' : f = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf
+    subst f
+    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨q, Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton q), e, hH, rfl⟩
+
+
+end
+end StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Operations

+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# The homogeneous kernel criterion for a principal filtered quotient
+
+A homogeneous polynomial disappears in the associated graded quotient by `(H)`
+exactly when it is divisible by the highest component of `H`. The statement is
+expressed in terms of representatives of lower weight; it thus supplies the
+kernel computation independently of a particular associated-graded construction.
+-/
+
+namespace StableCoordinate
+namespace WeightedInitial
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {σ K : Type*} [CommRing K] [IsDomain K]
+
+omit [IsDomain K] in
+lemma bounded_of_homogeneous {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ}
+    (hp : IsWeightedHomogeneous w p d) : Bounded w p d :=
+  fun _ hm => (hp hm).le
+
+omit [IsDomain K] in
+lemma top_sub_lower {w : σ → ℤ} {p r : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ}
+    (hp : IsWeightedHomogeneous w p d) (hr : Bounded w r (d - 1)) :
+    weightedHomogeneousComponent w d (p - r) = p := by
+  rw [map_sub, weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_self hp,
+    component_eq_zero_of_bounded hr (by omega), sub_zero]
+
+/-- The homogeneous representative criterion for the kernel of the associated
+-graded map from a weighted polynomial ring modulo one relation. -/
+theorem homogeneous_quotient_kernel_iff
+    (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ K) (e : ℤ)
+    (hH : Bounded w H e) (hHt : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H ≠ 0)
+    {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ} (hp : IsWeightedHomogeneous w p d) :
+    (∃ r : MvPolynomial σ K, Bounded w r (d - 1) ∧
+      p - r ∈ Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ K))) ↔
+    p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ K)) := by
+  classical
+  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
+  · subst p
+    constructor
+    · intro _
+      exact Ideal.zero_mem _
+    · intro _
+      exact ⟨0, bounded_zero w _, by simp⟩
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩
+    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hpr
+    have hprtop : weightedHomogeneousComponent w d (p - r) ≠ 0 := by
+      rw [top_sub_lower hp hr]
+      exact hp0
+    have hqr : q ≠ 0 := by
+      intro hq0
+      rw [hq0, mul_zero] at hq
+      rw [hq, map_zero] at hprtop
+      exact hprtop rfl
+    obtain ⟨t, hqt, hqtop⟩ := exists_top (w := w) hqr
+    obtain ⟨hprod, hprodtop⟩ := top_mul hH hqt hHt hqtop
+    have hprbound : Bounded w (p - r) d :=
+      (bounded_of_homogeneous hp).sub (hr.mono (by omega))
+    have hde : d = e + t := by
+      apply WithBot.coe_injective
+      calc
+        (d : WithBot ℤ) = weightedTotalDegree' w (p - r) :=
+          (degree_eq_of_top hprbound hprtop).symm
+        _ = weightedTotalDegree' w (H * q) := congrArg _ hq
+        _ = ((e + t : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) := degree_eq_of_top hprod hprodtop
+    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
+    refine ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q, ?_⟩
+    calc
+      p = weightedHomogeneousComponent w d (p - r) := (top_sub_lower hp hr).symm
+      _ = weightedHomogeneousComponent w (e + t) (H * q) := by rw [hq, hde]
+      _ = _ := component_mul_of_bounded hH hqt
+  · intro hpmem
+    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hpmem
+    have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
+      intro hh
+      rw [hh, mul_zero] at hq
+      exact hp0 hq
+    obtain ⟨t, hqt, hqtop⟩ := exists_top (w := w) hq0
+    have hhom : IsWeightedHomogeneous w (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) e :=
+      weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous e H
+    have htopself : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e
+        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H :=
+      weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_self hhom
+    have htopself_ne : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e
+        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) ≠ 0 := by rwa [htopself]
+    obtain ⟨hprod, hprodtop⟩ :=
+      top_mul (bounded_of_homogeneous hhom) hqt htopself_ne hqtop
+    have hde : d = e + t := by
+      apply WithBot.coe_injective
+      calc
+        (d : WithBot ℤ) = weightedTotalDegree' w p :=
+          (hp.weighted_total_degree hp0).symm
+        _ = weightedTotalDegree' w (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H * q) := congrArg _ hq
+        _ = ((e + t : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) := degree_eq_of_top hprod hprodtop
+    have hptop : p = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H * weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q := by
+      calc
+        p = weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p := (weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_self hp).symm
+        _ = weightedHomogeneousComponent w (e + t)
+              (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H * q) := by rw [hq, hde]
+        _ = _ := by rw [component_mul_of_bounded (bounded_of_homogeneous hhom) hqt, htopself]
+    let r := p - H * weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q
+    refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · have hb := (bounded_sub_top hH).mul
+        (bounded_of_homogeneous (weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous t q))
+      have hr : r = -((H - weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) *
+          weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q) := by
+        dsimp [r]
+        rw [hptop]
+        ring
+      rw [hr]
+      have heq : e - 1 + t = d - 1 := by omega
+      simpa only [heq] using hb.neg
+    · apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
+      refine ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q, ?_⟩
+      dsimp [r]
+      ring
+
+end WeightedInitial
+end StableCoordinate
+
+end OAI

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.CommRing
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations

+/-!
+# The zero-fiber elimination
+
+The quotient by the specialized defining equation of Section 2 is a polynomial
+algebra in three independent variables.  The construction is an algebra
+isomorphism, not merely a bijection on points, and works over any commutative
+coefficient ring.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (K : Type*) [CommRing K]
+
+abbrev Four := MvPolynomial (Fin 4) K
+abbrev Three := MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K
+
+def squareDifference : Four K := X 0 ^ 2 - X 1 ^ 2
+
+def relation : Four K :=
+  squareDifference K ^ 2 * X 2 - (1 + 2 * X 0 * squareDifference K) * X 3 - X 1
+
+def relationIdeal : Ideal (Four K) := Ideal.span {relation K}
+
+abbrev Ring := Four K ⧸ relationIdeal K
+
+def qmk : Four K →ₐ[K] Ring K := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K _
+
+def forward : Four K →ₐ[K] Three K :=
+  aeval ![X 0, X 1,
+    4 * X 0 ^ 2 * X 1 + (1 + 2 * X 0 * (X 0 ^ 2 - X 1 ^ 2)) * X 2,
+    -(1 - 2 * X 0 * (X 0 ^ 2 - X 1 ^ 2)) * X 1 + (X 0 ^ 2 - X 1 ^ 2) ^ 2 * X 2]
+
+lemma forward_relation : forward K (relation K) = 0 := by
+  simp only [forward, relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
+    map_ofNat, aeval_X, map_one]
+  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
+  ring
+
+lemma forward_vanishes : ∀ a ∈ relationIdeal K, forward K a = 0 := by
+  intro a ha
+  have h : relationIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (forward K).toRingHom := by
+    rw [relationIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
+    intro b hb
+    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
+    exact forward_relation K
+  exact h ha
+
+def toThree : Ring K →ₐ[K] Three K :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (forward K) (forward_vanishes K)
+
+@[simp] lemma toThree_qmk (a : Four K) : toThree K (qmk K a) = forward K a := rfl
+
+def backward : Three K →ₐ[K] Ring K :=
+  aeval ![qmk K (X 0), qmk K (X 1),
+    qmk K ((1 - 2 * X 0 * squareDifference K) * X 2 + 4 * X 0 ^ 2 * X 3)]
+
+lemma forward_backward : (toThree K).comp (backward K) = AlgHom.id K (Three K) := by
+  ext i : 1
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [backward, forward, squareDifference, map_ofNat]
+  ring
+
+lemma qmk_relation : qmk K (relation K) = 0 := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
+
+lemma backward_forward : (backward K).comp (toThree K) = AlgHom.id K (Ring K) := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
+  ext i : 1
+  change backward K (toThree K (qmk K (X i))) = qmk K (X i)
+  rw [toThree_qmk]
+  fin_cases i <;> simp [forward, backward, map_ofNat]
+  · have h := qmk_relation K
+    simp only [relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
+      map_ofNat, map_one] at h ⊢
+    linear_combination -4 * (qmk K (X 0)) ^ 2 * h
+  · have h := qmk_relation K
+    simp only [relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
+      map_ofNat, map_one] at h ⊢
+    linear_combination (1 - 2 * qmk K (X 0) * (qmk K (X 0) ^ 2 - qmk K (X 1) ^ 2)) * h
+
+/-- The zero fiber of the five-generator hypersurface presentation is affine
+three-space, expressed by an isomorphism of coordinate algebras. -/
+def presentationEquiv : Ring K ≃ₐ[K] Three K :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (toThree K) (backward K) (forward_backward K) (backward_forward K)
+
+end StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber
+
+end

+import OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber
+
+namespace OAI

+/-!
+# Specializing the five-variable presentation at p = 0
+
+This module proves, by explicit algebra maps, that specializing the hypersurface
+presentation before or after imposing its defining equation gives the same
+coordinate algebra.  No field, reducedness, or geometric assumptions are used.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+namespace StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable (K : Type*) [CommRing K]
+
+abbrev Five := MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K
+
+def sourceX : Five K := X 1 ^ 2 - X 2 ^ 2 + X 0 * X 3
+
+def sourceH : Five K :=
+  sourceX K ^ 2 * X 3 - (1 + 2 * X 1 * sourceX K) * X 4 - X 0 * X 4 ^ 2 - X 2
+
+def sourceIdeal : Ideal (Five K) := Ideal.span {sourceH K}
+abbrev Hypersurface := Five K ⧸ sourceIdeal K
+
+def hypersurfaceMk : Five K →ₐ[K] Hypersurface K := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K _
+
+def parameterIdeal : Ideal (Hypersurface K) := Ideal.span {hypersurfaceMk K (X 0)}
+abbrev SourceRing := Hypersurface K ⧸ parameterIdeal K
+
+def sourceMk : Five K →ₐ[K] SourceRing K :=
+  (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K (parameterIdeal K)).comp (hypersurfaceMk K)
+
+lemma sourceMk_parameter : sourceMk K (X 0) = 0 := by
+  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
+
+lemma sourceMk_relation : sourceMk K (sourceH K) = 0 := by
+  have h : hypersurfaceMk K (sourceH K) = 0 := by
+    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
+    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
+  change Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K (parameterIdeal K) (hypersurfaceMk K (sourceH K)) = 0
+  rw [h, map_zero]
+
+def specialize : Five K →ₐ[K] Ring K :=
+  aeval ![0, qmk K (X 0), qmk K (X 1), qmk K (X 2), qmk K (X 3)]
+
+lemma specialize_relation : specialize K (sourceH K) = 0 := by
+  have h := qmk_relation K
+  simpa [specialize, sourceH, sourceX, relation, squareDifference, map_ofNat] using h
+
+lemma specialize_vanishes : ∀ a ∈ sourceIdeal K, specialize K a = 0 := by
+  intro a ha
+  have h : sourceIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (specialize K).toRingHom := by
+    rw [sourceIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
+    intro b hb
+    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
+    exact specialize_relation K
+  exact h ha
+
+def specializeHypersurface : Hypersurface K →ₐ[K] Ring K :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (specialize K) (specialize_vanishes K)
+
+@[simp] lemma specializeHypersurface_mk (a : Five K) :
+    specializeHypersurface K (hypersurfaceMk K a) = specialize K a := rfl
+
+lemma specializeHypersurface_vanishes :
+    ∀ a ∈ parameterIdeal K, specializeHypersurface K a = 0 := by
+  intro a ha
+  have h : parameterIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (specializeHypersurface K).toRingHom := by
+    rw [parameterIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
+    intro b hb
+    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
+    simp [specialize]
+  exact h ha
+
+def specializeQuotient : SourceRing K →ₐ[K] Ring K :=
+  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (specializeHypersurface K) (specializeHypersurface_vanishes K)
+
+@[simp] lemma specializeQuotient_mk (a : Five K) :
+    specializeQuotient K (sourceMk K a) = specialize K a := rfl
+

+  aeval ![sourceMk K (X 1), sourceMk K (X 2), sourceMk K (X 3), sourceMk K (X 4)]
+
+lemma includeVariables_relation : includeVariables K (relation K) = 0 := by
+  have h := sourceMk_relation K
+  simp only [sourceH, sourceX, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_ofNat,
+    map_one] at h
+  rw [sourceMk_parameter] at h
+  simp only [includeVariables, relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul,
+    map_pow, map_ofNat, map_one, aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
+  linear_combination h
+
+lemma includeVariables_vanishes : ∀ a ∈ relationIdeal K, includeVariables K a = 0 := by
+  intro a ha
+  have h : relationIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (includeVariables K).toRingHom := by
+    rw [relationIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
+    intro b hb
+    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
+    exact includeVariables_relation K
+  exact h ha

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Nullstellensatz
+import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Polynomial.Basic
+
+namespace OAI
+
+/-!
+# Complex zero loci and ideal transport
+
+This module supplies the geometric interface needed when an ambient polynomial
+isomorphism is described on complex points.  Polynomial substitutions induce
+mutually inverse polynomial maps, not arbitrary set-theoretic bijections.
+Hilbert's Nullstellensatz then recovers radical defining ideals from their
+complex zero loci.  No conclusion about the manuscript's polynomial is assumed.
+-/
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface
+
+open MvPolynomial
+
+variable {k σ : Type*} [Field k]
+
+/-- The map on affine points contravariantly induced by a polynomial substitution. -/
+def pointMap (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (x : σ → k) : σ → k :=
+  fun i => aeval x (φ (X i))
+
+/-- Substitution and evaluation commute, for every polynomial. -/
+theorem aeval_pointMap (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (x : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    aeval (pointMap φ x) p = aeval x (φ p) := by
+  have h : aeval (pointMap φ x) = (aeval x).comp φ := by
+    ext i
+    simp [pointMap]
+  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h p
+
+@[simp]
+theorem pointMap_id (x : σ → k) :
+    pointMap (AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)) x = x := by
+  funext i
+  simp [pointMap]
+
+/-- Composition reverses because coordinate-ring homomorphisms are pullbacks. -/
+theorem pointMap_comp (φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (x : σ → k) :
+    pointMap (φ.comp ψ) x = pointMap ψ (pointMap φ x) := by
+  funext i
+  simp [pointMap, aeval_pointMap]
+
+/-- A polynomial algebra automorphism induces an affine-space automorphism on
+points; both directions are explicitly given by polynomial evaluation. -/
+def pointEquiv (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) :
+    (σ → k) ≃ (σ → k) where
+  toFun := pointMap e.toAlgHom
+  invFun := pointMap e.symm.toAlgHom
+  left_inv x := by
+    funext i
+    change aeval (pointMap e.toAlgHom x) (e.symm (X i)) = x i
+    rw [aeval_pointMap]
+    simp
+  right_inv x := by
+    funext i
+    change aeval (pointMap e.symm.toAlgHom x) (e (X i)) = x i
+    rw [aeval_pointMap]
+    simp
+
+@[simp]
+theorem pointEquiv_apply (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (x : σ → k) : pointEquiv e x = pointMap e.toAlgHom x := rfl
+
+/-- Pullback of a zero locus agrees with extension of its defining ideal. -/
+theorem preimage_zeroLocus (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
+    (pointEquiv e) ⁻¹' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k (I.map e.toRingHom) := by
+  ext x
+  constructor
+  · intro hx p hp
+    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ :=
+      (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective).mp hp
+    change aeval x (e.toAlgHom q) = 0
+    rw [← aeval_pointMap]
+    exact hx q hq
+  · intro hx p hp
+    change aeval (pointMap e.toAlgHom x) p = 0
+    rw [aeval_pointMap]
+    exact hx (e p) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem e.toRingHom hp)
+
+/-- The inverse point map carries a closed algebraic set to the zero locus of
+its transported ideal.  This fixes the usual contravariance convention. -/
+theorem image_zeroLocus (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
+    (pointEquiv e).symm '' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k (I.map e.toRingHom) := by
+  rw [← preimage_zeroLocus]
+  exact (pointEquiv e).image_symm_eq_preimage _
+
+variable [IsAlgClosed k] [Finite σ]
+
+/-- Over an algebraically closed field, radical ideals are determined by their
+sets of rational points.  The finite-variable hypothesis is essential. -/
+theorem radical_ideal_eq_of_zeroLocus_eq
+    {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical)
+    (h : zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k J) : I = J := by
+  calc
+    I = vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k I) := by
+      rw [vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hI.radical]
+    _ = vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k J) := congrArg (vanishingIdeal k) h
+    _ = J := by rw [vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hJ.radical]
+
+/-- Equality of geometric images under a polynomial ambient automorphism
+recovers equality of the transported radical defining ideals. -/
+theorem map_ideal_eq_of_image_zeroLocus_eq
+    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical)
+    (h : (pointEquiv e).symm '' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k J) :
+    I.map e.toRingHom = J := by
+  refine radical_ideal_eq_of_zeroLocus_eq ?_ hJ ?_
+  · have hm : I.map e.toRingHom = I.comap e.symm.toRingHom := by
+      ext p
+      rw [Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective]
+      constructor
+      · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
+        simpa using hq
+      · intro hp
+        exact ⟨e.symm p, hp, e.apply_symm_apply p⟩
+    rw [hm]
+    exact hI.comap _
+  · rw [← image_zeroLocus]
+    exact h
+
+/-- For prime defining ideals, image equality and ideal transport are
+exactly equivalent; no extra geometric assumption is introduced. -/
+theorem image_zeroLocus_eq_iff_map_eq
+    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
+    (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) [I.IsPrime] [J.IsPrime] :
+    (pointEquiv e).symm '' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k J ↔
+      I.map e.toRingHom = J := by
+  constructor
+  · exact map_ideal_eq_of_image_zeroLocus_eq e
+      (Ideal.IsPrime.isRadical inferInstance) (Ideal.IsPrime.isRadical inferInstance)
+  · intro h
+    rw [image_zeroLocus, h]
+
+omit [IsAlgClosed k] [Finite σ] in
+/-- The zero locus of the principal fiber ideal is exactly the named fiber,
+including the parameter value zero. -/
+theorem zeroLocus_fiber_ideal (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (t : k) :
+    zeroLocus k (Ideal.span ({p - C t} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k))) =
+      {x : σ → k | aeval x p = t} := by
+  rw [zeroLocus_span]
+  ext x
+  simp [sub_eq_zero]
+
+end StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface
+
+end
+
+end OAI

+  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p.ix]
+  · intro b hb hh
+    rw [FinJump, Gi_out _ (show pos x∉ Node.cells ⟨p.lev,b⟩ from by
+      intro H
+      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (cells_dis hh) H h),zero_smul]

+    (hp : s.here.lev < J) (h : x∈s.here.block M) (b : Bool) :

+  unfold tailE
+  let f (n) := ∑ k∈Finset.range (2^n),FinJump ⟨n,k⟩ (finMod s.wage u) x
+  let n := s.here.lev
+  have he : Finset.Ico s.here.lev J=insert n (Finset.Ico (n+1) J) := by
+    ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_Ico,n]; omega
+  rw [he,Finset.sum_insert (by simp),lone s s.here hh x u h]
+  cases b <;> rfl

+  let w := finMod (s.win v).wage u

+    funext i
+    unfold f g w lose win finMod; simp only [Pi.add_apply]
+    by_cases HH : v.take s.fund.mood i

+/-! # The uniform output path -/
+
+open Function Set Filter

+namespace OAI
+
+namespace FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths
+open Law Node Real Period Compress.Params Thermal Fund Scene Fork Road Event Journal Wire Pulse Thread Capture Chart Snapshot
+variable {M j J : ℕ} {s q : Scene M} {f : Grid M → ℝ}

+
+namespace CastShow
+open Troupe

+def jackpot (x : Grid M) {s : Scene M} (t : Play j M s) :=
+    s.norm*souvenir s.live j ((project t).stream x)
+def annual (x : Grid M) {s : Scene M} (t : Play j M s) : ℝ := match t with
+| .rest _ => 0
+| .ticket _ t => jackpot x t+annual x t
+| .freeze _ t => annual x t
+| .attempt _ _ l r => annual x l+annual x r
+| .jump s l r => if (step s).bit x then annual x r else annual x l
+
+lemma fit_ticket {s : Scene M} {t : Play j M s.reset} (h : (Play.ticket s t).Follows J f) :
+    Fit s.reset ∧ entry s.reset ∧ (s.live=true → exp (-height j) ≤ s.reset.norm) := by
+  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
+  have hh := hb.2.2

+  change s.mass/s.mass ≤ 4; rw [div_self hh.ne']; norm_num
+
+lemma annual_valid :
+    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, J ≤ M → ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,

+        ‖summons u x t‖ ≤ annual x t := by
+  filter_upwards [gala] with j hj M J hh s f t h u x hx
+  induction t with
+  | rest s => simp [summons,annual]
+  | ticket s t ih =>
+    rw [summons,annual]
+    have HT := fit_ticket h
+    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
+    apply le_trans (norm_add_le _ _)
+    apply add_le_add _ (ih he hx)

+  | freeze s t ih => exact ih h.2.2.2 hx
+  | attempt s v l r il ir =>

+/-- Prices in true history. -/
+def normStamp (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) :=
+    if s.live then (s.norm/s.mass)*stamp s j else 0
+def billOf : Event j M → ℝ

+| .march s .move _ => normStamp s j

+def overdue {s : Scene M} (t : Play j M s) :=

+lemma dueEmpty {s : Scene M} {t : Play j M s} (h : project t=blank s) : overdue t=0 := by

+  split; simp only [stats_nil,subtotal_nil,mul_zero]; rfl
+lemma due_restart {s : Scene M} {t : Play j M s} (h : s.norm=0) : overdue t=0 := by simp [overdue,h]

+      apply Ex_congr_mem; intro x hx; unfold t; rw [annual,H true x hx]; rfl
+    change ((U (s.smaller false)).Ex (fun x => annual x t) + (U (s.smaller true)).Ex (fun x => annual x t))/2=(yieldA l+yieldA r)/2

+import OAI.Analysis.FourierLLogL.Assembly.Rail
+/-! # The uniform output path -/
+
+open Function Set Filter
+open scoped Topology BigOperators ComplexConjugate
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace OAI
+
+namespace FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths
+open Law Node Real Period Compress.Params Thermal Fund Scene Fork Road Event Journal Wire Pulse Thread Capture Chart Snapshot
+variable {M j J : ℕ} {s q : Scene M} {f : Grid M → ℝ}
+open scoped Classical
+
+
+namespace Troupe
+
+/-- Depth of a sequence (no missing jumps within plateau) -/
+def matrix (n : ℕ) : Path M → Prop
+| [] => True
+| b::l => depthB b=n ∧ matrix (n+1) l
+
+lemma matrix_trip {x : Grid M} (l : Path M) (h : Trip x s l) :
+    matrix s.here.lev l := by
+  induction l generalizing s with
+  | nil => exact True.intro
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    have He : depthB b=s.here.lev := by unfold depthB; rw [h.2.1.lower.here,h.1]
+    have HH := ih h.2.2
+    rw [depth_next,He] at HH; exact ⟨He,HH⟩
+
+lemma matrix_cut (l : Path M) (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ) (h : matrix n l) :
+    ∃ p q : Path M, l=p++q ∧ matrix (n+p.length) q ∧
+      (∀ b∈p, depthB b < k) ∧ (∀ b∈q, k ≤ depthB b) ∧
+      n+p.length = min (max n k) (n+l.length) := by
+  induction l generalizing n with
+  | nil => refine ⟨[],[],rfl,True.intro,?_⟩; simp
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    obtain ⟨hp,hq,hh,hE,h₁,h₂,h₃⟩ := ih _ h.2
+    have HI : depthB b=n := h.1
+    by_cases hv : n < k
+    · refine ⟨b::hp,hq, by rw [hh]; rfl,?_,?_,h₂,?_⟩
+      · rw [List.length_cons,show n+(List.length hp+1)=n+1+List.length hp by omega]
+        exact hE
+      · intro x hx; rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl|hx
+        · omega
+        exact h₁ _ hx
+      · simp only [List.length_cons]
+        omega
+    · have H : hp.length=0 := by omega
+      have hL : hp=[] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero H
+      rw [hL,List.nil_append] at hh; cases hh
+      refine ⟨[],b::l,rfl,h,fun b hb => ?_,fun z hz => ?_,?_⟩
+      · simp at hb
+      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl|hz; omega
+        exact h₂ _ hz
+      · simp; omega
+
+lemma slab_on (l : Path M) (n : ℕ) (h : matrix n l) (a k : ℕ) :
+    ∃ p q r : Path M, l=p++q++r ∧
+      (∀ b∈p, ¬betweenS a k b) ∧ (∀ b∈r, ¬betweenS a k b) ∧
+      q.length ≤ k := by
+  obtain ⟨p,s,H,h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩ := matrix_cut l n a h
+  obtain ⟨q,r,hr,hx,hp,he,hk⟩ := matrix_cut s _ (a+k) h₁
+  refine ⟨p,q,r,by rw [H,hr,List.append_assoc],fun b hi hh => ?_,fun b hi hh => ?_,?_⟩
+  exact (h₂ b hi).not_ge hh.1
+  exact hh.2.not_ge (he b hi)
+  have ht₁ : l.length=p.length+s.length := by rw [H,List.length_append]
+  have ht₂ : s.length=q.length+r.length := by rw [hr,List.length_append]
+  omega
+
+/-- quality trip coupons that cover all high nonbad jumps before activation. -/
+def shades (m : Grade → ℕ) (u : Grid M) (l : Path M) (j : ℕ) :=
+    ∀ g : Grade, ∀ p q : Path M, l=p++q → stall u g j l p →
+      ∀ b∈p, snag g u b → betweenS (m g) (billWait g j l) b
+
+lemma sheds {s : Scene M} {l : Path M} (h : Cast j J f s l) (u : Grid M) :
+    ∃ m : Grade → ℕ, shades m u l j := by
+  choose m hm using fun g => bound_stage (u:=u) l h g
+  exact ⟨m,hm⟩
+
+def stripe (a : Grade → ℕ) (g : Grade) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) (b : Beat M) :=
+    if betweenS (a g) (billWait g j l) b then (1:ℝ) else 0
+
+lemma stripe_pos (a : Grade → ℕ) (g : Grade) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) (b : Beat M) :
+    0 ≤ stripe a g j l b := by unfold stripe; split <;> norm_num
+
+lemma stripe_bill (a : Grade → ℕ) (g : Grade) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) (x : Grid M)
+    {s : Scene M} (h : Trip x s l) : subtotal (stripe a g j l) l ≤ billWait g j l := by
+  let f := stripe a g j l
+  obtain ⟨v,w,p,hl,hv,hp,hw⟩ := slab_on l _ (matrix_trip l h) (a g) (billWait g j l)
+  have HF (m : Path M) (hi : ∀ b∈m, ¬ betweenS (a g) (billWait g j l) b) :
+      subtotal f m=0 := by
+    induction m with
+    | nil => rfl
+    | cons b r ih =>
+      have HH : f b=0 := ite_eq_right (hi b List.mem_cons_self)
+      rw [subtotal_cons,HH,ih fun y hy => hi y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy),zero_add]
+  have HX (m : Path M) :
+      subtotal f m ≤ m.length := by
+    induction m with
+    | nil => simp [subtotal]
+    | cons b r ih =>
+      have he : f b≤ 1 := by unfold f stripe; split <;> norm_num
+      rw [subtotal_cons, List.length_cons]; push_cast; linarith
+  change subtotal f l ≤ _
+  nth_rw 1 [hl]
+  rw [subtotal_app,subtotal_app,HF v hv,HF p hp,zero_add,add_zero]
+  apply (HX w).trans
+  exact_mod_cast hw
+
+
+lemma trim_cost (g : Beat M → ℝ) (hg : ∀ b, Ideal b.pre b.post → 0 ≤ g b)
+    {x : Grid M} (l p r : Path M) (h : Trip x s (p++(l++r))) :
+    subtotal g l ≤ subtotal g (p++(l++r)) := by
+  rw [subtotal_app,subtotal_app]
+  obtain ⟨ha,q,hq⟩ := trip_cut h
+  obtain ⟨hc,t,ht⟩ := trip_cut hq
+  linarith [trip_nonneg ht hg,trip_nonneg ha hg]
+
+lemma trip_depth_limit {l : Path M} {s : Scene M} (h : Cast j J f s l) :
+    s.here.lev+l.length ≤ J := by
+  induction l generalizing s with
+  | nil => exact (show s.Safe j J f from h).depth_ok
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    obtain ⟨rfl,⟨t,ht⟩,hh⟩ := h
+    have hi := ih hh
+    rw [List.length_cons]
+    have hX := ht.2.1.1.here
+    rw [depth_next,depthB,hX] at hi
+    omega
+
+end Troupe
+
+
+end FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths
+
+end OAI

+import OAI.Analysis.FourierLLogL.Assembly.Duration
+/-! # The uniform output path -/
+
+open Function Set Filter
+open scoped Topology BigOperators ComplexConjugate
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace OAI
+
+namespace FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths
+open Law Node Real Period Compress.Params Thermal Fund Scene Fork Road Event Journal Wire Pulse Thread Capture Chart Snapshot
+variable {M j J : ℕ} {s q : Scene M} {f : Grid M → ℝ}
+open scoped Classical
+
+
+namespace Troupe
+open Run Streak
+
+def lowI (j : ℕ) (b : Bool) := if b then mainIx j else 0
+def highI (j M : ℕ) (b : Bool) := lowI j b+M+1
+def playsL (j M : ℕ) (b : Bool) := Finset.Ico (lowI j b) (highI j M b)
+def picks (s : Scene M) (i j : ℕ) (b : Bool) :=
+    i ∈ playsL j M b ∧ hazard s false i
+
+def priciest (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (b : Bool) :=
+    if h : ∃ i, picks s i j b then Nat.find h else lowI j b
+def mutedR (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (b : Bool) :=
+    surcharge s false (priciest s j b)
+
+/-- scalar edge charges pay the largest bad level, chosen locally at the pre-bit moment. -/
+lemma pricey (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) (h : picks s i j b) :
+    side i ≤ 128*mutedR s j b := by
+  let n := priciest s j b
+  have hi : ∃ i, picks s i j b := ⟨i,h⟩
+  have hn : n=Nat.find hi := dite_eq_left hi
+  have HE : hazard s false n := hn.symm ▸ (Nat.find_spec hi).2
+  have H : side i ≤ side n := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
+      (hn.le.trans (Nat.find_min' hi h))
+  change side n / 128 ≤ edgeW s n at HE
+  change _ ≤ 128*surcharge s false n
+  rw [surcharge,ite_eq_left (show hazard s false n from HE)]; linarith
+
+def special (j : ℕ) (b : Beat M) := (rose (tagM (mainIx j +1)) (0:Grid M)).flag b.post
+
+def token (a : Grade → ℕ) (L : Path M) (j : ℕ) (s : Bool) (b : Beat M) :=
+    side M+512*mutedR b.post j s+
+      (∑ i∈playsL j M s,4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b) +
+        (if s then 4*(special j b+stripe a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b) else 0)
+
+lemma token_floor (a : Grade → ℕ) (j : ℕ) (s : Bool) (L : Path M) (b : Beat M) :
+    side M ≤ token a L j s b ∧ 512*mutedR b.post j s ≤ token a L j s b ∧
+      (∑ i∈playsL j M s,4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b) ≤ token a L j s b ∧
+      (s=true → 4*(special j b+stripe a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b) ≤ token a L j s b) := by
+  let z := ∑ i∈playsL j M s,4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b
+  have hZ : 0 ≤ z := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
+    (side_pos _).le) (stripe_pos _ _ _ _ _)
+  have hx : 0 ≤ mutedR b.post j s := surcharge_nonneg _ _ _
+  have hi : 0 ≤ special j b := flag_nonneg _ _
+  have hv := stripe_pos a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b
+  have hh := side_pos M
+  unfold token
+  unfold z at *
+  cases s <;> simp only [↓reduceIte,Bool.false_eq_true] <;>
+    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,fun H => ?_⟩ <;> first | linarith | contradiction
+
+lemma tokens_nonneg (a : Grade → ℕ) (L : Path M) (b : Beat M) (j : ℕ) (s : Bool) :
+    0 ≤ token a L j s b := (side_pos M).le.trans (token_floor a j s L b).1
+
+lemma amp_test {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u : Grid M) :
+    ‖gain s u‖ ≤ ampU s u ∧ ampU s u ≤ 4 ∧
+      ∃ b : Bool, ampU s u=‖scalar (s.smaller b) u‖ := by
+  have H (b) := (scalar_norm (h.child b) u).trans (h.child b).lift
+  constructor
+  · apply (norm_halfcomplex _ _).trans
+    have h1 : ‖scalar (s.smaller false) u‖ ≤ ampU s u := le_max_left _ _
+    have h2 : ‖scalar (s.smaller true) u‖ ≤ ampU s u := le_max_right _ _
+    linarith
+  · unfold ampU
+    refine ⟨max_le (H false) (H true),?_⟩
+    by_cases hh : ‖scalar (s.smaller true) u‖ ≤ ‖scalar (s.smaller false) u‖
+    exact ⟨false,max_eq_left hh⟩
+    exact ⟨true,max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hh)⟩
+
+lemma side_ant (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) : side j ≤ side i :=
+    pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h
+
+/-- Each unmasked direct jump outside the main intervals can be paid by its amplitude-selected
+coupons. During the recursion node n hasn't entered or is unmasked for its scalar level. -/
+lemma direct_point {s : Scene M} {L : Path M} {x u : Grid M} (h : Trip x s L)
+    (j : ℕ) (c : Bool) (a : Grade → ℕ) (hh : shades a u L j)
+    (n : ℕ) (l r : Path M) (b : Beat M)
+    (hR : c=true → stall u (tagM (mainIx j)) j L l)
+    (hc : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ico (lowI j c) n, stall u (tagL i) j L l)
+    (_hn : n ∈ Set.Icc (lowI j c) (highI j M c)) (hl : L=l++r)
+    (hm : b∈l) (hb : n < highI j M c → 4*side n < ampU b.post u) :

+  let v := token a L j c b
+  let p := ampU q u

+  have H := token_floor a j c L b
+  change _ ≤ v ∧ _ ≤ v ∧ _ ≤ v ∧ (c=true→_ ≤ v) at H

+  change p=_ at hz

+  apply hP.trans

+      by_contra he

+      unfold B at hi; rw [HE,show side 0=1 by simp [side]] at hi; linarith
+    have hI : mainIx j=t := by unfold t lowI; rw [ite_eq_left he]
+    apply le_trans _ (H.2.2.2 he)
+    by_cases ha : hazard q true t
+    · have HF : special j b=1 :=
+        ite_eq_left ⟨(show 0 < mainIx j + 1 by omega),by
+          change hazard q true (mainIx j+1-1); rw [hI]; exact ha⟩
+      rw [HF]
+      linarith [stripe_pos a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b]
+    · have HV : snag (tagM (mainIx j)) u b := by
+        rw [hI]; refine ⟨⟨z,?_⟩,ha⟩
+        change B^2 ≤ energy (q.smaller z) u
+        have hi' := scalar_energy (q.smaller z) (ht.1.climb.child z) u
+        change p=‖scalar (q.smaller z) u‖ at hz
+        rw [←hz] at hi'

+      have HW := hh _ l r hl (hR he) b hm HV
+      rw [show stripe a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b=1 from ite_eq_left HW]
+      have hx : 0 ≤ special j b := flag_nonneg _ _
+      linarith
+  have hk : p ≤ 4*B := le_of_not_gt hi
+  by_cases h : p < side K
+  · apply le_trans _ H.1
+    exact h.le.trans (side_ant M K (by unfold K; omega))
+  have hq : side K ≤ p := le_of_not_gt h
+  let goodN (i : ℕ) := t ≤ i ∧ side i ≤ p
+  have HX : goodN K := ⟨by unfold K; omega,hq⟩
+  have HF : ∃ i,goodN i := ⟨K,HX⟩
+  let i := Nat.find HF
+  have hE : goodN i := Nat.find_spec HF
+  have hV : i ≤ K := Nat.find_min' HF HX
+  have hS : i∈s := Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hE.1,Nat.lt_succ_of_le hV⟩
+  have HI : p ≤ 4*side i := by
+    by_cases HC : t=i
+    · unfold B at hk; rwa [← HC]
+    have HH := Nat.find_min HF (m:=i-1) (by have hi : t < i := lt_of_le_of_ne hE.1 HC; change i-1 < i; omega)
+    have hx' : p < side (i-1) := lt_of_not_ge fun H =>
+      HH ⟨Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne hE.1 HC), H⟩
+    have H := side_succ (i-1)
+    have HV : 0 < i := by have hi := hE.1; omega
+    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel HV] at H
+    nlinarith [side_pos i]
+  have hj : i < n := by
+    by_cases hz : n < highI j M c
+    · by_contra! he
+      exact not_lt_of_ge (HI.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (side_ant n i he) (by norm_num)))
+        (hb hz)
+    exact (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hS).2.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hz)
+  apply HI.trans
+  by_cases hv : hazard q false i
+  · apply le_trans _ H.2.1
+    linarith [pricey b.post j c i (show picks q i j c from ⟨hS,hv⟩)]
+  · let g := tagL i
+    have hb : stall u g j L l := hc _ (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hE.1,hj⟩)
+    have hi : betweenS (a g) (billWait g j L) b :=
+      hh g l r hl hb b hm ⟨⟨z,(show side i ≤ ‖scalar _ _‖ from le_trans hE.2 hz.le)⟩,hv⟩
+    have hx' : stripe a g j L b=1 := ite_eq_left hi
+    apply le_trans _ H.2.2.1
+    calc
+      _ = 4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b := by rw [hx']; ring
+      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun i => 4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b) (fun k _ =>
+        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (side_pos _).le) (stripe_pos _ _ _ _ _)) hS
+
+def tokenCost (j : ℕ) (s : Bool) (L : Path M) :=
+    1 + 512*subtotal (fun b => mutedR b.post j s) L+
+      (∑ i∈playsL j M s,4*side i*(billWait (tagL i) j L:ℝ))+
+        (if s then 4*(subtotal (special j) L+(billWait (tagM (mainIx j)) j L:ℝ)) else 0)
+
+lemma cross_subtotal (l : Path M) (s : Finset ℕ) (f : Beat M → ℕ → ℝ) :
+    subtotal (fun b => ∑ i∈s,f b i) l=∑ i∈s,subtotal (fun b => f b i) l := by
+  induction l with
+  | nil => simp only [subtotal_nil,Finset.sum_const_zero]
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    rw [subtotal_cons,ih]; simp_rw [subtotal_cons,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+
+lemma max_tokens {x : Grid M} (L : Path M) (h : Trip x s L)
+    (a : Grade→ℕ) (j : ℕ) (p : Bool)
+    (hh : L.length ≤ M) :
+    subtotal (token a L j p) L ≤ tokenCost j p L := by
+  let C i := 4*side i
+  have h1 : subtotal (fun _ => side M) L ≤ 1 := by
+    rw [subt_constant]
+    have H : (L.length:ℝ) ≤ 2^M := by exact_mod_cast (hh.trans Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le)
+    apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (side_pos _).le)
+    rw [side_card]
+  have h2 (T : Finset ℕ) :
+      subtotal (fun b => ∑ i∈T,4*side i *stripe a (tagL i) j L b) L ≤
+        ∑ i∈T,4*side i*(billWait (tagL i) j L:ℝ) := by
+    rw [cross_subtotal _ _ (fun b i => _)]
+    apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
+    rw [subtR]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (stripe_bill _ _ _ _ x h)
+      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (side_pos _).le)
+  have HE (b : Bool) :
+      subtotal (fun B : Beat M => 512*mutedR B.post j b) L=512*subtotal (fun B => mutedR B.post j b) L :=
+    subtR _ _ _
+  unfold token tokenCost
+  have h3 := stripe_bill a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L x h
+  cases p <;>
+   simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,add_zero]
+  · rw [blend _ (f:=fun _ => _) (g:=fun _ => _),blend _ (f:=fun _=>_) (g:=fun _=>_),HE]
+    linarith [h2 (playsL j M false)]
+  · simp_rw [blend _ (f:=fun b => _) (g:=fun b => _)]
+    rw [HE,subtR _ _ 4,blend _ (f:=special j)]
+    linarith [h2 (playsL j M true)]
+
+end Troupe
